title: Head of Brand, Client and Communications - Asia-Pacific (Maternity Cover)
description:
About the role
  
  
Lead the Marketing and PR strategy for the McLaren brand across Asia-Pacific. Reporting to the Regional Director, you will oversee Retail Marketing, Client Experience, Experiential Marketing, Brand training, CRM/Customer insights and PR, while supporting retailer marketing teams and protecting the brand image across the region.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
Define and execute a regional brand strategy aligned with McLaren’s global vision, ensuring adherence to Global Brand standards at all touchpoints.
  
  
Amplify global marketing and PR campaigns regionally and manage the marketing and PR budget.
  
  
Drive experiential marketing, regional partnerships, loyalty programmes and key events (e.g. Goodwood FoS).
  
  
Own CRM processes, customer journey initiatives and Global Client Experience standards across APAC.
  
  
Develop digital, product launch, bespoke personalization and Financial Services communication strategies with global and retailer teams.
  
  
Steer and measure retailer marketing plans, and work closely with regional sales to deliver funnel and commercial targets.
  
  
Lead the regional PR strategy with Global Communications, and support leadership with ad hoc reporting.
  
  
What you bring
  
  
Marketing degree or equivalent experience; 15+years of OEM sales/commercial experience.
  
  
Proven senior marketing or PR leadership, preferably in automotive or luxury retail.
  
  
Strong experiential and retail marketing, CRM and customer insight expertise.
  
  
Commercial acumen, negotiation skills and the ability to influence across a global organization.
  
  
Ability to manage multiple projects with intercultural, remote teams.
  
  
Fluent English (a second language is an advantage); knowledge of McLaren’s heritage is a plus.
  
  
Personal attributes
  
  
Credible brand ambassador with a passion for luxury vehicles and the automotive industry.
  
  
Confident communicator, team player and motivator, with strong planning and attention to detail.
  
  
Driven, adaptable and comfortable with travel and representing McLaren at regional events.

title: DIRECTOR
company: ONG BROTHERS SCAFFOLDING & ENGINEERING PTE LTD
description:
Role Overview
  
  
Working closely with executives, product/sales teams, and creative leads, this role turns business and product goals into clear stories and measurable campaigns. It balances high-level planning with hands-on oversight of messaging quality, budgets, and campaign performance.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Strategy & Positioning: Build integrated marketing communications plans, brand messaging frameworks, and tone-of-voice guidelines aligned with company growth goals.
* Campaigns & Content: Oversee product launches, events, digital/social campaigns, website messaging, and sales/customer collateral across channels.
* PR & Executive Visibility: Guide media relations, press releases, contributed articles, awards, speaking opportunities, and executive thought leadership.
* Customer Advocacy & Analytics: Partner with sales and customer teams on case studies and proof points, while tracking KPIs and ROI to refine future campaigns.
* Team & Budget Leadership: Hire, mentor, and manage internal marcom staff, agencies, and freelancers while controlling the departmental budget and timelines.

Ong Brothers Scaffolding and Engineering Pte Ltd is a Singapore based business providing the highest level of quality workmanship and customer service for both commercial and domestic clients alike.
  
  
We are a full-service company committed to providing scaffolding and engineering applications to commercial, construction, and industrial industry. Together, we bring more than a decade of professional and specialized scaffolding experience.
  
  
We’ve been providing superior scaffolding services whenever and wherever top-contracting organizations need it. Our goal with each client is to exceed expectations by working out things together through quality and safety, promising the highest level of productivity.
  
  
We go all out to provide the best service possible. Our services includes rentals, erections, services, dismantling, design and engineering as well as certified safety training to our personnel to help your project stay compliant with training and professional service regulations.
  
  
We have decades of combined experience in scaffolding and engineering industry from our professionals. Our company has been quickly established as one of the most trusted and respected scaffolding and engineering company in the industry. We managed all the past projects well through safe, secured, and competitive scaffolding services, as we put the same amount of dedication and meticulous attention to detail in every project we handle, regardless of its cost and size.
  
  
Ong Brothers Scaffolding and Engineering Pte Ltd was established in mid-2000, and since then, the company has gained quite a firm reputation as one of the most reliable scaffolding and engineering company in Singapore. We managed to deliver the same level of professionalism, passion, quality, and customer service by acquiring only the qualified, highly skilled and experienced individuals to deliver the work meticulously. All members of our team is committed to always provide accurate, complete, and timely results.

title: CEO
description:
Company Overview
  
  
Since its founding in 1919, the Kewpie Group has upheld honesty and integrity in producing quality food products, emphasizing good ingredients and a commitment to excellence.
  
  
Established in 2020,
  
  
Kewpie Singapore Pte. Ltd.
  
  
drives the sales, marketing, and market expansion of Kewpie’s iconic portfolio—including our signature Japanese-style mayonnaise, dressings, spreads, and jams—across Singapore’s retail and foodservice sectors.
  
  
As a key subsidiary within the Asia-Pacific region, we combine over a century of Japanese culinary craftsmanship with local market agility to deliver quality, innovation, and
  
  
"love around the kitchen table."
  
  
Job Summary
  
  
Kewpie Singapore Pte. Ltd. is seeking an experienced and strategic Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the company as country head while encompassing core operational leadership across the organization. Reporting to the Board of Directors and Regional Leadership, the CEO is accountable for overall business direction, sustainable growth, financial discipline, and governance compliance, while aligning local operations with corporate philosophy, Asia-Pacific (AP) regional collaboration, and group standards.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Develop and implement business strategies and management plans aligned with corporate vision, mission, and group values to drive company growth and sustainability.
  
  
Oversee company-wide operations, organizational structure, and cross-functional execution across commercial, operational, and corporate functions to ensure effective performance.
  
  
Lead talent acquisition, workforce planning, HR and labor management, and performance evaluation to build organizational capabilities and maintain a high-performing workforce.
  
  
Establish and monitor performance targets and KPIs to increase revenue, profitability, and operational efficiency.
  
  
Manage financial reporting, budgeting, cash flow, and cost control in compliance with laws, internal controls, and group governance standards to ensure financial discipline.
  
  
Cultivate and maintain sustainable relationships with key customers, suppliers, and business partners to support business development and collaboration.
  
  
Identify, evaluate, and propose new business initiatives and strategic investments to expand the company’s presence in Singapore and the Asia-Pacific region.
  
  
Prepare reports, obtain approvals, and ensure governance alignment with the Board of Directors and Regional Leadership according to authority matrices.
  
  
Required competencies and certifications
  
  
Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or higher
  
  
Minimum 10 years of executive or senior leadership experience, preferably in FMCG or food manufacturing
  
  
Proven experience managing P&L, multi-functional teams, or cross-market/regional initiatives within a structured corporate or matrix environment
  
  
Strong business communication and stakeholder management skills to lead local operations and collaborate with regional and group leadership
  
  
Other Information
  
  
Benefits
  
  
**Annual Leave:** Pro-rated 14 days in the first year, increasing by 1 day per year up to 21 days maximum
  
  
**Medical & Dental Benefits:** Medical reimbursement up to S$550/year and dental reimbursement up to S$150/year
  
  
**Allowances:** Monthly Car Allowance of S$500 (or Transportation Allowance if non-car owner) and Mobile Data Allowance of S$50
  
  
**Insurance:** Surgical Insurance (AIA)
  
  
**Leave Entitlements:** Sick Leave (14 days), Hospitalization Leave (60 days), Compassionate Leave, Marriage Leave (3 days), Maternity Leave (16 weeks), Child Care Leave (6 days)
  
  
**Salary Range:** S$10,700 to S$20,000 depending on experience
  
  
We thank all applicants for their interest in joining Kewpie Singapore Pte. Ltd. Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further discussion.
  
  
By submitting your application, you consent to Kewpie Singapore Pte. Ltd. collecting, using, and disclosing your personal data for recruitment and evaluation purposes in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).
  
  
Since the Kewpie Group’s founding in 1919, we have maintained an unwavering insistence that good products begin with good ingredients, while earnestly upholding an attitude of honesty and integrity as a Company that handles food items. We have always made efforts to create products with these ideals in mind.

title: Managing Director, APAC & Chief Revenue Officer
description:
Company Overview
  
  
Agile HRO is a global employment, payroll and workforce solutions company supporting businesses to hire,
  
  
employ and pay talent across international markets. Our core services include Employer of Record (EOR),
  
  
managed payroll, global mobility and HR advisory.
  
  
Job Summary
  
  
Lead Agile HRO’s growth across Asia Pacific as Managing Director, APAC & Chief Revenue Officer, owning global commercial and revenue strategy to drive profitable revenue, strategic account expansion, and EBITDA growth.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Lead Agile HRO’s commercial strategy and revenue growth across APAC to achieve business plan targets
  
  
Develop and execute growth strategies across priority markets, sectors, and client segments in the region
  
  
Build and manage strategic client relationships to expand enterprise partnerships and account opportunities
  
  
Identify and pursue new market, partnership, and account-expansion opportunities to increase revenue
  
  
Collaborate with Operations, Finance, and Customer Success teams to ensure profitable and deliverable regional growth
  
  
Own Agile HRO’s global commercial and revenue strategy, ensuring alignment across regions
  
  
Build and implement a disciplined, repeatable enterprise sales process to improve pipeline management and forecasting accuracy
  
  
Lead strategic enterprise sales, partnerships, and account expansion initiatives to drive commercial outcomes
  
  
Strengthen pricing discipline to protect gross margin while achieving revenue growth
  
  
Develop and lead the commercial team by setting clear targets and performance standards
  
  
Partner with Marketing to enhance demand generation, sales enablement, and market positioning
  
  
Collaborate with the CEO on company strategy, annual planning, budgeting, and international expansion decisions
  
  
Build leadership and commercial operating models to support Agile HRO’s next growth stage
  
  
Support initiatives that increase enterprise value and reduce founder dependency in revenue execution
  
  
Proactively bring solutions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership of commercial outcomes
  
  
Preferred competencies and qualifications
  
  
Senior commercial leadership experience within EOR, payroll, HR services, workforce solutions, or related B2B services
  
  
Proven track record of enterprise sales, strategic account growth, and commercial leadership
  
  
Deep experience operating across APAC markets
  
  
Strong understanding of pricing, gross margin, commercial P&L, and EBITDA
  
  
Experience building and leading high-performing sales teams
  
  
Credibility with senior enterprise stakeholders and strategic partners
  
  
Commercial ambition, financial discipline, and comfort with high accountability
  
  
Ability to work effectively in a founder-led business transitioning to an institutional and scalable operating model
  
  
Agile Talent merge technology with leading industry experts, building a strong global capability in talent acquisition. Aligning strategies and business plans to help win the talent war.
  
  
We are a Singapore start up with the ability to globally recruit, employ, hire and onboard your employees remotely and compliantly in 52 separate countries worldwide. Our global reach and extensive partner network enables us to deliver bespoke talent solutions to the technology, fintech, telco and financial services sectors.
  
  
We realise the challenges in identifying and securing top talent in the competitive and travel restricted environment you are faced with today . That’s why we will not only recruit your current needs, but will work consultatively with you to build a strong talent acquisition strategy and pipeline, continually focussing on your present and future talent plans.
  
  
Our team are well known recruitment industry leaders with proven track records in successful permanent & contract recruitment and in providing outsourcing solutions.

title: BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT DIRECTOR
description:
UNIVERSAL TECHMAX PTE. LTD. is a Singapore-based technology and services company specialising in system implementation, integration and technical support for technology solutions across the Southeast Asian market. The company provides technology solutions involving satellite networks and satellite data, high-performance database systems and user-friendly applications, as well as specialised products and systems including marine navigation lighting, thermal imaging technology and remote monitoring and control systems.
  
  
The company focuses on delivering innovative technology solutions, developing strategic partnerships and providing technical products and services to customers across regional and international markets.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The Business Development Director is responsible for leading the company's business development strategy, commercial growth and market expansion across Singapore, Southeast Asia and international markets. The role involves identifying and developing strategic business opportunities, establishing high-level relationships with clients, government agencies, industry stakeholders and international partners, and driving the commercialisation and market adoption of the company's technology products and solutions.
  
  
The position requires an exceptionally senior business development professional with extensive director-level leadership experience, strong commercial acumen, established industry networks and a proven track record in developing strategic partnerships, securing major business opportunities and driving sustained revenue growth in technology-related industries.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Lead and formulate the company's overall business development and commercial expansion strategies to drive revenue growth and strengthen the company's market position across regional and international markets.
  
  
Identify, evaluate and pursue strategic business opportunities in technology solutions, systems integration, satellite-based technology, thermal imaging, remote monitoring systems and other relevant technology sectors.
  
  
Develop and maintain strategic relationships with major corporate clients, government agencies, industry stakeholders, distributors, technology partners and international business partners.
  
  
Lead negotiations for major commercial agreements, strategic partnerships, distribution arrangements, project contracts and business collaborations.
  
  
Develop new markets and expand the company's customer base across Southeast Asia and other international markets through strategic market entry initiatives and commercial partnerships.
  
  
Drive the development and execution of business development plans, sales strategies, market positioning and revenue growth initiatives.
  
  
Identify emerging market trends, customer requirements, industry developments and new business opportunities to support the company's long-term commercial strategy.
  
  
Work closely with technical, engineering, operations and management teams to develop commercially viable technology solutions that meet customer requirements and market demands.
  
  
Oversee the preparation of commercial proposals, business plans, strategic presentations, tenders and contract negotiations for major business opportunities.
  
  
Establish and strengthen relationships with key decision-makers and senior executives to facilitate strategic business opportunities and long-term commercial partnerships.
  
  
Lead, mentor and oversee business development teams and senior commercial personnel to achieve business development objectives and performance targets.
  
  
Monitor business development performance, sales pipeline, commercial outcomes and market expansion initiatives, and provide strategic recommendations to management.
  
  
Represent the company at senior-level business meetings, industry conferences, international exhibitions, negotiations and strategic partnership discussions.
  
  
Explore joint ventures, strategic alliances, technology partnerships and other business expansion opportunities to support the company's long-term growth and competitiveness.
  
  
Job Requirements
  
  
Diploma or higher qualification in Business Administration, Business Management, Marketing, International Business, Economics or a related discipline, or equivalent qualification and experience.
  
  
At least 15 years of experience in senior business development, commercial management or strategic leadership roles at Director level or above.
  
  
Demonstrated track record of leading business development strategies, securing major commercial contracts, establishing strategic partnerships and driving significant business growth.
  
  
Extensive experience in business development, market expansion and commercial negotiations within technology, engineering, telecommunications, systems integration,satellite technology, industrial technology or related industries.
  
  
Proven ability to develop and manage high-level relationships with corporate clients, government agencies, international partners and senior industry stakeholders.
  
  
Strong understanding of international business development, market-entry strategies, strategic partnerships and cross-border commercial operations.
  
  
Demonstrated experience leading senior business development teams, managing commercial initiatives and achieving strategic business objectives.
  
  
Strong commercial, financial and strategic planning capabilities, including experience evaluating business opportunities, commercial proposals and partnership arrangements.
  
  
Excellent leadership, negotiation, stakeholder management and strategic communication skills.
  
  
Ability to engage confidently with senior executives, government representatives, international business partners and major corporate clients.
  
  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present and negotiate complex commercial proposals and business strategies.
  
  
Extensive regional or international business development experience will be highly advantageous.

title: Executive Director, Risk
description:

It is a jointventure between Standard Chartered Bank and Linklogis, a leading technologycompany in China. It combines Standard Chartered’s expertise in trade, riskmanagement and investor network with the technologicalproficiency of Linklogis. Headquartered in Singapore, Olea’s ambition is tobecome a leading global platform in empowering sustainable trade. Visit www.olea.net tofind out more.
  
  
**Role summary:**  
We are looking for an individual withexceptional logical thinking and emotional intelligence to join our Risk team. The primary job scope covers the whole range of risk in Olea: client andtransactional risk (including problem account management), financial crimecompliance, non-financial risk management (including operational risk) and riskgovernance.

o Identifyand manage credit, performance and fraud risk in the supply chain portfolio,communicating these risks effectively and transparently and challenging the deals proposed by theorigination teams, structuring deals to be within risk appetite and approvingthese, and where necessary filtering out deals outside of risk appetite.
  
  
o Assumeprimary responsibility for (i) problem account management and recovery; and (ii)financial crime compliance (including customer due diligence).
  
  
o Continuouslyanalyze portfolio performance and recommend strategies with both revenue andrisk in consideration, serving as a collaborative sounding board and trustedpartner to the business.
  
  
o Formulate,implement and review prudent risk management policies within the EnterpriseRisk Management Framework, so as to ensure effective governance of risks acrossthe organisation, most noticeablyoperations risks
  
  
o Representthe Risk function in client and other externally-facing engagements asrequired.
  
  
o Establish himself as a visible andsupportive leader within Risk, Legal and Compliance unit, and across Olea as awhole
  
  
o Takepersonal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics,including regulatory and business conduct, across the organisation, includingunderstanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, allapplicable laws, regulations, guidelines and policies.
  
  
**Role specific technical competencies:**  
o Ideally 20+years’ experience covering a significant proportion of the following:
  
  
o Creditrisk experience including decision-making / individual credit authority;
  
  
o Supplychain finance and/or commodity finance experience in more than one geography;
  
  
o Hands-onproblem account management experience with demonstrable results;
  
  
o EnterpriseRisk Management Frameworks and related governance.
  
  
o Operationalrisk (or related exposure e.g. audit).
  
  
o Financialcrime risk (or related exposure e.g. fraud risk).
  
  
Junior hires with less experience may be consideredin more junior roles.
  
  
o Exceptionaldrive and achievement orientation, intellectual agility and clarity of thought.
  
  
o Highcomfort level with the uncertainty of an expanding start-up, with constantself-education, ability to develop structure from scratch, creativeproblem-solving skills and resilience for the roller-coaster ride.
  
  
o Strongemotional intelligence and ability to build effective relationships withstakeholders.
  
  
o Teamleadership experience.
  
  
Qualifications (training, licences,memberships, and certifications):
  
  

* Degree in any discipline from a top university.
* Chartered Financial Analyst or GARP Financial Risk Managercertifications would be advantageous.

**Note:**  
Olea is committed to diversity and inclusion.By providing equalopportunities we foster a work environment which embraces diversityand gets the best out of the broadest spectrum of people to sustain businessperformance and competitive advantage. We build an inclusive culture bydemonstrating respect for each other’s unique strengths and perspectives toenable every employee to develop a sense of belonging and maximise theirpotential.

to find out more.

title: Associate Director, Head of Digital Operations
company: WPP MEDIA ASIA PACIFIC HOLDINGS PTE. LTD.
description:
Role Summary and Impact
  
  
We’re looking for a strategic, commercially minded Associate Director, Head of Digital Operations to lead digital performance marketing and operational excellence for luxury retail and ecommerce brands across APAC, with a focus on Southeast Asia.
  
  
You will drive customer acquisition and ecommerce growth, oversee campaign delivery and data governance, and lead a high-performing team of marketers and analysts. Working closely with clients and local markets, you will turn insights into action while maintaining brand standards and consistent execution.
  
  
Skills and Experience
  
  
**What you will do:**  
**Digital Strategy & Growth:**  
Lead the overarching digital performance marketing strategy across a portfolio of luxury retail and ecommerce brands. Develop audience, channel, and investment strategies that support customer acquisition, conversion, and sustainable growth.
  
  
**Media Strategy & Planning:**  
Translate regional business objectives and brand priorities into actionable digital media plans. Guide budget allocation, channel selection, and full-funnel planning, balancing brand equity with performance outcomes across APAC markets.
  
  
**Digital Operations & Campaign Delivery:**  
Oversee end-to-end digital campaign operations, from briefing and setup through activation, optimization, and reporting. Establish clear workflows, quality assurance standards, and escalation processes to ensure consistent, timely, and accurate delivery.
  
  
**Performance Management & Optimization:**  
Define campaign KPIs and measurement frameworks aligned with client objectives. Lead performance reviews and ensure teams take timely, evidence-based action to improve acquisition efficiency, conversion, and return on media investment.
  
  
**Data Governance & Measurement:**  
Lead operational data governance across campaign tracking, naming conventions, taxonomy, dashboards, and reporting. Work with analytics, technology, and privacystake holders to maintain data integrity, appropriate access controls, and compliance with applicable requirements and client policies.
  
  
**Analytics & Actionable Insights:**  
Turn campaign, audience, and ecommerce data into clear recommendations for clients and internal teams. Strengthen reporting practices to explain what is driving performance and where the next growth opportunities lie.
  
  
**Client & Stakeholder Management:**  
Build trusted relationships with regional and local client stakeholders, acting as a senior partner on digital performance and operations. Communicate strategic recommendations, performance outcomes, and operational priorities with clarity and confidence.
  
  
**Regional & Market Coordination:**  
Partner with local market teams across Southeast Asia and the wider APAC region to align execution with regional strategy. Establish effective ways of working that maintain consistent standards while accommodating market-specific consumer behavior and platform dynamics.
  
  
**Team Leadership & Development:**  
Lead, mentor, and develop performance marketers and analysts. Build capability in campaign optimization, analytical thinking, emerging platforms, and client communication, while ensuring clear accountability and effective resource allocation.
  
  
**Innovation & Operational Excellence:**  
Develop a structured test-and-learn agenda across audiences, platforms, automation, and measurement. Identify opportunities to improve productivity and campaign effectiveness without compromising brand standards or data quality.
  
  
**Commercial & Account Operations:**  
Oversee media budget tracking, pacing, forecasting, and reconciliation in partnership with account and finance teams. Maintain visibility of delivery commitments, resource requirements, and operational risks.
  
  
**Measures of Success:**  
**In 3 Months:**  
Establish strong relationships with key client contacts, local market teams, internal specialists, and media partners.
  
  
Develop a comprehensive understanding of the brand portfolio, business objectives, ecommerce priorities, and historical campaign performance.
  
  
Assess existing campaign workflows, measurement practices, and data governance processes, identifying priority improvements.
  
  
Establish clear ownership of campaign KPIs, reporting, quality assurance, and escalation processes.
  
  
Understand team capabilities and capacity, and put initial development priorities in place.
  
  
**In 6 Months:**  
Take ownership of regional digital operations and performance governance, leading regular client and market reviews.
  
  
Implement consistent campaign delivery, tracking, and reporting standards across priority brands and markets.
  
  
Demonstrate progress against agreed performance objectives through proactive optimization and actionable insights.
  
  
Launch a prioritized test-and-learn roadmap covering audience strategies, channel opportunities, and operational improvements.
  
  
Strengthen team capability through coaching, clearer responsibilities, and knowledge sharing.
  
  
**In 12 Months:**  
Deliver strong client servicing and strategic partnership, evidenced by positive stakeholder feedback.
  
  
Demonstrate measurable progress against agreed customer acquisition, ecommerce growth, and media efficiency objectives.
  
  
Embed scalable operating practices that improve delivery consistency, data integrity, and regional collaboration.
  
  
Translate successful tests into repeatable strategies and share learnings across brands and markets.
  
  
Build a high-performing team with clear development pathways and greater ownership of performance outcomes.
  
  
**What you will need:**  
At least 8 years of relevant experience in digital media, performance marketing, or digital operations, including team leadership responsibilities.
  
  
Proven experience leading multi-market digital programs across Southeast Asia or the wider APAC region.
  
  
Strong expertise in digital media strategy, planning, activation, and optimization across platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok, and programmatic.
  
  
A track record of driving customer acquisition and ecommerce performance; experience with luxury, premium retail, or consumer brands is advantageous.
  
  
Strong understanding of analytics, attribution, campaign tracking, and reporting, including the ability to interpret data critically and turn findings into action.
  
  
Experience establishing operational standards, quality assurance processes, and data governance practices.
  
  
Working knowledge of privacy requirements and responsible data handling, with the ability to collaborate effectively with specialist teams.
  
  
Excellent client relationship and stakeholder management skills, including the confidence to challenge constructively and influence senior stakeholders.
  
  
Strong commercial, organizational, and numerical skills, with experience managing budgets and operational priorities.
  
  
Proven ability to mentor performance marketers and analysts and foster accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  
  
A proactive mindset, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple brands, markets, and projects.
  
  
A passion for the evolving media landscape and a practical approach to evaluating emerging platforms and technologies.
  
  
Life at WPP Media & Benefits
  
  
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
  
  
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
  
  
Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)for more information on how we process the information you provide.
  
  
While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
  
  
GROUPM ASIA PACIFIC HOLDINGS PTE. LTD.

title: Director, Chief Administration Officer, APAC
description:
**Requisition ID:** 280107
  
**Employee Referral Program – Potential Reward:** $2,500.00
  
  
We are committed to investing in our employees and helping you continue your career at Scotiabank.

  

**Purpose**
  
The Chief Administration Officer (CAO) provides strategic leadership and oversight of the organization’s corporate-support and administrative functions in APAC. This contributes to ensuring business strategies, plans and initiatives for the Global Banking & Markets franchise in APAC are executed / delivered in compliance with governing regulations, internal policies and procedures.

CAO has responsibility for oversight of the following support functions : Global Wholesale Operations (GWO) , GBME (Technology), Finance, Business Management and Facilities/ Business Continuity management.

  

**Accountabilities**

* Leads and drives a customer focused culture to deepen client relationships and leverage broader Bank relationships, systems and knowledge.

* Understand how the Bank's risk appetite and risk culture should be considered in day-to-day activities and decisions.

* Creates an environment in which their team pursues effective and efficient operations of their respective areas in accordance with Scotiabank’s Values, its Code of Conduct and the Global Sales Principles, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day-to-day business controls to meet obligations with respect to operational, compliance, AML/ATF/sanctions and conduct risk.

* Builds a high-performance environment and implements a people strategy that attracts, retains, develops and motivates their team by fostering an inclusive work environment and using a coaching mindset and behaviours; communicating vision/values/business strategy; and managing succession and development planning for the team.

* Understand the Bank's risk appetite and risk culture and ensure these are fully communicated to and understood by the staff of the Singapore branch and incorporated and considered in day-to-day activities. At all times, the Branch is to be kept within the risk tolerance levels governed by the GBM Risk Appetite Framework (RAF) and Bank Risk Management Framework (RMF) as well as being guided by the, RAF, RMF and Risk Appetite Statement.

  

**APAC Strategic Planning & Advisory**

* Work closely with the Co-Heads of APAC to define the direction and the development of the APAC strategy. This includes partnering with multiple stakeholders to ensure timely and effective implementation of projects.

title: Director Medical Affairs, APAC
description:
Category: Medical Affairs

Location:
Singapore, Singapore, SG

**Your impact begins here**

  

As **Director Medical Affairs**, you will set the medical direction for diabetes, obesity care and Specialty care across APAC affiliates. You will make sure scientific evidence reaches healthcare professionals, experts and colleagues clearly and credibly, and that the voices of people living with these conditions shape our medical work. Your leadership will strengthen launch readiness, medical excellence and scientific credibility, helping more people across the region access the treatment and support they need.

  

**What you’ll bring**

You combine deep cardiometabolic expertise with the leadership to turn science into action across many markets.

* An advanced degree in Medicine (MD) or a PhD in a relevant scientific field.
* At least 10 years of experience in Medical Affairs or related roles within the pharmaceutical industry.
* A proven track record in cardiometabolic disease areas (diabetes and obesity) and in strategic leadership.
* Strong strategic vision, with the ability to develop and implement medical and scientific communication strategies aligned with broader Medical Affairs priorities.
* A strong patient-centric mindset, ensuring patient insights inform medical strategies, advisory boards and other strategic initiatives.
* Experience developing scientific communication and publication strategies, including real-world evidence (RWE) publications.
* The ability to lead and inspire a multidisciplinary team and to provide expert input into clinical trials and RWE plans.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to evaluate clinical data and RWE and translate scientific insights into strategic decisions.
* Established skills in building relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), healthcare professionals and international professional associations.
* The ability to explain complex science clearly and persuasively to diverse audiences, and to work with cultural sensitivity in a global context.
* Adaptability and strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate complex challenges and evolving scientific and market needs across APAC.
  

**What you’ll do**

You will be the medical voice for cardiometabolic care in APAC, working with affiliates, external experts and leadership to move from scientific insight to action.

* Provide enterprise leadership for Medical Affairs across the APAC Regional Office and affiliates, contribute actively to the regional Medical, Marketing & Regulatory leadership team and the broader Regional Office, represent APAC in International Operations Medical Affairs forums, and translate guidance into effective affiliate execution.
* Guide and align affiliate medical teams on resourcing, pre-launch and launch priorities, so KPIs are met across cardiometabolic and specialty therapy areas.
* Partner with Customer Excellence to elevate medical execution standards across affiliates and drive continuous improvement in medical excellence.
* Define and deliver publication plans and scientific communication across clinical trial phases, including RWE, and organise scientific meetings and symposia that educate healthcare professionals.
* Build trusted relationships with KOLs and international professional associations, run advisory boards, and work with marketing to develop DOL capability in the affiliates.
* Establish ways of working with Medical Affairs teams of eHealth providers to gather insights and strengthen scientific credibility, while partnering with Marketing to build relevant capability within affiliates and facilitate advisory boards.
* Bring the patient voice into clinical trial design, communication and advisory boards through engagement with patient advocacy groups; train internal teams on medical topics and insights; and ensure medical insights and updates are communicated consistently across the organisation.
  

**Who you’ll work with**

You will join Medical Affairs within Medical, Marketing & Regulatory in the APAC Regional Office, part of International Operations. You will report to the Assoc. VP, Medical, Marketing & Regulatory, and lead a team of five direct reports.

Your closest partners will be affiliate medical teams across APAC, Customer Excellence and marketing colleagues. Externally, you will work with KOLs, DOLs, international professional associations, patient advocacy groups and the medical affairs teams of eHealth providers. You will also carry APAC’s perspective into International Operations Medical Affairs forums and make sure guidance is translated into action in the region.

This is a role for someone who creates clarity, challenges constructively and brings different perspectives together, while leading innovation across scientific communication, publication strategy, medical education and patient engagement, and building strategic partnerships that advance medical excellence across APAC.

  

**What you can expect here**

You will work in an international environment where your expertise is valued and your voice carries weight in regional and global decisions. You will be trusted to take ownership, supported to perform at your best, and encouraged to try new approaches in scientific communication, publication strategy and patient engagement. You will grow through collaboration across markets and functions, and through working with leaders at the forefront of cardiometabolic care.

  

**Start now**

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to lead medical affairs across Asia-Pacific and turn scientific insight into progress for people living with serious chronic diseases, apply for the Director Medical Affairs, APAC role **9 December, 2026**

  

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

title: Customer Success Director
description:
The Job in short  
  
  
  
  
As a Customer Success Director at Backbase, you will be at the forefront of driving customer satisfaction and success across APAC. You will be responsible for ensuring that our customers derive maximum value from Backbase's Engagement Banking Platform. This role involves frequent travel across the region and requires a strong ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders at all levels, from C-suite decision-makers to programme leaders.  
  
  
  
  
Your mission is to foster product adoption and license consumption, enhance customer satisfaction, and contribute to Net ARR Growth by ensuring that our customers successfully leverage Backbase's solutions to achieve their business goals.  
  
  
  
  
Meet the Job
  
  

* Customer Relationship Management:

  
Develop and nurture strong, long-lasting relationships with key customers across your region.
  
  
Regularly engage with senior stakeholders to understand their evolving needs and expectations throughout the software development lifecycle, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor and valuable resource.
  
  
Facilitate complex discussions that involve multiple stakeholders, helping to align their goals with Backbase's solutions and unblocking any adoption and license consumption challenges.
  
  

* Value Maximization:

  
Collaborate with customers to identify opportunities to maximize the value they derive from Backbase products.
  
  
Work with Backbase Customer Advisory to localize business cases. Provide strategic guidance and best practices to ensure business cases align to the region and bank specific goals, ensuring customers are fully utilizing the range of product capabilities available to them.
  
  
Proactively identify and address potential challenges, working towards solutions that align with the customer's business objectives.
  
  
Develop joint success plans with senior stakeholders, with clear objectives that are aligned with their strategic goals.
  
  
Actively work with the customer on roadmap planning to track and ensure the realization of the business case throughout the programme lifecycle.
  
  

* Advocacy Building:

  
Identify and cultivate customer advocates who are willing to share their success stories and experiences with Backbase solutions.
  
  
Collaborate with marketing teams to create case studies, testimonials, and other materials that showcase customer success.
  
  

* Feedback Collection and Product Improvement:

  
Gather and analyze product utilization, and end user feedback on product experiences, providing actionable insights to R&D and steward the Request for Feature (RFF) process as a joint responsibility with the Services team.
  
  
Act as a bridge between customers and Backbase's product development organization. Work with the Backbase UX Research team, ensuring that customer needs and suggestions are considered in future product enhancements.
  
  

* Account Management:

  
Proactively manage renewals by aligning customer success plans and business cases with value realization, ensuring continued customer satisfaction and retention.
  
  
In collaboration with Sales, identify opportunities for account growth by understanding the banks' business dynamics and leveraging them to expand ARR.  
  
  
  
  
How about you
  
  

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Technology, Business, or a related field.

  

* Experience: 10+ years of experience in a customer-facing role, including consulting, customer support, delivery or account management, with a focus on customer success in the technology or software industry.

  

* Technical Acumen: Previous experience in roles requiring technical understanding, particularly in customer success management within a software company.

  

* Language Proficiency: Strong written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in English is also required.

  

* Customer-Centric Mindset: Passionate about delivering success for customers, with a deep commitment to understanding customer needs and delivering solutions that exceed their expectations.

  

* Results-Driven: Strong focus on customer satisfaction, with the ability to analyze data and provide actionable insights and maintain dashboards that drive product adoption and customer success.

  

* Relationship Builder: Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to challenge, negotiate, influence, and persuade stakeholders.

  

* Autonomous and Cross-Functional: Ability to work independently, take ownership of customer success initiatives, and drive results, while collaborating across teams with Sales, R&D and Services colleagues, as well as Backbase's partner network.

  

* Organizational Skills: Capable of prioritizing tasks, multitasking, and demonstrating adaptability in a dynamic environment.

  

* Commercial and Functional Acumen: Understand the unique cultural and digital trends in the customer's market and speak to business drivers, with a strong focus on maximizing value for customers. Experience in banking or other Financial Services is a plus.

  

* Frequent Traveler: Willingness to travel frequently across the region to engage with banks and ensure their success with Backbase.

  
  
  
This role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on Backbase's customer success, helping our customers achieve their strategic goals while driving growth and adoption of our engagement banking platform and other solutions.

title: International Marketing Director
company: ALIBABA SOUTHEAST ASIA HOLDING PRIVATE LIMITED
description:
**Internal Job Title :**  
Senior Product Operation Expert
  
  
Job Description
  
  
**1. Define the regional market strategy:** Own market entry and growth across Southeast Asia. Build a tiered approach for Indonesia, Vietnam, the Philippines, Thailand, Malaysia and Singapore based on developer population, willingness to pay and competitive landscape, and set clear priorities, growth targets and go-to-market playbooks for each country.
  
  
**2. Build local brand awareness and share of voice:** Grow Qoder's presence on each country's leading developer communities and social platforms, such as Viblo in Vietnam and Dicoding in Indonesia, as well as Facebook tech groups, Telegram, LinkedIn, and tech content on YouTube and TikTok, which matter across the region, to raise awareness of Qoder among local developers.
  
  
**3. Build a local KOL and community network:** Identify and nurture relationships with tech KOLs, YouTubers and community leaders in each country; partner with local tech organizations such as GDG and AWS User Groups to host meetups, workshops and hackathons; and develop a network of local Qoder Ambassadors.
  
  
**4. Expand university and talent partnerships:** Engage leading universities in the region (e.g., NUS, NTU, Universitas Indonesia, Institut Teknologi Bandung, Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology, Chulalongkorn University) and coding bootcamps; launch student programs, campus ambassador programs and curriculum partnerships to win over the next generation of developers.
  
  
**5. Break into IT services and outsourcing companies:** Target large IT services and software outsourcing firms in Vietnam, the Philippines, Malaysia and beyond, as well as tech unicorns (e.g., engineering teams at Grab, GoTo and Sea); drive adoption of Qoder's Teams and Enterprise editions and build flagship local customer case studies.
  
  
**6. Drive content and product localization:** Lead localization of the product UI, documentation, tutorials and marketing content into local languages (Bahasa Indonesia, Vietnamese, Thai, etc.). Given Southeast Asian users' price sensitivity and preference for local payment methods, drive regional pricing and integration of local payment options (GCash, DANA, OVO, MoMo, GrabPay, etc.).
  
  
**7. Leverage ecosystem resources:** Partner with Alibaba Cloud's Southeast Asia team, local cloud providers, telecom operators, IT training institutions and government digital economy programs in each country on co-marketing and channel distribution.
  
  
**8. Represent Qoder at regional conferences and events:** Plan Qoder's participation in major Southeast Asian tech events (e.g., SuperAI Singapore, Tech in Asia, Echelon and national developer conferences) to strengthen its regional influence.
  
  
**9. Bring market insights back to HQ and ensure compliance:** Gather user needs and competitive intelligence from each market, monitor local data and privacy regulations (Singapore's PDPA, Indonesia's PDP Law, Vietnam's Personal Data Protection Decree, etc.), and feed these insights into HQ's product and strategy decisions.
  
  
Job Qualification
  
  
1. Bachelor's degree or above, with 5+ years of experience in marketing, growth or business development in Southeast Asia. Background in developer tools, SaaS, cloud computing, AI, or taking internet products global is preferred.
  
  
2. Professional working proficiency in English. Proficiency in at least one local language (Bahasa Indonesia, Vietnamese or Thai) is preferred; Chinese is a plus.
  
  
3. Deep understanding of developer ecosystems, tech communities and the digital marketing landscape across Southeast Asian countries, with experience tailoring strategies to different markets. An existing network of local KOLs, communities, universities or media is highly desirable.
  
  
4. Proven track record of taking a product or market from 0 to 1 in Southeast Asia, with quantifiable results (user growth, community size, conversion, revenue, etc.).
  
  
5. Strong ability to collaborate across countries, time zones and cultures; willing to travel frequently within the region.
  
  
6. Strong interest in AI and large language models, and eager to be a hands-on, power user of AI coding tools.

Based in Singapore and reporting to the Regional Brand Director – Asia Pacific, the Retail Manager will oversee four boutiques and lead the Boutique Managers and retail teams across the region.

Own boutique sales targets, key performance indicators and action plans across all three markets.
  
  
Lead weekly performance reviews with Boutique Managers, using data to improve conversion, client development, productivity and sales effectiveness.

Proven people leadership capability, with a strong focus on coaching, performance and talent development.

title: Director of Business Development Acquisitions and Integration
description:
The opportunity
  
  
LinkEdge is a Singapore distribution business serving consumer brands across retail and trade channels. We plan to expand into Malaysia and explore company acquisitions in Singapore and Malaysia. This role will establish and develop those initiatives while leading the commercial and operational performance of our existing Singapore business.
  
  
Reporting to the CEO, you will develop new principal partnerships, evaluate market entry and acquisition opportunities, and plan the integration of approved businesses and portfolios. You will also remain accountable for Singapore revenue, margins, operating profit, working capital and service, working closely with Finance, HR and specialist advisers.
  
  
Business development acquisitions and integration
  
  
·
  
  
Develop regional business.
  
  
Develop opportunities for new principal partnerships, distribution mandates, categories and channels. Build the Malaysia market entry strategy, assess routes to market and potential partners, and recommend a phased plan to the CEO.
  
  
·
  
  
Build an acquisition pipeline.
  
  
Establish acquisition criteria and identify potential companies in Singapore and Malaysia. Assess strategic fit, commercial potential and operating capability, and prepare initial recommendations for further evaluation.
  
  
·
  
  
Evaluate opportunities.
  
  
Coordinate commercial and operational due diligence with Finance, legal and other advisers. Assess valuation assumptions, working capital, investment needs, risks and potential benefits. Support negotiations and prepare business cases for the company's investment approval process.
  
  
·
  
  
Plan and lead integration.
  
  
Create onboarding plans for new principal portfolios and integration plans for proposed acquisitions. Lead implementation after the necessary approvals and transaction completion, covering people, customers, stock, systems, supply chain and service continuity.
  
  
·
  
  
Strengthen partnerships.
  
  
Lead joint plans and business reviews with principals and key customers. Work with the CEO on strategic relationships and major negotiations, and translate approved commitments into disciplined execution.
  
  
Commercial and operational leadership
  
  
·
  
  
Own Singapore business performance.
  
  
Lead annual plans, budgets and reviews for existing and new Singapore portfolios. Manage revenue, margins, operating costs and profitability, and take timely corrective action.
  
  
·
  
  
Deliver reliable execution.
  
  
Lead commercial, trade marketing, retail operations, supply chain and IT/data teams. Improve forecasting, inventory availability, order fulfilment, warehousing and delivery performance through coordinated planning.
  
  
·
  
  
Build a scalable organisation.
  
  
Develop accountable leaders and clear decision rights. Create repeatable onboarding processes and shared capabilities so new portfolios can be added efficiently, with dedicated resources where commercially necessary.
  
  
·
  
  
Improve decisions and productivity.
  
  
Use business analytics, dashboards, process simplification and automation to improve visibility and reduce cost to serve. Partner with Finance on working capital, controls and business performance, and with HR on capability, succession and workforce planning.
  
  
·
  
  
Maintain commercial discipline.
  
  
Protect confidential information and manage competing portfolio interests. Maintain governance, safety and service standards. Keep commercial commitments within delegated authority; acquisition and investment decisions require the relevant CEO or Board approvals.
  
  
Experience and capabilities
  
  

* At least 15 years of relevant experience in FMCG, FMEG, consumer products or distribution, including at least 5 years in senior leadership with profit and loss accountability and responsibility across multiple functions.
* A record of profitable growth, developing principal or customer partnerships, and launching or integrating new portfolios. Experience evaluating acquisitions, coordinating due diligence or integrating acquired businesses is an advantage.
* Strong understanding of Singapore distribution channels and practical supply chain and retail execution experience. Knowledge of Malaysia distribution markets and market entry planning is an advantage.
* Sound commercial judgement and financial capability, including margins, trade investment, budgeting, inventory, receivables and working capital.
* Clear leadership communication, effective negotiation and the ability to develop managers, align teams and lead change in a growing business.
* A degree in business, management or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

What success looks like
  
  
Profitable Singapore performance; a credible Malaysia expansion plan; a qualified opportunity pipeline and sound investment recommendations; successful launches and integration of approved opportunities; dependable service; and stronger teams, working capital and productivity.
  
  
Please apply through MyCareersFuture with your CV and examples of relevant business development, operational leadership and integration experience.
  
  
LinkEdge International Pte Ltd
  
  
Where FMCG and FMEG careers accelerate.
  
  
LinkEdge International is one of Singapore's fastest-growing Go-To-Market distribution companies. We partner with world-class global FMCG and FMEG brands to deliver end-to-end distribution — retail sales, e-commerce, warehousing, transportation, merchandising and trade marketing — across 2,300+ outlets in five channels: Modern Trade, General Trade, Food Service, Specialty and eCommerce.
  
  
Founded in 2018 and led by veterans of leading multinationals, we combine MNC-grade discipline with entrepreneurial speed. Our data-driven approach to retail execution sets us apart in the market — and our people are the ones who bring it to life every day.
  
  
Why join LinkEdge?
  
  
Work with iconic brands.
  
  
Represent some of the world's most trusted FMCG and FMEG names in one of Asia's most competitive markets.
  
  
Grow faster.
  
  
In a lean, high-performance team of 130+, you'll take real ownership early — no waiting years for responsibility.
  
  
Learn from the best.
  
  
Our leadership brings decades of experience from top global companies, and we invest in developing every team member.
  
  
Be part of the growth story.
  
  
We're scaling rapidly, adding new brands, channels and capabilities — and creating new opportunities for our people as we grow.
  
  
If you're ambitious, hands-on and passionate about winning at retail, we want to hear from you.
  
  
Join us. Let's build the future of Go-To-Market distribution together.

title: Head of Regional HR and AI Transformation
description:

* Senior HR professional certification: SHRM-SCP (Society for Human Resource Management) and/or SPHRi (HR Certification Institute).
* Demonstrated delivery of AI or automation transformation inside an operating business —operating-model redesign, workflow automation with large-language-model tools, and governance — not advisory slideware alone.
* Experience advising founders, boards or listed-company management on organisation and compensation decisions.
* Professional fluency in English and Mandarin (working language with Taiwan, Malaysia and Vietnam leadership); Bahasa Malaysia an advantage.

Background in cybersecurity, cloud or enterprise technology.

Advantageous
  
  
Experience building channel/MSSP ecosystems.
  
  
Start-up, market-entry or zero-to-one experience.

Experience working with Chinese technology companies or cross-border teams.

PPWR
  
  
. Relevant professional EHS certifications and auditor qualifications areadvantageous.

title: Head of Strategy and Operations, APAC Product GTM
description:

Google will be prioritizing applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require Google's sponsorship of a visa.

For Sydney Applicants:

  
At Google, we have a vision of empowerment and equitable opportunity for all Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and commit to building reconciliation through Google’s technology, platforms and people and we welcome Indigenous applicants. Please see our Reconciliation Action Plan for more information.  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Singapore; Sydney NSW, Australia**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in a management consulting, sales operations, business strategy or corporate advisory role.
* 5 years of experience working with executive stakeholders.
* People management experience.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Track record of designing streamlined planning, goal-setting, and governance cadences that simplify execution and free commercial teams to focus on impact.
* Deep familiarity with Google's Ads product ecosystem (Search, YouTube, Apps, Commerce, or Measurement), Large Customer Sales motions, and APAC market dynamics.

**About the job**
-----------------

Within APAC Product GTM (pGTM), we accelerate and future-proof Large Customer Sales (LCS) revenue across Asia-Pacific's dynamic markets—commercializing AI-powered solutions across Search+, YouTube, Apps, Commerce, and Measurement while elevating APAC's customer and market voice with Global Product teams.

You will join a collaborative, analytical, and action-oriented group that turns complex, multi-product challenges into clear strategy and measurable impact.

The Go-to-Market Operations (GtM) team ensures Google's complex and ever-evolving Ads business runs smoothly. We are instrumental in setting go-to-market strategy, and ensuring flawless execution and operations against the strategy. We have teams embedded in each of the major Ads business areas as well as global teams that work across the business areas. Team members are analytical and strategic, with a pragmatic sense of how to get things done.

--------------------

* Equip pGTM Leads with trusted analytics, performance diagnostics, and sharp storylines for APAC Leadership team reviews, revenue calls, QBRs, and Product SteerCo.
* Resolve cross-pillar dependencies and align Regional BS&O, Country GTM, Marketing, gTech, and Global Product partners so pGTM programs land at scale.

title: Head, Investor Relations ( Manager / Associate )
description:
Tracx Logis Ltd. is a Singapore-headquartered, technology-driven and asset-light logistics group serving cross-border e-commerce sellers and enterprise shippers. Through its e-Commerce Logistics and Enterprise Logistics businesses, its Tmarkets Enabler services and its international network of subsidiaries, the Group provides fulfilment, customs clearance, last-mile delivery and international freight forwarding on 36 key cross-border routes. It is connected with 30 e-commerce and social media shopping platforms and has operations in 13 countries across Asia and Europe.
  
  
About the role
  
  
Tracx Logis Ltd. is seeking a
  
  
Head, Investor Relations
  
  
to join our team on a
  
  
full-time basis
  
  
, based in the Jurong East Region. This is a strategic leadership position that plays a pivotal role. As Investor Relations Manager, you will build and manage the Company's relationships with shareholders, noteholders, analysts and the wider investment community. Working closely with the CFO and the Co-CEO, you will help communicate the Group's strategy, performance and outlook clearly and consistently. In addition, the Company's securities may be listed in the future, and the role will involve establishing and running the investor relations function in connection with any such listing.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
Investor communications and engagement
  
  
Develop and execute the investor relations strategy and equity story, if and when the Company's securities become listed.
  
  
Act as the primary point of contact for shareholders, noteholders, analysts and prospective investors, and manage their enquiries.
  
  
Prepare results announcements, investor presentations, earnings call scripts and Q&A materials with the CFO, finance team and Legal Counsel.
  
  
Organise investor meetings, roadshows, conferences and site visits, and maintain the investor contact database.
  
  
Coordinate shareholder meetings and other shareholder communications, working with the Company Secretary and share registrar.
  
  
Market intelligence and reporting
  
  
Monitor share price, trading volumes, shareholder register movements and peer valuations, where applicable, and report insights to senior management and the Board.
  
  
Gather and analyse investor and analyst feedback, and advise management on market perception and investor expectations.
  
  
Benchmark the Group's disclosures, key metrics and investor messaging against comparable companies.
  
  
Disclosure and governance
  
  
Work with the Legal Counsel and the Disclosure Committee to ensure that investor communications are accurate, consistent and compliant with applicable disclosure requirements, including fair disclosure practices and blackout periods.
  
  
Maintain the investor relations section of the Company's website and coordinate with external investor relations, public relations and communications advisers.
  
  
Handle confidential and price-sensitive information with discretion, in line with the Company's insider trading and disclosure policies.
  
  
Corporate finance support
  
  
Support the CFO on capital markets activities, M&A communications and investor-facing aspects of potential acquisitions.
  
  
Support the preparation of sustainability (ESG) disclosures and other reports for investors.
  
  
Undertake any other investor relations and corporate finance matters as may be assigned from time to time.
  
  
Requirements
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accountancy, Business, Communications or a related discipline; CFA, CPA or a recognised investor relations qualification is an advantage.
  
  
4 to 8 years' relevant experience in investor relations, equity research, investment banking, corporate finance or financial communications.
  
  
Strong understanding of financial statements, valuation and capital markets, with the ability to translate operational and financial results into a clear investment narrative.
  
  
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong presentation and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
Experience engaging with US or other international institutional investors is an advantage but not a requirement.
  
  
Experience in logistics, freight forwarding, supply chain, e-commerce or platform businesses is an advantage but not a requirement.
  
  
Sound judgement, integrity and discretion in handling confidential and price-sensitive information.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
Tracx Logis Ltd. is committed to providing a rewarding and supportive work environment where employees can thrive and grow. We offer competitive remuneration packages commensurate with experience and qualifications. Our benefits include professional development opportunities and career advancement pathways within a dynamic and growing organization. As an equal opportunities employer, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and supported in their roles.
  
  
Apply now
  
  
If you are an accomplished investor relations professional with a passion for strategic communications and a proven track record of success, we would like to hear from you. Please submit your resume, cover letter, and a portfolio of relevant work to our recruitment team. We look forward to connecting with you.
  
  
At TracX Logis Pte Ltd (formerly known as Qxpress Pte Ltd), we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver possibilities. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve grown into one of Singapore’s most forward-thinking e-commerce logistics providers, empowering businesses with innovative, end-to-end fulfilment solutions tailored for the digital age.
  
  
With cutting-edge technology at the core of our operations, TracX goes beyond traditional logistics to offer a full suite of integrated services—from intelligent warehousing and automated sorting to last-mile delivery. Our systems are designed to provide real-time visibility, data-driven efficiency, and an exceptional customer experience.
  
  
Our name, TracX, reflects our relentless commitment to precision, innovation, and pushing the boundaries of what logistics can achieve. Backed by a regional network and a passion for customer success, we help brands scale faster, reach further, and deliver better.
  
  
At TracX, we’re not just moving packages—we’re powering growth. Join us in transforming the global logistics landscape.
