title: Head of Product and Platform
description:
**Salary:** $6000—$10000
  
  
About FinMet.sg
  
  
FinMet Pte. Ltd. (FinMet.sg) is incorporated in Singapore and registered with ACRA under UEN 202022529N. It runs https://finmet.sg, an online platform where customers in Singapore buy, sell and redeem physical gold. Every gram a customer buys is allocated to identified Swiss-made bars of 99.99% purity, stored with a professional vaulting provider in Singapore, and title passes to the customer. The company’s primary registered business activity is Gold Bullion Brokers and Dealers (SSIC 66123), and its secondary activity is Development of Software and Applications (SSIC 62011). FinMet.sg is registered with the Ministry of Law as a Registered Precious Metals Dealer (PS20240000367) and is a Local Associate member of the Singapore Bullion Market Association.
  
  
The Role
  
  
This role leads FinMet.sg’s operations in Singapore and is directly responsible for the company’s software and application development. You will own the FinMet.sg platform end to end: product direction, development delivery, regulatory alignment and customer documentation. You will also drive the company’s institutional partnerships and its growth in Singapore.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Platform and product development
  
  
Own the product roadmap and Product Requirements Document for the FinMet.sg web platform, covering buying, selling, redemption, customer onboarding and account statements.
  
  
Turn business, operational and regulatory requirements into clear development specifications. Manage delivery with the development team in Jira, including prioritisation, acceptance testing and sign-off for each release.
  
  
Oversee the platform’s integrations with Singapore’s national digital identity and payment infrastructure.
  
  
Specify and oversee new features such as referral programmes, recurring purchases, monthly portfolio statements and dedicated platform instances for institutional clients.
  
  
Regulatory compliance and risk
  
  
Make sure the platform and its processes comply with Singapore’s regulatory requirements for precious metals dealers, including anti-money laundering, counter-terrorism financing and data protection obligations.
  
  
Maintain the company’s KYC and customer due diligence procedures, and build the matching controls into the platform.
  
  
Draft and maintain the company’s customer-facing legal and product documents, so that they stay consistent with how the platform works.
  
  
Prepare cybersecurity incident reports and coordinate the response with the technical team.
  
  
Work with legal counsel on the regulatory treatment of new product features.
  
  
Operations
  
  
Write and maintain standard operating procedures for redemption, collection, gold allocation and customer campaigns.
  
  
Manage relationships with vaulting, collection-point and other service providers.
  
  
Business development and growth
  
  
Lead partnership discussions with financial institutions, including offering the FinMet.sg platform to institutions and developing lending against customer-owned gold with partner banks and lenders.
  
  
Plan and oversee marketing, including search and AI-search optimisation, content, promotional campaigns and media outreach.
  
  
Prepare presentation decks, concept notes and other materials for partners and stakeholders.
  
  
Coordinate the work of team members and interns across content, social media and operations.
  
  
Requirements
  
  
Degree in Business, Law, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field.
  
  
Knowledge of the bullion and precious metals industry in Singapore, including how physical gold is priced, stored, traded and redeemed.
  
  
Leadership experience, including leading teams and managing operations.
  
  
Experience writing detailed product specifications and managing an offshore or remote development team through Jira, including acceptance testing and release sign-off.
  
  
Working knowledge of Singapore’s anti-money laundering, customer due diligence and data protection requirements.
  
  
Experience drafting or maintaining customer-facing legal documents.
  
  
Strong written English, with the ability to produce regulatory, product and customer documents to publication standard.
  
  
Able to work across business, compliance and technical teams and manage several workstreams independently.
  
  
Preferred
  
  
A postgraduate business qualification such as an MBA.
  
  
Go-to-market experience with payments or fraud-prevention products.
  
  
Experience writing for publication, such as articles, reports or editorial content.
  
  
Experience in business development with banks or financial institutions, including platform or lending partnerships.
  
  
Familiarity with search and AI-search optimisation for regulated products.

title: Senior Partner Operations Manager
description:
As a
  
  
Senior Partner Operations Manager
  
  
, you'll own the operational strategy and execution for a portfolio of high-value enterprise partners on Wise Platform - driving continuous improvement in their payments’ experience, so partners stay operationally stable and ready to grow.
  
  
**That breaks into two parts:**  
**Owning the operational strategy:**  
You set and drive the strategy behind improving operational performance and volume retention for your partner portfolio - working to improve the partnership operations, in close partnership with the Account Management team (who own the commercial relationship).
  
  
**Resolving root causes of issues identified:**  
You put that strategy into action day-to-day, working with cross-functional teams across operations, product, tech, legal, compliance, implementation, and business development to keep partners stable and unlock growth.
  
  
You will be co-owning Wise Platform partner revenue retention and operational performance, working closely with the Account Management team and Wise operational teams to ensure Wise Platform Partners get the most value from our partnership, are operationally stable and can expand to new products and solutions.
  
  
**This role will give you the opportunity to:**  
Co-own revenue retention, operational performance, and relationships for your Enterprise platform partners - leading operational initiatives with internal teams to unblock growth opportunities. In practice, this means driving operational performance analysis and working to smooth out operations for the partners in your portfolio. You'll address operational concerns on the partnership as the final escalation point, spotting and resolving recurring friction patterns, while managing stakeholders and running business review meetings. You'll also propose solutions for partners looking to improve their operational state and support them through execution - ultimately removing the operational obstacles standing in the way of growth.
  
  
Partner with Account Managers to drive retention targets by improving transfer success, reducing operational issues, lowering contact rates, and enhancing overall partnership scalability. To do this - we expect you to use data insights to track performance, proactively addressing risks, and implementing initiatives that improve key retention metrics, ensuring long-term partner satisfaction and minimising churn.
  
  
Own operational success plans and data-driven business reviews, including helping manage Quarterly Business Reviews, to maximise the value partners get from Wise. Build plans aligned to key metrics (success rates, contact rates, customer satisfaction), holding both partners and internal teams accountable to timelines. Regularly present data analysis and progress updates to partners, using the insights to shape ongoing strategic improvements.
  
  
Advocate for partner needs by providing feedback to internal teams, influencing product roadmaps, and ensuring our platform evolves to meet the complex needs of enterprise banking and fintech clients.
  
  
Optimise internal and external processes, using data-driven insights to identify recurring challenges and implement solutions that scale operations and improve partner experiences.
  
  
Develop trusted relationships with senior stakeholders at partner organisations, ensuring alignment on operational goals and fostering long-term, strategic collaboration. Influence the partners to implement the endpoints & webhooks to help automate internal & partner’s support operational teams by sending the data via API to our partner.
  
  
Analyse the quality of the servicing we provide to our partners and their customers. Getting the feedback from partners and reviewing how internal procedures and SLAs help partners and their end-users get the most efficient service from Wise. Identify and raise the key improvement areas.
  
  
Who we are
  
  
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move money around the world. With the Wise account people and businesses can hold over 40 currencies, move money between countries and spend money abroad. Large companies and banks use Wise technology too; an entirely new cross-border payments network that will one day power money without borders for everyone, everywhere. However you use the platform, Wise is on a mission to make your life easier and save you money.
  
  
Co-founded by Kristo Käärmann and Taavet Hinrikus, Wise launched in 2011 under its original name TransferWise. It is one of the world’s fastest growing, profitable technology companies and is listed on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker, WISE.
  
  
16 million people and businesses use Wise. In fiscal year 2023, Wise processed approximately £105 billion in cross-border transactions, saving customers around £1.5 billion.
  
  
What it’s really like to work here
  
  
At Wise, we do things a bit differently. There’s no corporate nonsense, and no old-fashioned hierarchy. Instead, we work in dozens of self-sufficient, autonomous teams. Think of them like start-ups within a start-up that learn from each other.
  
  
Each team picks the problems they want to solve. So there’s no micro-management. No hiding behind fancy job titles. And no one telling you what to do. You are your own boss. But you’ll get tons of guidance and plenty of support from talented, super-smart colleagues from all over Wise.
  
  
We’re going to be upfront — the way we work doesn’t suit everyone. But if freedom, autonomy, and life-affirming, head-scratching professional challenges rock your world, we could be a match made in heaven.

title: Team Lead, RoA (Rest of Asia)
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

### **THE ROLE**

We are seeking a high-caliber, data-driven sales professional to transition from direct execution to strategic enablement as our Team Lead for Rest of ASEAN (RoA) to be based in Singapore.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**Position Overview**

In this critical regional role, you will be the chief architect of our distribution engine across Indonesia, Malaysia, and Thailand. Instead of carrying an individual direct quota, you will leverage your foundational enterprise or B2B sales experience to institutionalize rigorous sales cadences, structural forecasting methodologies, and pipeline governance across our tier-1 distributor networks.

The ideal candidate is an ex-sales practitioner—potentially coming from a major hyper-scaler or technology firms—who understands the realities of the field but wants to scale their impact by operationalizing partner performance and building high-velocity sales cultures across diverse Southeast Asian markets.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Commercial Cadence & Governance Design**

* Design, deploy, and enforce a standardized, highly disciplined operating rhythm (Weekly Pipeline Reviews, Monthly Business Reviews, and Quarterly Strategic Reviews) across all distributor sales teams in Indonesia, Malaysia, and Thailand.
* Transition distributors from ad-hoc tracking to structured outbound sales cadences, optimizing lead-to-opportunity conversion rates.
* Act as the primary interface between internal regional leadership and distributor country heads to ensure strategic alignment and execution visibility.

**Sales Forecasting & Pipeline Management**

* Establish deep pipeline integrity by implementing rigorous forecasting frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC, BANT) customized for channel environments.
* Run predictable weekly and monthly regional forecast consolidation roll-ups, translating raw distributor pipeline metrics into executive-level revenue projections.
* Conduct continuous gap analysis across the three target markets to identify coverage shortfalls and work with distributors to build targeted pipeline acceleration plans.

**Capability Building & Distributor Mentorship**

* Run high-impact training workshops for distributor account managers, coaching them on complex deal mechanics, pipeline cultivation, and customer-centric negotiation strategies.
* Accompany distributor reps on strategic, high-value customer meetings to model best-in-class sales behavior and validate field execution.
* Serve as the internal voice of the partner, advocating for local resources, marketing support, and programmatic overrides to unlock field sales roadblocks.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* **Professional Background:** Minimum of 8-12 years of B2B sales, account management, or partner success experience within the technology, SaaS, or enterprise software sectors across Southeast Asia.
* **Regional Market Expertise**: Proven track record navigating the commercial landscapes of Indonesia, Malaysia, and Thailand. A deep, empathetic understanding of regional cultural nuances, local distributor behaviors, and localized market dynamics is mandatory.
* **Operational Mastery**: Demonstrated experience managing structured sales cadences (outbound tracking, sequence optimization, and activity metrics) and institutionalizing forecasting frameworks. Own and enhance data sources and data reporting to gain scale and address any challenges or opportunities.
* **Analytical Acumen**: Strong command over modern CRM environments (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, or HubSpot) alongside advanced Excel skills for data manipulation and forecast modeling.
* **The "Ex-Sales" Edge**: Strong credibility with sales teams derived from having successfully carried and overachieved an individual quota in a previous role.
* **Communication & Languages**: Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills to influence executive stakeholders. Proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia or Thai is a significant advantage.

Join Everpure Singapore and be part of a team that's redefining data storage. Apply now and unleash your potential!

We are primarily an in-office environment; you will be expected to work from the Singapore office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless on PTO, work travel, or other approved leave

**INCLUDE FOR POSTING LOCATION IDENTIFICATION**

#LI-REMOTE, #LI-ONSITE

**WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:**

* **Innovation**: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
* **Growth**: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
* **Team**: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

**ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:**

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage.com if you're invited to an interview.

**OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:**

We're forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn't just accepted but embraced. That's why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.

**Join us and bring your best.**

**Bring your bold.**

**Pure and simple.**

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**Company Description**

At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.

Our prevention-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.

This is where innovation meets real-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems.

We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture.

What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely.

If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it

 **Job Description**

**About the Role**  
  
Check Point Software Technologies protects organizations as they adopt generative AI. Our AI Security  
portfolio includes AI Agent Security, which secures AI applications and agents at runtime; Workforce AI,  
which gives enterprises visibility and governance over employee AI usage; and AI Red Team, which helps  
organizations test AI systems against adversarial attacks.  
  
We are looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to drive post-sales customer success for our  
EMEA customers. You will own customer outcomes across all three products, work with some of the  
largest enterprises in the world, and build trusted relationships with senior security and technology leaders.  
Your work will drive adoption, retention, and expansion, and you will partner closely with Support,  
Solutions Architecture, Product, and Sales.  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the post-sales relationship and health for EMEA customers across AI Agent Security, Workforce AI, and AI Red Team.
* Engage with some of the largest enterprise customers in the world, including CISOs, Heads of IT, Heads of Security, and other senior stakeholders.
* Lead onboarding and adoption programs that take customers from initial deployment to measurable security outcomes.
* Build success plans with clear goals, milestones, and value metrics, and track progress with executive sponsors.
* Drive retention and expansion by identifying new use cases, cross-product opportunities, and renewal risks early.
* Oversee support escalations and ensure timely, high-quality resolution in partnership with the Support team.
* Serve as the voice of the customer, sharing insights with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap.
* Create repeatable playbooks, enablement content, and reporting for EMEA customer success.
* Partner with Account Managers and Account Executives on account planning, renewals, and expansion strategy.
* Work closely with the post-sales Solutions Architect, who serves as the technical resource for customers, to scope deployments, resolve technical blockers, and deliver technical value.

  
**Qualifications**  

* 7+ years in customer success, account management, or technical customer-facing roles.
* Experience with enterprise SaaS products, with a track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder accounts.
* Proven ability to manage multiple products and drive outcomes across large, global enterprise accounts.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to build credibility with CISOs and senior IT and security leaders.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present to executives.
* Data-driven approach to customer health, adoption, and retention metrics.
* Fluency in English required; additional European languages are a plus.
* Willingness to travel within the EMEA region as needed.  
    
  **Preferred**
* Experience in cybersecurity, cloud security, or AI/ML product environments.
* Understanding of AI security concepts such as prompt injection, data leakage, model risk, and AI governance.
* Experience selling or supporting products in the workforce or employee AI usage space.
* Familiarity with red teaming, penetration testing, or security assessment workflows.

description:
#### **Job ID**

66802

#### **Work Style**

Office Worker

#### **Brand**

HSBC

Full Time

24 November 2026

**Some careers have more impact than others.**

  

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

  

This team leads the implementation of the Group’s people strategy in line with our business objectives. It facilitates talent management, succession planning, and employee mobility while defining and overseeing frameworks that support employee performance management, reward, learning and development, resourcing and engagement.

  

We are currently seeking a high calibre professional to join our team as a **Head of Talent, Singapore.**

  

***Ready to shape Singapore’s talent strategy across hiring, succession and mobility?***

**Why HSBC**

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

**The Opportunity**

The Head of Talent, Singapore is a senior leadership role responsible for the integrated Talent Management and Talent Acquisition agenda across all businesses and Group Infrastructure in Singapore. Reporting to the Head of Talent, Asia & Middle East with joint accountability to the Country Head of People, Singapore this role translates Enterprise Talent strategy into focused market priorities and measurable outcomes. The focus is on ensuring HSBC can attract, identify, develop, retain and mobilise the talent and skills needed to deliver the business strategy in Singapore. The role partners closely with the CEO, Singapore and the Operating Committee and contributes to regional priorities as a member of the Asia & Middle East Enterprise Talent Leadership Team. It also provides strategic oversight for Australia, Malaysia and Taiwan with functional management responsibility for those markets. Success looks like a coherent end-to-end talent agenda with clear governance, stronger succession and mobility outcomes and hiring delivery that balances speed, quality, inclusion, risk and cost.

**What you'll be doing**

* Own and deliver the Singapore Talent plan aligned to Enterprise Talent strategy, regional priorities and the market business plan
* Translate enterprise frameworks into a market execution plan with clear outcomes, milestones, measures and governance
* Act as the senior Talent adviser to the Market Head of People, People Partners, business leaders and governance forums using external market insight and constructive challenge
* Integrate Talent Acquisition, succession, development, internal mobility and external pipelining into one coherent market agenda
* Oversee the Singapore Talent Acquisition strategy and outcomes across specialist and volume hiring with oversight of Executive and Leadership hiring in partnership with the relevant specialist team
* Strengthen succession planning for local critical roles and improve talent identification and calibration using evidence and fair inclusive processes
* Build talent intelligence on capability risks, critical skill gaps and workforce demand and convert insight into practical interventions
* Provide strategic direction to Heads of Talent in Australia, Malaysia and Taiwan reviewing delivery, risks and cross-market dependencies and escalating material issues

**What we're looking for**

* Proven Talent Acquisition or Talent Management leadership experience within a large complex and highly matrixed organisation
* Demonstrated delivery of an integrated talent agenda in partnership with specialist teams across Talent Acquisition and Talent Management
* Track record translating enterprise or regional strategy into market execution plans with measurable outcomes
* Established experience advising and influencing CEOs, Executive or Operating Committees and senior People and business stakeholders on material talent decisions
* Experience strengthening succession planning, successor coverage and readiness with owned and tracked development actions
* Capability using workforce, skills and talent intelligence to identify risks and gaps and implement practical interventions
* Background improving internal mobility and connecting talent pools with internal opportunities to build organisational capability
* Experience managing and developing culturally diverse teams including through organisational or operating-model change

**Building Singapore’s Talent Agenda**

If you want to shape how HSBC attracts, develops and mobilises talent across one of our most important markets this role offers scope to make a visible impact. You’ll work closely with senior leaders to turn strategy into practical delivery across hiring, succession and internal mobility. The remit spans market priorities in Singapore and regional collaboration through the Asia & Middle East Enterprise Talent Leadership Team. Apply to help build the talent and skills HSBC needs for the future in Singapore.

  

**Opening up a world of opportunity**
  
**http://www.hsbc.com/careers**

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Branded Retail Channel Lead (LEGO Certified Stores)
description:
Are you excited to be part of an ambitious growth journey, shaping how LEGO comes to life across our LEGO® Certified Stores?
  
  
Join us and step into a pivotal role to shape exceptional retail experiences while driving sustainable business growth across Singapore and Malaysia!
  
  
The role can be based in either Singapore or Malaysia.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
**Channel Development:**  
Key owner of overall channel leadership and management for LEGO Certified Stores (LCS) and LEGOLAND in Singapore and Malaysia.
  
  
Drive Joint Business Plan with team & Top-To-Top (T2T) meetings (BU GM participation), and input into BU integrated Commercial Planning (ICP).
  
  
Lead the channel strategy including collaboratively creating the activation calendar, channel budget management for trade investment, promotion, and marketing.
  
  
Ensure precision in channel sales and stocks plan forecast.
  
  
Support and lead the team to achieve channel goals.
  
  
Ensure all activities are aligned with company standards and compliance requirements.
  
  
Be on the constant lookout for growth opportunities in this space by being in close contact with Singapore and Malaysia malls.
  
  
**Partner Relationship Management:**  
Build and maintain strong partnerships in LCS and LEGOLAND through effective communication and joint initiatives.
  
  
Drive continuous improvement in enhancing partnership experiences, including addressing any partner challenges/issues/concerns in a timely manner.
  
  
Align on shared objectives and conduct regular performance reviews to ensure mutual success and growth.
  
  
Be fully accountable for Customer Pulse, ensuring sustained long-term partnership motivation and satisfaction, and drive needed actions with the channel team.
  
  
Support quarterly business reviews with partners to assess performance, align future plans and address performance gaps or growth opportunities.
  
  
Drive T2T dialogues with key partners monthly with BU GM.
  
  
**People Leadership:**  
Lead a team of 4, 2 Key Account Managers and 2 Retail Excellence Managers across Singapore and Malaysia, providing clear direction and support.
  
  
Enhance team capabilities through coaching, continuous feedback, career planning support and targeted training opportunities.
  
  
Be an active member of the BU Commercial Leadership Team (LT), contributing to strategic direction and priorities, while role modelling leadership behaviors and collaboration to inspire high standards across the BU.
  
  
**Market Insights & Reporting:**  
Monitor retail industry trends and competitive landscape to identify new opportunities for account growth and optimization.
  
  
Deliver regular, structured updates to senior management on channel performance, challenges, and emerging opportunities.
  
  
Co-own and drive ICP and discussions along with the BU Commercial Leadership team.
  
  
Play your part in our team succeeding
  
  
LEGO Branded Channel make up about 50% of the BU SMTR business. The branded channel strategy aims to boost brand awareness, enhance partner performance, and deliver a consistently high-quality retail experience for consumers and shoppers. As a key growth driver in Singapore and Malaysia, this strategy supports the business unit's growth plan by ensuring a consistent brand identity and enriching the consumer experience across all branded channel locations.
  
  
The Channel Lead plays a pivotal role in executing this strategy, focusing on increasing brand visibility, optimizing partner performance, and maintaining a superior retail experience.
  
  
Do you have what it takes?
  
  
Minimum 8 years of similar or relevant experience in channel and account management.
  
  
Previous leadership experience
  
  
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with all levels of internal and external organizations.
  
  
Excellent stakeholder management, and able to lead and influence horizontally and vertically.
  
  
Strategic attitude with drive for excellent execution.
  
  
Proven experience in resilient leadership with agility, leading / coaching/ mentoring and developing individuals and teams.
  
  
Solid understanding of retail operations, in-store execution, merchandising standards, and consumer journey across physical retail environments.
  
  
Hands-on experience in retail store operations and management, within either directly operated stores or franchise/partner-led retail environments.
  
  
Proactive, self-motivated attitude, demonstrating strong initiative and ownership.
  
  
Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

– All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.

Colleague Discount

Bonus

**Your workplace:**  
Your workplace will be the office, store or factory specified in this advert.

Our hybrid work model, Best of Both offers you the option of flexibility to work from home up to two days per week. Your People Leader will discuss the principles of the model, including how this option applies to your role and team.

title: VP, Head of Global & Regional Sellers and Co-Brand, Asia Pacific
description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Role Summary:

The Global & Regional Sellers and Co-Brand team grows Visa’s business with regional and global sellers across multiple industry verticals across Asia Pacific and represents Visa’s Co-brand Partnerships Center of Excellence (COE) in Asia Pacific. The team identifies new partnerships, expands and optimizes existing relationships and connects seller priorities with issuer, fintech, product and Visa Value-Added Services capabilities to create sustainable payment volume and revenue growth.

Based in Singapore and reporting to the SVP, GCM, IPVMC, the role provides regional leadership and coordination for seller and co-brand relationships operating across multiple Asia Pacific markets.

The role is accountable for defining and delivering Visa’s Asia Pacific strategy for regional and global sellers and co-brand partnerships. It combines go-to-market leadership, portfolio and pipeline management, senior client ownership and cross-functional execution to originate new partnerships, renew and expand strategic relationships, and improve the performance of existing programmers.

Key Responsibilities:

Shape the regional strategy:

* Define and lead the Asia Pacific Regional and Global go-to-market strategy, translating enterprise and regional priorities into clear partner segments, opportunity choices, market plans and annual business objectives.
* Prioritize the opportunity portfolio: Identify the regional and global sellers, OTAs, , retailers, digital platforms and other partners best positioned to grow Visa’s business, using market potential, strategic fit, economics, execution feasibility and long-term value.

Build and convert the pipeline:

* Develop and manage a disciplined pipeline across new, attack, renew and optimisation opportunities, with clear accountabilities, milestones, investment logic, risk assessment and performance reporting.
* Lead partnerships across multiple merchant segments: Build senior relationships and partnership strategies with leading online travel agencies, ecommerce players, GIG economy leaders, and broader travel ecosystem participants, addressing cross-border commerce, acceptance, credentials, loyalty, co-brand, data, risk and value-added services opportunities.
* Lead Regional Seller Business Development efforts: To onboard new regional and global account relationships for Visa in Asia Pacific

Optimise existing partnerships:

* Create initiatives that improve the performance of existing seller and co-brand programmes, strengthen customer value propositions and open new commercial opportunities.

Create integrated client propositions:

* Translate partner needs into differentiated solutions that bring together Visa’s core payment capabilities, credentials, acceptance, loyalty, data, risk, consulting and other Visa Value-Added Services.

Apply AI to growth and client engagement:

* Use data, analytics and AI-enabled insights to identify opportunities, improve partner prioritisation, strengthen account planning, personalise value propositions and accelerate commercial decision-making.
* Explore responsible applications of agentic AI and AI-enabled commerce that create new value for sellers, OTAs, issuers and consumers.

Own commercial outcomes:

* Deliver agreed sales, AANR and net revenue outcomes for designated accounts and partnerships, balancing growth, client value, investment discipline and risk.

Lead executive relationships:

* Own senior executive relationships with priority seller and co-brand partners and establish rigorous account plans, governance, relationship coverage and executive engagement.

Coordinate multi-market execution:

* Align geography leaders, account executives, product and functional teams to deliver partnerships consistently across markets while adapting propositions to local client, regulatory and commercial requirements.

Build and own the Asia Pacific Co-brand Centre of Excellence:

* Establish repeatable playbooks, opportunity frameworks, commercial narratives, best practices and performance standards for co-brand partnerships across Asia Pacific.
* Support market account teams to deliver on high priority co-brand business development and optimization initiatives.

Represent Visa externally:

* Act as a senior spokesperson for Visa’s seller and co-brand agenda at client forums, industry events and strategic partner engagements.

Lead and develop the team:

* Set ambitious objectives, establish a strong operating rhythm and build an inclusive, high-performing team with the capabilities and succession depth required for future growth.

Why this is important to Visa:

Regional and global sellers are increasingly influential in shaping how consumers discover, choose and pay, while OTAs, airlines, retailers and digital commerce platforms sit at the center of high-growth, cross-border and loyalty-rich payment journeys. This role will help Visa deepen its position with these partners, expand and improve co-brand programmes, and connect Visa’s network, credentials and value-added capabilities to the commercial priorities of some of the region’s most important commerce platforms.

The VP will turn this opportunity into measurable growth by building a stronger regional pipeline, winning and renewing strategic partnerships, improving the performance of existing programmes and coordinating execution across markets. Success will strengthen Visa’s relevance with sellers, issuers, fintechs and consumers while creating new pathways for growth towards 2030 and beyond.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

What you will need:

* 15+ years of senior commercial leadership experience, including substantial experience in sales, partnerships, business development, product or general management within payments, financial services, travel, retail, technology or digital commerce.
* Deep payments and partnership expertise, with a strong understanding of the commercial, operational and strategic dynamics linking merchants, issuers, networks, fintechs and consumers.
* Demonstrated experience originating, negotiating, launching and optimizing co-brand or strategic payments partnerships, including fluency in programmer economics, commercial models, value propositions and portfolio management.
* Experience managing a co-brand, cards, payments or partnership portfolio with P&L or equivalent revenue accountability. Exposure across airlines, travel, OTAs, retail, e-commerce or digital platforms is highly desirable.
* A strong understanding of the OTA and broader travel ecosystem, including cross-border payment flows, acceptance, loyalty, fraud and risk, merchant economics and the partnership needs of large digital travel platforms.
* A proven record of building and converting complex regional sales pipelines and delivering material commercial outcomes across multiple Asia Pacific markets.

title: Head of Operations
description:

YY Circle is Singapore's leading AI-driven workforce and lifestyle ecosystem, connecting businesses with a large network of flexible workers through technology-enabled staffing solutions. Product & Ecosystem Expansion
  
  

* Support adoption of new platform services and monetization initiatives.

* Drive growth of AI-enabled workforce solutions and emerging digital service offerings.

**Requirements:**  
**Experience:**  

* Minimum 7 years of leadership experience in high-growth technology, staffing, marketplace, logistics, or platform-based business.

* Executive leadership role with significant autonomy and decision-making authority.
* Opportunity to lead and scale a market-leading technology platform.

* Performance-based profit-sharing incentives.

A platform for income opportunities for all walks of life. In addition, a platform for businesses to offer quality lifestyle choices for YY Circle users. title: Customer Success and Account Manager
description:
**Job Description: Customer Success & Account Manager**

**About RubberWay**

RubberWay is a sustainability technology company dedicated to improving transparency, traceability, and responsible sourcing in the natural rubber supply chain. By connecting global buyers, processors, and smallholder farmers through digital tools and data-driven insights, RubberWay helps organizations identify sustainability risks, drive continuous improvement, and meet evolving ESG and regulatory requirements.

**Role Overview**

As Customer Success & Account Manager, you look after RubberWay’s users: the factories, through data collection, and the tyre manufacturers (TMs), through request management, progress updates and relationship building.

This is a highly external-facing role, working closely with factory contacts and TM teams across both of RubberWay's products, risk mapping and geo-mapping, which share many users and factories. As routine deployment tasks become more automated over time, the role will place greater emphasis on relationship and account work.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Factory Deployment: Risk Mapping and Geo-Mapping (60%)***

* Run deployments independently across both products: plan, train factory contacts on using the tools, explain the assessments, targets and data requirements, and manage the users.
* Create user guides and communicate product updates to users.
* Follow up with slow or inactive factories, keep progress on track for both products and escalate to TMs at the right moment, ensuring factories meet their committed deadlines.
* Make sure the data collected is clean and complete: check submissions for errors and gaps, and work with factories to correct them.
* Answer questions from factories and TMs about either product, and raise bugs with the team and the tech vendor where needed.
* Update TMs on deployment progress, send progress and completion reports to TMs and factories, and stay in frequent contact with TMs on their requests.
* Track deployment KPIs for both products, once defined by the team.
* Help improve and automate the deployment playbook (reminder cadences, templates, escalation rules).
* Look for synergies between the two products: where they share users and factories, streamline training, follow-ups, communication and reporting into one process, so that the same people are not contacted twice.

***Account Management (30%)***

* Manage year-on-year renewals of the services across both products and maintain customer relationships.
* Handle scope changes and expansion requests, such as additional factories or questionnaire questions.
* Understand the full range of RubberWay services so you can recommend relevant ones based on anticipated customer needs.
* Answer customer questions on topics such as EUDR status and the related services.
* Help keep leads warm: be the point of contact for prospects, share information about the process and what happens during deployment, and follow up with prospects after initial conversations.

***Communication & Marketing (10%)***

* Write content for the newsletter.
* Post on LinkedIn.
* Support a stronger online presence during the website redesign.

**Requirements**

***Education and Experience***

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* 3 to 4 years of work experience in customer-facing operational roles.
* Experience in customer success, account management, onboarding or implementation, ideally in a B2B setting.

***Skills and Competencies***

* Able to handle a mix of operational and relationship tasks: tracking many factories at once while building trust with TM contacts.
* A clear communicator who can train non-technical people and explain targets and processes simply, in writing and in conversation.
* Persistent and tactful when following up with people you have no authority over.
* Dependable and self-directed: you follow through on deadlines, check your work before it goes out, and flag problems early.
* Detail-oriented: able to spot errors and inconsistencies in data.
* A systems thinker: you spot where processes and users overlap and streamline them, so that one approach serves both products.
* Tech-savvy and comfortable with spreadsheets and dashboards: able to troubleshoot technical issues and learn new tools quickly.

**Desirable Qualifications**

The following are not required, but would be an advantage.

* Exposure to sustainability, supply chain or compliance topics, including EUDR.
* Fluency in Thai, Indonesian or French.
* An interest in marketing: you enjoy writing, social media or content, and would like to grow your skills in that area.

**What We Offer**

* A role in a small team, working closely with the team leads for each product
* Work across two products with many shared users and factories, and the chance to design one streamlined process that serves both.
* Growth as deployment becomes more automated, with more time for account and relationship work.

Pay: $4,000.00 - $5,000.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Singapore (Singapore)

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Customer Success Manager, Defence & Intelligence
  
  
As a Customer Success Manager for Defense & Intelligence you will be mainly responsible for managing and expanding relationships with strategic military and governmental agencies across Asia. Your mission will be to act as our main point of contact for our customers during their time with Planet’s contract life cycle and own your focus on customer value, retention and satisfaction. You will help customers maximize the value of Planet’s imagery and geospatial solutions, ensuring that they can effectively integrate Planet data into their workflows for applications.
  
  
The ideal candidate has experience working with military and/ or government agencies, and a great ability to navigate complex government structures, decision-making processes and interagency relationships. The ability to identify and build connections between ministries and stakeholders will be key to driving adoption and impact across government initiatives.
  
  
This is a full-time, remote position based in Singapore. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.
  
  
**Impact You’ll Own:**  

* Strategic Relationship Management: Act as the lead point of contact for high-stakes military and governmental agencies, fostering long-term partnerships built on trust and mission success.
* Workflow Integration: Partner with customers to deeply understand their specific mission requirements. You will guide them in integrating Planet data into their existing geospatial workflows.
* Navigation of Government Structures: Masterfully navigate the complexities of interagency relationships. You will identify key stakeholders across various ministries and build the necessary bridges to drive wide-scale adoption of Planet’s platform.
* Retention & Expansion: Own the renewal process and identify opportunities for growth. By demonstrating consistent value, you will ensure long-term contract stability and advocate for new use cases within your accounts.
* Customer Advocacy: Act as the internal "Voice of the Customer" within Planet, collaborating with Product, Sales, and Engineering teams to influence our roadmap based on regional requirements.
* Value Creation and Success Planning: Analyze and translate specific mission requirements into value creation by navigating complex interagency relationships to integrate Planet’s solutions directly into existing workflows. Develop and execute Success Plans that define clear KPIs for the customer, ensuring their "Mission Success" is quantifiable and visible to their leadership, and achieve value expansion by identifying new customer use cases.

**What You Bring:**  

* 4+ years of relevant work experience directly with Defence Forces and/or National Government agencies. You understand the nuances of the government procurement landscape and bureaucratic decision-making.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Marketing or a relevant field.
* Candidates are required to be proficient in English and Mandarin as these are the main languages used for internal and external communications, emails, and for contracting with Mandarin-speaking customers , regional partners, stakeholders, vendors and across global teams.
* A solid grasp of GIS, remote sensing, or satellite imagery applications. While software development experience is not required, you should be comfortable navigating geospatial workflows, terminology, and technical concepts alongside geospatial analysts.
* Ability to build connections across ministries and maintain relationships with both high-ranking officials and technical end-users.
* Exceptional negotiation and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex technical capabilities into strategic mission outcomes.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining high levels of engagement with a global team.
* Excellent problem-solving skills with a proactive mindset, and ability to multitask and prioritize job requirements.
* Willingness to travel.

**What Makes You Stand Out:**  

* Active armed forces reserve or veteran as a relevant intelligence professional.
* Account Management or Customer Success experience serving military and/or government customers.
* Understanding of government agencies, their procurement processes, and key initiatives related to defense & intelligence, and emergency management.
* Experience with platforms like ArcGIS, QGIS, or Google Earth Engine.

title: Sr Offering Development Director, Medical Affairs Content Pipeline
description:
Singapore, Singapore | Full time | Home-based | R1577410

  

**Job Overview**

We are currently looking for a Sr Offering Development Director to join our Commercial Solutions Excellence Centres organization, based in Singapore.

This role will lead the development of the Medical Affairs Content Pipeline program, a strategically important capability designed to transform how medical content is assembled, validated and developed. The Sr Offering Development Director will define the product strategy and manage the roadmap from MVP through to a scalable, integrated platform.

The role will focus on four core areas: defining the product strategy and roadmap; supporting the integration of an upcoming acquisition; leading concept testing and validation with clients; and facilitating integration with relevant IQVIA capabilities, including Marketing Co-planner and AI-powered content creation tools.

Working across IQVIA teams, clients and technology capabilities, the role will translate customer needs into a differentiated and scalable offering while supporting its successful commercialization and delivery.

The position combines strategic offering leadership with hands-on client engagement and delivery and is expected to be approximately 50% billable.

**Essential Functions**

* Define and lead the product strategy, vision and roadmap for the Medical Affairs Content Pipeline, progressing the capability from MVP towards a scalable platform.

* Lead the development and continued evolution of the offering, ensuring alignment with client needs, market opportunities and IQVIA's broader strategy.

* Work directly with clients to test concepts, validate requirements and translate feedback into clear product and development priorities.

* Support the integration of an upcoming acquisition into the Content Pipeline proposition and broader IQVIA offering landscape.

* Facilitate integration with relevant IQVIA solutions, including Marketing Co-planner, AI-powered content creation tools and other complementary capabilities.

* Partner across technology, product, Medical Affairs, delivery and commercial teams to develop differentiated, client-ready solutions.

* Support business development activities, including client discussions, proposals, RFPs and solution development.

* Provide subject matter expertise and strategic guidance throughout the sales and delivery lifecycle.

* Build strong relationships across a global, matrixed organization to drive alignment, decision-making and execution.

* Own the strategic direction and development roadmap for the Medical Affairs Content Pipeline.

* Establish clear priorities, requirements and milestones for progression from MVP to a mature, scalable capability.

* Lead client concept testing and validation, ensuring customer insight directly informs the proposition and development roadmap.

* Coordinate across internal teams to integrate relevant technology, data, AI and Medical Affairs capabilities into the offering.

* Support the effective integration of acquired capabilities, identifying opportunities to accelerate and strengthen the overall proposition.

* Develop clear value propositions and client-facing materials that articulate the business value and differentiation of the offering.

* Partner with regional and global teams to identify opportunities, support client engagement and drive adoption.

* Contribute directly to client delivery, with the role expected to maintain approximately 50% billable utilization.

* Balance immediate customer and delivery requirements with the longer-term development and scalability of the platform.

* Provide strategic input into investment priorities, capability development and future expansion of the offering.

* Represent the offering with senior internal stakeholders and clients across multiple markets.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree required; MBA or advanced business, technology, scientific or life sciences qualification preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

* Significant relevant experience in offering development, product strategy, consulting, technology-enabled services or Medical Affairs within the pharmaceutical, life sciences or related sectors.

* Demonstrated experience developing and scaling new products, platforms or service offerings from early-stage concepts or MVPs.

* Strong understanding of the pharmaceutical industry and the role of Medical Affairs, content and technology within the broader product lifecycle.

* Experience translating customer needs and market opportunities into clear product strategies, roadmaps and development priorities.

* Strong client-facing experience, including concept testing, solution development and engagement with senior stakeholders.

* Experience working across product, technology, commercial, Medical Affairs and delivery teams within a complex, global matrixed organization.

* Experience supporting the integration of new or acquired products, technologies or capabilities would be advantageous.

* Good understanding of emerging AI, automation and content technologies and their application within life sciences.

* Strong commercial mindset with the ability to balance offering development with client delivery and revenue-generating responsibilities.

* Excellent leadership, communication, presentation and stakeholder influencing skills.

* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders internally and externally without relying on direct authority.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make clear decisions in an evolving environment.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities and move effectively between strategic planning and hands-on execution.

description:

* Review presentation materials and responses to requests from regulators.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting of sanctions-related risks events/exposures and effectiveness indicators/metrics to BOS Board and Senior Management.
Lead the team to participate in any other assignments which contribute to an effective sanctions programme.  

**Who you work with**

  

A team of seasoned compliance professionals within Group Legal & Compliance. Group Legal & Compliance takes care of integrity and ensures compliance with all rules and regulations, developing the policies and procedures that manage and mitigate risk. In an evolving world where we’re actively driving digital transformation, it’s no easy task. But we thrive on the challenge because we’re future-ready and focused on driving change.

**Who you are**

  

* Degree qualifications in Accounting/Commerce/Economics/Finance, Banking, Engineering or Law, Political Science or related discipline
* Min. 10 years’ experience in compliance and anti-money laundering/counter terrorism financing/sanctions compliance with established financial institutions.
* Demonstrated track record of leading and developing high-performing sanctions or financial crime compliance teams.
* Has relevant AML/Sanctions experience in a regional/head office role.
* Has extensive knowledge of business, operations and the AML/CFT/PF regulatory framework in which bank groups operate.
* Has broad knowledge of the trade finance business and products, cash management services, transaction filtering and the ML/TF/Sanctions risks relating to FI business and operations.
Is familiar with international sanctions regulations from the United Nations, MAS, US, European Union, UK.  

  

**Who we are**

  

Singapore’s longest established bank, we’ve been helping people and businesses get what they want from life since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. From there, we provide support, services, solutions, and career paths that meet their individual needs and desires. Today, we’re on a journey of transformation. Embracing technology and creativity to become a future-ready learning organisation. But for all that change, the entire focus of our organisation remains to be Simply Spot On. In everything we do. And so whether you want innovate needs-based financial services. Work in friendly, supportive teams. Build lasting value in your community. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career.

  

Your Opportunity Starts Here.

Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

title: Supplier Performance Manager
description:
Location: Singapore, Singapore

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Singapore, Thales has been a trusted partner since 1973, originally focused on aerospace activities in the Asia-Pacific region. With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

The Supplier Performance Manager is responsible to manage and improve the operational performances of key suppliers (On Time Deliveries and On Conformity Deliveries).

A Supplier Performance Manager is appointed for several suppliers at local level entity/region as soon as needed according to context (High technical stakes or Risky technology or Mass production or Performance below objective) reached.

The main missions of a Supplier Performance Manager are:

  

* Manage operational performances for some selected Thales suppliers in close relationships with Procurement, Industrial, Engineering, Services and Quality teams and ensure that all the conditions, internal and external, enabling performances are in place
* He/She initiates improvement plans for the selected suppliers in terms of quality and on time deliveries during the execution phase
* He/She defines and controls the SKPIs (Suppliers Key Processes Indicators) objectives with the GBUs (Global Business Unit) organization: OTD (On-time Deliveries), quality ...

He/She reports to a SPM Team Leader  
Portfolio of suppliers, projects:  
from 5 to maximum 15 suppliers'
  
from 1 project to a few projects
  
when carrying SPM Leader role: 1 to 3 suppliers

Missions and responsibilities

In agreement with head of local entity operations, the Supplier Performance Manger main activities are:

Anticipation and Continuous Improvement

* In order to manage the continuous improvement, put in place the Thales best practices, including lean manufacturing, with his/her suppliers.
* Responsible for the deployment, within the selected suppliers, of corrective and preventive action plans which address process, product, or component alerts from industrial operations, customer line fit manufactures, or the field support organization.
* Act as a conduit to improve the overall interface between Thales and the Supplier, using lessons learned for the continuous improvement of both parties.
* Develop and execute plans, within the selected suppliers, to eliminate non-value add activities (e.g. the Seven Wastes, MUDA) in both Thales and Supplier processes, consistent with improving the quality and reliability of procured items.
* Deploy, within the selected suppliers, techniques including Six Sigma, DMAIC or Process Failure Mode Effects Analysis (PFMEA) to identify and evaluate the potential failures of process, prioritize actions to alleviate risk in both Thales and Supplier activities. Responsible for the deployment of corrective and preventive action plans which address process, product, or component alerts from industrial operations, customer line fit manufactures, or the field support organization.
* Participate to the transverse optimization actions such as Air Supply deployment (internet portal for exchanging data for Purchase Orders and forecasts), specific programs (ramp-up, ramp-down), new KPIs implementations, Reach (Registration, Evaluation and Authorization of Chemicals) regulations, logistics …
* Establish high level communication and intimacy with supplier's leadership team
* For anticipation, identify transformation targets, support associated roadmap deployment through weak signals awareness and risk mitigation plans
* For anticipation, set up subtiers mapping to assess risk exposure and propose ad hoc securitization

Crisis Mode

* In case of local supply chain crisis, leads the Task Force with his/her network
In case of Tiger Team at the Group level, can be part of the team  

  

Reviews, SKPIs and reporting

* Organize and conduct the supplier's performance reviews with the purchase department
* Validate and issue the SKPIs for his/her portfolio
* Establish a monthly reporting for his/her portfolio
* Prepare and participate to the local Suppliers Performance Committees and category performance reviews if needed
* Transmit the SKPIs to the group level
* Monitor and report on a regularly basis the global performance action plan addressing two main topics: quality and punctuality

Relationships with the global SPM organization and BLs (Business Line)

* Support Group initiatives in order to improve supplier performances for the Group
* Throughout his/her network, he/she escalates the identification of weak signals (in coordination with Industry, Engineering, Services, Quality and Purchasing departments) to the head of entity/region SPM when needed
* Reports the performance of his/her suppliers in category performance reviews when requested by Global SPM for suppliers with very low OTD/OCD
* Contribute to the knowledge of the complete Supply Chain starting from the tier one supplier and identify the weaknesses
May participate to the Thales IPCA Audit (Industrial Process Control Assessment) and support auditors for the closure of the findings  

  

When acting under SPM Leader role
  
For SPM leader role, he/she is in charge of the management of performances for specific suppliers on behalf of the Group in close collaboration with the SPM organization and Global and Regional Procurement. Such role of Leader is appointed by Global SPM Director (in alignment and agreement with SPM Network). On top of SPM Missions & responsibilities, the SPM Leader must:

* Act as a leader with a global vision of the supplier performance and coordination of SPMs from various entities
* Monitor Supplier Performance for the group, collect and organize the various root cause analysis done by SPM in entities and align with SPMs in entities needs to audit supplier sites
* Except when supplier is under Tiger Team or Supplier Development Management, collect the various action plans done by SPM in entities and ensure their correctness, coordinate action plan implementation under a global roadmap at supplier and internally, in relation with SPM in entities and lead performance reviews at supplier, by coordinating SPM in entities

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.
