Review the CDD checklist completed by Relationship Managers, ensuring the CDD documentation complies with regulatory requirements and is accurately recorded.
  
  
Periodic reviews
  
  
Oversee Financial Crime and/or Fiduciary Periodic Reviews, ensuring they are completed and signed off within deadlines, and monitor any risk or compliance issues through to clearance.
  
  
Act as the point of contact and quality assurance for Financial Crime Periodic Reviews, including those carried out by the team in Mauritius, and escalate risk or operational issues in line with the KRIs set by Group.
  
  
Re-evaluate customer risk ratings and re-assign them where appropriate, in line with Group timeframes and standards.
  
  
Client onboarding
  
  
Review Source of Wealth write-ups for new business and highlight any gaps against MAS guidance.
  
  
Review the new business checklist completed by Business Development Team.
  
  
Reporting and governance
  
  
Assist in preparing accurate and timely management reports for Exco, the Board, Group and other key stakeholders.
  
  
Accurately report the status of FCPR completion and other projects.
  
  
Testing, audit and regulatory
  
  
Assist with the development of testing plans and undertake First Line (Level One) quality assurance testing to demonstrate that BTAL meets its mandatory monitoring requirements according to customer risk ratings.
  
  
Support regulatory visits, audits and Compliance Validation Tests, follow up resulting action points, and contribute to satisfactory audit and CVT outcomes.
  
  
Review and enhance local Trust procedures or guidance notes, taking the initiative to improve efficiency and clarity.
  
  
People and development
  
  
Identifytraining needs arising from Periodic Reviews and day-to-day interaction with Relationship Managers, and prepare and present training material.
  
  
Oversee and assist with Control Team projects, completing them efficiently and within agreed timeframes.
  
  
Know-How/Competency Requirements
  
  
A minimum of 10 years’ experience in Trust / Company administration.
  
  
In-depth knowledge of Singapore AML regulations and Trustee and Director responsibilities.
  
  
STEP qualified or equivalent (preferably but not mandatory).
  
  
A general understanding of relevant laws in other offshore jurisdictions to which BTAL customer entities are routinely exposed.
  
  
Problem Solving Requirements
  
  
The Jobholder will be able to review a customer structure and identify any potential risks associated with that structure, be they fiduciary, regulatory, anti-money laundering, reputational, actual or potential financial losses or breaches. The Jobholder will be able to offer assistance and guidance to the Relationship Managers in how these areas may be mitigated or resolved.
  
  
The Jobholder will be able to identify more complex matters, identify any potential problems and reach a suitable conclusion as to how the problem may be solved.
  
  
Where the Jobholder identifies serious issues and where a solution is not immediately obvious or requires a higher level of involvement, then these matters are to be escalated to the Head of Trust Control for further discussion.
  
  
The Jobholder will be able to manage a team of staff setting high standards and leading by example; assisting with management of workloads and motivating and directing direct reporting lines.
  
  
An understanding of the regulatory environment will be required to effectively discharge duties with minimal reference toother members of the Risk team.
  
  
Trust is a tradition at Butterfield, in every sense of the word. As the Bank’s fiduciary services subsidiary, Butterfield Trust offers trust, estate, company management and custody services. Across the Group, the Butterfield Trust team assists with the formation and administration of trusts, companies and partnerships for both private and corporate clients designing solutions that meet our clients’ requirements.

title: Operations, Facilities & Programme Executive
description:
Job Summary
  
  
The Operations, Facilities & Programme Executive supports the effective day-to-day management of facilities under the Community of Impact (COI). The role is responsible for coordinating centre operations, facility bookings and maintenance, hospitality arrangements, administrative and financial processes, and the planning and delivery of programmes and events. The Executive works closely with staff, caretakers, vendors, volunteers, partners, and facility users to ensure that COI provides a safe, welcoming and well managed environment while supporting the organisation’s programmes and community objectives.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Centre Operations & Booking Management
  
  
Manage incoming enquiries through email, website, phone calls, walk-ins and other communication channels.
  
  
Manage the end-to-end booking process, including enquiries, site visits, confirmations, pre-arrival coordination, check-ins and post-event follow-up.
  
  
Maintain and update the centre's booking calendar and coordinate daily operations according to facility bookings and programme schedules.
  
  
Serve as the point of contact for groups staying at or using the centre, providing operational and logistical support as required.
  
  
Coordinate room and venue setup, AV/equipment requirements, F&B arrangements and other operational needs for bookings and events.
  
  
Attend to operational issues and troubleshooting, including outside office hours when necessary.
  
  
Develop, document and maintain relevant SOPs, operational workflows and facility usage guidelines.
  
  
Ensure compliance with centre policies, safety requirements and operational standards.
  
  
Facilities, Housekeeping & Resource Management
  
  
Coordinate servicing, maintenance and repair works with vendors and follow up to ensure timely resolution of facility issues.
  
  
Maintain accurate inventory and asset records for facility equipment and supplies.
  
  
Coordinate housekeeping arrangements to maintain a clean, safe and welcoming environment.
  
  
Coordinate room preparation and turnover between bookings, including cleaning, maintenance, bedsheets and other amenities.
  
  
Conduct pre- and post-use inspections of rooms, common areas and facilities where required.
  
  
Coordinate the procurement of operating, pantry, stationery and facility supplies, ensuring adequate stock levels and cost efficiency.
  
  
Manage vendors and service providers supporting facility operations.
  
  
People & Operational Support
  
  
Coordinate and manage caretakers' work schedules and duties relating to facility operations and programme support.
  
  
Attend to work-related matters concerning caretakers in accordance with organisational policies and applicable requirements.
  
  
Coordinate staff, interns, cleaners, volunteers and other operational resources required for centre activities.
  
  
Supervise and support interns, including students with special needs, during their attachment at the centre.
  
  
Liaise with partner institutions to support structured and meaningful internship experiences.
  
  
Programme & Event Management
  
  
Support the planning, design and delivery of programmes and activities aligned with COI and New Hope CSL objectives.
  
  
Programmes may include retreats for families, individuals, children and youths, social service professionals, community groups and external partners.
  
  
Develop and maintain a calendar of programmes and activities, including operating plans, budgets and resource requirements.
  
  
Coordinate programme logistics, participant registration, venue arrangements, equipment, volunteers and third-party contributors.
  
  
Work with internal and external stakeholders to ensure programme requirements and objectives are clearly communicated.
  
  
Promote programmes and activities to relevant stakeholders and intended participants.
  
  
Monitor programme delivery and gather feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
  
  
Support the evaluation and continuous improvement of programmes and activities.
  
  
Financial & Administrative Management
  
  
Prepare, issue and track invoices and follow up on outstanding payments.
  
  
Process refunds and support reconciliation of payments.
  
  
Maintain accurate financial and operational records for internal reporting and audit purposes.
  
  
Prepare reports and analytical summaries, including facility utilisation, programme participation and relevant financial information, for management reporting.
  
  
Prepare procurement documentation and ensure timely submission of vendor invoices to the Finance Department.
  
  
Communications & Stakeholder Engagement
  
  
Maintain positive relationships with facility users, community partners, neighbouring organisations, vendors and external collaborators.
  
  
Support partnerships with Social Service Agencies (SSAs), community organisations and other institutions to enhance centre engagement and outreach.
  
  
Prepare centre-related notices, signage, informational materials, newsletters, announcements and operational updates.
  
  
Ensure communications and collaterals are aligned with organisational branding and accessibility requirements.
  
  
Others
  
  
Any other related duties in New Hope CSL as assigned by Reporting Officer.
  
  
Accountability
  
  
Reports to Centre Manager / Head (COI) / Director, as determined by the organisation.
  
  
Accountable for the effective coordination of centre operations, facility readiness, programme support and administrative processes.
  
  
Competency Requirements
  
  
Core Competencies
  
  
**Communication & Stakeholder Engagement:** Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with colleagues, facility users, programme participants, community partners, vendors and volunteers.
  
  
**Customer Orientation & Hospitality:** Strong service orientation and commitment to providing a welcoming and positive experience for centre users and guests.
  
  
**Organisation & Coordination:** Strong organisational, planning and project coordination skills with attention to detail.
  
  
**Problem Solving & Adaptability:** Resourceful and able to respond effectively to operational issues and changing priorities.
  
  
**Independence & Teamwork:** Self-motivated, able to work independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues and partners.
  
  
**Hands-on Orientation:** Willing and able to support practical operational requirements associated with running a retreat, training and community facility.
  
  
Technical Competencies
  
  
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
  
  
Knowledge or experience in facility operations, vendor coordination, inventory management and programme / event logistics.
  
  
Ability to maintain operational and financial records and prepare basic management reports.
  
  
Familiarity with booking, administrative or facility management systems would be an advantage.
  
  
Education and Experience
  
  
Minimum GCE ‘O’ Level / Diploma in relevant disciplines
  
  
At least 3 years of relevant experience in facilities, operations, administration, hospitality, programme coordination or a related capacity.
  
  
Experience in managing multiple operational responsibilities within a facility, community space, hospitality environment or similar setting would be advantageous.
  
  
Relevant volunteering or work experience in the Social Service sector would be an advantage.
  
  
The nature of COI's operations may require occasional work outside normal office hours, including evenings and weekends, to support programmes, bookings and operational requirements.
  
  
The intent of this job description is to provide a representative summary of the major duties and responsibilities of the position. You may be required to perform job-related tasks other than those specifically presented in this description. This job description does not constitute a contract of employment.
  
  
New Hope Community Services (New Hope CS) is a social service agency working to bring change into the lives of the displaced and disadvantaged in the community.
  
  
Since 2004, we have been empowering our beneficiaries with opportunities to better their own lives. We provide a range of services and programmes such as temporary shelter, casework, mentoring, job-matching, life-skills training and support with long-term housing and employment. Together with our 3P Partners — Public, Private and People — we serve all people regardless of race or religion.
  
  
We are a full member of the National Council of Social Service since 2005 and have been granted Institutions of a Public Character (IPC) status until 2026.
  
  
Our Vision
  
  
To be a Beacon of New Hope to the Displaced and Disadvantaged in the Community.

title: Assistant Market Manager
description:
Role Purpose
  
  
Be part of our centralised pricing department and work with the Market Manager to manage quotation requests and deliver timely & accurate prices to customers. Assistant Market Managers will ensure speed-to-market for all pricing requests and assist the Market Manager in developing pricing tactics and strategies to achieve contribution and market share targets.
  
  
Role Accountabilities
  
  
Business/Growth Targets
  
  
Process quotation requests from sales in a timely and efficient manner in line with commercial targets.
  
  
Assist the setting of tariff levels and support development of competitive pricing proposals.
  
  
Assist the Market Manager in understanding key market, customer, and sector trends.
  
  
Assist the Market Manager in understanding competitive behaviours in the market.
  
  
Assist the Market Manager in understanding and achieving market share targets.
  
  
Assist the Market Manager in formulating proactive tactical pricing initiatives that react to market conditions and deliver value.
  
  
Facilitate non-standard quotation requests, as directed by the Market Manager.
  
  
Manage the day-to-day administrative functions of Market Management.
  
  
Customer Experience
  
  
**Contribute to an exceptional customer experience by ensuring:**  
Speed to market and fast quote turn times for sales team delivery.
  
  
Short-term pricing and sales strategies with regional sales teams.
  
  
Set and monitor discount from tariff levels to achieve speed to market.
  
  
Set Port Pair / Equipment type level tariffs.
  
  
Set and monitor strike rates at tariff levels.
  
  
Reporting
  
  
Own weekly & monthly reporting cadence across sectors (volume, revenue, utilisation, CTA), leveraging Power BI and internal trackers to provide accurate, forward-looking visibility.
  
  
Analyse performance vs contribution targets and model voyage assumptions, identifying gaps, risks, and opportunities with clear commercial drivers (pricing, mix, routing, capacity).
  
  
Proactively highlight wins, challenges, and required actions, ensuring timely escalation and alignment with Market Manager on corrective or growth initiatives.
  
  
Assist Market Manager in preparing related Quarterly Business Review (QBR) slide decks and presenting to the wider internal audience in Swire Shipping.
  
  
**Collect Market Intelligence & develop meaningful Insights:**  
Develop expertise in their CIF/FOB markets and embed this knowledge into the organization.
  
  
Review feedback from customers (via Sales) and competitor behaviour to contribute to tactical pricing and product discussions.
  
  
Analyse related market share, port stats & commercial information and translate it into meaningful insights to enable our Commercial Sales teams to hunt new opportunities in the market while maintaining existing customers (growing volume, market share & profit mindset).
  
  
Safety
  
  
Take responsibility for the safety of myself and those around me by displaying safety leadership principles (i.e. Safety I’s & Accountability ladder).
  
  
Challenging and stopping unsafe acts and behaviours or unsafe conditions.
  
  
Comply with the Global Safety Standards, Policies and Operating Procedures.
  
  
Key Qualifications & Skills
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
Degree in Business, Economics, Maritime Studies or related fields; open to fresh graduates with strong interest in shipping/logistics.
  
  
Demonstrated interest in global trade, shipping or supply chain (e.g. case studies, internships, coursework, competitions or MT programmes).
  
  
Track record of strong attitude, teamwork and collaboration in academic, internship or professional settings.
  
  
Technical Skills
  
  
0–5 years’ experience in shipping, logistics or commercial roles; strong analytical capability regardless of experience level.
  
  
Strong commercial and financial acumen, with ability to analyse pricing, contribution and performance drivers.
  
  
Proficient in data analysis and reporting tools (e.g. Excel, Power BI,) to support decision-making and performance tracking.
  
  
Clear communication and stakeholder management skills, with ability to translate data into actionable insights.
  
  
Demonstrates ownership, curiosity and proactive problem-solving in a fast-paced commercial environment.
  
  
Exposure to international liner trades or market dynamics is advantageous but not essential.
  
  
Professional Skills
  
  
**Customer-Centricity:** Dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal and external customers by providing improvements in products and services. Talks and acts with customers in mind. Builds a high level of customer orientation throughout the organisation.
  
  
**Ownership and Accountability:** Take responsibility for individual and team output and results.
  
  
**Collaboration and Teamwork:** Work effectively with internal and external stakeholders; seek and provide help to colleagues.
  
  
By submitting your CV, you are deemed to have agreed and consent to the collection, use and/or disclosure of your personal data to the Company for the purposes of recruitment and employment only in accordance with the Company's Recruitment Data Privacy Policy on our website.
  
  
Swire Shipping is committed to ensuring equal equitable access and participation for persons who experience disability. SSL is committed to treating persons with disability in a way that allows them to maintain their dignity and independence. Reasonable adjustments can be made upon request based on understanding of those accommodations.
  
  
Across Swire Shipping, we seek to create a supportive and inclusive environment that embraces individuality and recognise the benefits that these differences make. We do this by ensuring that all individuals are treated with respect and understanding and actively promote Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and do not tolerate discrimination, harassment, bullying, retaliation or intimidation of any kind. We are committed to driving the strategy, policies and accountability to build and sustain a diverse global workforce, through equitable processes and systems where everyone can contribute their very best.
  
  
Swire Shipping (SSL) is the wholly owned deep-sea shipping arm of John Swire & Sons Ltd, a privately held company with a long and distinguished history of trading and operating in the Far East. Swire Shipping is proud to have provided over 140 years of shipping services, spanning the globe. The Head office is located in Singapore, with regional offices in the UK, China, Hong Kong, India, Australia, New Zealand and across the Pacific Islands.
  
  
Our Strategic Vision is to be the leading provider of Sustainable Shipping solutions and our Customer’s Partner of choice. SSL owns and operates a modern, industry leading fleet of multipurpose vessels, handysize bulk carriers and bulk trans-loaders. Further, SSL’s orderbook includes additional number of eco-handysize newbuildings. SSL’s other core business activities include liner shipping, dry bulk shipping and bulk logistics.

title: Client Engagement Executive (Operations)
description:
Job Summary
  
  
The Client Engagement Executive (Operations) supports effective coordination, monitoring and improvement of New Hope Community Services Limited’s residential and housing operations. This is primarily an Operations role, requiring strong ownership, judgement, coordination and problem-solving. Client engagement is an important part of the role, but it does not carry professional social work or case-management responsibilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Administration
  
  
Coordinate operational administration, documentation, trackers and reporting.
  
  
Maintain oversight of outstanding matters and ensure timely follow-through and closure.
  
  
Review operational information, support audits and identify recurring gaps or areas for improvement.
  
  
Inspection & Enforcement
  
  
Conduct and coordinate operational inspections, reviews and compliance checks.
  
  
Support consistent implementation of house rules, tenancy requirements and operational standards.
  
  
Ensure incidents, infringements and corrective actions are properly documented, addressed and escalated where necessary.
  
  
Maintenance & Logistics
  
  
Coordinate facilities, maintenance, cleaning, inventory, assets and other assigned operational portfolios.
  
  
Liaise with contractors, service providers and relevant stakeholders.
  
  
Monitor defects, service gaps and corrective actions through to closure and identify recurring issues for improvement.
  
  
Client Engagement
  
  
Lead and supervise a team of Client Engagement Officers and / or Executives to ensure smooth daily operations.
  
  
Engage residents and tenants professionally while balancing individual needs with operational requirements.
  
  
Manage challenging operational situations calmly, firmly and appropriately.
  
  
Coordinate with Social Work and other functions where cross-functional support is required.
  
  
Others
  
  
Any other related duties in New Hope CSL as assigned by Reporting Officer.
  
  
Accountability
  
  
Reports to the Client Engagement Executive, Client Engagement Lead and / or Deputy Head, Operations.
  
  
Competency Requirements
  
  
Core Competencies
  
  
Strong ownership, accountability and follow-through.
  
  
Good operational planning, coordination and problem-solving skills.
  
  
Able to work independently and exercise sound judgement.
  
  
Good stakeholder management and communication skills.
  
  
Able to manage difficult situations professionally and communicate requirements clearly.
  
  
Strong documentation, reporting and administrative discipline.
  
  
Able to identify operational gaps and coordinate practical improvements.
  
  
Self-motivated individual with the ability to work independently.
  
  
Physically fit for general work.
  
  
Technical Competencies
  
  
Proficiency in IT Systems and Microsoft Office Suite (e.g., Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).
  
  
Education and Experience
  
  
Minimum Diploma or Degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent relevant working experience.
  
  
Relevant experience in operations, residential services, facilities, customer service, security, community services or similar environments would be an advantage.
  
  
Candidates with relevant transferable experience are welcome to apply.
  
  
Experience in coordination, stakeholder management, reporting or process improvement would be beneficial.
  
  
Willing to work shifts, weekends, after office hours or support emergency deployment where required by the assigned service.
  
  
Work Arrangements
  
  
Work arrangements depend on the service and site of deployment and will be stated for the specific vacancy. Candidates will be informed of the relevant work arrangement during the recruitment process.
  
  
Recruitment & Deployment
  
  
Candidates will be assessed through a structured interview and, where applicable, a job-relevant assessment. The primary service and likely deployment are indicated in this advertisement. Where there are other suitable Operations vacancies, candidates may also be considered based on overall suitability and operational requirements.
  
  
Final placement will be discussed with the candidate before appointment.
  
  
Following appointment, employees may be deployed across New Hope Community Services Limited residential and housing services where reasonably required to meet organisational and operational needs.

title: Associate, Client Onboarding, SME Banking
description:
Requisition Number: 66827

Job Location: Singapore, SGP

Global Grade: Band 8

Work Type: Office Working

Employment Type: Permanent

Posting Start Date: 26/11/2026

Posting End Date: 10/12/2026

:

**Job Summary**
---------------

Join our SME Banking Client Onboarding team and be at the centre of bringing new client relationships into the Bank. You will manage the onboarding journey from initiation through completion, performing customer due diligence and onboarding checks while partnering closely with Relationship Managers, Compliance and other internal stakeholders to resolve issues and keep cases moving forward. This role requires someone who can navigate complex onboarding requirements, exercise sound judgement and maintain a strong focus on both client experience and risk management.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy**  
• The Client Onboarding reviewer works in partnership with RM to get the client file to required standards of SME Banking
  
• Responsible for assessing the risks of the client, provide assurance to the Business that the client file meets requirements and approve the file. Role comes with additional responsibilities to support the SME Banking network and international proposition.

**Business**  
• Business Enabling support to SME Banking Front Office for all Client Onboarding related matters. Main knowledge to support cross border account opening is critical.

**Processes**  
• KYC/ CDD Account Opening
  
• Manage client approval end to end for the SME Banking files
  
• Review New Account Opening Documentation for completeness and validity
  
• Review accounts against all set internal standards for Client Due Diligence
  
• Check quality of the Source of Wealth if it meets set standards for On-boarding
  
• Conduct name screenings, adverse media findings, Sanctions links, Tax red flags
  
• Ensure complete and accurate record keeping of all relevant communications
  
• Ensure accuracy of data captured in SME system
  
• Advise frontline on SME CDD policy and procedures and applicable local regulations
  
• Escalate higher risk relationships and reputation risks arising from CDD to SME Compliance
  
• Consult with functional experts (i.e. Legal, Compliance, Tax) as needed
  
• Contribute to the implementation and controls for daily processes
  
• Comply to agreed Turn Around Times for assigned activities as detailed in the Document Operating Instructions and the Service Level Agreements
  
• Promote the spirit of continuous improvement by flagging any procedural issues that impact delivery of responsibilities with suggestions improvements and work around

**Risk Management**  
**• Execution responsibility for identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling, and mitigating financial crime risks, sanctions risks and reputational risks to the Group. Also, an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them.**

**Governance**  
**• Group Procedures including Group CDD Standards, SME Banking Segment Addendum and Country Addendum as well as guidance and department operating instructions.**

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**  
**• Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.**  
**• Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.**  
**• Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.**

**Key stakeholders**  
**• SME Market and Business Heads across the SME network**  
**• SME Banking Relationship Managers, Team Leaders and Client Services Managers**  
**• CFCC Advisory team**  
**• COO, Onboarding, WRB & COO, SME Banking**  
**• Head, Business Enablement & Strategic Initiatives, SME Banking**

**Our Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------

* **3+ years of experience in SME banking sector in KYC/AML role**
* **Solid knowledge and understanding of regulatory requirements relating to SME Banking CDD/AML**
* **Excellent verbal, presentation and written communication skills**
* **People and service oriented, A team player.**
* **High level of integrity and professionalism, with High attention to detail**
* **ACAMS or ICA Certification would be preferred**

**Role Specific Technical Competencies**
----------------------------------------

* **Critical thinking**
* **KYC**
* **Anti Money Laundering**
* **Client Onboarding**
* **Financial Crime Risk Management**
* **Risk Analysis**

**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

**We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.**

**Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.**

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation** **, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.**
* **In line with our Fair Pay Charter** **, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.**
* **Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance** **, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.**
* **Time-off** **including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.**
* **Flexible working** **options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.**
* **Proactive wellbeing support** **through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.**
* **A continuous learning culture** **to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.**

**Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.**

**Recruitment Assessments**
---------------------------

**Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.**

title: Head of Customer Service
description:
The Head of Customer Service oversees the department's operations and serves as the primary liaison with the Indonesian Embassy, relevant institutions and other counterparts in Singapore and Indonesia, in line with the Branch's and Head Office's policies and objectives.
  
  
RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  

* Submit report on CSD performance, such as opening accounts, outstanding balance, remittances volume and frequency include BNI MoRe transactions and ATM, as requested by Head office or any relevant authority, on weekly, monthly and quarterly basis.
* Ensure strict adherence to guidelines for preferential treatment to safeguard and avoid abuses and excesses. Any deviations from policy should be approved by senior management in writing.
* Together with other Departments, to perform marketing activities for CSD services such as: remittances and deposit products (savings account, current account, and fixed deposit)
* Upon management approval on CSD marketing plans, Head of Department may schedule courtesy visits to counterparts and submit call reports to the management.
* Maintain and develop working relationships with the Representative Offices of the Republic of Indonesia in Singapore and other relevant countries, Indonesian communities and the Indonesian diaspora in Singapore.
* Coordinate the activities of the Cash/Clearing, Current Account, Deposit and Remittance/Clean Collection sections to ensure efficient operations and compliance with Branch and Head Office policies.
* Review and approves inward clearing cheques for debit against customers' accounts
* Review, approves and signs cashier orders issued by the department
* Review the periodic reconciliation of fixed deposit balances in the general ledger against

customer's subsidiary ledger
  
  

* Conduct periodic count of:

1) stock of demand draft and cashier's orders at least twice in a year
  
  
2) cash and cash shortages/excesses
  
  
3) surprise cash balance check (once a month)
  
  

* Reviews and signs the following documents as evidence of approval:

1) outgoing SWIFT message
  
  
2) customer exchange forms
  
  
3) remittance advices
  
  
4) demand drafts issued
  
  
5) debit and credit notes
  
  
6) letters, reports etc to Head Office
  
  

* Reviews the exception reports so as to detect unauthorized remittances in the Funds

Transfer Module
  
  

* Ensure compliance with MAS Notice 626 for money laundering and MAS Anti-Terrorism Measure Regulations 2002 S515.
* Ensure effectiveness of the contingency plan for emergency situations such as robbery, natural disaster, etc.
* Periodically review the procedures in handling customers' inquiries and complaints to improve service level.
* Responsible to ensure adequate controls over:

1) inactive/dormant accounts
  
  
2) follow-up action on undelivered account statement
  
  
3) access to and release of stocks of negotiable documents in the strong room
  
  
4) staff who are not permitted to handle their own transactions
  
  
5) authorization of outward remittances via the Funds Transfer Module
  
  

* Ensure dual approval for cash transactions
* Perform final balancing in the vault at the end of day with chief cashier if both supervisors do not attend.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned by Senior Management and Head Office from time to time.

title: Head-Spa Therapist (No Experience Welcome/Training Provided)
description:
Start your journey in the beauty and wellness industry with us!

Perform 25-minute, 50-minute and 70-minute head spa treatments according to Jo: Hwa's service standards.
  
  
Ensure the cleanliness, hygiene and proper disinfection of spa rooms and equipment.
  
  
Provide attentive and professional customer service, ensuring a pleasant experience for every client.

The newest Korean Luxury Hair Salon with Hanok (Korean Authentic House) that is located in Capitol Kempinski

You will be continually receiving one on one training in the highest level.

Jo: Hwa is all about giving a positive impact to enrich your ‘Living’.
  
  
Jo: Hwa hair & living’s vision is to set a new expectation from the salon and your experience after leaving the salon.
  
  
Change starts here.

title: Head Bartender
description:
**Job Title: Head Bartender**

**Job Level:** Senior-level

**Department:** F&B Operations

**Full-Time Rate: $4,000 to 6,000/month (depends on exp)**

**Schedule:**

* **5–6 working days per week | Rotating 1–2 days off per week** (2 days off one week, 1 day off the following week).
* **Working hours may vary according to the roster, including weekends, public holidays, and closing shifts until 2 AM, based on business needs. Overtime and rest-day arrangements will follow applicable Singapore employment requirements.**

**Overall Job Objectives:**

The **Head Bartender** is responsible for leading daily bar operations and delivering high-quality beverage preparation and service across bar operations. The role oversees cocktail preparation, beverage quality, bar inventory, and bar team coordination while ensuring efficient operations, excellent customer experiences, and compliance with company SOPs.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Oversee daily bar operations, including preparation, service, stock replenishment, cleaning, and closing procedures.
* Prepare and serve classic cocktails, signature cocktails, spirits, and other alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages in accordance with established recipes and standards.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of spirits, including their characteristics, flavour profiles, origins, and use in cocktail preparation.
* Maintain working knowledge of wine and beer varieties, characteristics, and serving methods.
* Ensure consistency in beverage quality, measurements, taste, presentation, and service standards.
* Develop, test, and refine cocktail recipes and beverage offerings in line with the restaurant’s concept and customer preferences.
* Assist with beverage menu planning, pricing recommendations, promotions, and special event preparation.
* Lead, guide, and support bartenders and bar service staff in beverage preparation, service techniques, and adherence to SOPs.
* Plan bar preparation requirements and coordinate team deployment to support smooth service during peak periods.
* Monitor beverage inventory, stock movement, and consumption; conduct stock checks and assist with ordering and replenishment.
* Maintain proper storage, handling, rotation, and recording of alcoholic beverages, mixers, garnishes, and other bar supplies.
* Monitor beverage costs, portion control, and wastage, and identify opportunities to improve bar efficiency.
* Coordinate closely with service and kitchen teams to ensure timely beverage orders and smooth food-and-beverage service.
* Provide professional and engaging customer service, including explaining beverage options and recommending suitable drinks.
* Maintain cleanliness and organisation of the bar counter, preparation areas, glassware, equipment, and storage spaces.
* Support bar pre-opening activities when required, including equipment setup, menu preparation, supplier coordination, stock planning, and establishing bar SOPs.
* Follow company procedures and applicable Singapore requirements relating to responsible alcohol service, workplace safety, and food hygiene where applicable.
* Perform other related duties as assigned by the Outlet Manager or management team.

**Job Specifications:**

* 3–4 years of relevant experience working in a bar environment, preferably in a restaurant, bar, hotel, or hospitality establishment.
* Experience in a bar pre-opening or new outlet launch is an advantage.
* Experience working in a bar that also serves food, such as a restaurant bar or dining establishment, is an advantage.
* Practical experience and basic knowledge of wine and beer varieties, characteristics, and serving methods.
* Strong knowledge of spirits and classic cocktails, including standard recipes, preparation techniques, and presentation.
* Experience in bar inventory management, beverage cost control, and team supervision is beneficial.
* Team player with good work ethic and professional grooming and hygiene standards.
* **Valid Food Hygiene Certification, where required for the duties performed. Candidates who do not yet hold the certification may be considered if they can obtain it before undertaking duties that require it.**
* **Flexibility to work shifts, including weekends and public holidays, based on business needs**

**Key Deliverables:**

* Smooth and efficient daily bar operations.
* Consistent quality and presentation of cocktails and other beverages.
* Effective bar team coordination and adherence to service standards.
* Accurate beverage inventory management and responsible stock handling.
* Effective monitoring of beverage costs, portion control, and wastage.
* Clean, organised, and well-maintained bar facilities and equipment.
* Timely coordination with the kitchen and service teams.
* Positive customer experiences through professional beverage service.
* Successful support for bar pre-opening activities and new outlet launches, where applicable.
* Support for bar team development and adherence to company SOPs.

**Benefits of the role:**

* Annual and Medical Leaves
* Birthday Voucher
* Training and development provided
* Career growth opportunities
* Group discount (Dining & Salon)
* Opportunity to cross-train at overseas outlets

**ABOUT US:**

**INITIA GROUP** is the biggest brand concept leader in Singapore & Malaysia. We have been in the beauty and F&B industry for years and are now in Art, Retail, and Photo Studios. We are a fast-paced growing company, bringing all unique and on-trend concepts. We have a lot of expansions going on and we need additional talents in our growing family.

If you’re excited about our company’s vision for this position and want to start the path of becoming one of our future leaders, we’d like to hear from you.

**APPLY NOW!**

Pay: $4,000.00 - $6,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Professional development

Experience:

* Bartending: 3 years (Preferred)

License/Certification:

* WSQ Food Safety Level 1 (Preferred)
* WSQ Food Safety Level 2 (Preferred)

Location:

* Singapore 068720 (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Customer Relations Executive
description:
Company Overview
  
  
Megaton Shipping Pte Ltd is a Singapore freight forwarder established in 1991, providing quality logistics services. It maintains strong global partnerships and is a long-standing member of the Singapore Logistics Association, supporting businesses with reliable international shipping solutions.
  
  
Job Summary
  
  
Manage and coordinate import and export shipments by liaising with customers, carriers, and agents. Provide accurate quotations, negotiate costs, maintain schedules, and support sales and operations to ensure timely and efficient logistics service delivery.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Provide accurate air, sea, warehousing, and logistics quotations to customers and overseas agents to support sales efforts
  
  
Negotiate costs with carriers and suppliers to optimize shipping expenses
  
  
Respond promptly to enquiries from overseas agents and manage office accounts to maintain operational efficiency
  
  
Coordinate with customers, carriers, transporters, hauliers, forwarders, and agents to execute import and export shipments across sea, air, and land modes
  
  
Arrange bookings with carriers, co-loaders, and air co-loaders to secure shipment capacity
  
  
Maintain and update monthly freight rates and sailing schedules to ensure current information availability
  
  
Attend to walk-in enquiries, providing timely and accurate information to customers
  
  
Process customer orders accurately and promptly to meet service standards
  
  
Deliver customer support to maintain strong client relationships and satisfaction
  
  
Collaborate closely with Sales and Operations teams to align logistics activities with business goals
  
  
Perform ad-hoc duties assigned by the Head of Department to support team objectives
  
  
Preferred competencies and qualifications
  
  
Diploma or higher in a relevant discipline
  
  
Minimum of 3 years’ experience in logistics or freight forwarding industry
  
  
Knowledge of Sysfreight software to support shipment management
  
  
Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office applications for daily operational tasks
  
  
Strong interpersonal and communication skills to engage effectively with stakeholders
  
  
Positive attitude, hardworking nature, and ability to work well within a team
  
  
Effective time management skills to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
  
  
Ability to multi-task and adapt to changing job roles and responsibilities
  
  
Sales-oriented mindset with a desire to achieve sales targets
  
  
Megaton Shipping Pte Ltd is a Singapore freight forwarder company that has long been providing quality logistics service ever since its incorporation in 1991.
  
  
Our company is among the shipping companies in Singapore that has been a long-standing member of the Singapore Logistics Association. Megaton is a freight forwarder Singapore businesses can count on for all its logistics requirements.
  
  
We take pride in the strong relationships we have established over the years with shipping agents throughout the world. We make sure that we continuously venture and explore the international market, establishing reliable offices and agents in different parts of the world.

#L1-RS1
  
  
Allianz Apprenticeship Programme 2027 Intake

title: Customer Relations Officer (Wellness Spa)
description:
**Job Description:**  
Core customer service & front desk
  
  
Welcome customers, manage walk-ins, and ensure a warm, professional first impression.
  
  
**Handle phone/WhatsApp/email enquiries:** services, pricing, packages, therapist availability, promotions.
  
  
Register customers, update profiles, and verify memberships/packages/entitlements.
  
  
Manage bookings, rescheduling, cancellations, and waiting lists using the appointment system.
  
  
Coordinate customer flow and room/therapist allocation with the outlet team.
  
  
Sales support & revenue
  
  
Recommend suitable treatments/packages based on customer needs (without being pushy).
  
  
Explain promotions, memberships, and package terms clearly; support upsell and cross-sell.
  
  
Prepare quotations/invoices (if applicable) and ensure accurate billing.
  
  
Track leads/enquiries and follow up to convert bookings (e.g., post-enquiry follow-up).
  
  
Payment & cashiering
  
  
Process payments (cash, NETS, cards, PayNow, vouchers) accurately.
  
  
Handle refunds/exchanges according to company policy.
  
  
Maintain daily cashier reconciliation, petty cash handling, and end-of-day reports.
  
  
Customer relations & experience
  
  
Ensure customers understand pre/post-treatment instructions and outlet etiquette.
  
  
Proactively check satisfaction before and after treatments; escalate issues quickly.
  
  
Handle complaints calmly and professionally; document cases and follow through to closure.
  
  
Maintain VIP/high-value customer care (preferences, therapist requests, special notes).
  
  
**Support customer retention:** rebooking reminders, birthday/returning-client engagement, package expiry reminders.
  
  
Therapist/team coordination
  
  
Communicate customer preferences, contraindications, and special requests to therapists.
  
  
Support smooth handover between front desk and treatment team.
  
  
Work with therapists to manage schedule changes, breaks, and service readiness.
  
  
Assist with training new front-desk staff on service knowledge and customer handling standards.
  
  
Outlet operations & admin
  
  
Maintain cleanliness and presentation of reception/waiting areas (tea, towels, ambience).
  
  
**Manage documents:** consent forms, waivers, PDPA acknowledgements, service records.
  
  
Maintain stock levels of reception items (forms, vouchers, membership cards, retail display basics).
  
  
**Support simple reporting:** daily booking summary, customer feedback, package sales, therapist utilization (as assigned).
  
  
Compliance & data protection
  
  
Ensure
  
  
PDPA-compliant
  
  
handling of customer data and consent for marketing messages.
  
  
Follow hygiene, safety, and outlet SOPs; report incidents/near-misses.
  
  
Ensure accurate service descriptions—no misleading claims about medical outcomes.
  
  
**KPIs typically tied to the role:**  
Customer satisfaction score / complaint resolution time
  
  
Rebooking rate / retention rate
  
  
Package conversion rate (from enquiry or single session)
  
  
Booking accuracy (no-show reduction, schedule efficiency)
  
  
Cashiering accuracy (zero variance)
  
  
Kenko Holdings Pte Ltd is the parent company of Singapore’s premier wellness brand, Kenko Wellness Spa & Reflexology. With its name rooted in the Japanese word for “health” (健康), Kenko has cultivated over three decades of experience in delivering foot reflexology, body massage, and spa treatments from its founding in 1991. Operating multiple outlets in prime locations across Singapore, the company prides itself on a complete wellness journey – combining expert massage techniques, tranquil ambience, and a customer-centric experience.
  
  
As a group, Kenko Holdings oversees both the service-delivery arm and its training academy, establishing a synergistic ecosystem that spans spa operations and professional wellness education. With the wellness industry gaining momentum and consumer tastes evolving, Kenko is well-positioned for growth through service innovation (such as face/head/neck massage), expanded outlet coverage, and enhanced training and certification initiatives. By leveraging its trusted brand, strong operational foundation and commitment to wellness excellence, Kenko Holdings provides a compelling value proposition for both customers and strategic stakeholders.

title: HR & Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description:
Job Description & Requirements
  
  
1. Job Summary
  
  
We are seeking a responsible, organized and detail-oriented
  
  
HR & Talent Acquisition Coordinator
  
  
to support the daily human resources and recruitment operations of the company.
  
  
The successful candidate will assist with recruitment coordination for our restaurant outlets and head office, employee records management, preparation of HR documentation, onboarding and offboarding arrangements, attendance and leave administration, work pass documentation and other HR-related administrative duties.
  
  
This role requires regular coordination with candidates, employees, outlet managers and internal departments to ensure recruitment activities and HR administrative matters are handled accurately, efficiently and within the required timelines.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have at least one year of relevant HR experience, possess good organizational and communication skills, and be comfortable working in a fast-paced F&B environment. Candidates who are familiar with Singapore employment regulations, MOM requirements and HR/payroll systems will have an added advantage.
  
  
We welcome candidates who are proactive, meticulous, willing to learn and interested in developing their career in human resources.
  
  
2. Key Responsibilities
  
  
A. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Support
  
  
Assist in managing and coordinating the recruitment process for restaurant outlets, central kitchen and head office positions.
  
  
Post, update and maintain job advertisements on relevant recruitment platforms, job portals and other approved recruitment channels.
  
  
Monitor job applications and review candidate profiles against the relevant job requirements.
  
  
Conduct initial screening of applications and shortlist suitable candidates for further consideration by the HR team or hiring managers.
  
  
Contact candidates to arrange interviews, confirm interview appointments and communicate any changes to interview schedules.
  
  
Coordinate interview arrangements with outlet managers, department heads and other hiring personnel.
  
  
Prepare candidate summaries, interview schedules and other recruitment-related documentation for management review.
  
  
Follow up with candidates after interviews and assist in communicating the outcome of the recruitment process.
  
  
Assist with employment offers, including coordinating the collection of required documents and communicating joining instructions to successful candidates.
  
  
Follow up with candidates to confirm their acceptance of offers, intended commencement dates and reporting arrangements.
  
  
Assist in coordinating pre-employment documentation and onboarding arrangements for new employees.
  
  
Maintain an updated recruitment tracker covering vacancies, applications, interviews, offers, acceptance status and joining dates.
  
  
Follow up with outlet managers on outstanding vacancies, recruitment priorities and manpower requirements.
  
  
Assist in identifying suitable recruitment channels and improving candidate sourcing and follow-up processes.
  
  
Maintain accurate and organized recruitment records to facilitate reporting, tracking and future reference.
  
  
B. HR Administration & Employee Records Management
  
  
Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records in both electronic and hardcopy formats.
  
  
**Assist in preparing employment-related documents, including:**  
Employment offer letters and employment contracts.
  
  
Confirmation letters.
  
  
Salary revision and increment letters.
  
  
Promotion, transfer and deployment letters.
  
  
Resignation acknowledgements and termination-related documentation.
  
  
Other HR letters, notices and employee correspondence.
  
  
Check employee documentation for completeness, accuracy and consistency before submission for review or approval.
  
  
Ensure employee records are properly filed, organized and updated in accordance with the company's filing procedures.
  
  
Assist in collecting and verifying required employee documents during recruitment, onboarding and employment.
  
  
Maintain employee information, including personal particulars, contact details, job positions, departments, outlet assignments and employment status.
  
  
Assist in updating employee records when there are changes in salary, position, work location, employment status or other relevant particulars.
  
  
Monitor outstanding employee documents and follow up with employees or outlet managers to obtain the required information.
  
  
Assist in maintaining proper records of employee movements, including new hires, transfers, promotions, resignations and departures.
  
  
Prepare and organize supporting documents for internal reviews, management requests and HR audits.
  
  
Handle employee information responsibly and maintain strict confidentiality when dealing with personal data and employment records.
  
  
Ensure that HR documents are accessible to authorized personnel when required and are stored in accordance with company procedures.
  
  
C. Employee Onboarding & Offboarding
  
  
Coordinate onboarding arrangements for new employees, including document collection, completion of employment forms and confirmation of reporting details.
  
  
Assist in preparing employment documents and ensure that new hires complete the required documentation before or upon commencement, as applicable.
  
  
Coordinate with outlet managers to confirm employees' reporting dates, work locations, job positions and initial work arrangements.
  
  
Assist in communicating relevant joining instructions, reporting information and administrative requirements to new employees.
  
  
Support the HR team in updating employee details in the HR/payroll system upon commencement of employment.
  
  
Assist in preparing confirmation letters and tracking employees approaching the end of their probation period.

title: Junior Board Game Producer (with CS Support)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE
  
  
We are looking for a Junior Producer who will help bring tabletop games from concept to shelf while making sure the people who buy them are well looked after. You will split your time between supporting the Production team and helping our Customer Service team answer customer tickets, so you learn both how games are made and how players experience them.
  
  
You will report to a Senior Producer or the Head of Studio, supporting larger projects and owning simpler ones from start to finish, with guidance and room to grow. Suitable for entry-level candidates. No prior industry experience is needed.
  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** JUNIOR PRODUCER WITH CUSTOMER SERVICE SUPPORT
  
  
You will help the producers keep projects on time, on budget and to a high standard, and may be asked to run simpler projects of your own.
  
  
Own simpler projects (e.g., promos, accessories, or reprints) from start to finish, including scheduling, reviewing files, vendor coordination, and quality checks.
  
  
Track project timelines, task lists, deliverables, and meet deadlines you are given, keeping the Head of Studio or Senior Producers updated on progress.
  
  
Flag issues or delays early and bring proposed solutions up for discussion.
  
  
Prepare, maintain, and organize production documents, project files, factory quotations, ensuring versions, naming convention and folder structures are consistent and coherent.
  
  
Collect quotations from manufacturers and vendors and check the figures for accuracy.
  
  
Proofread and edit rulebooks and other text-heavy components under guidance for clarity, consistency, and typos, paying close attention to designer intent.
  
  
Check samples, physical printouts, and print files against specifications, reporting the contents and defects clearly.
  
  
Pack and ship samples and other prototypes securely to internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
Plan and draft crowdfunding campaign updates, and create supporting visual assets as needed (e.g., thumbnails, sample photographs).
  
  
Troubleshoot file issues with graphic designers, suppliers, and international partners.
  
  
Take notes in meetings and follow up on action items with other departments.
  
  
You will also work alongside the Customer Service team to make sure every player gets a clear, friendly and timely answer.
  
  
Understand and respond to customer tickets and emails about missing, damaged or defective components, replacements, and answer general product questions.
  
  
Work with logistics to arrange replacements, refunds, vouchers, or discounts within agreed guidelines.
  
  
Understand the company's structure, and route queries you are unable to answer to the right team (e.g. logistics, sales, or production).
  
  
Build up-to-date knowledge of our products and rulebooks so you can explain them confidently.
  
  
Log tickets accurately and keep response templates and FAQs current.
  
  
Spot recurring issues on the same product and escalate them promptly to the producers, so what customers tell us feeds back into production and quality checks.
  
  
Flag gaps in the customer service process, such as unclear policies, missing templates or handoffs that stall, and raise them with management so we can fix them or get the right help in place.
  
  
Help absorb ticket volume during busy periods such as crowdfunding fulfilment and new releases.
  
  
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
  
  
A willingness to learn and attention to detail are the qualities that matter most in this role. Beyond that, we care more about attitude and aptitude than a long CV.
  
  
A positive attitude towards learning new processes, tools and software, and a readiness to pick up new skills as the role and our processes evolve. These are essential for growth within the company.
  
  
Exceptional attention to detail and organization.
  
  
A bachelor's degree or diploma in any discipline, or an equivalent mix of education and experience.
  
  
Good command of written English, with the ability to communicate professionally and accurately.
  
  
Problem-solving skills, with the ability to think from a production point of view and come up with sensible solutions that can realistically be achieved with the resources and capabilities available.
  
  
Willingness to research independently before asking, and to ask when you are stuck.
  
  
The confidence to speak up. Some of the most useful contributions come from noticing what others have not, so we expect you to flag anything you think might be a problem, even if other producers or teams have not spotted it, rather than waiting to be told what to do.
  
  
Ability to prioritize, juggle several projects, and meet deadlines.
  
  
Good collaboration skills, and openness to feedback.
  
  
Proficiency in Microsoft Office or equivalent software.
  
  
NICE TO HAVE
  
  
None of these are required.
  
  
Enjoys tabletop games, RPGs, or miniatures games.
  
  
Familiarity with the hobby games industry and experience backing crowdfunding campaigns (e.g., Kickstarter, Gamefound, Indiegogo, etc.).
  
  
Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (such as Photoshop, InDesign or Acrobat), or any other image editing or print layout software, and comfort working on Mac OS.
  
  
An eye for aesthetics or graphic design.
  
  
Familiarity with print production, plastic production, or board game production.
  
  
Proficiency in a second language (e.g., Mandarin for liaising with suppliers, French for liaising with colleagues, etc.).
  
  
WHAT YOU'LL LEARN
  
  
This role is a launchpad into a full production role. Working on both sides (Production and Customer Service) gives you valuable experience: first-hand knowledge of what players notice when a game reaches their table.
  
  
The full production pipeline, from development, liaising with suppliers, art and sculpting through manufacturing and quality control.
  
  
How crowdfunding and retail fulfilment work, and how customer care fits into them.
  
  
Hands-on mentoring from Senior Producers, with regular feedback.
  
  
A generalist start. Producers here work across many areas at first. Over time, we observe your strengths and you grow into a more specialized role or a more senior generalist role.
  
  
Evolving processes and tools. We are a large company supporting many teams, so processes will keep changing and adapting to change is part of every role.
  
  
Asmodee Singapore is part of the Asmodee Group, a global publisher and distributor of tabletop games. Our studio works on crowdfunding projects and develops and produces hobby board games and miniatures games, working with partners and teams around the world.

description:
**Name of Authority:** Junyuan Secondary School
  
  
**Contract Period:** 1 January 2027 to 31 December 2027 or after issuance of LOA, whichever is later
  
  
Working Hours
  
  

* Mondays: 7:30am to 5:30pm
* Tuesdays and Thursdays: 7:30am to 3:15pm
* Wednesdays and Fridays: 8:00am to 5:30pm
* The school may specify other deployment hours.

Requirements
  
  

* Preferred: Diploma in Care and Programme (Student Services & Coaching), or a related discipline or equivalent qualification from a recognised institution.
* Preferred: 3 or more years of relevant experience in student management, youth engagement, school-based support, counselling, mentoring or behavioural intervention programmes. Applicants without prior work experience may also apply.
* Preferred skills and attributes: strong interpersonal and communication skills; professional and confidential handling of sensitive student matters; calm and firm disposition; documentation and case management skills; collaboration with staff and parents; positive student engagement and rapport.

Job Scopes
  
  
**The Services required are set out as follows:** Job purpose: The SWBE shall report to the school’s Head of Department of Student Management & School Leaders.
  
  
1. The SWBE will work closely with students, school staff, and external agencies to provide timely and structured support for students, with the aim of promoting a safe, inclusive, and positive school culture.
  
  
a) Student Well-Being & Environment
  
  

* Promote a positive, inclusive, and supportive school culture that prioritises student well-being.
* Assist in identifying, supporting and monitoring at risk students with social, emotional or behavioural attendance concerns.
* Provide social, emotional and basic academic support as part of re- integration for students returning to school after long-term absences.
* Support daily student engagement during school hours to reinforce positive behaviour, orderliness, and a caring school environment.
* Conduct regular walkabouts to observe student behaviour, build rapport, and provide informal mentoring where appropriate.
* Engage in regular patrolling outside school area to ensure safety and discipline of the students to infuse positive community culture.
* Engage and manage students during recess, lunch and after-school hours daily to help maintain noise level, orderliness and discipline at all times.

b) Life Skills Development
  
  

* Develop and curate resources to support life skills education, including socio-emotional regulation, resilience, communication, and decision- making.
* Plan, coordinate, conduct and support targeted life skills programmes for identified groups of students including monitoring of attendance and students’ progress.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of programmes and refine materials based on student needs and outcomes.

c) Student Discipline & Case Management
  
  

* Assist in the management and follow-up of student discipline cases in a fair, consistent, and professional manner.
* Conduct preliminary investigations into discipline-related matters and support documentation of cases.
* Maintain accurate case notes and records in accordance with school policies and confidentiality requirements.

d) Restorative Practices & Student Intervention
  
  

* Facilitate restorative conversations and mediation sessions between students involved in conflicts.
* Support students in reflecting on their behaviour and taking responsibility for their actions.
* Work with school staff to design and implement follow-up interventions that support positive behavioural change.

e) Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Serve as a key liaison between parents, teachers, and school leaders in managing student welfare and discipline matters.
* Collaborate closely with teachers and school staff to develop coordinated support strategies for students.
* Provide updates and inputs to school leaders on student cases and intervention progress.
* Provide school support for student programmes, interventions, and parent engagement where required.

f) Other Duties and Responsibilities
  
  

* Any other duties and responsibilities as assigned by the school.

2. The SWBE will propose, design, develop and implement appropriate programmes and interventions to strengthen students' social- emotional competencies, life skills, resilience and sense of belonging in school. Through purposeful and meaningful conversations, the SWBE will build positive and trusting relationships with identified students, providing a safe and supportive space for them to express their thoughts and feelings, reflect on their experiences, develop self- awareness, strengthen interpersonal skills and cultivate positive coping strategies. The SWBE will also facilitate restorative conversations and interventions to support students to regulate their emotions, process their experiences, strengthen their coping mechanisms and regain readiness to re-engage positively with school routines, relationships and learning.

You will turn the brand's commercial plan into live campaigns, listings and ads, keep the stores healthy, and report results back to the brand. The Virtual eCommerce Executive track does the same work remotely, with a greater focus on store operations, campaign setup and reporting.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Store and account management**

- Manage daily operations of assigned brand stores on Shopee, Lazada and TikTok Shop, including Seller Centre back-end, store health and shop scores.

- Act as the day-to-day point of contact for the brand team and marketplace account managers.

- Ensure compliance with platform policies and the brand's guidelines on pricing, claims and imagery.

**Campaign planning and execution**

- Build and run the monthly eCommerce calendar around mega campaigns (3.3, 6.6, 9.9, 11.11, 12.12), payday sales and brand days.

- Set up vouchers, flash deals, bundles, gift-with-purchase and pricing mechanics; secure campaign slots and platform co-investment.

- Track stock readiness with the brand and warehouse ahead of each campaign.

**Listings and content**

- Create and optimise product detail pages (titles, keywords, images, video, A+ content) for search visibility and conversion.

- Coordinate with designers and the brand on store decoration, banners and key visuals.

**Performance marketing**

-Support affiliate and KOL programmes and TikTok livestream and short-video content.

**Data and reporting**

- Track GMV, traffic, conversion, AOV, ROAS and market share; prepare monthly business reviews for brand partners.

- Monitor competitor pricing, promotions and category trends and turn them into recommendations.

**Operations and customer experience**

-Coordinate order fulfilment, returns and stock replenishment with the warehouse / 3PL. - - Oversee chat response, reviews and customer issues to keep ratings high.

**Requirements**

- Diploma or Degree in Business, Marketing, eCommerce or a related field.

- 1 to 3 years of hands-on experience managing Shopee, Lazada and/or TikTok Shop stores; experience with official / Mall stores is a plus.

- FMCG, beauty, personal care or consumer goods experience preferred; agency or eCommerce enabler experience is a strong advantage.

- Working knowledge of Seller Centre, campaign mechanics and marketplace advertising. - - Comfortable with data: proficient in Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP).

- Hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for daily work, e.g. writing product titles and descriptions, keyword research, campaign copy, review and chat replies, and summarising sales data.

- Organised and detail-oriented, able to juggle several brands and deadlines during campaign peaks.

- Clear communicator who can work with brand clients and platform teams.

- Willing to support mega campaign nights and occasional livestreams outside office hours.

**For the Virtual eCommerce Executive track**: proven ability to work independently and remotely, a reliable home setup, and availability during Singapore business hours.

**Good to Have**

- Experience with TikTok Shop affiliates, livestreaming or short-form content.

- Basic design skills (Canva, Photoshop).

**What We Offer**

- Exposure to global FMCG brands and direct partnership with marketplace teams.

- Structured training on platform tools and clear progression to Senior Executive and Account Manager.

- Annual leave, medical and dental benefits.

**About Us**

Founded in 2016, Prestigio Delights is a Singapore-based FMCG e-commerce and distribution business. We work with established consumer brands across online marketplaces and retail channels, bringing everyday products to consumers and businesses.

**How to Apply**

- Send your CV with a short note on the stores and brands you have managed, plus your expected and current salary.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
**Partner launch delivery for the Trust Platform**

Location: Remote, Singapore. Some travel to partners in Asia and Europe.

**About Syntelligence AI**

Syntelligence AI builds network-native anti-scan services that protect voice and messaging channels for telecom operators. Our Trust Platform combines pre-call scam detection, AI call-screening and real-time in-call protection and is being deployed with some of the largest mobile operators in the world. We are owned by five founding telco-operators and are taking our first service to market in early 2027.

**The Role**

We are hiring our first Technical Programme Manager to own the Trust Platform launch and deployment process.

Our first partner launch is in Q1 2027. You will deliver it alongside our Head of Commercial and Head of Product, learning the operator, product and integration processes from the inside. Out of that launch you will write the playbook systematizing how we plan, govern and deliver a Trust Platform deployment with a mobile operator. You will then lead the launches that follow, with further partners already lined up in Europe and Asia.

This is a customer-facing role. You will sit between our engineering, product and commercial teams on one side and the partner’s network, IT, marketing, legal and customer-care teams on the other. You will be the single point that links every workstream, owning and delivering it. You will report to the Head of Commercial and Operations and work daily with the Head of Product, CEO and CTO.

**Responsibilities**

* **Deliver the first launch as part of the core team.** Work with the Head of Commercial and Head of Product to take our first partner live: build and run the integrated plan, coordinate workstreams on both sides and own the risks, dependencies and decisions that get a regulated operator service into production.
* **Write the playbook.** Turn the first launch into a repeatable programme: the plan structure, the launch checklist spanning commercial, technical, regulatory, marketing and customer-care readiness, the governance cadence with the partner and the templates and artefacts each launch needs.
* **Lead subsequent launches.** Run one programme per partner from kick-off to go-live, adapting the playbook to each operator’s organisation, infrastructure and market.
* **Keep commitments moving on both sides.** Own the operating rhythm with each partner, keep status, actions and decisions visible and make sure nothing slips between meetings.
* **Coordinate the technical tracks.** Partner with engineering and product so that integration, testing and evaluation milestones are planned, tracked and communicated clearly to the partner.
* **Build the POC approach.** Define how we scope, resource and run proofs of concept with new prospects, including success criteria and timelines, so that each one is a step towards a launch.
* **Represent delivery in governance.** Bring the partner delivery view to our internal reviews and to joint governance with partners and shareholders.

 **Requirements**

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years in technical programme management, implementation or delivery management, or a software engineering background that moved into programme leadership.
* You have taken enterprise customers from signature to go-live at a B2B SaaS company, running the customer’s stakeholders as well as your own.
* Enough technical depth to hold engineering to account and translate for non-technical stakeholders: you can follow an architecture discussion about APIs, cloud and on-premise deployment, integration etc. and you know what questions to ask.
* A record of running several complex programmes in parallel with predictable outcomes: you ran the plan and own the risks and the dependencies.
* Excellent written communication. Your plans, status reports and decision logs are the documents that move our processes forward.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with telecom operators, network infrastructure vendors or other regulated enterprise customers with long, multi-stakeholder deployment cycles.
* Exposure to security, privacy or regulatory workstreams as part of a launch (data processing agreements, security reviews, consent).
* Early-stage or scale-up experience where you built the process rather than inherited it.
* Proficiency in Japanese.

title: Director Operational Risk - Behavioural Risk
description:
Our client, one of the worlds leading banks, is creating a specialist role in its Risk Management Group for an organisational psychologist or behavioural scientist. You'll sit in the second line of defence within Operational Risk, and your job is to understand why people behave the way they do. That means finding the human drivers behind risk events and building a stronger risk culture across Singapore and the bank's core markets.

This isn't a typical risk role. Your evidence, research and ideas will feed straight into senior management and risk committee reporting.

**What you'll be doing**

* **Strengthening risk culture:** applying organisational psychology to improve the bank's risk culture framework, maturity model and behavioural indicators
* **Diagnosing behaviour:** running interviews, focus groups, surveys and culture deep dives to uncover the behavioural patterns behind risk events
* **Using the data:** pulling together survey results, misconduct data and incident data to spot emerging themes and priorities
* **Challenging root-cause analysis:** independently reviewing the behavioural analysis behind significant incidents and thematic reviews
* **Designing what works:** shaping practical behavioural interventions with the business, HR and risk teams, and measuring whether they make a lasting difference
* **Building measures:** developing and validating culture surveys, scoring methods and dashboards for senior management
* **Teaching and training:** designing and running behavioural science training for risk managers, HR and staff, both in person and digitally
* **Looking ahead:** assessing new behavioural risks from technology and new ways of working, such as over-reliance on AI, automation bias and pressure-driven shortcuts
* **Influencing across the bank:** turning behavioural evidence into clear, practical recommendations for business, risk, technology and HR leaders

**What you'll bring**

* A postgraduate degree in organisational, industrial-organisational or occupational psychology, behavioural science or a related field. A doctorate or professional accreditation is a plus
* 10+ years applying organisational psychology or behavioural science in large, complex organisations. Banking, financial services or another regulated industry is preferred
* Deep knowledge of organisational culture, psychological safety, behaviour change and human factors
* Hands-on experience with mixed-method research: surveys, psychometrics, interviews, focus groups and thematic analysis
* A track record of designing and evaluating behavioural interventions and learning programmes
* Excellent facilitation, writing and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas simply to senior leaders
* The confidence to give independent challenge, balanced with good judgement and a practical, commercial outlook
* A strong grasp of research ethics, confidentiality and responsible use of employee data

**Why this role**

It's a rare senior seat where behavioural science sits at the heart of a major bank's risk function. You'll be backed to apply your expertise across the organisation, and you'll help shape how the bank handles the human side of AI and new ways of working.
