**WE ARE BBC STUDIOS**
----------------------

A globally renowned media company borne of the BBC. We make and distribute the world’s most sought-after TV, audio and digital content.

Our ambition is to be the home of the most powerful, entertaining, and inspiring stories for people all around the world.

**PURPOSE OF THE ROLE**
-----------------------

BBC StoryWorks is the commercial content studio within BBC Studios, creating high-quality content and campaigns that connect brands with audiences through powerful storytelling.

The Executive Producer, BBC StoryWorks APAC, provides senior creative production expertise across commercial campaigns, helping transform strategic and creative concepts into compelling content experiences. Working closely with Content Strategy, Project Managers, Sales, clients and external production partners, the role is responsible for commissioning and overseeing production, safeguarding creative quality and storytelling standards, and ensuring campaigns are delivered effectively, are compliant, meet clients’ objectives and offer value to audiences.

The role will primarily commission and manage external production partners, while maintaining accountability for creative execution, storytelling quality, production approaches and campaign delivery. The Executive Producer will also support the development of production capabilities, strengthen partner relationships and contribute to the continued growth of BBC StoryWorks APAC.

**YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND IMPACT**
----------------------------------------

* Provide senior creative production expertise across commercial campaigns.
* Advise on production feasibility, scope, timelines, budgets and executional approaches during campaign development.
* Translate approved strategic and creative concepts into effective production plans.
* Manage multiple campaigns simultaneously and balance competing priorities.
* Champion creative excellence, storytelling quality and audience engagement.
* Lead the commissioning of production companies, directors, freelancers and specialist vendors.
* Evaluate and approve production treatments, creative responses and executional approaches from production partners.
* Provide editorially-informed guidance throughout production and post-production, ensuring alignment with BBC StoryWorks quality standards.
* Provide final BBC recommendations on edits and content presentation prior to client approval.
* Develop and maintain a strong network of trusted production partners across APAC and internationally.
* Forecast and manage production budgets, negotiating delivery costs against client budgets and agreed commercial parameters.
* Collaborate with Content Strategy, Sales, Legal, Compliance, Insights and BBC Studios Ad Sales teams.
* Support positive client experiences through exceptional creative execution and delivery.
* Ensure content complies with BBC policies, commercial compliance requirements, advertising standards and legal obligations.
* Contribute to new production approaches, formats, process improvements and the growth of BBC StoryWorks APAC.

**YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**
------------------------------

**Essential**

* Significant experience producing commercial content campaigns within a branded content studio, publisher, broadcaster, agency or production company.
* Experience commissioning and managing external production companies, freelance talent and specialist suppliers.
* Strong understanding of content production across video, photography, social and multi-platform delivery.
* Proven experience forecasting and managing high-value production budgets.
* Strong creative judgement with the ability to assess production treatments and storytelling execution.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Commercial awareness and the ability to balance creative ambition with budget realities.
* Knowledge of advertising standards, content compliance and rights management.
* International production experience covering diverse markets such as China and Japan.

**Desirable**

* Existing network of production partners across Asia Pacific.
* Experience working within a publisher, broadcaster or media owner environment.
* Familiarity with BBC structures, processes and editorial standards.
* Interest in emerging storytelling formats, production innovation and audience engagement.

**JOB IMPACT**
--------------

The Executive Producer oversees the creative production of commercial campaigns across BBC StoryWorks APAC. Working closely with Content Strategy, Sales, Project Management teams and external production partners, the role is accountable for translating approved campaign concepts into high-quality content experiences that meet client objectives and BBC standards. The Executive Producer commissions and oversees external production partners and is responsible for the quality of creative execution, storytelling and production delivery from project kick-off through to completion.

title: Associate Director
description:
BTS is a consultancy specializing in the people side of strategy. For decades we have designed experiences that change how people work and help the world's leading companies turn strategy into results, combining deep business knowledge with hands-on development so leaders and their teams grow together with their company.

As an Associate Director in our Sales & Marketing Practice, you will work directly with sales and marketing leaders at leading corporations in Singapore and across the region. You will learn how they sell, how they structure their commercial organizations and what drives performance in the field, then help shape the behaviors their people need to execute their sales strategy. Your focus is Commercial Excellence Development, and over time you will master BTS's SAM solutions and become the regional subject matter expert for them.

**What you will do**

This is a true Triple Threat role: you design the experience, you facilitate it, and you sell and grow the work. You will be expected to be strong in all three and to bring Commercial Excellence expertise to each.

**Design and develop**

* Lead the design of Commercial Excellence solutions: interview clients, frame the commercial challenge, and shape programs around how their sellers and account teams win
* Work with the BTS Global Team to develop immersive experiences such as simulations, digital learning and role-play, drawing on BTS IP from around the world
* Bring what you learn in the field back to improve BTS's global SAM methodologies and AI-enabled tools
* Lead project teams, manage and develop consultants, and build a culture where people give and ask for feedback

**Facilitate**

* Facilitate and co-facilitate workshops, sales kickoffs and working sessions, including leadership development, for sellers, account managers and commercial leaders
* Coach participants and their managers so new skills show up in real customer conversations
* Bring humor, fun and healthy competition to sessions while keeping a clear link to business results

**Sell and manage accounts**

* Find, shape and close new opportunities, and expand our work with existing clients across Singapore and the wider region
* Build senior client relationships and a network of commercial, sales and HR decision-makers
* Help other account managers grow their accounts by selling SAM offerings, and work with the BD team to prospect potential clients in the right way
* Scope projects accurately, prepare proposals and pricing with the account team, and own project and account delivery

**Become the regional SAM expert**

* Build deep knowledge of our SAM solutions by working on projects, learning from experienced practitioners and joining the global SAM community
* Grow into the go-to subject matter expert for the region, able to position, scope and lead delivery with clients
* Advise account teams on which SAM solution fits a client's commercial challenge, and coach other BTSers in the region

**What we are looking for**

We want curious, humbly inclusive people with a can-do spirit and the right attitude, who bring diverse experiences and perspectives and add value to our Singapore business.

**Experience and background**

* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience
* 8 to 10 years of experience, in-house or in consulting, in commercial enablement, sales training or related work
* A proven track record in a revenue-generating or account management role, with senior client relationships and a network of commercial, sales or HR decision-makers in Singapore and the region
* Experience leading projects and teams, and developing consultants, to deliver client outcomes
* Permanent eligibility to work in Singapore without sponsorship

**Skills and capabilities**

* **Commercial Excellence expertise:** you understand how sales organizations, account planning, sales methodology and enablement work, and can link them to business results
* **Business acumen:** you use business and operating model knowledge to position BTS work, and read a client's commercial metrics and financials to understand how they sell
* **Problem framing and insight:** you frame the client's real commercial problem and bring insights beyond the current project
* **Client-ready communication:** you challenge assumptions respectfully, synthesize complex conversations and deliver hard messages well, in a clear, down-to-earth way that earns credibility with sales leaders
* **Presence:** you can hold the room, engaging senior and sales audiences and earning their attention and trust
* **Accountability:** you own outcomes, scope work accurately, and learn quickly, with the curiosity to master new solutions

**Nice to have**

* Experience with sales simulations, AI-enabled learning or sales methodologies
* Experience across multiple Asian markets, and additional languages

**Why BTS**

BTS is a global firm with offices on six continents. You will work in small teams on varied projects for leading clients, with no industry verticals, in an entrepreneurial culture of freedom and responsibility. Over time you take on more, from leading workstreams to building client relationships and developing other BTSers.

We work in a hybrid model, with an expectation of being in the office 50% of the time when you are not traveling. Travel happens when you lead clients through the experiences your team has designed: on average 30 to 50% of the time, occasionally more than 50% and occasionally less than 30%.

BTS is an equal opportunity employer and values diverse backgrounds, perspectives and experiences. To apply, submit your resume through the BTS careers site.

req39576

12/8/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC

**Description**

At the Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency (MIGA), a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. MIGA’s guarantees help mitigate risks. In fiscal year 2026, the WBG Guarantee Platform delivered a total of $17.8 billion in guarantees. For more information, visit https://www.miga.org/

Recognizing the need for MIGA to achieve this ambition and be closer to prospective new clients, MIGA’s established the Regional Office, Singapore in 2011 with a Regional Head (RH) mandated to originate new business opportunities and client relationships for MIGA in in support of MIGA’s focus areas. The presence of staff in the region helps MIGA more effectively work with clients and allows the Agency to actively participate in regional markets and to benefit from the strength of outbound and inbound investments. It also offers a chance to build on the increasing interest of investors looking for opportunities in the emerging markets.

  

MIGA’s Operations Department (MIGOP) is seeking a Regional Head of East Asia-Pacific Hub with extensive political and public sector credit risk underwriting, new business origination, and client relationship management experience, who will identify new business opportunities for MIGA and the WB’s GP, achieve business targets and grow the World Bank Group guarantee business. This position will be based in Singapore. The selected candidate will report to MIGA’s Financial Institutions Group (FIG) Director based in Washington D.C.

**Duties and Accountabilities**

The Regional Head of East-Asia Pacific Hub plays the primary role in developing MIGA’s business pipeline in the East Asia-Pacific region, with a particular focus on inward and outward FDI countries in the region. He/she will be responsible for developing and implementing strategies to identify clients/ projects in priority sectors, countries, and areas. He/she will oversee the provision of technical underwriting support from the region, conduct outreach to clients and provide overall quality assurance for work produced by the East Asia-Pacific region teams based in Singapore, Thailand (Bangkok), Japan (Tokyo), China (Beijing), and South Korea (Seoul). The Regional Head will primarily report to MIGA’s FIG Director with the responsibility to support both the FIG and Industries Directors in all areas including pipeline and portfolio management, new business development and meeting overall business targets for MIGA. The Regional Head will also support the Directors and MIGA’s Senior Management Team overall in policy, planning and strategy for the East Asia-Pacific region. In addition, the Regional Head will be the primary counterpart for World Bank and IFC regional engagements. S/he is expected to maintain close contact with the various country management units (CMUs) on sector and regional issues impacting MIGA’s pipeline.

The work of the Regional Head involves frequent interaction with top government officials and equivalent contacts in other international organizations, private sector companies and financial institutions that are clients, potential clients, and partners of MIGA, including counterparts within and across sectors, networks, and other WBG units. The role also requires contact, as required, with the MIGA Board and Board Committees, and senior and executive management at Headquarters and in the field.

Responsibilities include:

* Ensuring proper financial and fiduciary management of MIGA's resources.
* Ensuring the successful delivery of the WB GP commitments by closely coordinating with WBG sister institutions and relevant staff, host governments, and partner institutions, including conducting ongoing roadshow / briefing sessions to regularly inform such stakeholder groups on the goals and objectives, and progress of the WB GP.
* Ensuring the agreed Accountability and Decision Making (ADM) protocols for the WB GP are consistently and comprehensively applied where/when applicable.
* Supervising and coordinating the work programs of the East Asia-Pacific outposts of MIGA to ensure the development of viable Asia-wide business development and client strategies
* Managing relationships with Host Government and Host Government Officials in countries identified as priority markets for the Agency
* Collaborating with other units within MIGA, IFC, and the WBG to deliver high-level business results, with a particular focus on WB/IFC regional staff
* Working with the FIG, Industries, and World Bank Infrastructure Guarantees Unit managers and staff to provide oversight of all political risk insurance underwriting and business origination work of the East Asia-Pacific team, including quality control of all papers and presentations for MIGA management and MIGA's Board, and providing high-level client management oversight including leadership or participation in client teams.
* Ensuring consistency of MIGA’s guarantees with WBG country partnership strategies
* Identifying new business opportunities for MIGA and WB GP using the IDA PSW and other Blended Finance modalities at MIGA’s disposal, among other business development tools
* Providing a specialized focus on business development and origination in lesser developed countries in the East Asia-Pacific and other developing regions covered by the WBG, and develop and implement strategies for sub-sectors and priority areas such as climate / energy transition, and gender
* Developing client/ project leads; assist clients through the application process; structure initial deals, provide high-level client relationship management; working with MIGA FIG and Industries teams as needed when a new application is received to facilitate the underwriting of a transaction and to ensure excellent client service; developing and maintaining partnerships with regional DFIs and other like-minded institutions involved in foreign investment
* Developing and maintaining contacts with private sector investors, lenders and other institutions involved in the development and implementation of investment projects
* Meeting with prospective clients to market MIGA's guarantee products as well as with MIGA partners to better understand the market for political risk insurance and public sector credit risk guarantee solutions in priority areas and to identify new market opportunities for MIGA and the WB GP;
* Structuring complex transactions and assessing project risks;
* Coaching and mentoring junior staff, supervising the staff located and working in the region;
* Representing MIGA and the WB GP at high-level conferences or other events where MIGA desires to market its services and products; overseeing sponsorship at such events where needed;
* Advising MIGA's Management Team on business development strategies as needed.
* Frequent travel is required to follow up on project opportunities that are likely to result in new business for MIGA.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master’s degree in international Business, Finance, Economics, or related field plus at least 12 years of directly relevant experience (such as political risk underwriting, public / sovereign debt finance, public procurement finance, project finance, and/or private sector work in emerging markets);
* Extensive knowledge of emerging markets finance and economic development as well as an understanding of issues related to investment insurance and foreign direct investments in emerging markets;
* Sound financial analysis skills, including experience analyzing and structuring complex project and debt finance;
* Demonstrated high level technical underwriting skills, and proven track record in business development and in handling complex project risk underwriting and/or project and corporate finance;
* Demonstrated high-level understanding of political / sovereign risk guarantee products, and their application in the project and export finance banking fields;
* Strong client orientation, diplomatic skills, as well as sensitivity to social and cultural issues as they affect multilateral risk mitigation and investors going into developing countries;
* Demonstrated experience leading teams and a proven track record in delivering high quality work results;
* Demonstrated interpersonal skills in managing and motivating people and teams;
* Experience in guiding, mentoring and coaching staff on technical and business issues;
* Experience in working across boundaries; and experience in joint projects ventures with key multilateral and bilateral institutions;
* Ability to make forward-looking and practical decisions with a bias towards a results and implementation culture, with a focus on the big picture and the overall strategic framework for development;
* High degree of discretion, ethics, tack, and sensitivity in handling confidential and sensitive information; ability to maintain high standard of personal integrity;
* Excellent command of written and oral communications skill in English required, with ability to make persuasive oral and presentations. Ability to speak Japanese, Chinese, or Korean would be a plus

As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:

* Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.
* Responsibly leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision-making.
* Bring experience working in fragile, conflict-affected, and violent (FCV) contexts and are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in their application materials, where applicable.

**WBG Culture Attributes:**

1. Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.  
2. Thoughtful risk-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
  
3. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.

World Bank Group Core Competencies

title: Associate Director, Client Solutions
description:
About the role
  
  
As an Associate Director, Client Solutions, you will own operational excellence for a high-profile APAC client. You will lead the operations function across one or more client teams. You will be a senior partner to the Client Services Lead and a trusted advisor to client and agency leadership. You will set the operating model and delivery rhythm, and you will be accountable for delivery quality, risk, and efficiency. You will lead, coach, and develop a team of operations managers and associates. You will also help shape operational best practice across the wider business.
  
  
Reporting line
  
  
This role reports directly to the Senior Business Operations Director. It works in close partnership with the Client Services Lead and the wider client leadership team.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
Leading delivery and client operations
  
  
Own end-to-end delivery for the client. Make sure scopes of work become robust, integrated plans that meet client expectations on time, on budget, and to quality standards.
  
  
Be accountable for delivery risk. Set up the governance, risk, and issue management approach, and drive resolution of the most complex challenges.
  
  
Set the operating rhythm for the client. This covers planning cycles, ceremonies, reporting cadence, and escalation paths. Make sure it is understood and followed across the cross-functional team.
  
  
Partner with Resource Management on capacity and demand planning. Make sure the right people and skills are in place now and for the future, and resolve resource challenges early.
  
  
Provide the Senior Business Operations Director and Client Services leadership with clear, insight-led reporting on performance, risk, and opportunity. Escalate with recommendations.
  
  
Act as a senior partner to Client Services on client and partner management by:
  
  
Preparing for and leading operational conversations with senior client and regional stakeholders.
  
  
Holding teams accountable for their deliverables and inputs.
  
  
Facilitating key client meetings, governance forums, and business reviews.
  
  
Making sure decisions, actions, and follow-ups are documented and tracked.
  
  
Work with Client Services on scope management and commercial discipline. This includes spotting scope changes, supporting change request conversations, and protecting delivery margin.
  
  
Anticipate issues before they arise. Put mitigation plans in place with Client Services and agency leadership.
  
  
Make sure the team understands the client's service level agreements. Hold the team to them, and own the approach for reporting against SLAs.
  
  
Model effective collaboration and communication, and champion it across the cross-functional team and with the client.
  
  
Driving operational effectiveness
  
  
Lead team wash-ups and retrospectives. Turn the findings into measurable improvements, and own their implementation.
  
  
Own the application of the end-to-end Campaign Delivery Process and Quality Standards across your client team. Track adherence and remove barriers to adoption.
  
  
Use data and performance metrics to identify trends, root causes, and efficiency opportunities. Make evidence-based recommendations to senior leadership.
  
  
Identify opportunities to improve productivity, tooling, automation, and ways of working. Lead their rollout across the client team.
  
  
Contribute to the wider operations community by shaping best practice, templates, and standards that can scale across teams and clients.
  
  
Leadership and talent development
  
  
Lead, coach, and develop a team of Operations Managers and Associates. This includes objective setting, performance feedback, and career development.
  
  
Build team capability through mentoring, structured onboarding, and knowledge sharing.
  
  
Act as the point of escalation and guidance for the team on complex or ambiguous delivery situations.
  
  
Support resourcing and hiring decisions for the operations team, and help build a strong succession pipeline.
  
  
Foster an inclusive, high-performing team culture built on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  
  
Key requirements
  
  
10+ years of relevant professional experience, ideally in a media agency and/or management consulting firm. This should include substantial experience leading delivery for large, complex, or multi-market clients.
  
  
Proven experience leading and developing teams, either through direct line management or by leading teams without formal authority.
  
  
Demonstrated track record of managing senior client relationships and influencing stakeholders across functions, regions, and levels, including senior leadership. Experience with APAC or multi-market stakeholders is a strong plus.
  
  
Experience owning delivery risk, governance, and quality for complex programmes. This includes working with scope, budgets, and commercial considerations.
  
  
Strong grounding in project and programme management methodologies, and a record of delivering complex, cross-functional work.
  
  
Experience working in Agile environments, including leading sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, and other Scrum ceremonies.
  
  
Strong analytical and data-driven problem-solving skills, including root-cause analysis and translating insight into action.
  
  
A strategic, curious mindset about business operations. You identify opportunities and drive change that improves effectiveness and efficiency.
  
  
Sound judgement and the ability to make decisions and resolve issues in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
  
  
Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail. You bring structure and clarity to complex situations.
  
  
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present confidently to senior audiences.
  
  
Outstanding stakeholder management and relationship-building skills, with the credibility to influence and collaborate at all levels.
  
  
A proactive, adaptable mindset. You can manage multiple priorities and stay composed under pressure.
  
  
A positive attitude, high energy, and a collaborative approach to teamwork.
  
  
Life at WPP Media & Benefits
  
  
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
  
  
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
  
  
Please read our Privacy Notice(https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) for more information on how we process the information you provide.
  
  
While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
  
  
GROUPM SINGAPORE PTE. LTD.

Senior Director, International Research Partnerships – MRL
description:
Job ID

JR118508

**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.**

Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.

**Senior Director, International Research Partnerships – MRL**

**Job Summary**

Micron is seeking an accomplished **Senior Director, International Research Partnerships – MRL** to lead the company’s external research ecosystem and strategic innovation alliances outside the United States. This leader will develop and oversee partnerships with leading universities, national laboratories, government agencies, research institutions, and industry consortia across key international regions to accelerate breakthrough innovation and strengthen Micron’s long-term technology leadership.

As a key member of the Micron Research Labs (MRL) leadership team, this role will identify emerging technologies, build collaborative research programs, influence external innovation agendas, and enable Micron to gain early access to transformative scientific discoveries. The role will also lead the international external research program-management function, including solicitations, proposal selection, contracting, compliance, milestone delivery, portfolio reporting, and achievement of Micron objectives across countries, cultures, and time zones.

**Key Responsibilities**

**International External Research Strategy**

* Develop and execute Micron’s international external research and partnership strategy, aligned with MRL priorities and long-term technology roadmaps.
* Identify emerging technologies and innovation opportunities across priority regions, including Asia and Europe.
* Build a portfolio of strategic global collaborations that expands Micron’s access to talent, ideas, intellectual property, specialized research capabilities, and regional innovation ecosystems.

**University, Government & Research Institution Partnerships**

* Develop and strengthen partnerships with leading international universities, research institutions, national laboratories, and government-sponsored initiatives.
* Lead Micron-funded external research programs, including technical challenge definition, solicitations, proposal evaluation and selection, awards, and ongoing program oversight.
* Align Micron’s technical and business objectives with relevant research opportunities across key regions.
* Pursue appropriate external research funding and co-investment opportunities in key geographies, working with local senior leaders and partner functions to shape and advance opportunities.
* Create talent pipelines through faculty engagement, graduate research programs, fellowships, and internships.
* Influence research priorities relevant to future memory, semiconductor, packaging, and computing technologies, in alignment with MRL’s research agenda.

**Research PMO, Solicitations & Contracts**

* Lead an international research program-management function with clear processes, execution discipline, governance, and accountability.
* Own the end-to-end operating model for external research, from intake and solicitation through proposal review, contracting, kickoff, milestone tracking, reporting, and closeout.
* Manage scope, schedules, budgets, deliverables, dependencies, risks, decisions, and outcomes across a geographically distributed portfolio of complex research programs.
* Ensure Micron’s objectives remain aligned with program objectives and expected research outcomes.
* Orchestrate agreement workflows with Legal, Procurement, Finance, Government Affairs, Export Compliance, Research Security, and intellectual property teams, adapting to country-specific requirements.
* Maintain portfolio-level visibility through executive dashboards, program reviews, and reporting on spend, milestones, publications, intellectual property, talent outcomes, and measurable impact.
* Identify execution gaps, remove barriers, and drive corrective actions across time zones and organizational boundaries.

**Industry Ecosystem & Organizational Leadership**

* Represent Micron in strategic international consortia and industry forums, positioning the company as a leading global innovation partner.
* Build relationships with local governments, startups, venture groups, and innovation hubs, partnering with Micron’s corporate ventures team on strategic opportunities.
* Establish governance frameworks for partnership selection, management, measurement, and renewal across regions.
* Ensure effective collaboration among MRL, international research sites, technology development, Legal, Finance, Government Affairs, and business organizations.
* Lead and develop partnership and program-management professionals supporting the international research portfolio.

**Other & AI Responsibilities**

* Integrate AI-assisted tools and insights into research partnership development, portfolio analysis, program management, reporting, and other relevant aspects of the role to improve efficiency, quality, and effectiveness, while exercising sound judgment and complying with organizational standards and applicable legal requirements.
* Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by identifying, testing, and sharing appropriate AI-enabled enhancements across the international external research portfolio.
* Apply appropriate human oversight and critical judgment when using AI-generated insights or outputs, particularly when supporting research evaluations, partnership decisions, intellectual property considerations, and executive-level recommendations.

**Required Qualifications**

* BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related discipline.
* 10+ years of experience in research, innovation strategy, intellectual property licensing frameworks, technology partnerships, ecosystem development, and/or program or portfolio management.
* Proven ability to operate with autonomy and speed while remaining aligned with broader organizational strategy, priorities, and governance.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams and complex, cross-functional research programs from concept through closeout.
* Ability to apply contemporary artificial intelligence tools responsibly to improve the speed and quality of technical and program-management work, while exercising sound judgment and critically validating outputs.
* Proven ability to negotiate and manage complex, multi-country strategic partnerships, solicitations, agreements, and sponsored research programs.
* Strong executive communication, influencing, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to operate effectively across cultures and time zones.
* Deep understanding of semiconductor technology and international research ecosystems.
* Knowledge of international funding mechanisms, collaborative R&D models, commercialization pathways, research security, export controls, intellectual property protection, and technology transfer.

* Ability to travel internationally and work effectively across cultures, geographies, and time zones.

**Preferred**

* Experience leading university relations, government engagement, national laboratory engagement, or external R&D initiatives within the semiconductor ecosystem outside the United States.
* Established network across international academia, government, research institutions, and industry research communities.
* Demonstrated record of translating external research collaborations into measurable technology and business impact.
* Experience building a research PMO, portfolio-management system, or external research operating model across multiple countries.

**Micron Values**

In this role, you will be expected to embody Micron’s core values of **People, Innovation, Tenacity, Collaboration, Customer Focus, and Speed**, building trusted partnerships while advancing innovation and accelerating execution across Micron’s global research ecosystem.

**About Micron Technology, Inc.**

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life *for all*. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.
  
  
To learn more, please visit micron.com/careers
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
  
  
To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact hrsupport\_sg@micron.com

Micron Prohibits the use of child labor and complies with all applicable laws, rules, regulations, and other international and industry labor standards.

Micron does not charge candidates any recruitment fees or unlawfully collect any other payment from candidates as consideration for their employment with Micron.

However, all information provided must be accurate and reflect the candidate's true skills and experiences. Misuse of AI to fabricate or misrepresent qualifications will result in immediate disqualification.

Micron Foundation

  
Strong communities and education are vital to the success of both society and innovative companies. Every Micron site understands the complex needs of their local community. Whether it’s through strategic giving, sponsorships or deploying team member volunteers, we are making a difference.  
  
  

Sustainability

  
Micron is committed to sustainable practices and supporting our global community. We are building and maintaining sustainable operations, products, and communities while focusing on opportunities and risks that are most important to our business success and stakeholders.

title: Senior Campaign Manager
description:
About TEAM LEWIS
  
  
TEAM LEWIS is a global marketing agency that has moved from start-up to multinational in a little over two decades. Its success is due to a combination of factors: its ability to read the future and prepare for it; leveraging cutting-edge AI; strategic thinkers delivering award-winning campaigns; expanding client relationships into new markets or services; and above all, independence from outside investors. The practice, its people, and its campaigns have won many awards, including Cannes Lions, PRovoke Media, ICCO, European Excellence, PRCA Digital, Digital Impact, Global Digital Excellence.
  
  
At the heart of our community is the TEAM LEWIS Foundation (TLF), a non-profit charitable entity. Since its launch in 2021, it has funded over 2,600 causes. It is one of the largest employee-directed philanthropies in the world. The TLF promotes a wide variety of social, cultural, and environmental causes that benefit society. It aims to strengthen the bonds between the creative industries, businesses, government, and non-profits. Community charities are championed by employees who, in addition to the financial donation, volunteer their time and skills to maximise grant effectiveness.
  
  
Purpose of the role
  
  
The Senior Campaign Manager owns the client relationship. They are responsible for meeting client expectations and ensuring the client is kept fully up to date with critical activity on the account. In addition, they are responsible for developing that relationship by identifying and selling additional services. The Senior Campaign Manager takes the lead in maintaining key media relationships on behalf of all clients, leads outreach for campaigns, and oversees the integration of social media activity into campaigns. This person is also responsible for managing a team, coaching junior members of staff, ensuring individuals have the right skills, and that the team works together effectively.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Client Management
  
  
Oversees and maintains a consultative relationship with the client, acting as a contact and partner for all marketing and communications services
  
  
Responsible for maintaining excellent client communication at all levels; defining deadlines and service agreements whilst ensuring these are met consistently by the team
  
  
Works closely with the client to regularly review account performance,identifying and communicating opportunities for additional PR, marketing and digital tools and services
  
  
Works with the management team to ensure account profitability and effective budgeting
  
  
Plays an integral role in the new business process, taking an instrumental role in generating content and presentation preparation, in addition to attendance
  
  
Ensures regular contact with the client is maintained by direct reports and other team members
  
  
Media Relations
  
  
Oversees all media relations activity on behalf of the client, maintaining key media contacts for campaigns and projects
  
  
Builds, maintains and develops robust relationships with journalists, bloggers, influencers and analysts across national, trade and vertical media channels
  
  
Utilises network to create and maximise client coverage, advising on potential opportunities
  
  
Maintains and promotes a sound understanding of current affairs relevant to the client’s industry and the wider news agenda
  
  
Guides the team on formulating rapid response to breaking news on behalf of clients, reacting quickly to emerging stories in line with client profiles
  
  
Content
  
  
Oversees and provides content creation for campaigns and projects including press releases, articles, blog entries, and other written material
  
  
Drafts - and oversees the drafting of - a broad range of written materials including biographies, briefing documents, media alerts, soundbites, Q&As, backgrounders and boilerplates, ensuring a consistent level of high-quality content
  
  
Works with content experts to drive the improvement of own and others knowledge of impactful techniques and writing styles
  
  
Digital / Social Media
  
  
Uses social media platforms to expand own network, develop media relationships and positively impact client results
  
  
Pitches additional digital content including infographics, animations and video to support written content and client aims
  
  
Uses social media and proactively explores new tools, solutions and processes to continuously evolve and optimise client PR campaigns
  
  
Provides social media insight as well as execution and management of related digital activity
  
  
Works collaboratively with the digital team to increase the utilisation of digital services wherever possible
  
  
Team working and Development
  
  
Acts as a respected line manager, working closely with line reports to maximise strengths, improve weaknesses and support career development
  
  
Line manages the account team, including coaching, supervision, assessment and review of junior team members
  
  
Sets team objectives on a daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly basis
  
  
Defines and positions deliverable client objectives with the account team
  
  
Monitors team activity levels against budget, increasing and decreasing individuals allocation where necessary
  
  
Provides guidance to colleagues on how to best manage campaigns, including answering general new business requests
  
  
Works with the Talent team to recruit high calibre junior level candidates into the team
  
  
Works with the HR team to reward, retain and develop your team and resolve any performance related issues
  
  
Regularly attends and leads TEAM LEWIS training sessions and daily press briefings to enhance skills and develop knowledge
  
  
Reporting and Analysis
  
  
Ensures that all activity and results are reported back to the client, providing insight and analysis across all aspects of the account
  
  
Communicates account performance internally (account reviews) and provides strategic advice to the client based on measurable analytics
  
  
Monitors and reports back on account KPIs and ensures accurate reporting by junior team members
  
  
Provides detailed reports to the Campaign Director or senior management team on request
  
  
General
  
  
Runs and supports training sessions, with a view to maximising opportunities to expand team skills and grow revenues
  
  
Takes a proactive role in promoting the TEAM LEWIS brand, its work, identity and values
  
  
Supports the HR / talent team by promoting both internal and external opportunities at TEAM LEWIS across social media and via the referral scheme
  
  
Contributes and supports the continuous improvement of systems, practices and policies
  
  
Overall, acts as a guardian of best marketing practice
  
  
About you
  
  
Relevant experience working in a B2B, corporate, consumer, or digital communications agency environment at a Campaign Manager or Senior Campaign Manager level
  
  
Understanding of client business issues and requirements
  
  
Understanding of the local market and opportunities for growth
  
  
Strong project management skills with an ability to plan and prioritise
  
  
A persuasive and convincing writing style
  
  
Excellent general knowledge of and a keen interest in current affairs
  
  
Ability to delegate effectively
  
  
Calmness under pressure and ability to achieve tight deadlines
  
  
Ability to interact confidently with clients at a senior level
  
  
Ability to troubleshoot team and client problem areas – and suggest a remedial course of action
  
  
Creative thinking and an open-minded approach
  
  
This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of the responsibilities for this role. Other responsibilities may be added from time to time.
  
  
TEAM LEWIS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating and fostering an environment focused on equality, empowerment and respect. We strive to create an inclusive workplace that supports and celebrates our diversity. We continue to invest in our efforts to ensure that TEAM LEWIS is a place where everyone can thrive.
  
  
TEAM LEWIS may use Orbital, our secure proprietary technology platform, to support parts of our application and interview process at various stages of your candidacy.
  
  
The company is an integrated communications agency that has gone from start-up to multi-national in a little over two decades. The company now ranks in the top 40 agencies worldwide and has 24 offices. Its success is due to a combination of factors: talented people delivering award winning campaigns; expanding client relationships into new markets or services; making strategic acquisitions. The agency, its people and client campaigns have won many prestigious awards, including Cannes Lions, Holmes Report, ICCO, PRCA and European Excellence.

description:
Job Responsibilities
  
  
1. Execute international shipping operation strategies, manage, train and assess the operation team, optimize workflows, and establish standardized operation and risk control systems.
  
  
2. Oversee end-to-end international voyage operations, resolve operational emergencies, coordinate overseas resource docking, and ensure smooth vessel operations.
  
  
3. Manage full-scale voyage cost control and fee negotiation, review operational and financial data, optimize operational strategies, and improve overall business profitability.
  
  
4. Cooperate deeply with the commercial team to support market development, project implementation and key client maintenance, and provide operational data and professional decision-making suggestions.
  
  
5. Manage the review and filing of voyage documents, settle and collect freight and demurrage fees, maintain accurate ERP system data, and control financial risks.
  
  
6. Keep updated with international maritime regulations, ensure full business compliance, cooperate with the legal team to handle operational disputes and insurance claims, and implement proactive risk prevention measures.
  
  
7. Undertake other strategic, business upgrading and system development tasks assigned by management.
  
  
Job Requirements
  
  
1. Bachelor’s degree or above in Shipping, International Trade, English or related majors, with proficient knowledge of end-to-end international shipping business and industry practices.
  
  
2. Over 4 years of international shipping operation experience including at least 1 year of team management experience, with solid capabilities in cost control, process optimization and commercial collaboration.
  
  
3. Fluent in English for independent overseas business communication, adaptable to cross-timezone work, with excellent stress resistance, data review and risk prediction capabilities.
  
  
4. Proficient in shipping ERP systems with high professional integrity; candidates with relevant working experience in large ship-owning companies are preferred.
  
  
Xingtong Shipping Co., Ltd. (“the Company”) was founded in December 1997 with a registered capital of 325 million Yuan, mainly engaged in overseas shipping of bulk liquid dangerous cargoes, and was listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange On March 24, 2022, with the stock code 603209. The Company is a Vice Director Unit of the Chemical Transportation Committee of China Shipowners' Association, a Vice President Unit of the Dangerous Chemical Logistics Branch of China Federation of Logistics & Purchasing, a Vice President Unit of Fujian Shipowners' Association, a President Unit of Quanzhou Shipowners' Association, and one of the three leading shipping enterprises in Fujian Province.
  
  
The Company is committed to becoming a "world-class, domestic leading chemical supply chain integrated service provider". According to the "1+2+1" strategic development plan, the company continues to deepen its main business, continue to improve quality, reduce costs and increase efficiency, with the main line of expanding and strengthening the domestic coastal liquid cargo dangerous goods transportation business, with the development of clean energy transportation and participation in international shipping as the two wings, and the building of a digital platform as the help, to transform to a comprehensive chemical supply chain provider and achieve high-quality development.

title: Area Director - Recurring Customer Success Subscriptions
description:
**Who You Are**
---------------

You are a strategic, self-directed, and highly motivated leader with a proven track record of building and scaling high-performing teams in a subscription-based business model. You excel at building and maintaining executive-level relationships and are a natural communicator at all levels of an organization. With exceptional leadership and problem-solving abilities, you strategically balance customer outcomes, team growth, and business objectives. You are a “trusted advisor” at heart, adept at managing dynamic priorities, assessing risk, and creatively resolving complex challenges to ensure long-term customer success and value realization.

  

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

As an Area Director, you will be a key leader in launching and scaling a new strategic line of business centered on recurring advisory and managed subscriptions. You will own a significant and growing ARR portfolio, transforming how we deliver continuous value to our customers through a “white glove” subscription service.

  

* **First 90 Days:** You will establish the operational framework for this new subscription-based offering, defining the delivery model, key performance indicators (KPIs), and engagement processes. Working with tenured leaders, you will master the business and sales motions, taking accountability for the end-to-end client experience.
* **First Year:** You will be fully responsible for the program’s P&L, including service delivery, customer satisfaction (CSAT), net revenue retention (NRR), and team management. You will act as a key escalation point and a strategic advisor to your customers, peers, and team members, fostering a culture of professional growth and goal achievement.

  

**Duties and Responsibilities**
-------------------------------

* **Strategic Program Leadership:** Lead the strategy and execution for the new subscription offering, defining responsibilities and processes to ensure a seamless and high-value client experience.
* **Subscription & Financial Oversight:** Oversee the P&L of the program, with a primary focus on gross and net revenue retention, profitability, and customer lifetime value.
* **Advisory Subscription Delivery:** Ensure advisory and recurring subscription are delivered effectively, driving measurable outcomes and value realization for customers.
* **Commercial Partnership:** Partner cross-functionally with Sales, owning the subscription portion of deals, including C-level presentations, RFP responses, and proposal/SOW generation for recurring revenue opportunities.
* **Customer Relationship Management:** Serve as the senior executive sponsor for key customer relationships within the portfolio, acting as the primary point of contact for strategic guidance and escalations.
* **Growth Identification:** Proactively identify and cultivate opportunities for expanding the recurring subscription footprint, driving both customer success and SailPoint revenue growth.
* **Team Leadership & Development:** Manage the team's performance, including staffing decisions, utilization, performance reviews, and career development. Actively coach and mentor team members, guiding them in career development through regular feedback and support. Coach direct reports on managing customer health, identifying risks, and executing renewal and expansion strategies. Participate in recruiting and development activities to build a world-class team with the right mix of advisory, technical, and commercial skills.
* **Executive Reporting:** Provide strategic updates on portfolio performance, customer health, and revenue forecasts to SailPoint senior leadership.
* **Autonomous Identity Advisory:** Guide enterprise customers through the maturity curve from static, manual identity management to AI-driven, autonomous identity governance.
* **Agentic Value Realization:** Drive customer adoption and measurable ROI for SailPoint's advanced AI, machine-learning, and automated capabilities, helping customers build trust in automated decision-making and agentic workflows.
* **Machine & Agent Identity Strategy:** Advise C-level executives on best practices and frameworks for securing and governing non-human identities, including AI agents, service accounts, and automated bots.
* **Internal AI & Agentic Enablement:** Champion the use of AI and agentic tools within the Customer Success team to automate low-leverage tasks, predict account health risks, and scale “white glove” service delivery efficiently.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

* 10+ years of professional experience at a Software/SaaS or technology consulting company.
* 5+ years of direct people management experience, preferably leading customer success, professional services, or account management teams.
* Proven experience managing a P&L and driving key SaaS metrics (e.g., ARR, NRR, Gross Margin).
* Demonstrated experience with account management duties (health scoring, renewal strategy, risk mitigation, and executive relationship management).
* Exceptional mentorship skills with a passion for continuous improvement and team development.
* Outstanding communication and presentation skills, with extensive experience working with C-level executives.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities, with a history of managing complex customer engagements.
* **Emerging Tech Fluency:** Familiarity with AI-driven enterprise software, autonomous workflows, and the unique security challenges of machine/agent identity governance.
* **Change Management:** Proven ability to drive change management within large organizations, specifically helping them transition to AI-assisted or fully autonomous operational models.

  

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience (Technical degree or MBA is a plus).
* CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional is a plus)
* CISM (Certified Information Security Manager is a plus)
* CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional is a plus)

title: Product Design Engineer
description:
Business overview
  
  
Volex is a global leader in integrated manufacturing and a trusted supplier of power products. With expertise in cable assemblies, data center connectivity, electric vehicle charging, and consumer electronics, we serve a diverse range of markets worldwide.
  
  
Headquartered in the UK, we operate 28 manufacturing locations and employ over 14,000 people across 25 countries. Our business spans five divisions: Complex Industrial Technology, Consumer Electricals, Electric Vehicles, Medical, and Off-Highway/Specialist Automotive.
  
  
Our products power everything from everyday household devices to advanced medical equipment. Through our local sales teams and authorized partners, we deliver innovative solutions to OEMs and EMS companies around the globe.
  
  
Job Role / Job Overview
  
  
Product Design Engineer role is based on-site in Singapore and reports to the Product Engineering/Product Safety Director. The incumbent will lead the end-to-end development of next-generation interconnect solutions for consumer electronics and domestic appliance applications. This role is responsible for conceptualizing, designing, validating, and industrializing innovative connector and cable-related products that set new benchmarks in performance and manufacturability. The position requires strong technical expertise, hands-on problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate closely with cross functional teams and customers to ensure timely and successful project delivery.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Lead product design activities from concept generation through to production release.
  
  
Conduct detailed design reviews, feasibility studies, and engineering analyses to ensure robust and manufacturable solutions.
  
  
Drive design discussions with customers, gather technical requirements, and present project updates.
  
  
Oversee prototype builds, sample trials, and functional testing to validate product performance.
  
  
Troubleshoot design and manufacturing issues, identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions.
  
  
Apply engineering tools such as FMEA and DOE to optimize product reliability and manufacturability.
  
  
Manage multiple projects, ensuring alignment with customer specifications, cost targets, and timelines.
  
  
Guide and mentor junior engineers within the team to enhance technical capability and project execution.
  
  
Collaborate with tooling, process, and manufacturing teams on plastic injection moulding and high-speed stamping processes.Ensure designs meet high cosmetic standards and functional requirements for engineering plastics and metal contacts/terminals.
  
  
Maintain close communication with suppliers, customers, and internal stakeholders throughout the development cycle.
  
  
Education & Certifications
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  
  
Knowledge in FMEA and Design of Experiments (DOE) required.
  
  
Technical Requirements
  
  
Minimum 5 years of experience in product development within engineering, electronics, or high-tech industries.
  
  
Experience in connector or cable design and development is highly advantageous.
  
  
Proficient in 3D CAD design software such as UG/NX, SolidWorks, Pro-E/Creo, or AutoCAD.
  
  
Strong mechanical design skills for plastic components and metal terminals used in high-speed stamping dies.
  
  
Solid understanding of engineering plastics and injection moulding processes, with ability to achieve high cosmetic and functional standards.
  
  
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
  
  
Personal Requirements
  
  
Ability to lead project teams and coordinate cross-functional efforts to meet customer requirements and timelines.
  
  
Strong sense of ownership, initiative, and attention to detail.
  
  
Effective communication and interpersonal skills; strong team player.
  
  
Languages
  
  
Fluency in English is essential as the role involves preparing technical documentation and communicating with global customers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams
  
  
Any other languages spoken will be an added advantage
  
  
Equal Opportunity Statement
  
  
Volex is committed to upholding fair, inclusive, and non-discriminatory employment practices. All employment decisions are based strictly on job-related qualifications and merit, without regard to personal characteristics unrelated to job performance. We maintain a zero-tolerance policy toward discrimination, harassment, and the use of child labour. Volex also recognises and respects the right of employees to representation and collective bargaining, and we are dedicated to fostering a safe, respectful, and empowering work environment for all.
  
  
Volex is a leading global provider of interconnect solutions and power products, servicing the telecommunications, datacoms / data-centre, industrial, consumer and medical sectors for over 100 years.
  
  
Volex's range of interconnect solutions include original-design fibre-optic, high-speed copper and radio frequency (RF) cable assemblies. Volex has design and manufacturing facilities spread across the globe, enabling flexibility in meeting customers' delivery timetable and price targets.
  
  
Our solutions are used in many high-tech products and services vital to modern life: communications networks, medical equipment, power generation, and everyday business and domestic equipment.
  
  
We are a well established firm and looking for dynamic, motivated, and passionate individual to join our esteem organization.
  
  
If you are looking for long-term fulfilling career with great prospects and a lot of learning opportunities.

title: Global Value and Access Manager, JAPAC
description:
Singapore Affiliate - Duo Tower

JOB ID: R-262675 LOCATION: Singapore Affiliate - Duo Tower WORK LOCATION TYPE: Remote DATE POSTED: Nov. 26, 2026 CATEGORY: Value and Access

**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

**Live**

**What you will do**

Amgen is one of the world’s leading independent biotechnology companies. For over 4 decades, Amgen has pioneered biotechnology breakthroughs, to bring state-of-the-art medicines from laboratory to the patient. Amgen has not only discovered and developed innovative human therapeutics but has invested in cutting edge manufacturing capability and support services to deliver these exciting therapies to medical teams around the world. Japan and Asia Pacific (JAPAC) is the fastest growing region in Amgen. Now we are hiring for a **Global Value and Access Manager, JAPAC based in Amgen Singapore.**

**The Team**

* The JAPAC GV&A team is part of the Global Value & Access organization, supporting markets across the JAPAC Region.
* The team reports to RVAL (Regional Value & Access Lead)/GV&A Sr. Director for JAPAC and supports a diverse set of markets, including Japan, China, Australia, South Korea, Taiwan, Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Thailand, India, Indonesia, Vietnam and the Philippines.

**The Role**

* The GV&A Manager, JAPAC will support affiliates across pricing, financial planning, access strategy, and evidence generation while helping strengthen Value & Access capabilities across local markets. The role will also contribute to regional priorities and selected global GV&A initiatives.
* Preferred location for applications: Singapore

**Live**

**What you will do**

**Key Responsibilities**

The GV&A Manager, JAPAC works across three interconnected areas: Strengthening Value & Access for local markets, contributing to impact across the JAPAC region, and leading global initiatives bringing market insights into global solutions and initiatives.

**1. Strengthen Value & Access Strategy and Capability for Local Markets:** *Provide hands-on Value & Access support to JAPAC affiliates across pricing, financial planning, access strategy, evidence generation, and capability development*

***Pricing, Contracting & Financial Planning***

* Deliver pricing analysis and translate findings into actionable recommendation
* Support country price floor setting, pricing governance process, including review of business cases and contract price reviews
* Partner with affiliates ensuring key assumptions is clearly defined, appropriately challenged during financial forecasting

***Access Strategy & Scenario Planning***

* Support robust access strategies for new launches, indication expansions, and key lifecycle events
* Support access scenario planning across pricing, eligible populations and timeline in local access dynamic and potential business implications
* Provide structured information cascading and connect relevant global and regional insights, tools, and expertise
* Support reimbursement submissions, dossier governance, and other critical access activities based on market needs

***HTA Excellence & Evidence Generation***

* Help affiliates in addressing payer and HTA questions by connecting relevant evidence, expertise and resources
* Support affiliates in identifying evidence gaps and advise evidence generation plans in collaboration with medical and relevant stakeholders.

**2. Catalyze Regional Impact:** *Extend impact beyond individual markets by connecting affiliates, identifying shared priorities, and supported targeted regional initiatives*

***Regional Decision Support***

* Support regional pricing and access analysis, business cases, CRB governance, and financial planning activities where a consolidated or cross market perspective is required
* Help synthesize market insights into clear implications and recommendations for regional stakeholders

***Support Targeted Regional Workstreams***

* Contribute regional initiatives addressing shared business or capability need in JAPAC
* Support RVAL in identifying emerging regional V&A needs and mobilizing targeted expertise and resources.

***Enable Cross-Market Learning and strengthen JAPAC V&A Community***

* Facilitate peer exchange of successful approaches, challenges and lessons across JAPAC
* Support regional V&A meetings, workshops, training that strengthen connectivity and capability across the JAPAC V&A community.

**3. Advance Global Solutions:** *Bring JAPAC market insights into GV&A leading key global initiatives*

***Contribute to global CoE (Centers of Excellence) and TF (Task Forces)***

* Contribute and own selected global CoE, task forces, and strategic initiatives based on priorities and expertise
* Bring JAPAC market perspectives and implementation experience into global solution development

***Connect Country Insights with Global Solutions***

* Surface affiliate needs, access challenges, and market learnings to inform global strategies and solutions
* Translate relevant global tools (i.e., ACT) into practical application across JAPAC, helping affiliates understand and adopt solutions that can strengthen local execution

**Win**

**What we expect of you**

**Essential Qualifications/Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in pharmacy, Business, Finance, Economics, Life Sciences, or a related field
* 5+ years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical pricing, market access, finance, commercial analytics, or a related function
* Strong analytical capability, with experience translating complex pricing and market data into clear business insights and recommendations
* Strong strategic and critical thinking skills, with the ability to connect market insights, access dynamics, and business considerations; challenge assumptions; and develop practical solutions to complex V&A challenges
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders and influence across functions
* Strong project management skills, with a structured approach and the ability to manage multiple priorities
* High attention to detail, accuracy, and quality
* Fluency in written and spoken English

**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience in pricing operations, business analytics, or financial planning within the pharmaceutical industry
* Knowledge of HTA and health economics, including their application to market access and reimbursement
* Understanding of pharmaceutical pricing, reimbursement, and access environments
* Proficiency with relevant systems and analytical tools, including strong Excel and PowerPoint skills
* Demonstrated ability to proactively identify emerging issues, assess business implications, and recommend appropriate actions
* Strong project management and communication skills, with the ability to manage priorities effectively.

**Thrive**

**What you can expect of us**

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, so we work to care for our teammates’ professional and personal growth and well-being

* Vast opportunities to learn and move up and across our global organization
* Diverse and inclusive community of belonging, where teammates are empowered to bring ideas to the table and act
* Generous Total Rewards Plan comprising health, finance and wealth, work/life balance, and career benefits

Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.
