title: Director, Solution Engineer
description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.
  
  
When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing
  
  
Why We Have This Role
  
  
Our pre-sales team helps some of the largest organizations in the world find and close experience gaps with the Qualtrics XM Data & AI Platform, which combines experience management (XM) data with artificial intelligence (AI) to predict what comes next and act on it.
  
  
As a Director of Solution Engineering, you and your team will partner with our Sales Teams on our largest and most strategic opportunities to win both the technical decision and the business case. You bring the product depth to show what the platform can do and the strategic perspective to help executives decide what to do with it. While most of your efforts will be focused in the pre-sales environment, some of the additional cross-functional initiatives may include input in product direction, content generation, contributing to analyst reports/relationships and attending marketing events.
  
  
How You’ll Find Success
  
  
Earning trust with Account Executives and Sales leaders as their go-to partner on deal strategy and execution.
  
  
Becoming a trusted advisor and strategic partner to customer executives, helping them build their XM vision and a roadmap toward the art of the possible.
  
  
Building and showcasing world-class product demonstrations to highlight the value of Qualtrics products in unique, compelling and creative ways.
  
  
Winning the technical decision and the business case on complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
  
  
Contributing to team outcomes, including win rate, pipeline, net new annual recurring revenue (ARR), customer satisfaction and strategy for key accounts.
  
  
Raising the bar for the team by sharing what works and helping your peers grow.
  
  
How You’ll Grow
  
  
Learning the full XM platform, including customer experience, employee experience and market research, and the AI capabilities that connect them.
  
  
Deepen your expertise in AI and data and shape how customers apply them to business outcomes.
  
  
Build influence with Product and Marketing by bringing field insight into product direction and go-to-market strategy.
  
  
Grow as a leader through mentoring, deal coaching and cross-functional initiatives, with a career action plan built alongside your manager.
  
  
As we build an AI-first company and change the market for Experience Management, you will be at the cutting edge of this transformation in enterprise software.
  
  
Things You’ll Do
  
  
Lead a team of Solution Engineers
  
  
Set high level strategy for the Solution Engineering department across the APJ region and collaborate across senior leadership to execute that strategy
  
  
Establish and monitor key performance indicators for the Solution Engineering Department
  
  
Review, implement, and maintain the hiring strategy for the Solution Engineering team in close partnership with the People team to maximize growth
  
  
Drive the adoption of Qualtrics solutions within strategic accounts, expanding usage across departments within the enterprise. Translate product/technical features into value drivers.
  
  
Work collaboratively with Product Management, Marketing and Engineering during the development, launch and continuing refinement of existing and new Qualtrics products.
  
  
Develop/maintain technical and business knowledge of industry directions and trends
  
  
Participate in the completion of RFPs/RFIs and various requirement documents during the prospect/customer vendor evaluation process.
  
  
What We’re Looking For On Your Resume
  
  
7+ years of prior Sales/Solutions Engineering, or Solution Architect experience with complex software in a SaaS/Cloud environment, selling to C/VP level buyers
  
  
Outstanding professional, sales, and technical capabilities; comfortable supporting both enterprise (field) and inside sales teams on targeted accounts
  
  
Ability to explain and resolve common technical aspects of SaaS software, including security, protocols for APIs, SLAs, email/communication specifications, etc.
  
  
Ability to see and present 'the big picture', architect solutions to solve customer problems, and uncover business challenges and develop custom solutions to solve them
  
  
Demonstrated excellent customer facing verbal and written communication skills: needs analysis, positioning, business justification, and closing techniques.
  
  
Experience in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL a plus
  
  
Experience and familiarity with contact centers and voice of the customer programs
  
  
Experience and familiarity with AI and Large Language Models
  
  
Previous work in Customer and/or Employee Experience software and systems, including pre or post-sales support
  
  
Our Team’s Favourite Perks and Benefits
  
  
Comprehensive total rewards package including base salary, incentives, and generous benefits.
  
  
Private health insurance with extensive coverage.
  
  
Quarterly Wellness Stipend to support physical and mental well-being.
  
  
Office perks including lunch allowances and well-stocked kitchens (Singapore office) and flexible work options.
  
  
Opportunities for ongoing learning and career growth within a global, category-defining company.
  
  
**The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model:** Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organisational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #hybrid
  
  
At Qualtrics, our mission is to close experience gaps—the costly differences between what customers and employees expect, and what they’re receiving.
  
  
8,500+ organizations worldwide and more than 3/4 of the Fortune 100 rely on the Qualtrics Experience Management Platform™ to collect, analyze, and act on feedback—more feedback than they ever thought possible. With Qualtrics XM, organizations can manage the four core experiences of business—customer, employee, product, and brand experience. Organizations can be at every meaningful touchpoint, for every experience, and predict what will resonate most with customers and employees.

description:

**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.**

Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.

**Senior Director, Packaging Engineering**

  
  

**Job Summary**

The Senior Director, Packaging Engineering provides global technical, organizational, and execution leadership for semiconductor package development, New Product Introduction (NPI), qualification, low-volume manufacturing (LVM), and transition to high-volume manufacturing (HVM).

This role leads the development and deployment of packaging technologies, including **wire bond and flip chip interconnects**, ensuring alignment with product roadmaps and customer requirements for quality, reliability, cost, manufacturability, capacity, and time-to-market. The leader will drive technical excellence across a global, multi-site engineering organization while partnering closely with Product Development, Business Units, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Test, Equipment, Materials, and external manufacturing partners.

  
  

**Main Responsibilities**

* **Set the global packaging engineering strategy and technology roadmap**, aligning package architectures, assembly technologies, materials, equipment, and engineering capabilities with future product and business requirements.
* **Lead package technology development and deployment** across products and manufacturing locations, including technical risk assessment, characterization, design of experiments (DOE), process-window development, reliability assessment, and technology qualification.
* **Drive end-to-end NPI and qualification execution**, from package design and technical risk assessment through qualification, LVM, first-volume ramp, and HVM transfer, with a focus on on-time and first-pass qualification.
* **Provide technical leadership for product and process integration** across die, package, materials, equipment, assembly processes, reliability, and manufacturing, driving robust process capability, yield learning, defect reduction, and manufacturing controls.
* **Ensure manufacturing readiness and global technology transfer**, including mature process recipes, specifications, tooling, materials, equipment, metrology, control plans, and engineering documentation before deployment to captive and OSAT manufacturing locations.
* **Partner with Business Units, Product Development, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Test, and external partners** to resolve critical technical challenges and balance performance, schedule, cost, capacity, supply resilience, and time-to-market.
* **Build and lead a high-performing global engineering organization**, developing leadership and technical talent, strengthening succession pipelines, and driving common engineering standards, best-known methods, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement across sites.
  

  

**Other & AI Responsibilities**

* Drive operational excellence and value engineering across packaging yield, quality, reliability, cycle time, productivity, cost, equipment utilization, standardization, and supply resilience.
* Champion appropriate use of **AI-assisted engineering, analytics, and productivity tools** to improve decision-making, engineering effectiveness, technical problem-solving, and execution while ensuring responsible use in accordance with organizational, security, and legal requirements.
* **Lead AI-enabled transformation within the organization**, identifying opportunities to simplify engineering workflows, accelerate analysis and learning, improve productivity, and scale effective solutions across the global engineering network.

**Candidate Profile / Job Requirements**

Minimum Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Semiconductor Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* **15+ years of relevant semiconductor packaging, assembly, product/process integration, or manufacturing engineering experience**, including significant technical and organizational leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated experience leading technologies or products through **development, NPI, qualification, LVM, and HVM**, including global or multi-site deployment.

Must-Have Technical Capabilities

* Deep expertise in semiconductor packaging and assembly technologies, including **wire bond and/or flip chip**, package/process integration, materials, equipment, qualification, reliability, yield, and manufacturing.
* Strong knowledge of engineering methods including technical risk assessment, DOE, process characterization, SPC/FDC, process controls, failure analysis, reliability engineering, and yield improvement.
* Proven ability to develop and deploy packaging technologies within complex, global semiconductor manufacturing environments, including collaboration with captive manufacturing and OSAT partners.

Leadership & Business Capabilities

* Demonstrated ability to lead through senior leaders and technical experts across large, geographically distributed engineering organizations.
* Strong strategic thinking, executive communication, decision-making, and stakeholder influence across technical, manufacturing, quality, product, supply chain, and business organizations.
* Proven ability to develop engineering talent and succession pipelines while establishing a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, accountability, innovation, and execution.

AI & Digital Fluency

* Demonstrated digital fluency and ability to **lead responsible adoption of AI-enabled capabilities** to improve engineering productivity, problem-solving, knowledge sharing, decision-making, and business outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

* Master’s degree or PhD in a relevant engineering or technical discipline.
* Broad experience with advanced packaging technologies, global manufacturing networks, technology proliferation, or semiconductor memory products.
* Experience driving major technology, organizational, manufacturing, or digital transformation initiatives at enterprise scale.
  

  

**Micron Values -** Demonstrate leadership consistent with Micron’s values:

title: Corporate Planning & Management, Global Procurement – Strategic Sourcing, Executive Director, Singapore
description:
**Corporate Planning & Management, Global Procurement – Strategic Sourcing, Executive Director, Singapore**

  

**Divisional Overview**

The Corporate Planning & Management (CPM) division integrates financial planning, spend management, third-party risk management to support strategic decisions across the firm.

**Finance & Planning** drives business planning, budgeting, and analytics across revenue, expense, liquidity, and capital. The pillar includes divisional CFOs providing strategic finance advisory, Product Finance managing non-compensation expense governance, and Corporate Insurance & Advisory overseeing the firm's insurance needs and risk mitigation.

**Global Procurement** strategically manages third-party engagement, optimizing value and mitigating risks across the supply chain. Key functions include Strategic Sourcing, Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), Procure to Pay (P2P), Travel, and Sustainable Operations driving ESG initiatives.

**Product & Reporting** manages the product lifecycle for CPM technology platforms and delivers comprehensive reporting, dashboards, and analytics. The team oversees financial planning and analysis systems, spend management tools, and TPRM solutions while providing stakeholders with actionable insights for evidence-based decisions.

**CPM Management** provides strategic oversight, operational support, communications and change management, and risk governance across the division.

  

**Role Overview**

Professionals in CPM have an analytical mindset, exhibit intellectual curiosity, and are from diverse academic backgrounds. This role sits within Global Procurement.

  

The role requires collaboration with different functions across the firm on a regular basis, an ability to work independently, and frequent interaction with senior stakeholders. It also entails in-depth analysis and reporting for senior management, requiring diligence and a commercial mindset. The candidate is required to work closely with global counterparts and should have excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  

The role requires a highly motivated and commercially astute Strategic Sourcing buyer to join our Strategic Sourcing team. In an increasingly AI-enabled sourcing environment, this role is critical in driving strategic value, optimizing spend, leading negotiations with suppliers, and fostering robust supplier relationships. The successful candidate will leverage cutting-edge AI tools and data analytics to inform sourcing strategies, manage complex categories, and influence key stakeholders across the business. This position offers an excellent opportunity for a professional to grow their career in a forward-thinking and impactful procurement function.

  

Spend categories in scope include but are not limited to both Technology Sourcing (Hardware, Software, Telecom, Cloud Services, Professional Services) and Corporate Services/Non-Tech Sourcing (Real Estate, Human Resources, Marketing, Professional Services).

  

Role based in Singapore.

  

**Job responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:**

* **Strategic Sourcing & Category Management:**
  + Support development and execution of category strategies aligned with organizational objectives, leveraging market insights and AI-driven analytics to identify opportunities for cost savings, value creation, and risk mitigation.
  + Conduct in-depth spend analysis and market research, utilizing AI tools to uncover patterns, forecast demand, and inform strategic sourcing decisions.
  + Manage the full sourcing lifecycle, including supplier selection, RFx processes, contract negotiation and partner with business owners on the implementation, and ongoing performance management.
  + Incorporate total cost of ownership into negotiation strategies and drive continuous improvement within assigned categories.
  + Support compliance to the Firmwide Third Party Risk and Control Framework and associated programs
  + Engage with Risk Partners across the organization (e.g., compliance, legal, technology), as needed to manage risks and drive resolution of Strategic Sourcing issues
* **Stakeholder Management & Influence:**
  + Serve as a primary point of contact and strategic advisor for assigned business partners, translating business goals and risk appetite into effective sourcing strategies.
  + Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders across various departments (e.g., Finance, IT, Legal, Operations) to ensure cross-functional alignment and successful strategy execution.
  + Facilitate cross-functional alignment and provide executive updates, gaining consensus among diverse stakeholders through clear and compelling communication.
  + Influence decision-making and drive strategy alignment by presenting data-driven insights and recommendations to leadership.
* **Commercial Acumen & Negotiation:**
  + Demonstrate strong commercial acumen, understanding cost structures, licensing models, contract terms, and financial levers to drive value-based procurement decisions.
  + Lead and support negotiations with suppliers to secure optimal pricing, terms, and innovation while preserving long-term strategic relationships.
  + Analyse complex procurement challenges, synthesize data, evaluate trade-offs, and develop sound, objective recommendations that balance business needs, risk and commercials.
  + Liaise with legal teams to draft and negotiate contract terms while ensuring appropriate contract structures, pricing models, vendor incentive models, service level agreements and performance indicators are applied consistently across vendors
  + Monitor market dynamics, including consumer preferences, industry trends, and regulatory changes, adjusting category strategies accordingly.
* **AI-Enabled Sourcing Environment:**
  + Actively leverage AI to support understanding of spend, supplier performance, risk monitoring, and contract intelligence.
  + Utilize AI-driven insights to optimize purchasing decisions, manage risks, and enhance supplier collaboration and innovation.
  + Embrace and adapt to new AI tools and technologies that streamline procurement processes, from demand forecasting to automated contract analysis.

**Competencies:**

* **Functional Expertise** – Understanding of strategic procurement, category management approach and procurement value proposition
* **Strategic Mindset** – Abilityto effectively create category strategies and influence key stakeholders on sourcing decisions. Needs to clearly understand and articulate the Procurement value proposition and demonstrate clear strategic thinking / intent. Ability to analyze complex problems, develop innovative solutions, and contribute to long-term strategic planning.
* **Technical Skills** – Demonstrate strong technical skills required for the role including project management, supply chain management, sourcing and procurement and financial/analytical skills.
* **Drive and Motivation** – Successfully handles multiple tasks, operates at pace, takes initiative to improve his/her own performance, works resiliently towards challenging goals, persisting in the face of obstacles.
* **Client and Business Focus** – Strong stakeholder engagement skills. Effectively handles difficult requests, builds trust, long-term relationships with clients, helps the client to identify/define needs and manages client/business expectations
* **Teamwork** – Is a strong team player by collaborating with others within and across teams, encouraging other team members to participate and contribute and acknowledging others' contributions
* **Technology Adoption**: Embraces and adapts to new AI tools and technologies that streamline procurement processes, from demand forecasting to automated contract analysis.
  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelors / Post Graduation;
* Minimum 8 years’ experience in Strategic Souring and Category management, particularity in the indirect spend with a preference in corporate services sourcing
* Experience of Sourcing procure to pay tools (Ariba, Fieldglass, PMweb)

title: Senior Compliance Specialist
description:
AtriCure, Inc. provides innovative technologies for the treatment of Afib and related conditions. Afib affects more than 33 million people worldwide. Electrophysiologists and cardiothoracic surgeons around the globe use AtriCure technologies for the treatment of Afib and reduction of Afib related complications. AtriCure's Isolator® Synergy™ Ablation System is the first medical device to receive FDA approval for the treatment of persistent Afib. AtriCure's AtriClip® Left Atrial Appendage Exclusion System products are the most widely sold LAA management devices worldwide. AtriCure's Hybrid AF™ Therapy is a minimally invasive procedure that provides a lasting solution for long-standing persistent Afib patients. AtriCure's cryoICE cryoSPHERE® probe is cleared for temporary ablation of peripheral nerves to block pain, providing pain relief in cardiac and thoracic procedures. For more information, visit AtriCure.com or follow us on Twitter @AtriCure.

We foster a culture of inclusion by embracing diverse experiences and individuals where everyone's authentic self is welcome. We offer supporting programs and resources that provide enriching and equitable opportunities for each person to contribute professionally and personally.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The APAC Senior Compliance Specialist supports the regional implementation, roll-out and continuous improvement of the global compliance and privacy program across the Asia Pacific region. The role provides regional support and subject-matter expertise to strategic global compliance projects, core governance processes, and high-risk monitoring programs.

The global compliance program covers anti-corruption, health care compliance, Health Care Professional (HCP) interactions, ethical business practices, transparency reporting, medical device promotion, and privacy and data protection. The position acts as a primary point of contact to cross-functional leaders, drives program governance, and provides peer guidance, coaching, and direction on regional compliance matters drawing on prior knowledge of regional health care compliance and ethical business practices.

The role works closely with members of the Global Compliance Team, both the International Compliance team and the Global Operations team in the US and will partner with business functions in the identification and solution of compliance and privacy issues. The role reports directly to the Director of International Compliance and Global Privacy. The preferred base location for the position is Hong Kong or Singapore; other locations may be considered depending on experience.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF THE POSITION:**

* Assist in the implementation, roll out, and continuous improvement of the global compliance and privacy program across APAC (currently 10 geographies), to promote compliance with local laws, industry best practices and support business needs while maintaining global compliance standard processes.
* Operate day-to-day regional compliance matters and escalate significant risks or complex issues to the Director of International Compliance and Global Privacy.
* Support the deployment of the compliance program with guidance and support from the Global Compliance Team (International & US) while retaining responsibility for APAC field roll out and follow-through.
* Apply prior knowledge of APAC compliance requirements and local business practices to identify regional risks, advise stakeholders, and translate global policies into practical and effective local controls and procedures.
* Develop regional dashboards and reports that communicate key risks, monitoring results, emerging trends by geography (number is expected to increase), and remediation status to regional leadership and the global compliance team.
* Monitor compliance requirements for HCP engagements, sponsorships, congresses, educational events, research and innovation forums, and marketing activities.
* Localize, where needed, compliance policies, standards, and operating procedures for APAC geographies in coordination with Global Operations team, documenting local requirements and escalating conflicts with global compliance company standards.
* Work on compliance education and practical guidance; adapt global materials for APAC audiences and languages and assist with the development and implementation of compliance training to employees and third parties and ultimately being responsible for the administration and monitoring of the compliance awareness program.
* Support several compliance initiatives, including monitoring of transparency disclosures and related legal requirements across the regional markets and assisting in data collection for these requirements.
* Act as a practical business partner who helps teams find compliant ways forward, offering timely advice and workable alternatives while maintaining clear compliance standards.
* Provide compliance and data privacy general guidance and support to internal business partners.
* Provide general support to the global compliance team as needed.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, compliance, legal studies, finance, or a related field and at least 7 years of relevant experience, or an advanced degree and at least 5 years of relevant experience.
* Proven hands-on experience in health care compliance in APAC markets, with a strong understanding of local business practices and industry codes of ethics and guidelines, such as JFMDA and AdvaMed China.
* Experience in either medical devices, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, or another highly regulated industry; experience with HCP engagement oversight, grants, investigator-sponsored research, privacy, or data protection; and experience designing employee education curricula and measuring training effectiveness.
* Communicate fluently in Mandarin and English, explain complex requirements clearly, present findings and recommendations, influence stakeholders, and facilitate training. Japanese language skills are preferred.
* Proven hands-on experience in health care compliance in APAC markets and able to work independently.

title: Director of Operations
description:
**Job Summary:**  
The job holder provides strategic and operational leadership for the operations portfolio of The Institution of Engineers, Singapore (IES), translating organisational priorities into effective plans, coordinated delivery and measurable outcomes. Reporting to the Executive Director, the Director (Operations) is one of two Directors in IES, alongside the Director (Corporate Services), and leads operational delivery, professional programmes, registries, major events, member services, service excellence and process improvement.
  
  
The Director works closely with the Executive Director, the Director (Corporate Services), departments, committees and external stakeholders to strengthen cross-functional coordination and ensure the successful delivery of IES programmes and services. The Director (Operations) leads and develops the operations team, promotes an accountable and outcome-driven culture, and works collaboratively with Corporate Services to secure the resources, systems and support required for effective operational delivery.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities (but, not limited to):**  
Strategic and Organisational Operations
  
  
(a)
  
  
Partner the Executive Director, the Director (Corporate Services) and relevant department heads to translate IES strategy and annual priorities into coordinated operating plans, milestones and departmental deliverables for the operations portfolio.
  
  
(b)
  
  
Provide oversight of day-to-day delivery within the operations portfolio, resolve operational dependencies and coordinate with the Director (Corporate Services) where support from finance, HR, IT, corporate communications, facilities or governance secretariat functions is required.
  
  

* Establish an outcome-based operating rhythm with clear ownership, service standards, dashboards and regular performance reviews.
* Identify operational risks, bottlenecks and improvement opportunities, and recommend practical, sustainable solutions to management.

2. Operational Governance, Risk and Compliance
  
  
(a)
  
  
Ensure operational policies, standard operating procedures, delegated authorities and records within the operations portfolio are current, consistently applied and aligned with IES governance requirements.
  
  
(b)
  
  
Prepare timely, accurate and complete operational inputs, reports and follow-up actions for relevant Council, Exco, Chartered Engineering Board and committee meetings, for coordination and meeting support by the Director (Corporate Services) and the respective secretariat.
  
  
(c)
  
  
Manage operational risks, business continuity requirements and incident response within the operations portfolio, and implement relevant internal or external audit recommendations in coordination with the Director (Corporate Services).
  
  
(d)
  
  
Maintain operational compliance with applicable legislation, funding conditions, contractual obligations and programme requirements, working with the Director (Corporate Services) on data protection, workplace safety, records management and other corporate compliance matters.
  
  
3. Operational Excellence and Digital Transformation
  
  

* Lead the review, standardisation and digitisation of end-to-end workflows to improve productivity, control, turnaround time and stakeholder experience.
* Define operational requirements and lead user adoption and benefits realisation for systems supporting the operations portfolio, in partnership with the Director (Corporate Services), who oversees information technology, access controls and technology governance.
* Develop reliable management information and performance dashboards to enable evidence-based decisions and early intervention.
* Promote responsible use of automation and AI-enabled tools, with appropriate controls for data quality, privacy, security and human oversight.

4. Cross-Functional Coordination and Resource Planning
  
  

* Identify and prioritise the people, financial, technology, communications, facility and administrative support required for operational delivery, and coordinate these requirements with the Director (Corporate Services).
* Develop operating and project budget requirements, monitor expenditure and performance within approved allocations, and work with the Director (Corporate Services) on financial planning, controls, procurement and contract administration.
* Specify operational service levels and promptly escalate facility, system or resource issues to the Director (Corporate Services), who has functional oversight of the relevant support services.
* Contribute operational requirements and performance feedback for vendors supporting programmes, registries and events, while procurement governance, contracting and vendor administration remain under Corporate Services.

5. Programme, Registry and Event Delivery Oversight
  
  

* Provide operational oversight and coordination for assigned professional registries, skills initiatives, membership services, programmes and major IES events, while respecting the authority of relevant Boards and committees.
* Ensure applications, renewals, assessments, CPD matters, committee approvals, databases, websites, payments and annual reports are administered accurately and within agreed timelines.
* Strengthen project governance through approved scopes, budgets, schedules, risk controls, stakeholder plans, post-event reviews and documented lessons learned.
* Lead operational planning and cross-department coordination for major events such as the Annual General Meeting, World Engineers Summit, National Engineers Day and other institutional programmes, with Corporate Services providing finance, HR, IT, corporate communications, facilities and meeting-secretariat support as applicable.

6. Stakeholder, Member and Service Excellence
  
  

* Build trusted working relationships with members, volunteers, committee leaders, government agencies, Institutes of Higher Learning, industry and strategic partners.
* Set service standards and escalation protocols, monitor stakeholder feedback and ensure complaints or service failures are resolved promptly and professionally.
* Represent IES at meetings and engagements as delegated by the Executive Director, and follow through on institutional commitments.
* Ensure operational information and content supplied by the operations portfolio are accurate and timely, and coordinate publication and external messaging with the Director (Corporate Services), who oversees corporate communications.

7. People Leadership and Organisational Capability
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop a collaborative, accountable and service-oriented operations team with clear goals, roles and performance expectations.
* Build workforce capability through succession planning, cross-training, knowledge management and targeted professional development.
* Promote open communication, psychological safety, ethical conduct and disciplined follow-through across reporting lines.
* Plan workforce capacity for peak periods and major programmes, and support change management to embed new processes and systems.

8. Operational Budget and Performance Accountability
  
  

* Prepare operating and project budget proposals, forecasts and resource plans for the operations portfolio; monitor approved expenditure and take timely corrective action in consultation with the Director (Corporate Services).
* Monitor agreed key performance indicators covering service quality, timeliness, productivity, compliance, budget, stakeholder satisfaction and improvement outcomes.
* Submit concise and accurate management reports, highlighting achievements, emerging risks, decisions required and recovery actions.

**Other Related Matters:**  

* Attend Council, Exco, Management, Chartered Engineering Board and committee meetings as required to provide operational updates and advice; provide papers and follow-up actions to the relevant Corporate Services secretariat for meeting administration.
* Any other related duties assigned by the Executive Director.

**Qualifications and Experience:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Operations Management or a related discipline; a relevant postgraduate qualification is advantageous.
* At least 10–15 years of relevant experience, including a minimum of 8 years in a senior leadership role overseeing multidisciplinary operations, professional programmes, registries, member services or major events.
* Demonstrated experience in strategy execution, operational excellence, programme or project management, service delivery, stakeholder management, process improvement and organisational change.
* Experience in a professional body, membership organisation, Trade Association and Chamber, non-profit organisation, public agency or education and training environment is advantageous.
* A recognised qualification in project management, process improvement, risk management or change management is advantageous.

**Required Competencies / Skills:**  

* Strategic and systems thinking, with the ability to convert institutional priorities into coordinated execution.
* Strong people leadership, judgement and decision-making, with the confidence to manage competing priorities and difficult issues.
* High standards of integrity, governance awareness, confidentiality and accountability.
* Strong analytical and financial acumen, with disciplined attention to detail and risk.
* Excellent stakeholder engagement, negotiation, facilitation, presentation and written communication skills.
* Digitally fluent and comfortable leading process redesign, system implementation, data-driven management and responsible adoption of AI-enabled tools.
* Member and service-oriented, adaptable, resourceful and calm under pressure.
* Able to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic environment, including after office hours or on weekends when required for major events or urgent operational matters.

The Institution of Engineers, Singapore was formally established on July 1966 as the national society of engineers in Singapore. IES is the premier engineering Institution in Singapore and is often called upon by the Government to provide feedback on professional engineering matters.
  
  
IES is well represented among the faculty members of the major engineering institutions of higher learning in Singapore. Through close collaboration with the local universities and polytechnics, IES organises courses, seminars and talks for engineers and IES members to advance the continuous development of engineers.
  
  
The Institution maintains close links with professional organisations of engineers regionally and throughout the world. These include organisations in Australia, China, Japan, United Kingdom and the United States. The Institution also represents Singapore in the World Federation of Engineering Organisations (WFEO), ASEAN Federation of Engineering Organisations (AFEO) and the Federation of Engineering Institutions of Asia and the Pacific (FEIAP) in promoting goodwill and fellowship among all engineers in the region and internationally.
  
  
Through its Engineering Accreditation Board (EAB), IES obtained full signatory status in the Washington Accord (WA) in June 2006. The entry grants IES the authority to represent Singapore, the first country within the ASEAN region which has obtained full signatory status in the WA, to vet education systems under the WA mutual recognition framework.
  
  
To raise the technical competencies of engineers in Singapore and promote engineering to the community, IES has introduced the Chartered Engineer Programme, World Engineers Summit and National Engineers Day.
  
  
IES will not rest on its laurels and will seek to bring the engineering profession greater recognition and raise the status of engineers both locally and internationally through closer collaboration with its stakeholders and contributions to society.

description:
Job Purpose
  
  
The Deputy Head, Activity Hub works in close partnership with the Head of Activity Hub to drive the strategic direction, operational excellence, and clinical governance of the centre. The role shares operational leadership with the Head, overseeing day-to-day multidisciplinary rehabilitative services, staff supervision, enterprise initiatives, and regulatory compliance, while deputizing in the Head’s absence.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  
1.Strategic Leadership & Operational Partnership
  
  
Partner closely with the Head of Activity Hub to set operational goals, evaluate service quality, and align centre workflows with organizational strategy.
  
  
Deputize for the Head in administration, management committee meetings, and external liaison when required.

title: Workplace Manager, Singapore
description:
We are looking for an experienced and energetic people leader to take ownership of the workplace operation for our Singapore office, while also providing local leadership across our Personal and Team Assistant teams. This is much more than keeping an office running smoothly - it is an opportunity to lead across a multidisciplinary support environment, raise service standards, create clear accountability, and shape an environment where people can perform at their best.

  

You will be highly visible across the office and work closely with the Heads of Office, partners, fee earners, and regional and global support teams. We are looking for someone who brings energy, sound judgement, and leadership presence, who builds strong relationships while being confident enough to challenge, make decisions, and move things forward.

Most importantly, you will enjoy leading people. You will set clear expectations, develop capability, recognise great performance and address issues when standards are not being met. You will bring people with you through change, encourage ownership, and create a positive, collaborative culture where high standards are understood and consistently delivered.

  

**What you'll lead**

  

You will have broad responsibility for the Singapore workplace and business support operation, including:

* Leading and developing the local Workplace & Facilities team, with clear accountability for performance, development, service standards, leave, and operational coverage.
* Leading workplace and facilities operations, suppliers, contractors, building-management relationships, budgets, and day-to-day operational risk.
* Leading Reception, hospitality, meeting-room, and client-facing services to deliver an excellent experience for colleagues, clients, and visitors.
* Providing local people leadership to our PA and Team Assistant teams, including objectives, performance, development, coaching, leave, and coverage.
* Overseeing PA/TA workloads, resource allocation, and service delivery, ensuring support is deployed effectively and transparently in line with the wider APAC operating model.
* Building trusted relationships with the Heads of Office, partners, and senior stakeholders, and confidently navigating competing priorities and perspectives.
* Establishing clear service expectations across different support functions and addressing performance, capability, or relationship issues when they arise.
* Taking ownership of operational issues and ensuring they are resolved effectively, escalating thoughtfully rather than simply passing problems on.
* Managing workplace budgets and supplier performance, continually looking for opportunities to improve service, efficiency, and value.
* Leading workplace improvements, office projects, and new ways of working from idea through to implementation, and contributing to regional projects where required.
* Supporting business resilience, health & safety, and other critical operational requirements.
* Using feedback, data, and management information to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Working closely with regional functional leaders and global teams so that Singapore operates consistently with Firm-wide standards while responding effectively to local requirements.

**What we're looking for**

  

We are particularly interested in proven people leaders. You will already have substantial experience directly managing and developing people and ideally experience leading multidisciplinary teams or different service functions.

  

You will be comfortable:

* setting expectations and holding people accountable
* coaching and developing different personalities and levels of experience
* managing performance, conduct, conflict and difficult conversations
* leading different teams while creating a consistent and collaborative culture
* leading people through change and bringing them with you
* making decisions and exercising sound judgement without needing constant direction
* influencing senior stakeholders and constructively challenging when appropriate
* balancing competing operational, stakeholder, and people priorities
* managing workloads and resources effectively
identifying opportunities for improvement and having the energy to make them happen  

You are likely to have strong experience in workplace, facilities, office operations, business support, hospitality, or another service-led corporate environment. Experience within professional services or an international organisation would be particularly valuable.

Just as importantly, you will be visible, approachable, resilient, and solutions-focused. You'll know when to listen, when to coach, when to challenge and when to make the call.

You'll bring strong organisation and attention to detail, excellent written and verbal English communication skills, and the confidence to operate effectively with people at every level of the business.

  

**Why this role?**

  

You'll be joining a business where our workplace and support teams play an important role in how our people connect, collaborate, and serve our clients. You'll have the opportunity to make the operation your own, develop capable teams, and directly influence how support is delivered across the Singapore office.

  

If you are an experienced people leader who enjoys bringing structure to complexity, developing people, improving how things work, and creating an environment where teams can succeed, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Vice President, IT Service Management (ITSM) Leader (Job ID:10081090)
description:
The IT Service Management (ITSM) Leader is responsible for governing and continuously improving IT service delivery across the organization. This role provides leadership for key ITSM processes, including Incident Management, Major Incident Management, and Problem Management, ensuring operational effectiveness, service stability, and business continuity.
  
  
The role ensures IT services are delivered efficiently, risks are proactively managed, service disruptions are minimized, and continuous improvements are implemented in alignment with ITIL best practices and organizational objectives.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  
1. ITSM Governance & Strategy
  
  
Develop, implement, and maintain ITSM policies, standards, procedures, and governance frameworks.
  
  
Establish and monitor Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Operational Level Agreements (OLAs), and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  
  
Ensure alignment with ITIL, ISO 20000, and organizational requirements.
  
  
Drive ITSM maturity improvement and service excellence initiatives.
  
  
2. Incident Management
  
  
Lead the Incident Management process to ensure timely restoration of IT services.
  
  
Coordinate technical and business stakeholders during service disruptions.
  
  
Facilitate Major Incident Management Meetings (MIMMs) and provide regular status updates.
  
  
Ensure incidents are recorded, tracked, escalated, and resolved according to defined service levels.
  
  
3. Problem Management
  
  
Analyze recurring incidents and service failures to identify underlying root causes.
  
  
Assign and coordinate with Problem Owners to drive resolution activities.
  
  
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and post-incident reviews.
  
  
Implement corrective and preventive measures to reduce future incidents.
  
  
4. Service Performance Monitoring & Reporting
  
  
Define, monitor, and report service metrics and operational performance indicators.
  
  
Prepare management reports and dashboards for governance forums.
  
  
Analyze trends, risks, and opportunities for service improvement.
  
  
Ensure accurate and complete service data is maintained for reporting and audit purposes
  
  
5. Continuous Service Improvement
  
  
Conduct ITSM process reviews and maturity assessments.
  
  
Identify opportunities to improve processes, tools, and service quality.
  
  
Recommend and implement process enhancements and automation initiatives.
  
  
Drive lessons learned and knowledge-sharing activities across teams.
  
  
6. Stakeholder & Branch Support
  
  
Develop and maintain strong relationships with business and technology stakeholders.
  
  
Support regional branches in adopting ITSM processes, procedures, and tools.
  
  
Provide guidance, training, and awareness on ITSM best practices.
  
  
Respond to inquiries, reporting requests, audits, and regulatory requirements from management, Head Office, and local authorities.
  
  
7. Leadership & People Development
  
  
Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams during operational and service recovery activities.
  
  
Coach and mentor team members and branch ITSM practitioners.
  
  
Promote collaboration, knowledge sharing, and operational excellence.
  
  
Act as a role model and ensure compliance with company policies and standards.
  
  
Job Requirements
  
  
:
  
  
Minimum of 8 years’ experience in IT Service Management (ITSM), with service operations and governance experience.
  
  
Demonstrated experience of the ITIL framework and industry best practices for IT Service Management.
  
  
Proven experience in managing key ITSM processes, including Incident Management, Major Incident Management, Problem Management, and Service Improvement initiatives.
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex IT service issues, identify root causes, and develop effective solutions.
  
  
Experience in monitoring service performance and leveraging metrics, KPIs, and trend analysis to drive continuous service improvements.
  
  
Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders across all organizational levels.
  
  
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, coordinate, and build relationships across business and technology teams.
  
  
Ability to prioritize and manage multiple activities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment while maintaining service quality and operational stability.
  
  
Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL Foundation/Managing Professional or equivalent certifications are highly desirable.
  
  
We regret to inform that only shortlisted applicants will be notified.
