We are convinced that only by fulfilling our social responsibilities can we truly be excellent corporate citizens.

title: CHIEF OPERATING OFFICER
description:
To lead and oversee GD Precision’s overallmanufacturing and operational activities in the precision engineering industry,ensuring operational efficiency, productivity, product quality, on-timedelivery, cost competitiveness and sustainable business growth.
  
  
The COO is responsible for translating theCompany’s business objectives into operational strategies and execution plans;optimising the use of production capacity, manpower, machinery and otherresources; strengthening management capabilities; and ensuring compliance withCompany policies, approved SOPs, quality requirements, workplace safetystandards and applicable laws and regulations.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
A. Overall Operations Management
  
  
1. Lead and oversee GD Precision’s manufacturing and operationalfunctions, including CNC machining, production planning, engineering, quality,maintenance, stores/warehouse and other supporting functions.
  
  
2. Develop and implement operational strategies, annual operating plans, production targets and performance improvement initiatives aligned with the Company’s business objectives.
  
  
3. Ensure effective coordination across departments to achieve customer requirements, production schedules, quality standards and delivery commitments.
  
  
4. Monitor key operational performance indicators, identify gaps and ensure timely corrective and preventive actions.
  
  
5. Identify operational bottlenecks, capacity constraints, process inefficiencies and business risks, and drive practical solutions.
  
  
6. Provide regular operational reports, analysis and recommendations to the Managing Director.
  
  
B. Production & Manufacturing Management
  
  
7. Oversee production planning, scheduling, job allocation, workflow management and capacity utilisation for CNC machining and other manufacturing processes.
  
  
8. Ensure production output meets customer drawings, specifications, approved processes, quality requirements and delivery schedules.
  
  
9. Monitor machine utilisation, production output, cycle time, setup time, downtime, labour productivity, scrap, rejection and rework.
  
  
10. Ensure effective utilisation of CNC machines, tooling, fixtures, cutting tools, raw materials, consumables and production manpower.
  
  
11. Review production capacity and manpower requirements against customer demand, sales forecasts and confirmed orders.
  
  
12. Ensure production processes, work instructions, machine-setting practices and process parameters are properly established and followed.
  
  
13. Work with Production and Engineering teams to resolve machining issues, production delays, programming constraints and recurring process problems.
  
  
14. Ensure proper control of work-in-progress, job priorities and production status reporting.
  
  
C. Engineering, Process Development & TechnicalSupport
  
  
15. Oversee engineering and process development activities, including drawing review, manufacturability assessment, process planning, routing and production method selection.
  
  
16. Ensure appropriate development and control of CNC programmes, machining processes, tooling, jigs, fixtures and setup documentation.
  
  
17. Review technical feasibility, production capacity, material requirements, estimated cycle time and process risks for new and existing jobs.
  
  
18. Work with Sales/Customer Service and Engineering teams on new enquiries, quotations, new product introduction and customer engineering changes.
  
  
19. Drive process optimisation toimprove machining accuracy, cycle time, productivity, material utilisation and manufacturing cost.
  
  
20. Promote the effective use of automation, digitalisation, manufacturing systems and appropriate technology to improve operational performance.
  
  
D. Quality Management & Customer Satisfaction
  
  
21. Ensure products and manufacturing processes consistently meet customer drawings, specifications, quality standards and contractual requirements.
  
  
22. Work closely with Quality to strengthen incoming, in-process and final inspection, process controls, measurement systems and product traceability.
  
  
23. Monitor customer complaints, non-conformities, rejection rates, scrap, rework and quality-related operational losses.
  
  
24. Ensure timely investigation, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and prevention of recurring quality issues.
  
  
25. Support customer audits, supplier/customer quality reviews and relevant quality management system audits.
  
  
26. Ensure appropriate control and maintenance of measuring equipment, inspection records and quality documentation.
  
  
27. Promote quality ownership and accountability across all manufacturing and supporting departments.
  
  
E. Operational Financial Performance & Cost Control
  
  
28. Take accountability for operational performance and contribute to the Company’s profitability and financial objectives.
  
  
29. Work closely with Finance to prepare and monitor operating budgets, production costs, manpower costs and departmental performance.
  
  
30. Monitor material costs, labourand overtime costs, tooling and consumable usage, machine running costs,utilities, subcontracting costs and other operating expenses.
  
  
31. Review job costing, actual production performance and cost variances, and implement improvement actions where required.
  
  
32. Identify and implement cost-reduction initiatives without compromising product quality, workplace safety or customer requirements.
  
  
33. Minimise material wastage, scrap, rework, excessive setup time, machine idle time and avoidable operating expenses.
  
  
34. Evaluate capital expenditure requirements for machinery, tooling, automation and facility improvements, and submit proposals with appropriate justification and expected returns.
  
  
F. Equipment, Maintenance & Facility Management
  
  
35. Oversee the reliability, availability and performance of CNC machines, production equipment, measuring equipment and supporting facilities.
  
  
36. Ensure preventive maintenance programmes are implemented and monitored to minimise breakdowns and unplanned downtime.
  
  
37. Review machine utilisation, maintenance costs, equipment condition and replacement or upgrading requirements.
  
  
38. Ensure production machinery, electrical systems, compressed-air systems and workplace facilities are maintained in safe and operational condition.
  
  
39. Coordinate with Engineering and Maintenance teams to resolve technical issues affecting production and product quality.
  
  
40. Identify opportunities to improve equipment reliability, machine capability, automation and overall manufacturing efficiency.
  
  
G. Manpower Management & Leadership
  
  
41. Lead, manage and develop Production, Engineering, Quality, Maintenance and other operational managers and team leaders.
  
  
42. Establish clear departmental responsibilities, reporting structures, performance expectations and accountability.
  
  
43. Work with HR to develop manpower plans, recruitment priorities, skills development, technical training and workforce productivity initiatives.
  
  
44. Ensure adequate skilled manpower is available to meet production and business requirements, including succession and cross-training plans.
  
  
45. Monitor manpower productivity, overtime, absenteeism, employee turnover, discipline and training effectiveness.
  
  
46. Develop the leadership and technical capabilities of department heads, supervisors and key employees.
  
  
47. Promote teamwork, communication, discipline, accountability and a culture of continuous improvement.
  
  
H. Workplace Safety, Regulatory Compliance &Governance
  
  
48. Ensure operational activities comply with applicable workplace safety, health, environmental and factory-related laws and regulatory requirements.
  
  
49. Oversee the implementation of risk assessments, safe work procedures, machine safety measures, housekeeping and other preventive controls.
  
  
50. Ensure employees are appropriately trained and authorised for their assigned machinery, equipment and work activities.
  
  
51. Monitor workplace incidents, near misses, unsafe conditions and corrective action implementation.
  
  
52. Ensure proper control of materials, chemicals, waste and other regulated items where applicable to the Company’s operations.
  
  
53. Ensure departments comply with approved Company policies, SOPs, work instructions and operational standards.
  
  
54. Strengthen internal controls over production orders, inventory, raw materials, tooling, work-in-progress finished goods and delivery processes.
  
  
55. Ensure proper documentation, traceability, accountability and segregation of duties; support internal and external audits and close audit findings promptly.
  
  
56. Escalate significant operational risks, control failures, safety incidents and compliance breaches to the Managing Director.
  
  
I. Supply Chain, Inventory & Delivery Performance
  
  
57. Work with Procurement, Stores/Warehouse, Production Planning and Logistics to ensure timely availability of raw materials, tooling, spare parts and production consumables.
  
  
58. Oversee inventory control, stock accuracy, material issuing, material traceability and proper storage practices.
  
  
59. Monitor supplier and subcontractor performance in relation to quality, cost, lead time and delivery reliability.
  
  
60. Ensure coordination of production schedules, subcontracting activities and delivery arrangements to meet customer commitments.
  
  
61. Identify supply chain risks and implement appropriate mitigation plans for critical materials, suppliers and production requirements.
  
  
J. Continuous Improvement & Business DevelopmentSupport
  
  
62. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, quality, delivery performance, cost competitiveness and operational profitability.
  
  
63. Implement Lean Manufacturing,5S, waste reduction, standardisation and other suitable operational excellence practices.
  
  
64. Review operational processes and identify opportunities for automation, digitalisation, improved production monitoring and data-driven decision-making.
  
  
65. Support Sales and Customer Service in assessing production capacity, technical feasibility, costing, leadtime and delivery commitments.
  
  
66. Provide operational input for new customer requirements, new product introduction, process development and expansion of manufacturing capabilities.
  
  
67. Support factory expansion, machinery investment, capacity enhancement and strategic operational projects.
  
  
68. Ensure improvement initiativeshave measurable objectives, clear ownership and sustainable business benefits.
  
  
JOB REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS
  
  
A. Education & Professional Qualification
  
  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechatronics, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management or a related discipline.
* A Master’s Degree in Business Administration (MBA) or a relevant management qualification would be anadvantage.
* Professional qualifications or training in Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Operational Excellence, Quality Management or Project Management would be advantageous.

B. Working Experience
  
  

* Preferably 15 years or more ofrelevant experience in precision engineering, CNC machining or manufacturing operations.
* At least 5–8 years ofexperience in a senior operational management or leadership position.
* Proven experience managing manufacturing operations, production teams, engineering activities and operational performance.
* Experience in CNC machining, precision components, machining processes or related manufacturing industries would be highly preferred.
* Demonstrated track record inimproving productivity, product quality, delivery performance and operational profitability.
* Experience in production planning, capacity and manpower planning, job costing, budgeting and cost control.
* Experience in managing machinery investment, process improvement, automation or manufacturing expansion projects.

C. Technical & Functional Competencies
  
  

* Strong understanding of precision engineering and manufacturing operations, particularly CNC machining and production planning.
* Good understanding of engineering drawings, machining processes, CNC programming and setup, tooling, fixtures and process capability.
* Understanding of quality management systems, inspection methods, measurement equipment and customer quality requirements.
* Strong knowledge of production costing, job profitability, operational budgets and performance analysis.
* Understanding of machine safety, workplace safety requirements and applicable environmental controls.
* Knowledge of inventory management, material planning, procurement and supply chain coordination.
* Experience with ERP/MRPsystems, production reporting and operational performance dashboards would bean advantage.
* Ability to establish andimplement operational SOPs, internal controls and continuous improvemen tinitiatives.

D. Leadership & Management Competencies
  
  

* Strong leadership, strategic thinking, decision-making and execution capabilities.
* Excellent analytical,problem-solving and operational management skills.
* Strong commercial awareness andbusiness acumen, with a focus on cost, quality and delivery.
* Ability to lead, motivate anddevelop cross-functional management teams and employees.
* Strong communication,negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
* High integrity, accountability and commitment to good corporate governance.
* Ability to manage change, resolve operational issues and drive measurable performance improvements.

E. Other Requirements
  
  

* Good command of English; proficiency in Mandarin and/or Bahasa Malaysia would be an advantage, depending on operational requirements.
* Ability to work collaboratively across departments and, where applicable, across the Company’s operating locations.
* Ability to respond to urgent operational issues and critical business situations when required.

GD Precision Group Plants are operating in Malaysia & Singapore. Our facilities have sophisticated machineries & fabrication to support customers’ products with flexibility & Low-Cost Manufacturing Country “MALAYSIA”.
  
  
In the exceedingly dynamic high-tech precision machining industry, it is critical for us to extend the best-in-class engineering and manufacturing services. We have the tools and the capability to machine the most complicated parts and components.
  
  
We add value to your processes with our efficient approach to inventory management and order fulfillment. We bring about a collaboration between all stakeholders in your business such as suppliers and customers, distributor, retailer, OEM, or product end user.

title: General Manager
description:
Reports to
  
  
General Committee
  
  
Responsible for
  
  
All employees, through the management team
  
  
**Appointment term:**  
Contract appointment for an initial two-year term, with the option to extend for a further one year.
  
  
The General Manager leads the Club’s management team and is accountable for operational performance, member experience, staff development and financial sustainability. The role combines visible leadership with sound commercial judgement, delivering measurable improvements while preserving the Club’s character and traditions. The GM develops recommendations for the General Committee (GC) and implements approved strategy within the Club’s Rules, Bye-Laws, policies, budgets and delegated authority.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
1. Strategy and governance
  
  
Work with the GC to develop the Club’s strategic priorities and annual business plan, supported by clear objectives, resource requirements and implementation timelines.
  
  
Provide timely management reports and candid advice, presenting options, financial implications and risks. Track agreed actions and escalate material issues promptly.
  
  
Coordinate routine reporting through the President in accordance with approved governance arrangements. Support Sub-Committees with information and advice, and deliver management’s agreed actions within their Terms of Reference and delegated authority. Convenors remain responsible for their committees’ work.
  
  
2. Leadership and people development
  
  
Lead and develop heads of department, set measurable objectives and hold them accountable for results. Maintain effective coordination across departments and address underperformance promptly.
  
  
Oversee workforce planning, recruitment, training and succession planning. Build a service culture based on accountability, respect, open communication and consistent standards.
  
  
Review staffing deployment and productivity against service requirements. Maintain constructive employee relations and ensure staff concerns receive fair and timely attention.
  
  
3. Operations and service quality
  
  
Direct daily operations across food and beverage, sports and recreation, events, membership services, facilities and support functions. Maintain consistent service and presentation standards throughout the Club.
  
  
Maintain a regular, visible presence across facilities and at key events. Identify service gaps, resolve recurring problems and ensure corrective actions are completed.
  
  
4. Financial and commercial management
  
  
Prepare and manage operating, cash-flow and capital budgets in accordance with the Club’s approval requirements. Monitor performance, explain variances and take timely corrective action within delegated authority.
  
  
Give the GC clear financial forecasts and recommendations supported by reliable data. Strengthen cost control, purchasing discipline and the responsible use of Club resources.
  
  
Review outlet performance, food and beverage costs, staffing productivity and facility utilisation. Recommend improvements to pricing, service delivery and programming that balance member value with financial sustainability and approved subsidy policies.
  
  
Assess revenue opportunities for their contribution, resource requirements and effect on member experience. Maintain adequate planning for asset renewal and future operating needs.
  
  
5. Member experience and communications
  
  
Build constructive relationships with members across different ages, interests and backgrounds. Seek feedback actively and use it to improve services, activities and facilities.
  
  
Ensure complaints are handled fairly, consistently and promptly. Exercise sound judgement in sensitive situations and apply the Club’s Rules and policies impartially.
  
  
Work with the management team and relevant committees to strengthen participation, membership retention and the appeal of the Club to families and future members.
  
  
Oversee accurate, timely member communications. Exercise discretion and confidentiality, and coordinate sensitive announcements through the appropriate approval process.
  
  
6. Facilities and capital projects
  
  
Ensure buildings, equipment and facilities are safe, well maintained and presented to the expected standard. Maintain preventive maintenance schedules and prioritised plans for repair and replacement.
  
  
Develop business cases for capital expenditure, including costs, benefits, alternatives and operational impact. Deliver approved projects to agreed scope, budget and timelines, with appropriate procurement and contractor oversight.
  
  
7. Controls and risk management
  
  
Maintain effective operational controls and compliance with applicable laws, licences, the Club’s Rules and Bye-Laws, and approved policies. Ensure that audit findings and control weaknesses are addressed promptly.
  
  
Oversee health and safety, food safety, security, insurance and emergency preparedness. Maintain incident reporting and business continuity arrangements, and escalate significant risks to the GC.
  
  
Ensure appropriate protection of personal data, confidential information and Club systems. Improve the use of technology and management information where it strengthens service, efficiency or decision-making.
  
  
Maintain accurate records of material decisions, contracts and management actions. Exercise delegated authority responsibly and obtain approval for matters outside that authority.
  
  
Working arrangements
  
  
Five-day work week, scheduled according to operational requirements, generally including
  
  
one weekend day
  
  
.
  
  
Flexibility to work either Saturday or Sunday, depending on Club activities and operational needs.
  
  
Attendance at significant Club events, including those held in the evenings, with the work schedule adjusted accordingly.
  
  
Occasional full weekends off may be arranged in coordination with the Senior Management Team to ensure appropriate management coverage.
  
  
Candidate profile
  
  
Essential experience and capabilities
  
  
Substantial senior leadership experience in a private members’ club or a comparable hotel, resort or hospitality operation, with responsibility across multiple departments and for overall financial performance.
  
  
A demonstrated record of improving service quality and operating results, developing managers and implementing organisational change. Accomplished deputy GMs or equivalent leaders with suitable breadth of responsibility will be considered.
  
  
Strong financial literacy and practical understanding of budgets, forecasts, food and beverage operations, staffing productivity and capital expenditure.
  
  
Ability to work constructively with an elected committee and volunteer office-bearers, understand a member-owned club’s priorities and maintain clear boundaries between governance and management.
  
  
Sound judgement, personal integrity and discretion, with the confidence to give candid professional advice and take ownership of agreed decisions and results.
  
  
Strong written and verbal communication, interpersonal and conflict-resolution skills, with sensitivity to an international membership and a diverse workforce.
  
  
A relevant degree or professional qualification, or equivalent experience demonstrating the capabilities required for the role.
  
  
Desirable experience
  
  
Leadership experience in a private members’ club, particularly one with substantial dining, sports, recreation and social activities.
  
  
Experience in Singapore or a comparable Asian hospitality environment, and familiarity with local operating requirements.
  
  
Experience delivering capital projects or modernising operational systems, and relevant professional membership or club management certification.
  
  
First year priorities
  
  
The GM will agree detailed objectives and targets with the GC following an initial assessment of the Club’s operations. Priorities will include:
  
  
Within the first 90 days, assess service standards, financial performance, management capability and operational risks, and present a prioritised improvement plan with clear ownership and milestones.
  
  
Establish departmental objectives and a concise monthly performance report, with reliable data and consistent follow-through on agreed actions.
  
  
Deliver approved improvements in food and beverage performance, staffing deployment, member experience and the use of facilities.
  
  
Strengthen the management team, address significant control or maintenance gaps and progress approved projects against agreed milestones.
  
  
Performance assessment
  
  
Performance will be assessed against objectives agreed with the GC, covering member satisfaction and participation, financial results, service standards, staff capability and retention, project delivery and the resolution of material risks. Targets will reflect the Club’s approved budgets, service commitments and subsidy policies, with regular progress reviews.
  
  
Founded in 1865, the Tanglin Club is Singapore’s leading private members’ club with members from more than 60 countries. The Club offers a diverse range of social and sporting amenities in the exclusive Claymore district, along with reciprocal partnerships with over 130 outstanding private members’ clubs throughout the world. The Club is also listed in the Top 100 of the Platinum City Clubs of the World 2022-23, which represents the finest clubs in the world that demonstrate excellence in all aspects of their operations. As part of a Great Place to Work®-Certified organisation, you will join an environment that values creativity, ownership, and excellence in execution.

title: Executive, Group Hospitality Services(10645)
description:
Overview
  
  
Reporting to the linen contract manager (CM), you’ll be involved in exciting projects that will directly impact how we work and support our colleagues. You will handle data insights to streamline operations, improve the quality of our service, manage vendor relationships, and overall ensure we run a smoother and more purposeful operation – all while contributing towards impactful work with meaningful outcomes for our colleagues and patients.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  
You will be responsible for the following
  
  
:
  
  
Oversee the management and execution of hospitality service contracts
  
  
Work collaboratively with service partner(s) to strengthen service delivery, coordination and continuous improvement
  
  
Identify service risks, gaps or performance issues and implement timely corrective actions
  
  
Implement initiatives that enhance service quality, operational efficiency and resource utilisation
  
  
Managing onsite vendor’s staff
  
  
Supervising in-house linen attendants
  
  
Managing linen inventory
  
  
Verification of vendors’ documentation (e.g. KPI reports, invoices, FTE)
  
  
Conduct random ground inspections on linen delivered to wards/clinics
  
  
Prompt follow up on inter-department feedback or requests
  
  
Requirements
  
  
Degree in any field
  
  
Minimum 2 years work experience, preferably in healthcare setting
  
  
Self-motivated and able to take initiative at work
  
  
Able to resonate with colleagues of all levels (e.g. linen health attendants, department head)
  
  
Good analytical and organisation skills for the purpose of streamlining operations rooted on data-driven decisions
  
  
About the NATIONAL UNIVERSITY HOSPITAL
  
  
The National University Hospital is a tertiary hospital and major referral centre with over 50 medical, surgical and dental specialties, offering a comprehensive suite of specialist care for adults, women and children. It is the only public hospital in Singapore to offer a paediatric kidney and liver transplant programme, in addition to kidney, liver and pancreas transplantation for adults.
  
  
The Hospital was opened on 24 June 1985 as Singapore’s first restructured hospital. Each year, the Hospital attends to more than one million patients.
  
  
As an academic health institution, patient safety and good clinical outcomes are the focus of the Hospital. It plays a key role in the training of doctors, nurses, allied health and other healthcare professionals. Translational research is pivotal in the Hospital’s three-pronged focus, and paves the way for new cures and treatment.
  
  
A member of the National University Health System, it is the principal teaching hospital of the NUS Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine and the NUS Faculty of Dentistry.
  
  
For more information, visit
  
  
www.nuh.com.sg

title: Head, Corporate Service
description:
Roles & Responsibilities

The Head, Corporate Services is a key member of AMP’s management team, contributing significantly to AMP’s leadership by shaping organisational priorities, strengtheningcross-functional collaboration and shared accountability, and fostering a cohesive and inclusive management culture across AMP and its entities.

The Head provides strategic leadership and oversight of AMP’s corporate functions, including Corporate Communications, Branding, and Digital Marketing, Finance, Technology and Facilities Management, ensuring alignment with the organisation’s mission, strategic priorities, and governance requirements.

The role drives organisational effectiveness through financial stewardship, technology enablement, operational excellence, brand management, and stakeholder communications. The Head is responsible for developing corporate capabilities, optimising resources, managing risks, and strengthening systems, processes, and infrastructure to support AMP’s growth and long-term sustainability.

**MAIN DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Corporate Strategy, Governance and Organisational Excellence**

a) Develop and implement corporate services strategies, plans, and frameworks to support AMP’s mission, strategic priorities, and organisational objectives.

b) Lead the development and review of corporate policies, governance frameworks, and operating guidelines to strengthen organisational effectiveness, accountability, and compliance.

c) Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, service quality, and stakeholder experience across corporate functions.

d) Provide strategic advice and recommendations to Management on corporate services matters, emerging trends, risks, and organisational priorities.

**2. Finance, Risk and Resource Stewardship**

a) Provide oversight of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation to ensure financial sustainability and prudent stewardship of organisational resources.

b) Lead the development and implementation of risk management, internal controls, and compliance frameworks to safeguard organisational assets and reputation.

c) Oversee financial governance, procurement, and funding utilisation to ensure compliance with regulatory, audit, and donor requirements.

d) Monitor organisational performance and resource utilisation to support informed decision-making and effective resource deployment.

**3. Technology, Infrastructure and Business Continuity**

a) Lead the development and execution of technology and digital transformation strategies to enhance organisational effectiveness, productivity, service delivery, and stakeholder experience.

b) Oversee the management of technology infrastructure, cybersecurity, enterprise systems, and digital platforms to support operational resilience, innovation, and organisational growth.

c) Drive the adoption of emerging technologies and digital solutions to improve business processes, data-driven decision-making, and operational efficiency.

d) Develop and oversee infrastructure strategies and asset management plans to ensure the organisation’s facilities, systems, workplaces, and resources remain sustainable, scalable, and aligned with current and future operational needs.

e) Provide strategic oversight of facilities management, workplace operations, space planning, maintenance programmes, and vendor partnerships to ensure safe, efficient, and fit-for-purpose environments.

f) Lead infrastructure enhancement and workplace transformation initiatives to optimise resource utilisation, improve employee experience, and support organisational growth and service delivery.

g) Establish and maintain business continuity, disaster recovery, workplace safety, and crisis management frameworks to safeguard organisational operations, assets, and stakeholders.

**4. Corporate Communications and Branding and Digital Marketing**

a) Lead the development and execution of AMP’s corporate communications, branding, and digital marketing strategies to strengthen organisational visibility, reputation, and stakeholder engagement.

b) Oversee brand governance and the consistent application of AMP’s brand identity across all communication channels and platforms.

c) Direct strategic communications, media relations, public engagement, and digital outreach initiatives to support organisational objectives.

d) Monitor communication effectiveness and stakeholder sentiments to strengthen AMP’s positioning and public profile.

**5. Stakeholder Management**

a) Build and maintain strategic relationships with government agencies, regulators, vendors, and other stakeholders to advance organisational objectives.

b) Lead workforce planning, talent development, and capability-building initiatives across corporate services functions in AMP Group to strengthen organisational performance.

c) Foster shared service collaboration across divisions and subsidiaries to ensure effective service delivery and alignment with organisational priorities.

d) Champion a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, service excellence, and accountability across corporate services functions.

**6. Leadership and People Management**

a) Provide leadership and direction to corporate services teams to achieve organisational goals and operational excellence.

b) Promote employee engagement, collaboration, and a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

c) Lead change management initiatives to support organisational transformation and strategic priorities.

**7. Develop Organisational Capability for Service Delivery**

a) Drive capability development strategies to strengthen the division’s professional competencies, leadership bench strength, and service delivery capabilities.

b) Assess current and future workforce capability requirements and establish capability-building priorities to support the division’s strategic objectives and evolving service needs.

c) Lead the development and implementation of learning, talent, and succession plans to ensure organisational readiness and sustainability.

d) Cultivate a high-performance and continuous learning culture that promotes professional excellence, innovation, and service effectiveness.

e) Strengthen leadership and management capabilities across the division to enhance organisational resilience, employee engagement, and operational performance.

f) Champion workforce planning and talent development initiatives to ensure the division is equipped with the skills and expertise required to meet current and future service demands.

**SECONDARY DUTIES**

a) Participate in inter-divisional project committees and render support to other department events as and when required.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Information Technology, Communications, Marketing, Facilities Management, Public Administration, or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification is an advantage.

* Minimum 10 years of progressive leadership experience in corporate services, shared services, operations, or a related function, with experience overseeing multiple corporate functions.

* Proven track record in leading and managing corporate services portfolios, including Finance, Technology, Facilities Management, Corporate Communications, Branding, and Digital Marketing.

* Experience in strategic planning, organisational governance, risk management, resource optimisation, and operational excellence.

* Experience working with senior management, Boards, auditors, regulators, and external stakeholders.

* Proven ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams, drive organisational performance, and build strategic partnerships.

To apply, click here.

title: Deputy Director, Systems & Support Centre
description:
**[What the role is]**

The Deputy Director leads the Systems & Support Department, comprising the Systems & Data Branch, Procurement Support Branch, and Store & Registry Support Branch. The Department provides the systems, data, financial, procurement, exhibit-management and investigation-records capabilities supporting the Enforcement Group.
  
  
The role is accountable for the Department's strategy, governance, organisational performance and capability development. The Deputy Director leads the three Branch Heads, aligns resources and support services with operational priorities, and provides executive oversight of major technology programmes, procurement and budget management, vendor-supported services, seizure-store operations and investigation-records management.
  
  
The officer works closely with senior management, operational divisions, corporate functions, technology teams and service providers to manage organisational risks, resolve cross-functional issues and strengthen the effectiveness and resilience of the Enforcement Group's enabling capabilities.

**[What you will be working on]**

* Lead the Systems & Support Department and provide strategic direction to its three Branches, ensuring alignment with the Enforcement Group’s priorities and operational requirements.
* Establish the Department’s operating model, governance framework, performance expectations and capability-development priorities, and hold Branch Heads accountable for delivery.
* Integrate systems, data, finance, procurement, exhibit-management and investigation-records functions into a coherent and responsive support model.
* Provide executive oversight of major technology and transformation programmes, ensuring that investments deliver integrated, secure and operationally effective solutions.
* Oversee the Department’s budget, procurement and resource-planning functions, ensuring effective prioritisation, sound governance and value-for-money outcomes.
* Provide strategic oversight of seizure-store and investigation-records operations, ensuring effective accountability, security, traceability and business continuity.
* Establish Department-wide risk, performance and reporting arrangements, and advise senior management on significant delivery issues, control gaps, resource pressures and investment needs.
* Provide senior oversight of vendors and service providers, ensuring that contractual arrangements, service standards and escalation mechanisms support operational requirements.
* Drive process improvement and digitalisation across the Department to strengthen efficiency, visibility, controls and service delivery.
* Lead workforce planning, succession planning and capability development across the Centre’s technical, operational and corporate-support functions.
* Build effective partnerships with operational divisions, corporate functions and external stakeholders, and resolve issues that cut across Branch or organisational boundaries.
* Represent the Department in senior management, technology, procurement, governance, audit and cross-divisional forums

**[What we are looking for]**

* Background in any discipline. Relevant qualifications in information technology, operations management, business administration, procurement, finance, logistics or a related field would be an advantage.
* Substantial leadership experience in a complex operational, technology, regulatory or corporate-support environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary functions and senior managers across several specialised portfolios.
* Strong strategic leadership and organisational-management capabilities, with the ability to integrate diverse functions into a coherent operating model.
* Experience overseeing major technology, transformation, procurement, resource-management or operational-support programmes.
* Strong governance, risk-management and performance-management orientation, with the ability to balance operational needs with accountability and control requirements.
* Sound judgement and analytical ability, particularly in prioritising investments, managing organisational risks and resolving complex cross-functional issues.
* Strong stakeholder-management and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively with senior management, operational leaders, corporate functions and service providers.
* Excellent communication and people-leadership skills, including the ability to develop senior officers and build sustainable organisational capability.
  

  

The successful candidate will be offered a 1-year contract (with option for automatic renewal for a further one year) in the first instance.

  
  

Shortlisted candidates would be contacted within 30 days from the closing date of the advertisement. We regret that only shortlisted candidates would be notified.

title: Senior Manager - IT (Applications)
description:
Summary
  
  
The Head of Application IT Service Operations is responsible for the end-to-end stability, performance, and continuous improvement of the organization's business-critical applications in production. This role owns the operational lifecycle of applications post-go-live — incident, problem, and change management — ensuring service levels are met, risks are proactively managed, and the application landscape supports business objectives reliably and efficiently.
  
  
This is a senior leadership role that bridges business stakeholders, application development/vendor teams, and in frastructure operations to deliver a seamless, high-quality service experience.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Service Operations & Delivery
  
  

* Own overall accountability for application availability, performance, and stability across the enterprise application portfolio (ERP, CRM, FP&A/CPM, and other line-of-business systems)
* Establish and manage IT Service Management (ITSM)processes: incident, problem, change, release, and configuration management ,aligned to ITIL best practices
* Define, track, and report on SLAs/OLAs/KPIs with application vendors, managed service providers, and internal teams
* Drive root-cause analysis and permanent resolution for recurring or high-severity incidents

Team & Vendor Leadership
  
  

* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing application support organization (internal staff and outsourced/managed service partners)
* Manage relationships with internal and external application vendors and system integrators, including contract performance, escalations, and roadmap alignment
* Establish an effective on-call/escalation model for24x7 critical application support where required

Governance, Risk & Compliance
  
  

* Ensure application operations comply with relevant regulatory, data residency, security, and audit requirements
* Own disaster recovery and business continuity planning for in-scope applications, including regular DR testing
* Maintain application support documentation, run books, and knowledge management standards

Continuous Improvement & Strategy
  
  

* Drive automation and self-service initiatives to reduce manual effort and improve mean-time-to-resolution (MTTR)
* Partner with Application Development/Delivery teams to ensure smooth transition of new releases and projects into steady-state operations (hypercare-to-BAU handover)
* Monitor emerging trends in AIOps, observability, and service management tooling, recommending adoption where it improves service quality
* Manage the application operations budget, including licensing, support contracts, and tooling costs

Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Act as the primary escalation point for business stakeholders on application service issues
* Provide regular service performance reporting to senior leadership (steering committees, IT leadership team)
* Chair or contribute to Change Advisory Board (CAB)meetings

Requirement
  
  

* Degree / Master in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field;
* 12+ years of progressive IT experience, with 5+ years in a leadership role managing application support/service operations teams
* Proven experience managing production support for large-scale enterprise applications (e.g., ERP such as SAP, CRM, financial planning/CPM platforms, or similar)
* Strong knowledge of ITIL framework (ITIL v4certification preferred)
* Demonstrated experience managing outsourced/managed service provider relationships and contracts
* Experience with ITSM tooling (ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, Jira Service Management, or similar)
* Track record of managing 24x7 support operations and major incident management
* Experience operating in a regulated or enterprise environment with data residency/compliance requirements is a plus
* Strong leadership and people management skills, with experience building and scaling teams
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, able to translate technical issues for business and executive audiences
* Vendor and contract management expertise
* Certifications: ITIL v4, PMP, or Six Sigma is a plus
* Experience with cloud-hosted and hybrid application environments is preferred
* Familiarity with AIOps/observability tools (Dynatrace, Splunk, Datadog, etc.) is an added advantage
* Experience in [industry-specific — e.g., financial services, manufacturing, retail] is advantageous
* Able to commute for work daily.
* Work Location: 60 Pioneer Road, Tuas
* Work Days & Time : Monday to Friday, 8am - 5.30pm

By submitting your application for this position, you consent to the collection, use, and disclosure of your personal data by ST Logistics and its recruitment partners, including Employment and Employability Institute Pte Ltd, for the purpose of i) employment facilitation and ii) data and statistical analysis. You may find out more information on the PDPA policies at [https://www.stlogs.com/pages/personal-data-policy/] and [https://www.e2i.com.sg/pdpa/].
  
  
ST Logistics is the Government Business Group and Public Sector arm of Toll Global Logistics. We specialise in total supply chain management service including freight management, contract logistics, fulfilment logistics, reverse logistics and distribution in the Defence and Government sector. With the rapid growth in our competencies, we provide a more extensive portfolio of service offerings in aviation services, public sector logistics solution and an integrated suite of services including Healthcare Supply Chain and Logistics, Occupational Health and Wellness, Clinical Service and Health Screening.

title: Senior Advisor, ESO
description:
Just imagine helping employees across Australia and Japan get every hour worked, leave entitlement and adjustments recorded accurately and compliantly.
  
  
As our Senior Advisor, you'll deliver a consistent, high-quality employee service experience across Time & Attendance as well as benefits. You'll play a key role in supporting employees and stakeholders across Australia and Japan, ensuring compliance with local legislation, resolving complex cases and helping strengthen processes and controls.
  
  
'This position is a 1-year fixed term contract with no relocation support'
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
  
Managed end-to-end Time & Attendance processes, including working hours, attendance, overtime, shift schedules and leave administration.
  
  
Resolved complex time, attendance in partnership with Hire to Retire teams and local stakeholders.
  
  
Ensured compliance with employment legislation, statutory requirements and company policies by mainly managing Australia and Japanese markets
  
  
Analysed Time & Attendance data to identify discrepancies, trends and operational improvement opportunities.
  
  
Supported process improvement, controls, automation initiatives or system enhancements within Time & Attendance and Hire to Retire Operations.
  
  
Worked in regional Hire to Retire operations with responsibility for HR policy and legislative compliance across APAC.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  
Built or maintained Power Apps solutions supporting HR service delivery or employee processes.
  
  
Supported automation initiatives for Time & Attendance, using Power Apps and familiarity with UKG and hands-on T&A operations.
  
  
Used SAP HR, Workday, Service Now or comparable Human Capital Management platforms.
  
  
Applied Japanese language skills to support employees and stakeholders in a business environment.
  
  
Japanese/Australia proficiency to understand local T&A scenarios
  
  
What you'll build
  
  
Accurate and compliant Time & Attendance administration across Australia and Japan.
  
  
Reliable inputs covering allowances, deductions and time-related adjustments.
  
  
Strong operational controls that improve data quality, accuracy and compliance.
  
  
Effective partnerships with HR teams, external vendors and local stakeholders.
  
  
Continuous improvements to Time & Attendance processes, systems and automation capabilities.
  
  
The role will need to cover the full scope but focusing more on T&A administration.
  
  
What matters most is your ability to translate legislative requirements into practical processes, investigate issues thoroughly and maintain a high standard of operational accuracy. The Employee Service Operations (ESO) works closely with payroll but does not handle payroll operations.
  
  
Life on the team
  
  
This role is part of BSO Employee Services Operations APAC, based in Singapore, delivering Hire-to-Retire services across the region, including Benefits, Time & Attendance, and Learning Administration. Australia and Japan will be the primary markets within the role's focus, with flexibility to support other APAC markets as business needs arise.
  
  
What success looks like
  
  
Success in this role means becoming a trusted specialist for Time & Attendance and Hire-to-Retire across Australia and Japan. You'll confidently navigate legislative requirements, resolve complex cases, identify opportunities to improve processes and help strengthen automation and operational efficiency. You'll work closely with external vendors and local stakeholders, ensuring employees receive a consistent and reliable service experience while contributing to the LEGO Group's continued growth ambitions.
  
  
'Candidates must have the right to work in Singapore without employer sponsorship'
  
  

* With occasional supervision, tasks are assigned with some explanation• More independently solving medium tasks with low level of support

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
  
  
What’s in it for you?
  
  
**Here is what you can expect:**  
Family Care Leave
  
  

* We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

Insurances
  
  
– All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.
  
  
Wellbeing
  
  

* We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.

Colleague Discount
  
  
– We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.
  
  
Bonus
  
  

* We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.

**Your workplace:**  
Your workplace will be the office, store or factory specified in this advert.
  
  
**Hybrid Working:**  
Our hybrid work model, Best of Both offers you the option of flexibility to work from home up to two days per week. Your People Leader will discuss the principles of the model, including how this option applies to your role and team.

title: US Service Operations Leader
description:
**Who are we?**
===============

Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.

People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.

**Why work at Howden?**

We have always been employee-owned and driven by entrepreneurial spirit. Right from the beginning, we've focused on employing talented individuals and empowering them to make a real difference to the company, whilst building successful and fulfilling careers at the same time. Simply put, we hire talented specialists and give them what they need to make a difference for clients.

Always have, always will.

People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down disappointed head- hunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work/life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.

**What is the role?**

We are seeking a **US Service Operations Leader** in remote work schedule.

**ROLE SUMMARY**

The National Field Service Operations Leader is responsible for leading and standardizing service delivery across all verticals/branches nationally, ensuring consistent, high-quality client service, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance across the Howden US Verticals. This role owns the operational performance of service teams, drives national rollout of operating standards and technology, and serves as the primary link between corporate operations strategy and on-the-ground execution. The role requires strong people leadership across a distributed workforce, a deep understanding of insurance brokerage service delivery, and the ability to balance national consistency with local market needs.

**What will you be doing?**

**US Service Operations Leadership**

* Lead field service operations across all branch/regional offices nationally, ensuring consistent execution of service standards for client onboarding, policy servicing, renewals, claims support, and day-to-day account management.
* Set the national operating model for field service delivery, balancing standardization with flexibility for regional/local market requirements.
* Matrix management of Vertical Operations Leaders the Service and service teams across multiple locations.
* Own national service-level performance, including turnaround times, service quality, client retention indicators, and issue escalation resolution.

**Performance Management & Accountability**

* Establish national KPIs and service standards for field operations; monitor performance dashboards and hold regional leaders accountable to targets.
* Conduct regular business reviews with regional/branch leadership to assess performance, identify risks, and drive corrective action.
* Manage staffing levels, workload distribution, and resource allocation across field locations to match business volume and growth.
* Lead performance management, coaching, and development of regional operations leaders and their teams.

**Process Standardization & Technology Adoption**

* Partner with Process Design/Governance, IT, and Digital teams to roll out standardized processes, workflow tools, and platforms across all field offices.
* Drive national adoption of new systems, automation, and service technology, ensuring field teams are trained and change is effectively managed.
* Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks or inconsistencies between field offices; champion best-practice sharing across regions.

**Compliance & Risk**

* Ensure field service operations comply with regulatory, licensing, E&O, and internal audit requirements across all jurisdictions served.
* Partner with Compliance and Risk teams to embed controls into field-level workflows and respond to audit findings.
* Oversee timely resolution of client complaints, service failures, and operational risk incidents at the field level.

**Stakeholder & Client Engagement**

* Act as an escalation point for significant client service issues requiring senior operational involvement.
* Partner with Sales/Producers and regional leadership to ensure operations support business growth, new client onboarding, and account retention strategies.
* Represent field operations in national leadership forums, providing visibility into field performance, risks, and improvement initiatives.

**Change Leadership**

* Lead the field-level rollout of national initiatives (M&A integrations, new product launches, technology changes, restructuring) ensuring smooth transition and minimal service disruption.
* Support workforce planning and organizational design for field operations as the business scales or restructures.

**What are we looking for?**

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Insurance, Operations Management, or related field.
* 8+ years of progressive operations leadership experience within insurance brokerage, insurance carrier, or financial services, including multi-site or multi-region management.
* Demonstrated experience managing distributed teams across multiple locations, ideally at a national or multi-regional scale.
* Strong knowledge of insurance brokerage operations (placement, servicing, claims support, renewals, compliance).
* Track record of driving standardization and performance improvement across a field/branch network.

**Preferred**

* Insurance industry licensing/designations (e.g., CPCU, CIC, or equivalent) a plus.
* Experience with brokerage management systems (e.g., Applied Epic, Sagitta, EPIC) and workflow/CRM platforms.
* Experience leading through M&A integration or large-scale organizational change.
* Lean/Six Sigma or continuous improvement training.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong people leadership skills; ability to manage and develop leaders across a dispersed, multi-site organization.
* Excellent communication and executive presence; able to translate corporate strategy into field-level execution.
* Strong analytical skills to interpret performance data and drive fact-based decisions.
* Comfortable balancing national consistency with regional/local flexibility.
* Willingness and ability to travel frequently to field locations.
* Resilient, decisive, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

**Compensation and Benefits**

The expected base salary range for this role is $195,000 - $205,000; actual base salary will be determined based on factors including candidate experience and work location. This role is classified as exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).

In addition to a competitive base salary, employees are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus. Howden also offers a variety of benefits and programs, subject to eligibility, including:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance, including healthcare savings and reimbursement accounts
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Flexible Paid Time Off and paid parental leave
* Life and Disability insurance

**Our sustainability promise**

We’re on a life-long journey to become an ever-more sustainable group. It's a commitment to taking care of our people and the world we live in, to doing good business, and to making a positive impact wherever we can. Our governance processes, company policies, and review systems are all geared towards our goal of making a positive impact in the world. You can read more about our sustainability work here.

#LI-KF1

**What do we offer in return?**
===============================

A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:

* Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new
* We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges
* We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond

**Reasonable adjustments**
==========================

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours\* or hybrid working\*.

If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.

* Not all positions can accommodate changes to working hours or locations. Reach out to your Recruitment Partner if you want to know more.

Permanent

title: Operation Coordinator - Singapore (#679)
description:
Our Core Values are at the heart of who we are, and everything we do….
  
People.
  
Planet.
  
Product.
  
Motive Offshore Group delivers trusted, multi-sector solutions across the global energy industry, combining specialist equipment rental, manufacturing, and industry-leading Testing, Inspection & Certification (TIC) services. We are committed to delivering sustainable and innovative solutions, and we require highly skilled individuals, like you, to come and be part of our journey.
  
We have many exciting opportunities globally as we rapidly expand our reach and capabilities, in particular with the low carbon and energy transition areas. We aim to assist our clients and suppliers to join us as we move into the more sustainable world.
  
Most importantly, our People are our most valuable asset here at the Motive Offshore Group. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative, and collaborative workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to achieve their full potential. We celebrate diversity in all its forms—across race, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, religion, and background—and we are dedicated to creating a culture of equity and belonging. Our hiring practices are rooted in fairness and integrity, focusing solely on an individual’s abilities, contributions, and potential. We strive to ensure that every employee and candidate feels seen, heard, and valued as they grow with us. If you want to learn about how you can #FindYourMotive with us, head to our join us page, here.
  
  
**About the role:**  
**Location:** Singapore
  
**Hours:** Full-time
  
Reporting to the Workshop Manager, the Operations Coordinator supports the efficient delivery of rental, certification and inspection activities across the APAC region. Working closely with internal teams, clients and suppliers, you will coordinate project documentation, maintain operational records, support project administration, and ensure systems and certifications remain up to date.
  
As part of a growing global business, you'll have the opportunity to work with colleagues and clients across the APAC region and beyond. This role offers exposure to a wide range of projects, the chance to develop your skills in a supportive environment, and the opportunity to play a key role in the continued growth of our Singapore operations.
  
  
**About the team:**  
You will be joining a dedicated and collaborative team, with key operations based in the APAC region. As our Motive team continues to expand, our APAC region plays an integral role in supporting the business's operations across the wider Asia region.
  
You will also be working alongside a committed and proud Motive team globally that want to play their part in the growth of the business and support each other daily to create a positive, values driven and hard-working professional environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  
People
  
Adopt and promote the Motive Offshore Group People Values and ensuring their use is embedded throughout.
  
  
Be a positive ambassador for Motive Offshore Group Ltd
  
  
Develop strong working relationships with key stakeholders – clients, colleagues etc.
  
  
Planet
  
HSEQ – compliance with health, safety and environmental regulations, and the company’s management system.
  
  
Participate in internal and external training courses where identified.
  
  
Adhere to and participate in company-wide sustainability policies, procedures and initiatives as they are developed to support our Net Zero objectives.
  
  
Product
  
Providing administrative support to the Rentals and TIC Division within the APAC region.
  
  
Ensuring records & certification within the Kinetic system remain current.
  
  
Set up Rentals and Certification & Inspection projects, taking out appropriate job numbers and assigning appropriate Motive equipment numbers.
  
  
Compile project specific documentation such as technician & equipment certification packs, project information and testing package.
  
  
Assist with completion of post work scope costing sheets.
  
  
Maintain equipment asset files identifying schedule for retesting.
  
  
Adhering to and following project related Quality Management System procedures.
  
  
Liaise with client and/or third parties as requested.
  
  
Archive project files as appropriate.
  
  
Assisting Project Managers with Maintaining Salesforce Revenue Schedules in line with project / operational timeline revisions.
  
  
Updating Asset Voice ensuring equipment line items, cost sheets and invoices are accurate.
  
  
Ensuring project timesheets for equipment and personnel are reflective of work done and in agreement with client approvals.
  
  
Ensuring monthly KPIs are up to date and the KPI owners remain accountable for their respective KPIs.
  
  
Supporting the Sales and Proposals team with logistics and 3rd party equipment costs in order to support bids and tenders.
  
  
Ensuring supplier purchase orders are receipted into the system in a timely manner.
  
  
General office duties, filing and other duties which may arise within the company.
  
  
Providing administrative support to other departments as and when is needed
  
  
Answering telephones, forwarding calls, and taking messages as necessary.
  
  
**Required skills / knowledge:**  
Degree or equivalent in Business Administration or suitable employment experience.
  
  
Previous operations experience within Oil & Gas Service Company would be beneficial.
  
  
Languages spoken should be English and Mandarin. Bahasa Malay and Indo would be beneficial.
  
  
Self-motivated.
  
  
Ability to work on own initiative and as part of a team.
  
  
Excellent communication skills.
  
  
Ability to prioritise.
  
  
Quality experience in presentation skills
  
  
Exceptional attention to detail.
  
  
Must be based in and have the right to live and work in Singapore.
  
  
**What we can offer you:**  
Alongside the benefits below, working with Motive can take you places that you might not have thought possible. Every region we operate in, bring their own wonderful cultures & ways of working. And as a global business, you will become colleagues with people not only in the UK, but also in Singapore, the UAE, Norway, Brazil and in the US. You can look forward to becoming part of our people-centred approach that sees us work closely together, supporting clients and projects in multiple countries across the world.
  
People are at the heart of everything we do and we’re incredibly proud of the development opportunities that many of our staff have benefitted from. Since we started in 2010, we’ve seen school leavers work their way to senior positions, people relocate to other parts of the world and countless colleagues develop skills, receive training and advance their technical knowledge to enhance their own career, which in turn helps us continuously improve as a business, an employer and carry out the services we have become renowned for. At Motive, we believe in growing together. We are One Team, One Motive, and your journey is part of our shared success.
  
  
**Alongside this, you’ll get:**  
Health Insurance
  
  
21 Holiday days a year plus Singapore public holidays
  
  
Long Service Awards
  
  
Employee Referral Scheme
  
  
Regular Team Building Events
  
  
**How to Apply & what happens next:**  
You’re happy and ready to apply? Great, thank you.
  
You can apply by sending us a CV with any supporting documents telling us why you’d like to work with us at Motive Offshore Group.
  
We want to find great people and learn more about you as a person, ensuring we all have a positive recruitment journey. So please, tell us more about you, however you’d want.
  
Once we’ve reviewed your application, we’ll be back in touch as soon as possible to update you on the next stages of the process. If you have any questions about the role or want to chat about what life is like at Motive Offshore Group, email us at recruitment@motive-offshore.com.
  
  
Motive Offshore Group is committed to protecting the privacy and security of your information. By applying for any of our roles, you agree to our Application Candidate Privacy Notice. Read more about how your information is used and protected in the Privacy Policy.

title: Senior Client Manager
description:
Working with the Global Client Programme Team to shape and execute a best-in-class Global Client Programme that broadens our strategic relationships and delivers significant growth in revenue and profitability.
  
  
Managing and developing a small number of the firm's strategic clients and Asia-priority clients, helping the client teams to be outward-facing and focused on revenue generation opportunities.
  
  
Recognised as an expert in client relationship management this role will assist in embedding the Global Client Programme across the firm at all levels and championing the adoption of our best practice approach to client relationship management by fee-earners around the firm for all clients.
  
  
**Key relationships:**  
Regular direct contact with clients under management
  
  
Daily interaction with the Global Client Programme Lead, Global Client Programme Team members, Asia team members and for each client under management, the Lead Partners (both in-region and globally)
  
  
Frequent contact with the Global Head of Clients and Sectors, Head of Asia, the wider client team including other Relationship Partners, Associate Client Managers, trainees and key stakeholders in Finance and HR across Asia offices and relevant global hubs
  
  
Frequent contact with other Client Managers to collaborate and share ideas
  
  
Frequent contact with the Chief Client Officer, the Head of Marketing & Communications and the wider Marketing & Communications and online services teams, to align Asia‑focused client development and campaigns with global initiatives
  
  
Regular interaction with other key partners including relevant Sector Heads and other Programme Lead Partners
  
  
Work with the BD team to deliver on the marketing and business development objectives of the firm
  
  
**Job responsibilities:**  
**Revenue and profitability growth:**  
lead a client team in delivery of a bespoke set of revenue and profitability growth targets set by the Lead Partners and agreed by the relevant Sector Head.
  
  
**Extend the firm-to-firm relationship:**  
facilitate the adding of new International Practice Group (IPG)/National Practice Group (NPG)/jurisdiction billing relationships by actively seeking opportunities to introduce colleagues, products and services to our strategic clients.
  
  
**Pitch Conversion:**  
Convert opportunities by crafting compelling value propositions to win work in formal pitch processes.
  
  
**Institutionalise client relationship:**  
increase number of touch points between firm and client with a sustainable long term engagement programme.
  
  
Encourage/educate key stakeholders
  
  
to share best practice and support other client teams to developing client relationships.
  
  
**Deep knowledge about all aspects of our service delivery:**  
fully utilises the firm’s systems and networks to understand the client’s relationship with the firm and uses this knowledge to take ownership of the client plan and drive execution of actions internally.
  
  
Direct engagement
  
  
: engage in short regular face-to-face discussions with the client about their strategy and business issues.
  
  
**Intelligence gathering:**  
develop a comprehensive understanding of the structure, operations and strategic direction of the client and consistently disseminate business intelligence internally through regular internal reporting.
  
  
Secondments
  
  
: oversee secondment strategy for target clients and work closely with secondees on placement with the client (before, during and after).
  
  
**Strategic analysis:**  
build an understanding of how and where the firm can best position itself in relation to the account in view of client strategy, client structures, revenue and profitability (including gap analysis), relationship mapping, market share, competitor activity, developments in the client's markets and client needs analysis
  
  
**Client listening:**  
proactively seek feedback at all levels from the client to spot opportunities and threats. Support the Client Listening lead & Alumni Programme Manager to deliver our Client Listening and Alumni initiatives including preparing for and gathering client feedback, tracking and analysing and acting upon feedback gathered and monitoring alumni movements and activities.
  
  
**Communication:**

title: Project Management Office Support
description:
Reports To (If any)
  
  
Service Delivery Manager
  
  
Job Overview
  
  
We are seeking a proactive, hands-on delivery Project Management Office (PMO) Support- Core Banking Implementation within our Service Delivery Division. The role involves coordinating a bank-side core banking implementation involving business users, operations, IT teams and external vendors.
  
  
The successful candidate will independently build and manage an integrated implementation plan, identify cross-workstream dependencies and critical-path risks, and drive timely decisions when scope, dates, resources or deliverables change. This role requires active delivery coordination rather than meeting administration or status collection alone.
  
  
The candidate is responsible for ensuring delivery activities comply with Braindge's Credo and business policies, and will work closely with business, vendor, Head Office and Singapore IT stakeholders.
  
  
Responsibilities and Duties
  
  
Own the integrated implementation plan
  
  
: Build, baseline and maintain a logic-linked bank-side schedule with detailed activities, accountable owners, durations, predecessors/successors, milestones and readiness/approval gates.
  
  
Plan across all readiness workstreams
  
  
: Sequence test-data and environment readiness, UAT execution, defect retesting, IOP/procedure updates, user training, business rehearsal, BCP, cutover and go-live activities; include migration/reconciliation tasks where applicable.
  
  
Identify dependencies and critical-path risks
  
  
: Map hand-offs between business, Operations, vendors, Head Office IT and Singapore IT; monitor critical-path tasks, resource conflicts, decision deadlines and prerequisites that could block the next milestone.
  
  
Assess slippage and propose recovery
  
  
: When an activity is delayed or scope changes, determine which dependent tasks and milestone dates are affected; prepare revised forecasts, re-sequencing options, mitigation actions and escalations for decision.
  
  
Track execution against evidence
  
  
: Compare actual progress with the baseline and near-term look-ahead; verify completion through deliverables, testing results, approvals or sign-offs rather than relying solely on reported status.
  
  
Drive stakeholders to closure
  
  
: Run working-level planning and follow-up sessions, obtain realistic commitments, resolve ownership gaps and ensure overdue actions and conflicting schedules are escalated to the right decision-makers.
  
  
Control governance and reporting
  
  
: Maintain the master schedule, milestone tracker, dependency/RAID and decision logs, and produce concise updates highlighting variance, next steps, impacts, accountable owners and decisions required.
  
  
Coordinate implementation readiness
  
  
: Track outstanding user, operational and technical deliverables, cutover checkpoints and required approvals; surface unresolved issues before business rehearsal, go/no-go and go-live readiness reviews.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
Must Have
  
  
At least 5 years of experience in IT project planning, delivery coordination or PMO work, including meaningful involvement in banking system implementation, major upgrades or transformation programmes.
  
  
Proven experience creating and owning an integrated, dependency-linked implementation schedule from detailed workstream inputs, not simply combining status reports or meeting notes.
  
  
Hands-on ability to baseline and update plans, assess critical path and resource constraints, forecast schedule impacts and develop credible recovery or re-sequencing options.
  
  
Working knowledge of bankside UAT planning, defect/retest cycles, implementation procedures, business readiness, BCP, rehearsals and cutover/go-live checkpoints.
  
  
Strong ability to challenge unrealistic dates, coordinate business/IT/vendor hand-offs and escalate blockers with clear consequences, responsible owners and decision options.
  
  
Practical proficiency in Microsoft Project or equivalent scheduling software, plus Excel and PowerPoint for analysis, tracking and stakeholder reporting.
  
  
Diploma/ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  
  
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  
  
Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
  
  
Ability to work independently and collaborate in a team environment.
  
  
Strong organizational and time management skills.
  
  
Preferred/ Advantageous
  
  
Prior involvement in end-to-end core banking replacement or migration, including data conversion/reconciliation, multiple test cycles and production cutover.
  
  
Experience coordinating Head Office and local-bank workstreams; familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps or similar delivery/defect tracking tools.
  
  
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is an advantage.
