As a member of the Business Operations branch of Corporate IT, the IT Asset Management Associate is part of the team responsible for the lifecycle of user assets needed by our 22,000 + global end users. In addition, this person is in position to execute effective and efficient procurement and asset services, ensuing values and competencies in maintaining transparency, integrity, and compliance.

  

The Asset Management Associate derives meaningful operational metrics which align to OLA/SLAs across the function and manages continuous improvements with regards to accurate and appropriate inventory across the enterprise.

Reporting to Visa's Director of IT Asset Management, this role’s primary focus is with inventory data maintenance. As a business office function, this role has significant impact on the day-to-day success of the overall transformational journey of Corporate IT.

  

The Asset Management Associate works with internal customers and peers to ensure data accuracy and lifecycle management of assets. As needed, they support the delivery of financial and logistical acquisition of End User assets. She/He works with peers to derive total cost of ownership (TCO) improvements through operational efficiencies as well as vendor management activities. Areas of experience include data analysis around asset lifecycle, inventory management and reporting, process development\optimization and global logistics and on-time delivery of services/assets.

Essential Functions:

Operational:

* Ensuring strict adherence to our process lifecycle, updating systems and documents regularly
* Perform monthly inventory validation audits for Visa sites. This includes validation of status and the reconciliation of certificates of destruction when an asset is decommissioned.
* Reconciling inventory across a variety of systems and statuses (in stock, in use, legal review, etc.) as well as wiping/disposal activities.

Travel Requirements:

Physical Requirements:

description:
**Associate Director, Business Partnership #AIDA**
==================================================

**Company:** Singtel Group

***Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.***

*We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.*

*From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.*

*At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.*

*This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.*

*Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.*

**Be a Part of Something BIG!**

As an AD, Business Partnership (Networks), you will be responsible for serving as the strategic interface between Singtel Networks and the AI & Data Analytics (AIDA) organisation across Mobile Networks (4G/5G), Broadband and IP Core, Fixed Voice and TV Networks. You will co-own the Networks-AI transformation agenda and accelerate Singtel's ambition to achieve TM Forum Autonomous Networks Level 4 and beyond through AI-enabled network planning, engineering, assurance and operations.

Working across AIDA's core pillars and Networks stakeholders, you will translate network challenges into prioritised AI initiatives, redesign end-to-end processes, drive adoption and capability development, and deliver measurable improvements in customer experience, service resilience, productivity and cost efficiency.

**How You will Make An Impact:**

**Strategic Alignment & Autonomous Networks Roadmap**

* Act as Networks' principal interface into AIDA, aligning AI investments with Networks strategy and the Autonomous Networks (AN) maturity roadmap.
* Partner with Mobile, Broadband/IP Core, Fixed Voice and TV leaders to identify priority journeys and define phased AI-enabled transformation outcomes.
* Translate TM Forum AN Level 4+ ambitions into actionable initiatives, maturity milestones, ownership and adoption plans.

**AI Use Case Identification & Development**

* Identify, assess and prioritise high-value use cases, including predictive fault detection, cross-domain root-cause analysis, self-healing service assurance, traffic and capacity forecasting, network optimisation and intelligent change management.
* Co-design solutions with network subject matter experts, AI architects and delivery teams, integrating OSS/BSS, telemetry, alarms, topology, inventory and operational knowledge as appropriate.
* Validate feasibility, data readiness, safety, operational impact and expected business value before scaling solutions.

**Process Reimagination & Autonomous Operations**

* Redesign network workflows from manual monitoring and reactive troubleshooting towards proactive, closed-loop and policy-governed operations.
* Define human-in-the-loop checkpoints, fallback procedures, auditability and operational controls for AI-driven recommendations and automated actions.
* Promote secure, resilient and interoperable AI solutions using AIDA enterprise platforms and governed data foundations.

**Change Management, Workforce Readiness & Adoption**

* Champion an AI-first and automation-first mindset across network engineering, network operations centres (NOC) and field operations.
* Partner with Networks leaders to develop AI literacy, operational skills and role-based capabilities for AN Level 4+ readiness.
* Coordinate pilots, deployment, handover and adoption tracking to embed solutions into day-to-day operations.

**Value Realisation & Performance Management**

* Define baseline and target KPIs, including incident detection and resolution time, service availability, change success, automated resolution rate, operational productivity, cost-to-operate and customer experience.
* Track realised benefits, adoption and maturity progression, prioritising initiatives based on tangible outcomes rather than technology deployment alone.
* Report business cases, results and reusable success stories through AIDA's value-realisation framework.

**Cross-Domain Collaboration & Governance**

* Represent Networks requirements in AIDA governance and portfolio prioritisation forums, aligning network architecture, cybersecurity, data, operations and vendor stakeholders.
* Support responsible AI governance, network change controls, cybersecurity and service continuity for mission-critical networks.
* Resolve cross-functional dependencies and escalate material risks, design exceptions and investment decisions through appropriate approval channels.

**Skills for Success:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* At least 10 years of experience in telecommunications networks, engineering, operations or transformation, with exposure to at least one of Mobile (4G/5G), Broadband/IP Core, Fixed Voice or TV networks.
* Proven delivery of cross-functional automation or data-driven initiatives and strong influence with senior stakeholders.
* Understanding of network operations, assurance, incident and change management, OSS, telemetry and automation.
* Ability to translate operational problems into AI use cases and measurable KPIs, with familiarity in AI/ML, AIOps and data integration concepts.
* Strategic thinking, analytical problem-solving, stakeholder management, executive communication, change leadership and process reengineering skills.
* Appreciation of mission-critical network resilience, cybersecurity, operational controls and responsible AI deployment.

**Good To Have:**

* Postgraduate qualification in technology, analytics or business.
* Experience across multiple network domains and large-scale network transformation programmes.
* Knowledge of the TM Forum Autonomous Networks maturity framework, closed-loop automation, intent-based networking, 3GPP/ETSI standards and relevant network architecture or ITIL certifications.
* Experience in workforce transformation, benefits realisation and ecosystem/vendor management.
* Experience in AN maturity assessments and network operations transformation.

**Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?**

**Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.**

**Take the leap with Singtel to shape what’s next and accelerate your growth.**

title: Construction Manager- Data Center Retrofit
description:
We're looking for an experienced Construction Manager to deliver retrofit and upgrade projects in operating data centers. You'll manage construction in live, mission-critical facilities, including power and cooling upgrades, capacity expansions, equipment replacements and infrastructure modifications, while keeping uptime, safety and quality intact. You'll work with client's operations, engineering, design, EHS and procurement teams, and lead general contractors and trade partners from pre-construction through commissioning and handover.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Manage retrofit projects end to end scope definition, constructability review, execution, commissioning and closeout.
* Plan and control work in live environments with the operations team, including shutdown windows, Vendor
* Procedures (VP), Transfer of Custody (TOC), permits to work and risk assessments.
* Oversee GCs and trade contractors on safety, quality, schedule and cost performance.
* Review and validate schedules, pay applications, change orders and cost forecasts.
* Find, track and reduce project risks, and escalate issues early when they need leadership action.
* Coordinate MEP tie-ins and integration with existing electrical (UPS, switchgear, generators, busway) and mechanical (chillers, CRAH/CRAC, pumps, cooling distribution) systems.
* Support the commissioning team (Cx Levels 1-5), close out punch lists and deliver turnover documentation.
* Promote a strong safety culture on site and make sure client's EHS standards and Singapore regulations are followed.
* Give clear, regular status updates to stakeholders and leadership.

Minimum qualifications
  
  

* 10+ years of construction management experience, with at least 5 years on data centers or other mission-critical facilities.
* A track record of delivering retrofit or brownfield projects in live, operating environments.
* Working knowledge of data center electrical and mechanical systems.
* Experience managing contractors, budgets, schedules and change orders.
* A bachelor's degree in civil, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Construction Management or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Top 5required skills
  
  

* Live-site retrofit delivery: Running shutdowns, Vendor Procedures (VP), Transfer of Custody (TOC) and risk controls so critical load is never put at risk. MEP systems knowledge: Handling tie-ins, sequencing and integration with existing critical Infrastructure.
* Contractor and commercial management: Reviewing pay apps, negotiating change orders and managing vendor performance. Schedule, cost and risk control: Tracking progress and finding problems before they escalate. Cross-functional coordination and safety leadership: Aligning operations, engineering and contractors with a safety-first mindset.

Preferred qualifications
  
  

* PMP, CCM or an equivalent certification.
* Experience with hyperscale or large enterprise data center owners.
* Familiarity with P6 / MS Project and construction management platforms such as Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) and Oracle Primavera Unifier.
* Experience with Uptime Institute tier concepts and critical facility operations.
* Experience working with Singapore regulatory requirements and local contractors.
* Experience working with multi-national, multi-cultural teams.

**Preferred Industry Background:**  
Data Center background and Pharma or oil and gas industries (similar type of equipment, hence faster adaptation)
  
  
**Top 3 non-negotiable must-have skills:**  

* Communication skills - XFN partners
* Project Management
* Mechanical Engineering (More preference than mandatory)

title: VP Account Management
description:
***We're looking for an experienced, Mandarin speaking VP Account Management with a strong background in payments to join our growing team at Thredd.***

title: Senior R&D Engineer
description:
About the Role
  
  
H3 Zoom is seeking an experienced, hands-on Senior R&D Engineer to contribute to applied research and product development for inspection and built-environment applications.
  
  
This role combines technical investigation, experimentation and software engineering. You will evaluate new approaches, solve practical engineering challenges and translate promising ideas into reliable capabilities that can be integrated into our products and services.
  
  
Working closely with the VP of R&D and colleagues across software, AI, product and field operations, you will take ownership of technical work and contribute across projects as priorities evolve.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Applied Research & Development
  
  
Investigate technical challenges and develop practical solutions using computer vision, applied AI and spatial data processing.
  
  
Review relevant research, evaluate alternative approaches and develop prototypes against defined technical and operational requirements.
  
  
Assess emerging methods and technologies for measurable improvements in accuracy, reliability, efficiency and usability.
  
  
Experimentation & Technical Validation
  
  
Plan and conduct experiments, benchmarks and field evaluations to assess the performance of proposed solutions.
  
  
Support data collection, preparation and quality assurance, including site visits and field activities where required.
  
  
Analyse results, investigate failure cases and refine solutions using evidence from testing and operational feedback.
  
  
Maintain reproducible experimental records and clearly document findings, limitations and recommendations.
  
  
Software Engineering & Product Delivery
  
  
Develop maintainable Python software, reusable components and supporting technical documentation.
  
  
Collaborate with software and product teams to integrate, test and refine R&D outputs within operational systems.
  
  
Take ownership of assigned deliverables from initial investigation and prototyping through validation, integration and product handover.
  
  
Balance technical innovation with performance, maintainability, delivery requirements and commercial value.
  
  
Technical Collaboration
  
  
Work across disciplines to understand requirements, resolve technical issues and support project delivery.
  
  
Contribute to technical reviews, shared engineering practices and knowledge transfer.
  
  
Provide hands-on support across R&D initiatives as business and product priorities evolve.
  
  
Qualifications & Experience
  
  
Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, Geomatics, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
  
  
Typically five or more years of relevant experience in applied R&D, software engineering or related technical roles.
  
  
Strong Python programming and software engineering skills, with experience developing robust, maintainable code.
  
  
Hands-on experience in computer vision, applied machine learning and 3D or spatial data processing.
  
  
Sound understanding of geometry, measurement accuracy, data quality and technical validation.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to investigate unfamiliar problems independently, evaluate alternatives and make sound engineering decisions.
  
  
Proven experience translating research or prototypes into tested, integrated and operational capabilities.
  
  
Ability to communicate technical findings clearly and collaborate effectively with engineering, product and field teams.
  
  
Additional Advantages
  
  
Experience with relevant computer vision, machine learning or 3D processing libraries.
  
  
Experience working with real-world imagery, spatial datasets or sensor data.
  
  
Familiarity with engineering, industrial or built-environment applications.
  
  
Experience in performance optimisation, scalable data processing or cloud computing environments.
  
  
Candidate Profile
  
  
We value a versatile, technically rigorous and pragmatic engineer who enjoys solving difficult problems and delivering useful results. title: AVP/VP, Solution Architect, Technology Group
description:
Location:
Singapore, SG

Job Function: Technology Group

Job Type: Permanent

Req ID: 17645

**About GIC**
  
GIC is one of the world's largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 locations around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world's industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we work at the Point of Impact for Singapore's financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.

  

**Technology Group**
  
We experiment, design, and lead a 24×7 global business where we support core capabilities in asset management, trading, investment operations, and risk management. We deliver secure, reliable, and integrated solutions, and provide insights on new and emerging technologies.

  

**Strategy, Architecture, and Transformation Group**
  
The Strategy, Architecture & Transformation (SAT) group shapes and drives GIC’s technology strategy, ensuring alignment with business priorities and enterprise goals. Bringing together expertise in strategy, architecture, engineering, and transformation, the team strengthens governance, promotes consistency, and accelerates delivery across the Technology Group. Through modern practices and close collaboration, SAT leads the development of an architectural strategy that reinforces oversight and accountability while enabling reliable, scalable solutions and informed decision making across the Technology Group and, more broadly, across GIC.

  

**What impact can you make in this role?**

The Solution Architect designs end-to-end operations and technology solutions across operating model, applications, data and integration, and sees them through governance and delivery. The role leads data platform design on Databricks, Snowflake or equivalent, deployed on AWS.

  

**What will you do as a Solution Architect?**

Core responsibilities

* Review business requirements and define end-to-end solutions across operating model, applications, data and integration.
* Work with application vendors and service providers to shape end-to-end solutions.
* Engage business stakeholders so that solutions are complete, fit for purpose and meet business needs.
* Run solution architecture development to agreed timelines, in line with GIC's North Star, design principles, policies and standards.
* Communicate solutions to stakeholders, project and product teams, vendors and technical teams to secure understanding and acceptance.
* Support and govern implementation: resolve issues, manage solution changes and confirm that delivery meets business needs.
  

Solution development

* Lead the design and deployment of scalable, resilient solutions that meet scalability, performance and security requirements, and support investment capabilities, risk management and operational efficiency.
* Architect data platforms on Databricks, Snowflake or equivalent, hosted on AWS.
* Evaluate and recommend technologies that align with the fund's goals.
  

Collaboration and stakeholder engagement

* Partner with investment professionals, Technology, Operations and project teams to understand business needs and support delivery.
* Facilitate workshops to gather requirements and present architectural proposals.
* Present architecture proposals to senior management, explaining the value and impact of each solution.
  

Governance and compliance

* Ensure solutions comply with the North Star enterprise architecture, design principles, policies, standards and regulatory requirements.
* Guide solutions through governance processes to approval.
  

Mentorship and knowledge sharing

* Mentor junior architects and technical staff on solution architecture and development best practices.
* Share knowledge with team members and stakeholders to build a culture of continuous improvement.
  

Documentation and reporting

* Create and maintain documentation for architectural designs, processes and systems.
* Prepare reports and presentations for senior management on Total Portfolio operations and technology initiatives.
  

Continuous improvement

* Track industry trends, new technology and best practices in investment management systems.
* Research emerging technologies, assess their impact on the fund's operations and investment strategies, and recommend adoption.
* Lead initiatives that introduce new technologies and methods across the organisation.
  

**What makes you a successful candidate?**

Must have

* Hands-on architecture experience with Databricks, Snowflake or an equivalent lakehouse or cloud data warehouse.
* Experience designing and deploying solutions on AWS, including S3, IAM, VPC networking, Glue, Lambda and container services.
* 10+ years in technology, including 5+ years as a solution or enterprise architect.
* Strong skills in data modelling, ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs and event-driven integration.
* Ability to explain designs and trade-offs to senior management and technical teams.
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
  

Nice to have

* Databricks certification.
* Investment management or financial services background.
* Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
* Experience delivering ML or AI platforms.
  

**Work at the Point of Impact**
  
We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.

**Flexibility at GIC**
  
At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration, but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.

  

**GIC is an equal opportunity employer**
  
GIC is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

  

**Learn more about our Technology Group here:**
  
https://gic.careers/group/technology-group/

**Our PRIME Values**
--------------------

#### **Our PRIME Values**

GIC is a values driven organization. GIC’s PRIME Values act as our compass, enabling us to fulfil our fundamental purpose and objectives. It is the foundational bedrock which governs our behaviors, our decision making, and our focus. It informs both our long-term strategy as a firm, and the way we relate to our Client, business partners and employees. PRIME stands for Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence.

* Evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management and control frameworks.

Audit

* Cloud Development Environments & IDEs — Cloud-based development environments, AI-assisted coding tools, developer toolchains (CLIs, SDKs, IDE extensions, devcontainer features), and agentic development capabilities.
* DevSecOps & CI/CD — CI/CD pipelines, artifact management, security scanning integration, infrastructure-as-code, and secure software delivery tooling.
  

**What impact can you make in this role?**
  
As a Product Engineer in DevEx, you will build and evolve the internal solutions that help GIC plan, track, and improve how technology work is delivered. You will develop our project and portfolio management (PPM) and data analytics solution, and establish a new capability to measure developer experience (DX) and engineering effectiveness. You will also help shape GIC's approach to an Agentic Development Life Cycle (ADLC), where AI agents support engineers across the delivery lifecycle. You will use the ADLC to build your own products, so that new practices are tested on real work before they are adopted more widely. Your work will give teams across GIC clearer insight into their delivery and practical ways to engineer more effectively with AI.
  
You are an engineer who is convinced of AI's potential in software engineering and already works with coding agents in your daily practice. You are willing to question established ways of working, but you judge new approaches by results. You stay accountable for the quality, security, and reliability of what you ship.

  

**What will you do as a Product Engineer (DevEx)?**

You will work across a few connected areas, including PPM and data analytics, developer experience metrics, and ADLC practices and tooling. The emphasis across these areas will change as priorities evolve.

* **Evolve the PPM solution.** Enhance and operate our project and portfolio management solution.
* **Deliver data analytics capabilities.** Build data pipelines, models, and analytics, including AI-assisted features such as natural-language querying and automated insights, so that delivery and operational data can inform decisions.
* **Establish developer experience metrics.** Define, collect, and present metrics on developer experience, productivity, quality, and delivery outcomes, drawing on established frameworks (e.g. DORA, SPACE) and data from source control, CI/CD, and work management tools.
* **Shape the ADLC.** Help define how AI agents can take part in each stage of the lifecycle, from specification and design through implementation, testing, review, and deployment, with clear human oversight and accountability.
* **Build ADLC tooling and practices.** Develop reusable workflows, frameworks, and reference implementations, such as spec-driven development, context engineering practices, MCP integrations, and human-in-the-loop review, and apply them to your own products first.
* **Enable teams.** Write guidance, share learnings, and support engineering teams in adopting practices that have proven useful.
* **Engineer for the enterprise.** Work with platform, security, risk, and architecture teams so that solutions meet requirements for security, governance, observability, and compliance.
  

**What makes you a successful candidate?**

* Experience
  + 8+ years of experience in software engineering, including hands-on design, build, and operation of production systems.
  + 2+ years of experience leading complex, cross-team engineering initiatives as an engineer or technical lead.
  + Strong programming proficiency in Python, plus one or more of Java, C#/.NET, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
  + Experience building data-driven applications, including SQL, data pipelines, data modelling, and analytics or BI tools.
  + Experience integrating with enterprise delivery tools such as project management systems, source control, and CI/CD pipelines. Exposure to PPM or engineering metrics is a plus.
  + Hands-on experience building applications with large language models, including agentic workflows, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation, context engineering, and evaluation of AI outputs.
  + Demonstrated AI-native development practice: you use coding agents across the software development lifecycle, recognise their limitations, and validate AI-generated output before release.
  + Working knowledge of cloud platforms (preferably AWS) and modern engineering practices, including CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and automated testing.
  + Clear technical communication: you can write guidance, share learnings, and explain trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

* AI Conviction & Pragmatism
  + Firm belief in AI's potential to improve how software is built, backed by personal practice and experimentation with emerging tools.
  + Willingness to challenge established SDLC conventions, combined with the judgement to tell real progress from hype.
  + Ability to turn new ideas into practical tools and practices that other engineers can adopt.
  + Keeps current with developments in a fast-moving AI landscape.

* Product & Delivery Mindset
  + Treats engineering work as a product: understands users, measures outcomes, and iterates based on feedback.
  + Comfortable owning a product backlog and making prioritisation decisions.
  + Experience working in agile teams with a focus on incremental delivery.

* Governance & Ways of Working
  + Ability to balance innovation with enterprise requirements for security, risk management, and responsible use of AI.
  + Strong stakeholder management skills across engineering, architecture, platform, and cybersecurity teams.
  + Comfortable navigating competing priorities and driving alignment.

* Personal Attributes
  + Clear and effective communicator, both written and verbal.
  + Curious, pragmatic, and outcome-focused.
  + Consistently demonstrates GIC's PRIME values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit, and Excellence.

**Work at the Point of Impact**
  
We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.

**Flexibility at GIC**
  
At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration, but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.

  

**GIC is an equal opportunity employer**
  
GIC is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

  

**Learn more about our Technology Group here:**
  
https://gic.careers/group/technology-group/

**Our PRIME Values**
--------------------

#### **Our PRIME Values**

GIC is a values driven organization. GIC’s PRIME Values act as our compass, enabling us to fulfil our fundamental purpose and objectives. It is the foundational bedrock which governs our behaviors, our decision making, and our focus. It informs both our long-term strategy as a firm, and the way we relate to our Client, business partners and employees. PRIME stands for Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence.

description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

Job Description

**Location: Seletar, Singapore**
--------------------------------

*Only candidates with the legal right to work in Singapore will be considered. Please note that applicants without this eligibility will not be considered.*

**Why join Rolls-Royce?**

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere. By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.

  

An exciting opportunity has become available for a Supplier Quality Manager to join the Aftermarket Organisation in Singapore. This role form part of the Leadership team, reporting into the Senior Supplier Quality Manager within Aftermarket Operations and deployed into the relevant Aftermarket Operations VP.

  
  

**Job Description Summary**

The Supplier Quality Manager will provide leadership, expertise and direction on Quality and Safety, both internally and across the external Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul network, to ensure current and future Products & Services meet requirements, and to drive improvement to the associated Operating System, so that the Business can achieve its strategic goals, enhance its reputation and deliver customer satisfaction.

  
  

**Key Accountabilities**

  

* Provide Quality and Safety leadership and expertise to drive maturity and improvement across the MRO Network to deliver performance that enables the business to achieve its goals and enhance its reputation.
* Define, govern and facilitate the execution of the Journey to Zero Harm for Off-Wing Aftermarket Operations and with the External MRO Network, by embedding robust governance as part of the Operating System.
* Lead and facilitate the process for sharing HSE Best Practice and Learning Bulletins across the External MRO Network (JV's) and Rolls-Royce
* Define, govern and facilitate the execution of the Journey to Zero Defects for Off-Wing Aftermarket Operations and with the External MRO Network, by embedding robust governance as part of the Operating System.
* Coach and lead suppliers and joint ventures to develop, deliver and execute effective Zero Defects, Zero Harm and Quality Improvement Plans, ensuring the Supplier has all the relevant prevention skills required.
* In support of the Assurance plan and in partnership with risk owners, provide proactive assurance that regulatory, business and customer requirements will be met.
* Identify and lead strategic projects and programmes aimed at improving Quality and Safety performance across the MRO Network.
* Drive the development and maturity of the Supplier / Joint Venture Quality Management System to ensure readiness for approval and compliance to regulatory and MRO SABRe requirements.
* Lead the governance of the Quality and Safety performance (KPIs) of the aligned suppliers through performance and compliance monitoring to maximise efficiency and effectiveness in meeting requirements and business goals. Where Quality and Safety performance diverges from target, drive and coach the suppliers on recovery.
* Protect the business and customer through leading and coaching problem containment and resolution, to minimise impact and to ensure the necessary corrective and preventative actions are completed and verified in a timely manner.
* Drive Supplier performance using a Zero Defects culture, through use of the Integrated Supplier Scorecard (ISS), conducting Supplier Maturity Assessments (SMA) and utilising Supplier Engagement Plans (SEP) to improve / manage gaps. Gather intelligence and provide analysis of MRO shops' Quality, Safety Management and HSE performance to understand risk and provide an objective basis for taking remedial and improvement actions.
* Ensure the external MRO Network self-lead improvement and engage appropriate internal and external resources.
* Drive the governance and sharing of Quality and Zero Defects best practices and learning across the MRO Network via regular Community of Practices, Safety Action Groups and Quality Alerts to benchmark and drive implementation of actions.
* Develop the Quality Capability (skills & knowledge) and culture of direct reports, where applicable; as well as of personnel in the aligned business to ensure process compliance and meet regulatory, customer and business requirements.
  

  

**Key Experiences and any Qualifications**

  

* Professionally qualified with relevant experience in either Quality, MRO or Aerospace
* Demonstrated levels of leadership and influence
* Desirable MRO Part 145 knowledge
* You have demonstrated experience and track record of delivering results in a Quality role, ideally in an MRO Part 145 environment
* You can demonstrate good knowledge of relevant international standards or regulatory requirements
* You will have experience of root cause analysis, problem solving / 8D investigation methods and process improvement techniques.
* You will have experience in terms of containment activities and be able to provide regular updates to internal stakeholders.
* You will have a strong customer focus, able to effectively influence and challenge appropriately to manage customer expectations.
  

  

Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls-Royce into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your future vision too.

Rolls-Royce are committed to being a respectful, inclusive, and non-discriminatory workplace where individuality is valued, diverse perspectives fuel innovation, and everyone can thrive.

As part of our selection process, candidates in certain locations may be asked to complete an online assessment, which can include cognitive and behavioural aptitude testing relevant to the role. If required, full instructions for the next steps will be provided.

title: VP of Quality
description:
**About Lumilens**

At Lumilens we are building the critical photonics infrastructure that powers tomorrow’s AI supercomputing. From chip-to-chip optical interconnects to scalable photonic engines, Lumilens is unlocking a new era of computing - faster, cooler, and massively more efficient.

We’re a well-funded startup backed by Mayfield and led by veterans who’ve built and scaled some of the most transformative technologies in the industry. At Lumilens, we’re developing high-speed photonics products purpose-built to power the future of AI infrastructure and high-performance computing.

This isn’t incremental innovation, it’s a ground-floor opportunity to rethink the optical layer from the silicon up. You’ll work alongside a team of world-class engineers solving some of the hardest challenges in scaling optical systems. Every line of code, every design decision, every breakthrough you help deliver will shape the infrastructure of tomorrow.

If you're looking for mission, momentum, and the chance to make an outsized impact, jump on the rocket ship. We’re just getting started.

**About the role**

We are looking for a VP of Quality to build and lead Lumilens' global quality and reliability organization as we scale our optical interconnect products, including 800G/1.6T pluggable transceivers, near-package optics, and co-packaged optics, from qualification to high-volume production for hyperscale data center customers. You will own quality end to end, from design and suppliers through manufacturing, customer qualification, and field performance, and you will be the company's quality voice with our most demanding customers. This is a senior leadership role that partners closely with Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Sales, and reports to executive leadership.

**Responsibilities**

* Define the quality and reliability strategy for Lumilens, and grow and lead a high-performing team spanning quality engineering, reliability engineering, supplier quality, customer quality, and quality management systems.
* Establish and scale a Quality Management System (QMS) certified to ISO 9001, including document control, change management, internal and external audits, and quarterly business reviews for our own sites and our contract manufacturing and OSAT partners.
* Own product reliability and qualification for lasers, photonic integrated circuits (PICs), and optical modules, including test strategy aligned with Telcordia GR-468, JEDEC, and customer-specific requirements (e.g., HTOL, damp heat, temperature cycling, accelerated aging, storage), reliability modeling (FIT rates, wear-out, MTTF), and ongoing reliability testing (ORT).
* Serve as the primary quality interface for hyperscaler and OEM customers. Lead customer qualifications, audits, and quality agreements, and own quality scorecards, RMAs, and 8D corrective action responses within committed timelines.
* Build a supplier quality program for critical components, including lasers, PICs, DSPs, optics, substrates, fiber array units, etc. Partner with contract manufacturers and OSATs to meet our corporate quality standards.
* Embed quality into our new product introduction (NPI) process: Partner with Engineering on DFMEA/PFMEA, design reviews, control plans, and phase-gate exit criteria to ensure products are designed for reliability and manufacturability.
* Drive manufacturing quality through the production ramp: set and achieve DPPM, yield, and outgoing quality targets, and deploy SPC, process capability (Cpk), test coverage, and containment practices.
* Build failure analysis (FA) capabilities for optical, electrical, and materials analysis, in-house and with external labs, to drive fast and rigorous root-cause analysis.
* Implement quality data systems and end-to-end traceability (serial- and lot-level, integrated with MES and test data) to provide early warning of yield, reliability, and field issues.
* Monitor field performance of deployed products in customer data centers, and lead escalations, containment, and corrective actions when issues arise.
* Ensure compliance with relevant standards and regulations, including ESD control (ANSI/ESD S20.20), cleanroom and contamination control, laser safety (IEC 60825-1), and environmental requirements (RoHS, REACH, conflict minerals).
* Report quality KPIs and cost of quality to the executive team and Board, and build a culture of continuous improvement, data-driven decision making, and ownership of quality across the company.
* Lead quality across multiple sites and regions, including manufacturing operations and partners in Asia.

**Qualifications**

* 15+ years of experience in quality and reliability for optical, photonics, or semiconductor hardware, including at least 5 years leading quality organizations at Director or VP level.
* Proven track record of taking products from NPI to high-volume production, ideally for transceiver, hyperscale data center or major networking OEM customers.
* Deep expertise in optoelectronic reliability and qualification and in failure mechanisms of lasers, PICs, and optical packaging.
* Experience building or scaling an ISO 9001 QMS, and leading customer and third-party audits.
* Strong supplier quality experience with contract manufacturers and OSATs, particularly in Asia.
* Strong command of statistical and quality methods. Six Sigma Black Belt or ASQ CQE/CRE certification is a plus.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work under pressure in customer escalations and to influence across Engineering, Operations, and leadership.
* Bachelor's degree in Quality Management, Supply Chain, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Optics, Materials Science, or a related field. Master's or PhD preferred.
* A builder's mindset suited to a fast-scaling startup, and willingness to travel internationally to sites, suppliers, and customers.

title: Senior/Manager, PLM - Operations
description:
This critical role leads the PLM Office for Operations as the single owner and “front door” for every product lifecycle event –prototypes and samples, NPI, engineering changes (ECR/ECO/PCN), parts transfers and End-of-Life – across all XP Power factories and the supply chain. Its mission is to ensure every product enters, changes and leaves production on time, at the right cost, with zero uncontrolled customer impact. The role is based in Singapore.
  
  
Prime Responsibilities and Duties
  
  
•
  
  
**Prototypes and samples:**  
Intake and prioritise build requests, kit long-lead parts,book factory slots, track builds through to shipment and feed build issues back to Engineering.
  
  
•
  
  
**New Product Introduction (NPI):**  
Own Operations readiness from concept gate to volume,running NPI concurrently to APQP standards; provide DFM/DFT and supply-risk input; ensure BOM, AVL and routing are ready in ERP; lead PPAP/FAI, pilot runs and ramp plans through to signed manufacturing release.
  
  
•
  
  
**Engineering change control (ECR/ECO/PCN):**  
Assess the Operations impact of every ECR onstock, WIP, POs, cost and capacity within 5 working days; plan effectivity and cut-in; disposition obsolete stock; and trigger customer PCNs.
  
  
•
  
  
**EOL and obsolescence:**  
Monitor supplier PDN/EOL notices, score risk, plan last-time buys (LTBs) and funding, request alternate-part qualification and plan product discontinuation with Sales.
  
  
•
  
  
**Parts and portfolio transfers:**  
Validate and release all internal and external part transfers within XP Power’s global operations footprint.
  
  
•
  
  
**Process and data ownership:**  
Act as process owner for Operations PLM workflows and business owner of PLM/ERP Operations data (item master, BOM, change workflow),maintaining one integrated lifecycle pipeline and dashboard.
  
  
•
  
  
**Financial and compliance control:**  
Manage the E&O, scrap and LTB financial impact of lifecycle events, and ensure ISO 9001 / ISO 13485 and customer change-control compliance, including copy-exact and formal PCN notice periods.
  
  
•
  
  
**Decision rights and governance:**  
Decide effectivity dates, cut-in, stock disposition and prototype build priorities; recommend LTB quantities and funding and NPI manufacturing go/no-go; escalate cost above threshold and customer-impacting conflicts to the VP Operations. Chair or co-chair the weekly Ops Change Control Board, NPI gate reviews, and the monthly EOL & LTB board, life cycle pipeline review (S&OP input) and parts transfer review.
  
  
•
  
  
**Stakeholder partnership:**  
Provide one voice on lifecycle topics to Engineering and Product Management (with Engineering retaining design authority and no ECO released without Operations sign-off), Sales and customers, manufacturing sites, Supply Chain and Quality & Compliance, escalating to the COO and CTO where required.
  
  
•
  
  
**Team leadership and capability:**  
Build four capabilities – NPI Program Management, Change & Configuration,EOL/Obsolescence & Components, and Parts/Portfolio Transfers – initially by redeploying existing roles and sizing the team after the 90-day baseline; lead a network of site PLM champions (dotted line); and close gaps in competencies,methods and data.
  
  
Qualifications and Experience
  
  

* Engineering degree; MBA or PMP is advantageous.
* 5+ years in operations, NPI or PLM in electronics manufacturing.
* 5+ years leading teams across several sites and countries; power electronics or regulated markets (semi cap, medical) preferred.
* Strong knowledge of PLM/ERP change workflows, BOM and item master, and configuration management(CMII a plus).
* Working knowledge of obsolescence tools, LTB/E&O costing, PPAP/FAI, IPC, ISO 9001and ISO 13485.
* Proven ability to build data-system architecture (eg Claude level 6), modern cross-functional workflow management and visual PLM boards.
* Able to influence Engineering and Sales without direct authority, and to remain calm and credible with customers during escalations.
* Balances process discipline with pragmatism; builds and coaches teams across cultures.

XP Power is a designer and manufacturer of electronic power conversion products which it supplies to the electronics industry. It serves the Industrial, Healthcare, Semiconductor Equipment Manufacturing and Technology markets. It has sales and marketing operations in North America, Europe and Asia and manufacturing in China, Vietnam and North America. The Company is listed on the London Stock Exchange.
  
  
The Company has a history of consistently growing revenues (18% CAGR over the last 4 years) and profits (16% CAGR over the last 4 years) and is highly cash generative. Revenues in 2019 were in excess of US$250 million. The company has ambitious growth plans to enter the FTSE250 within the next 3 years. XP Power has been consistently profitable and cash generative.
  
  
Current situation
  
  
Over the last 10 years XP Power has transformed its business from that of a distributor to a designer and then manufacturer of its own product. The Company has also expanded its addressable market through acquisitions of businesses that allow it to access the profitable areas of high voltage and radio frequency power. This strategy has enabled the Company to penetrate a significant number of blue-chip customers in its target market sectors and has resulted in a significant increase in earnings. With this expansion the business has become progressively more complex and many new exciting roles with good career development opportunities are being recruited.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
We are looking for self-motivated professionals who thrive in fast paced dynamic environments to join our team. We are proud of and committed to our culture that values Customer Focus, Flexibility, Knowledge, Speed, and Integrity. Joining our team means you will work in a high performing global company where employees collaborate and strive for excellence and can make a difference.
  
  
XP Power is an equal opportunities employer

description:
**WHO WE ARE:**
===============

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. From there, we provide support, services, solutions, and career paths that meet their individual needs and desires.

Today, we’re on a journey of transformation. Leveraging technology and creativity to become a future-ready learning organisation. But for all that change, our strategic ambition is consistently clear and bold, which is to be Asia’s leading financial services partner for a sustainable future.

We invite you to build the bank of the future. Innovate the way we deliver financial services. Work in friendly, supportive teams. Build lasting value in your community. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career.

Your Opportunity Starts Here.

**Why join**
============

As a Compliance Specialist within OCBC’s Group Compliance team, you will play an important role in supporting the Bank’s market conduct surveillance, conflicts management and Control Room framework. You will gain exposure to Global Markets and Investment Banking activities and work closely with business and support functions to identify and manage regulatory, conduct and conflicts-of-interest risks.

  

You will also contribute to the continued enhancement of the Bank’s surveillance and compliance capabilities, including communication surveillance, pre-trade clearance controls and supporting systems.

  

**How you succeed**
===================

To succeed in this role, you will need strong analytical and investigative skills to assess surveillance alerts, identify potential regulatory or conduct concerns, and determine when matters require escalation or further review.

You will work collaboratively with stakeholders across Global Markets, Investment Banking and other business and support functions to develop appropriate controls and risk mitigation measures. Your sound judgement, attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities will enable you to deliver effectively in a fast-paced and evolving regulatory environment.

  

**What you do**

* Perform communications surveillance of Global Markets dealers and relevant Investment Banking staff to identify potential regulatory, market conduct and compliance concerns

* Conduct compliance monitoring and surveillance over Global Markets and Investment Banking activities
* Perform conflicts-of-interest assessments involving dealers, transactions and relevant business activities
* Identify and escalate potential regulatory, market conduct or conflicts-of-interest risks arising from business activities
* Work with relevant stakeholders to develop appropriate controls and risk mitigation measures
* Perform Control Room responsibilities supporting Investment Banking activities, including the management of information barriers and potential conflicts of interest
* Support the administration of restricted and watch lists, staff dealing controls and other conflict-management requirements, where applicable
* Maintain relevant data and records within the pre-trade clearance system
* Support the administration and continued enhancement of pre-trade clearance controls, processes and systems
* Manage and support compliance initiatives and projects, including the implementation and enhancement of surveillance and compliance systems
* Provide regulatory compliance training and guidance to relevant business and support functions
* Review and update compliance policies, procedures and guidance to reflect changes in regulatory requirements, risks and business practices

**Who you are**
===============

* A recognised university degree
* At least 3 years of relevant experience in regulatory compliance, market conduct, surveillance, Global Markets or Investment Banking compliance, or a related area within a financial institution
* Relevant external or internal audit experience covering financial institutions may also be considered
* A good understanding of banking activities and regulatory compliance requirements
* Exposure to Global Markets, Investment Banking, communications surveillance, market conduct or Control Room activities would be an advantage
* Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify and assess potential regulatory and conduct risks
* Good written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders across different functions and levels
* Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within agreed timelines
* Proactive, independent and resourceful, while also being an effective team player
* Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced and evolving regulatory environment
* Meticulous, with strong attention to detail and sound judgement

**What we offer:**
==================

Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

title: AVP/VP, Asset Liability Management, Market Risk Management
description:
**WHO WE ARE:**
===============

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. From there, we provide support, services, solutions, and career paths that meet their individual needs and desires.

Today, we’re on a journey of transformation. Leveraging technology and creativity to become a future-ready learning organisation. But for all that change, our strategic ambition is consistently clear and bold, which is to be Asia’s leading financial services partner for a sustainable future.

We invite you to build the bank of the future. Innovate the way we deliver financial services. Work in friendly, supportive teams. Build lasting value in your community. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career.

Your Opportunity Starts Here.

**Why Join**
============

This is a role within the Asset Liability Management team under the Group Risk Management division. You will have the opportunity to contribute to the management of the Bank’s balance sheet structure, interest rate and liquidity requirements, through the measurement, management and analysis of asset liability risks.

**How You Succeed**
===================

To excel in this role, you should have the experience and solid understanding of concepts and regulatory standards involving asset liability risk. These could be in the areas of liquidity risk, interest rate risk in the banking book (IRRBB) or structural foreign exchange (SFX) risk management. You should have a good control mindset, be comfortable working with handling data and systems, and have the ability to present risk and balance sheet information into clear, concise insights for senior management and committees. Strong analytical, communication, and presentation skills are essential.

**What You Do**
===============

* Generation and review of ALM risk reports for management and regulatory reporting
* Analyse ALM risk exposures to determine trends and the basis of variances in exposures
* Contribute to stress testing as part of enterprise-wide and thematic stress tests
* Review and assess new product proposals from an ALM risk perspective, ensuring alignment with risk appetite, policies, and regulatory requirements
* Engage with business units (e.g. corporate treasury, global markets, overseas risk and treasury units) on risk appetite, strategies and positions
* Support risk functions in overseas branches and subsidiaries on risk monitoring, management strategies and regulatory engagement
* Represent ALM at various committees to present various topics including risk assessments, key developments and limit reviews
* Review ALM risk limits, triggers, and utilization, including the assessment of limit calibrations, breaches, and remediation actions
* Drive process enhancements and innovation initiatives to improve reporting efficiency, data quality, and management insights through automation, dashboarding, and the adoption of AI solutions
* Conduct regular reviews of ALM methodologies, assumptions, and policies to ensure alignment with regulatory expectations, industry developments, and best practices
Participate in user testing of the ALM system as part of system enhancements and parameter updates  

**Who You Are**
===============

* At least 5 - 10 years of related experience in the reporting and management of Liquidity, IRRBB or SFX risk management, for e.g. related to LCR, NSFR, repricing gap, PV01, NII and EVE
* Ability to synthesize risk and balance sheet information into clear and concise presentations for senior management and committees
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders across various functions
* Analytical, attentive to detail, and comfortable with handling data on Microsoft Excel and presenting results in tabular and chart format
* Coding, dashboarding and automation skills would be a plus

**What we offer:**
==================

Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

title: Manager, Field Engineering (Greater China)

The successful candidate will engage with the Greater China Region internal teams and customers in Mandarin for technical sales discussions, address technical challenges, and articulate clear technical solutions and value propositions.

title: Manager, APJ Inside and Academy Systems Engineering
description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart!**

**About Nutanix**

Nutanix is a global leader in hybrid multicloud computing. Our cloud platform enables organizations to run applications and data anywhere—in private data centers, public clouds, and at the edge—with simplicity and freedom of choice.

**The Opportunity**

Nutanix is seeking a motivated, results-oriented Manager, APJ Inside and Academy Systems Engineering to lead the regional inside presales organization and oversee the development of early-career Systems Engineers across APJ.

This leader will manage a team of 6+ Inside Systems Engineers supporting Inside Account Executives and commercial customers across the APJ region. The team will educate, consult, assess, architect, and propose Nutanix solutions while building trusted relationships with technical decision-makers, customers, and partners.

In parallel, this role will oversee the APJ SE Academy, ensuring that the 5+ Associate Systems Engineers develop the technical, commercial, and customer-facing capabilities required for successful placement into Inside or Field Systems Engineering roles. The manager will lead hiring, onboarding, coaching, assessment, engagement, and career progression for Academy participants.

The role reports to the VP, Global Presales, Inside and Subscription Sales and works closely with Inside Sales, Field Sales, Field and Inside SE leadership, Talent Acquisition, Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional partners.

**Your Role**

Lead the APJ Inside Systems Engineering team -

* Lead, coach, and develop a regional team of Inside Systems Engineers; set clear goals, conduct regular 1:1s, provide ongoing feedback, and hold meaningful career conversations.
* Establish an effective operating cadence across APJ, including pipeline reviews, deal inspections, forecast support, skills development, and cross-functional issue resolution.
* Partner with Inside Sales Managers and Account Executives to maintain healthy pipeline progression and improve deal velocity, technical win rates, and customer outcomes.
* Support complex proposals, product specifications, solution designs, technical discovery, whiteboarding, and demonstrations; act as a player-coach on strategically important opportunities when appropriate.
* Serve as an escalation point for customer and partner satisfaction, coordinating with Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, and other teams to resolve issues.
* Build relationships with technical leaders at customers and partners and represent Nutanix through roadmap, vision, and solution presentations.

**Own the APJ SE Academy**

* Partner with Talent Acquisition and regional stakeholders to recruit and hire Associate Systems Engineers into annual cohorts.
* Own the Academy participant experience from onboarding through readiness for placement, including structured training, mentoring, shadowing, customer interaction, and hands-on technical learning.
* Coach Associates through customer discovery, technical whiteboarding, live demonstrations, proposals, product specifications, custom solutions, and problem-solving.
* Track participant progress through structured assessments, performance reviews, competency milestones, and documented development plans.
* Establish clear readiness criteria and facilitate successful placement into Field or Inside Systems Engineering roles.
* Maintain strong communication across the Sales and SE organization so Academy participants receive consistent coaching, meaningful field exposure, and appropriate support.

**Build a high-performing regional organization**

* Define and manage team metrics covering business impact, productivity, capability development, retention, and talent progression.
* Use consistent skill criteria to support hiring, development, performance management, promotion, and Academy placement decisions.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, high-energy culture across countries, markets, and time zones.
* Identify opportunities to improve presales coverage, capacity, enablement, processes, and coordination across APJ.
* Model Nutanix’s values and maintain the highest standards of personal and professional ethics and integrity.

**What Success Looks Like**

**First 90 days**

* Clear operating cadence established across the APJ Inside SE team and Academy.
* Direct reports, Academy participants, key stakeholders, and active opportunities understood.
* Individual ramp and development plans in place for new Inside SEs and Academy Associates.
* Role boundaries, escalation paths, and collaboration rhythms established with Inside Sales, Field SE, and regional leadership.

**First year**

* The APJ Inside SE team is progressing against agreed business and talent targets.
* Pipeline contribution, technical win rate, ramp time, retention, and customer outcomes are improving or meeting plan.
* Academy participants are progressing against defined competencies and are being placed into Field or Inside SE roles at the expected rate and quality.
* A strong succession pipeline and healthy, inclusive team culture are evident across APJ.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Must-have**

* 3+ years of direct people-management experience, or equivalent leadership experience with clear accountability for team outcomes.

title: SVP / VP, Specialist, Technology Risk (Cybersecurity), Risk Management Group
description:
**Business Function**

  

Risk Management Group works closely with our business partners to manage the bank’s risk exposure by balancing its objective to maximise returns against an acceptable risk profile. We partner with origination teams to provide financing, investments and hedging opportunities to our customers. To manage risk effectively and run a successful business, we invest significantly in our people and infrastructure.

  

Technology is key to enabling the DBS vision of being the leading bank in Asia. We are constantly challenged by ever changing technology landscape, increasing customer sophistication / demands and introduction of new / updated regulatory requirements. We need passionate Technology Risk Managers who play a high impact role as second line function in enhancing the bank’s technology risk and cybersecurity posture.

  

This includes identifying potential technology and cybersecurity risks associated with existing, evolving and new technology systems and business processes, assessing potential impacts and engaging with other technology leaders on the risk treatment options based on enterprise risk appetite. Risks and mitigation plans are reported to senior leadership for review and attention.

  

**The Role**

  

Experience in Cybersecurity principles, solutions and processes are essential for this position. The candidate is a driven, self-starter, who plays an active role working in a dynamic environment with the Technology risk teams to conduct independent assurance of risk management and drive IT risk management initiatives. The role is expected to have a proven record of positively influencing stakeholders at all levels of the organisation and is responsible to promote risk culture.

  

Additionally, the candidate needs to have analytical skills to assess information and identify potential risks, possess problem-solving skills to be able to determine how to reduce those risks, and introduce more forward-looking measures of risk.

  

The candidate should have proven experience in driving complex cybersecurity initiatives and managing cross-functional workstreams, as they will play a key role as the bank embarks on a large-scale cybersecurity transformation programme.

  

The candidate should be inquisitive on risks and controls issues and rationalize their mitigation. Communication skills are important to inform management about potential risk issues, provide actionable reports, including articulating impact on policy changes. There will be frequent opportunities to represent Technology Risk’s view in risk forums and different levels of risk committees. The demands and high-visibility nature of this position require an expert with a proven ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment and who can begin contributing immediately.

**Responsibilities**

  

* Work with stakeholders across Group Technology to manage Technology Risks relating to cybersecurity
* Partner with first line peers to succinctly assess, frame and report on cybersecurity risks relative to risk appetite.
* Ability to review and challenge cybersecurity design, define and initiate stress testing against various risk scenarios.
* Ability to use analytical thinking to identify security gaps, risks, control issues and propose / review mitigation strategies.
* Conduct independent assurance to evaluate effectiveness of IT controls.
* Lead thematic second line assurance reviews, including short and targeted focused reviews for areas of topical and key concern.
* Lead and drive cybersecurity risk-related projects and initiatives, ensuring successful implementation.
* Independently manage transformation workstreams, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and delivering project outcomes.
* Oversight of remediation of issues arising from first line identification of control deficiencies, internal and external incidents, including deep dive reviews to identify root cause.
* Demonstrate strong judgment to balance being both a trusted advisor to the business and driving effective challenge.
* Champion risk awareness and best practices with various stakeholders to uplift risk culture in the organisation.
* Enhance the business’ understanding of regulatory/compliance requirements and the implications to individual initiatives and the broader firm.
* Provide robust risk management oversight in supporting various internal, external audits and regulatory inspections / examinations.
* Monitor outstanding risk items and audit issues to ensure proper ownership and follow-up.
* Ability to work independently, prepare and write comprehensive reports for senior management on technology risk management activities and risk events for presentation to risk committees.
* Ability to communicate complex technology risk concepts in a clear and concise manner.
* Mentor more junior members of the team.
Stay current on emerging cyber threats and potential implications to the organisation.  

  

**Requirements**

  

* Degree holder in Information Technology, Computer Science or related discipline.
* Minimum 10-15 years of working experience in relevant field.
* Professional memberships and security or risk management certifications would be considered favourably (e.g., CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CISM, CCSP, etc.)
* (1) Technical Experience
  + IT professional with good understanding of technology platform with specialisation in security domains
  + Familiar with assessing or designing controls for AI systems.
  + Prior experience in cybersecurity transformation projects would be considered favourably.
  + Experienced with technical security solutions surrounding various technologies such as but not limited to: IDS, IPS, firewall management, anti-virus, content filtering, secure email solutions, network sniffing, log management & analysis, forensics, VPN, load balancing, routing, switching and network management.
  + Prior experience in either banking, IT risk management, or security-related.
  + Sound knowledge in regulatory requirements (e.g. MAS Notice FSM-N05, FSM-N06, TRM guidelines, Cyber Security Act, Banking Act, and Personal Data Protection Act) and industry standards/ frameworks such as ITIL, SANS, COBIT, NIST, ISO 27001/2.
* (2) Non-Technical Experience
  + Strong interpersonal and communication skills that include active listening, writing and executive presentation skills.
  + Excellent influencing and persuasion skills
  + Proven critical analytical, including and the ability to express a point of view supported by data (with both technical and non-technical audiences)
  + Comfortable raising concerns early and knows when to escalate, including the ability to raise issues and facilitate constructive problem-solving at all levels of the organization.
  + Experience in a first-line role at a financial institution or regulatory agency (preferred)
  + Good planning and other project management skills, including strong organisation skills.
  + Solutions oriented; ability to work with all levels of management and staff
  + Self-driven, passionate about hands-on learning on emerging technologies and its risks.
  + Self-starter, performance-oriented individuals
  + Passionate about driving change through innovation.
  + General understanding of overall banking business
* (3) Work Relationship
  + Support the Head of Unit in discharging the responsibilities of the team.
  + Strong ability in knowledge sharing with peers.
  + Contribute as a member of Team and collaborate with fellow team members and technology managers.
  + Develop relationships with peer in the technology organisation.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

**About the Role**

The Vice President, Customer Success – APAC is a strategic, revenue-focused leader responsible for driving net ARR growth across the existing customer base throughout Asia Pacific. They will lead a high-performing, geographically distributed Customer Success organisation, with a clear mandate to maximise retention, accelerate upsell and cross-sell, and drive AI product adoption. Through a value-led, commercially disciplined approach, they will ensure customers continuously realise and expand the value of their investment.

The VP CS APAC will balance a consistent regional strategy with local execution, adapting customer engagement to different languages, business practices, procurement processes, regulatory environments, and levels of market maturity.

Working closely with Sales, Solutions, Marketing, Product, and Training, the VP will align regional go-to-market efforts, strengthen expansion pipelines, and enable seamless account growth.

Ultimately, this role positions Customer Success as a primary driver of strong net revenue retention and sustained ARR growth across APAC.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Revenue Growth:** Own the Customer Success strategy across APAC, partnering with Sales and Account Management to drive renewals, upsell, cross-sell, and net ARR growth.
* **Regional Strategy & Local Execution:** Translate global priorities into country-level plans that reflect local energy markets, customer expectations, cultural nuances, and commercial practices.
* **Leadership:** Lead, mentor, and develop a geographically distributed Customer Success team, building regional collaboration, local accountability, and commercial discipline.
* **Executive Relationships:** Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders, adapting communication and engagement to local business cultures and decision-making structures.

* **Segmentation Strategies:** Develop customer coverage and engagement models based on account potential, market maturity, geography, language, and customer needs.
* **Playbooks & Processes:** Implement scalable Customer Success playbooks for success planning, renewals, expansion, and risk management across countries and time zones.
* **Retention & Renewals:** Lead proactive retention planning, identify account risks early, and coordinate interventions to minimise churn and protect recurring revenue.
* **AI & Product Adoption:** Accelerate adoption of Energy Exemplar’s products and AI capabilities, connecting usage to measurable customer outcomes and expansion opportunities.
* **Success Metrics:** Establish and track net revenue retention, gross retention, renewal rates, expansion ARR, product adoption, customer health, and NPS.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration & Escalations:** Partner with Sales, Product, Solutions, Support, and executive teams to resolve escalations and strengthen customer relationships.
* **Value Creation:** Embed value reviews and account success plans that demonstrate business impact and increase customer engagement and share of wallet.
* **Onboarding Excellence:** Partner with implementation and services teams to ensure effective handovers, clear success measures, and faster time to value.

**Candidate Requirements & Qualifications**
-------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Management, Strategy, Economics, Communications, Electrical Engineering, or an equivalent discipline or relevant experience.
* 10+ years’ experience within a fast-growing SaaS business.
* 5+ years’ experience leading a Customer Success function within the energy industry.
* Demonstrated leadership across multiple APAC markets, with the ability to lead a region-wide remit and adapt execution to local nuances.
* Strong understanding of APAC’s diverse energy markets, regulatory environments, procurement practices, and customer decision-making processes.
* Proven track record of delivering retention, renewals, expansion, and net ARR growth across APAC.
* Experience leading geographically distributed teams across different cultures, languages, and time zones.
* Experience using AI and automation to improve customer engagement, retention, expansion, and operational efficiency.
* Strong commercial judgement, analytical skills, and experience using customer health and revenue data to prioritise action.
* Ability to build trusted executive relationships and navigate complex, multi-stakeholder customer organisations.
* Entrepreneurial mindset, high energy, and strong advocacy for the customer voice.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English; additional APAC language capabilities would be advantageous.
