This is a high-impact, quota-carrying field sales role focused on generating net new business across a portfolio of non-named accounts, with **Vietnam as the primary market** and **Singapore and Malaysia as secondary markets**. You will drive ServiceNow growth through a channel-first model by identifying, engaging, and winning with the right partner for each opportunity in each country. You will be the quarterback of a virtual team across Partner Managers, Partner Marketing, Partner Pre-Sales, and Partner Excellence to execute a disciplined multi-country territory plan, with Vietnam as the main focus, and drive pipeline from first engagement through to closed-won.

**What you get to do in this role:**

* **Territory planning and execution:** Own and develop a structured territory execution plan across assigned non-named accounts, with Vietnam as the primary market and Singapore and Malaysia as secondary markets. Prioritise accounts by country (Vietnam first), industry, whitespace, and partner coverage. Build and maintain a healthy pipeline to meet and exceed quarterly and annual new business targets.
* **Partner-led sales motion:** Collaborate with the Partner Manager Group to identify and select the right partners for each country in your territory (primarily Vietnam, and secondarily Singapore and Malaysia) by industry focus and solution capability. Co-develop joint account plans and co-selling motions with selected partners to drive pipeline creation and deal progression.
* **Demand generation with partners**: Partner with the Partner Marketing Group to design and execute joint demand generation campaigns, including field events, roundtables, digital campaigns, and prospecting activities, tailored to each country and targeted at your assigned account portfolio.
* **Sales cycle leadership:** Lead opportunity qualification and customer engagement, leveraging Partner Pre-Sales support for discovery, solution demonstrations, and technical pre-sales activities. Maintain deal momentum from first meeting through to commercial close.
* **Partner capability development:** Work with the Partner Excellence Group where needed to bring new partners on board or enable existing partners with new solution competencies relevant to your territory's needs; ensuring the right capacity and capability is in place to support your pipeline.
* **Pipeline and forecast discipline**: Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM records. Provide regular pipeline reporting, deal status updates, and forecast inputs. Participate in deal reviews and business reviews with leadership as required.
* **Industry and solution positioning**: Apply strong industry knowledge to frame ServiceNow's value proposition relevantly for target buyers across your territory, spanning verticals such as financial services, manufacturing, public sector, retail, telecommunication, or technology, depending on your assigned accounts and country.

  
**Qualifications**

**To be successful in this role you have:**

* **Sales track record:** 5 – 8+ years of quota-carrying B2B technology sales experience with a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding targets. SaaS sales experience strongly preferred
* **Channel sales expertise:** Proven experience selling through or with channel partners, co-selling, joint pipeline creation, and managing partner-led deal motions. Knows how to enable and motivate partners to prioritise your deals.
* **Industry knowledge**: Strong understanding of one or more key industries in Vietnam (primary market) and/or Singapore and Malaysia (secondary markets) (e.g. financial services, manufacturing, public sector, retail, telecommunication, technology). Able to speak credibly to business challenges, buying centres, and digital transformation priorities relevant to your territory.

* **AI fluency:** Leverages AI tools to enhance productivity, including pipeline prioritisation, account research, outreach personalisation, and sales forecasting. Able to articulate AI-powered product value to business buyers.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
**About Sentient**
------------------

Sentient is building the future of open-source AI. Our mission is to ensure that the most powerful AI systems remain open, accessible, and beneficial to everyone.

Backed by leading investors including Founders Fund and Pantera Capital, Sentient brings together world-class AI researchers, engineers, and builders to develop cutting-edge open-source AI technologies.

Our work spans AI agents, model verification, AI benchmarking, and self-improving AI systems. We're focused on turning frontier research into useful, widely adopted products that push the boundaries of what's possible with open-source AI.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a highly technical, entrepreneurial Product Manager to help shape and build the next generation of AI products at Sentient.

You'll work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI research and product development, identifying promising research breakthroughs and turning them into products that developers and businesses actually want to use.

This is a hands-on role that requires strong technical judgment, product intuition, and the ability to take ideas from early exploration through launch and adoption. We're looking for someone who is equally comfortable exploring new technologies, prototyping solutions, engaging with users, and working alongside researchers and engineers.

You'll collaborate closely with our research, engineering, and leadership teams to determine what we should build, why it matters, and how to bring it to market. The role reports to the VP of Product and works alongside the team’s PM Lead, who will set overall product direction.

**Location:** Remote. The team is spread across Singapore, Hong Kong, and UAE, so you'll need regular overlap with Asia/Middle East working hours, with flexibility across timezones as we are a global team.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Find product opportunities where our research, emerging technology, and market need meet, then set the vision, priorities, and roadmap.
* Lead products from first concept through prototype, launch, and adoption, working with engineering, research, and go-to-market teams.
* Work with AI researchers to spot promising breakthroughs and turn them into product requirements, user experiences, and technical specifications.
* Evaluate technical approaches and make architectural trade-offs alongside engineering.
* Build prototypes and proofs of concept yourself, using code, APIs, and current AI tooling: LLMs, agents, evaluation frameworks, and developer infrastructure.
* Design experiments and evaluations to test product hypotheses, and move quickly from idea to working demo to user feedback.
* Talk directly with developers, design partners, and customers. Define and track adoption, engagement, performance, and retention, and feed what you learn back into product and research priorities.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Required Qualifications**

* You have taken a technical product from concept to launch, and you can show us the product and its usage numbers.
* You have worked as a software or ML engineer, or have equivalent hands-on technical depth.
* You write Python well enough to build a working agent prototype against LLM APIs on your own.
* You have designed and run evaluations for an LLM or agent system, and can explain why a given eval does or does not predict real-world performance.
* You can point to a time you killed or reshaped a technically promising idea because users did not need it.
* You have driven an initiative from start to finish without a defined brief or someone else setting the scope.
* You can explain a research result to a customer and a customer problem to a researcher, clearly and in writing.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience as a founder, founding product manager, early-stage engineer, or technical product lead.
* Experience building AI developer tools, AI agents, ML infrastructure, model evaluation systems, or open-source products.
* Familiarity with agent frameworks and modern AI development workflows.
* Experience collaborating with research scientists or bringing emerging AI technologies to market.
* Contributions to open-source AI projects or active involvement in developer communities.
* Experience working with design partners to validate and refine new products.

**Why Join Sentient?**
----------------------

### **Why open source**

At a closed lab, the product is access to a model. Here, the product is something developers can run, inspect, and build on themselves. That changes the job in three ways.

* **Your work is public.** Most of what you ship lives in the open, where anyone can read it, fork it, and challenge it. Your track record is visible to the whole field, not locked inside one company.
* **Your users are your collaborators.** Developers file issues, send pull requests, and tell you what is broken within days. You learn faster than any private beta allows.
* **You build for adoption, not lock-in.** A product wins here because developers choose it, not because they have no alternative. That is a harder bar and a more honest one.

### **What else you get**

* **Work at the frontier of AI:** Collaborate with leading researchers and engineers on technologies shaping the future of artificial intelligence.
* **Meaningful ownership:** Have a direct impact on product strategy, technical direction, and execution.
* **Research meets real-world impact:** Translate innovative AI research into practical products used by developers and organizations.
* **Builder-driven culture:** Work with an ambitious team that values experimentation, technical excellence, and delivering meaningful results.

If you're passionate about AI, enjoy building products from the ground up, and want to shape the future of open-source AI, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Description
  
  
Ensures operational excellence in driving company’s business growth locally and globally in accordance to company expansion plan.

OPERATIONS MANAGEMENT

Company Overview
  
  
Jumbo Group of Restaurants began with Jumbo Seafood, a home-grown seafood restaurant that was established in 1987 and best known for its chilli and black pepper crabs. title: Deputy Director
description:
Family Group: Administration

**Scope of Role:**

  

Reporting to the Chief Human Resource Officer, the Deputy Director, Learning & Organisation Development provides strategic leadership and operational oversight for enterprise learning, professional development, organisation development, learning technologies and workforce capability initiatives. The role partners senior leaders across the organisation to build a future-ready workforce, strengthen organisational culture, and drive continuous learning, innovation and performance excellence.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* **Lead the organisation’s Learning & Organisation Development (L&DO) strategy and operations**, ensuring alignment with workforce, capability, talent, and organisational development priorities.
  

* **Drive enterprise-wide learning needs analysis (LNA)** by partnering business leaders, HR Business Partners, reporting officers and professional groups to identify current and future capability requirements, translating these into annual learning plans and development roadmaps.
  

* **Oversee learning governance, budgeting and resource planning**, including annual budget forecasting, expenditure management, procurement compliance, cost optimisation and stewardship of learning investments.
  

* **Develop and implement integrated learning frameworks and pathways** that combine formal learning, experiential development, coaching, mentoring, workplace application and career development opportunities.
  

* **Lead the planning, administration and continuous improvement of learning operations**, including learning calendars, programme delivery, vendor management, enrolment, evaluation, service excellence and employee learning experience.
  

* **Establish and monitor learning analytics and management dashboards**, providing actionable insights on participation, capability gaps, learning effectiveness, return on investment and organisational outcomes to senior leadership.
  

* **Oversee the end-to-end New Hire Journey**, ensuring effective pre-boarding, onboarding, orientation and workforce integration experiences that reinforce organisational culture, values, operating principles and strategic priorities.
  

* **Provide leadership and governance for professional development programmes**, including development awards, recognition awards, scholarships, conferences, study visits and other employee development initiatives, ensuring transparency, equitable access and alignment with organisational objectives.
  

* **Govern overseas learning and benchmarking opportunities**, ensuring strategic relevance, value-for-investment, policy compliance, effective knowledge transfer and translation of learning into organisational improvements.
  

* **Co-lead organisation development and culture transformation initiatives**, partnering leaders and stakeholders to embed desired mindsets, behaviours and values through learning interventions, leadership engagement and change management strategies.
  

* **Champion the adoption and integration of NHG Operating Principles** across onboarding, leadership development, learning programmes and people practices, translating principles into sustainable workplace behaviours and organisational effectiveness.
  

* **Provide strategic oversight of learning technologies and digital platforms**, including Learning Management Systems (LMS), capability development portals and digital learning ecosystems to enhance accessibility, user experience, governance and reporting.
  

* **Drive innovation in digital, blended and technology-enabled learning**, leveraging emerging learning technologies, self-directed learning solutions, microlearning and AI-enabled tools to improve learning effectiveness, scalability and personalisation.
  

* **Lead business process transformation and automation initiatives**, including robotic process automation (RPA) and AI-enabled solutions, to streamline learning administration, improve service delivery and enhance operational efficiency.
  

* **Build organisational capability for future-ready learning**, fostering data-driven decision-making, digital fluency, AI literacy and continuous improvement while leading and developing a high-performing L&D team and partnering effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
  

* **Lead, guide and develop a multidisciplinary team** while ensuring the effective delivery of a broad and evolving portfolio
  

**Requirements:**

  

* Recognised bachelor’s degree in Human Resource Management, Human Resource Development, Organisational Development, Business Administration, Psychology, Education, Learning Sciences or a related discipline.
* Minimum 8–10 years of progressive professional experience in Learning & Development, Capability Development, HR Development or Organisation Development (*will be preferred*).
* Strong team management with at least 3 years of experience in leading teams, programmes or major workstreams.
* Demonstrated experience operating in a complex, matrixed, fast-growing or transforming organisation.
* Proven experience managing learning budgets, learning operations, stakeholder relationships and multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of adult learning principles, capability frameworks, learning needs analysis, learning evaluation and organisational development practices.
* Practical experience in digital learning, learning systems, analytics and technology-enabled process improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence engaging senior leaders and multidisciplinary stakeholders.
* Comfortable with 100% work onsite arrangement with office location in Novena.
  

**Good to Have:**

  

* IHRP certification, such as IHRP-Senior Professional, where relevant to the HR leadership scope, will be highly advantageous though not a must.

* Advanced Certificate in Learning and Performance (ACLP), Diploma in Design and Development of Learning for Performance (DDDLP), or equivalent adult education qualification.
* Professional certifications in coaching, facilitation, change management, instructional design, Lean Six Sigma or project management.
* Familiarity with Power BI, Microsoft Power Platform, enterprise LMS platforms and generative AI applications.

title: Marine Superintendent
description:
Company Overview
  
  
PG SHIPMANAGEMENT PTE. LTD. specializes in ship management services, ensuring vessel safety, compliance, and operational excellence through expert technical and marine management.
  
  
Job Summary
  
  
Lead and supervise vessel operations and engineering aspects to ensure compliance with maritime regulations and safety standards. Manage technical issues, conduct security assessments, analyse audit reports, and implement crew training to uphold operational excellence.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Monitor daily vessel movements to ensure operational efficiency and safety
  
  
Supervise vessel operations and verify ship staff compliance with management policies and maritime regulations at international, state, and local levels
  
  
Manage all technical and operational issues, including correspondence, ensuring adherence to International Safety Management (ISM) codes, classification society rules, and maritime insurance requirements
  
  
Oversee vessels from an engineering perspective while primarily working in an office environment
  
  
Conduct security assessments in accordance with Designated Person Ashore (DPA) and Company Security Officer (CSO) requirements
  
  
Issue Quality, Health, Safety, and Environment (QHSE) Alerts and Bulletins to vessels to communicate critical information
  
  
Analyse reports such as SIRE/CDI, Flag State inspections, Port State Control (PSC), external audits, and other relevant documents to identify compliance gaps
  
  
Initiate and track corrective actions for timely closure based on Marine/Safety Director guidance
  
  
Develop and implement training programs for officers and crew to enhance safety and operational competencies
  
  
Review and respond promptly to safety and operational reports received from vessels
  
  
Required competencies and certifications
  
  
Hold Class 1 Certificate of Competency (COC)
  
  
Minimum 3 years’ experience as a Master
  
  
At least 2 years’ experience as a Marine Manager in a reputable ship management or ship-owning tanker company
  
  
Knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, OHSAS 18001, and Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006
  
  
Diploma or above and proficient IT skills

title: MANAGER
description:
We are looking for an efficient and committed Manager to join our office. As a Manager, you will be managing the day to day activities. You will be responsible for arranging meetings for the staff, provide them necessary official documents and keep a record of the appointments within the office. You will be also arranging monthly repairs and renovations.
  
  
You will also be organizing office operations and procedures. You should be highly dedicated to work and have exceptional organizational skills. If you are ready to take up Manager duties and responsibilities, then apply right away. We will love to meet you.
  
  
Responsibilities of a Manager
  
  

* Work with Human Resources staff to recruit, interview, select, hire, and employ an appropriate number of employees.
* Provide oversight and direction to the employees in the operating unit in accordance with the organization's policies and procedures.
* Health and safety of the workforce.
* Carrying out and attaining the mission and the goals of the business unit managed.
* Development of a superior workforce.
* Development of the department.
* Development of an employee-oriented company culture that emphasizes quality, continuous improvement, key employee retention and development, and high performance.
* Personal ongoing self-development and personal growth as an employee.
* Coach, mentor, and develop staff, including overseeing new employee on boarding and providing career development planning and opportunities.
* Empower employees to take responsibility for their jobs and goals. Delegate responsibility and expect accountability and regular feedback.
* Consciously create a workplace culture that is consistent with the overall organization's and that emphasizes the identified mission, vision, guiding principles, and values of the organization.
* Lead employees using a performance management and development process that provides an overall context and framework to encourage employee contribution and includes goal setting, feedback, and performance development planning.
* Lead employees to meet the organization's expectations for productivity, quality, continuous improvement, and goal accomplishment.
* Provide effective performance feedback through employee recognition, rewards, and disciplinary action, with the assistance of Human Resources, when necessary.
* Maintain employee work schedules including assignments, job rotation, training, vacations, and paid time off, telecommuting, cover for absenteeism, and overtime scheduling.
* Maintain transparent communication. Appropriately communicate organization information through department meetings, one-on-one meetings, and appropriate email, IM (Instant Messaging), and regular interpersonal communication..
* Plan and implement systems that perform the work and fulfill the mission and the goals of the department efficiently and effectively.
* Plan and allocate resources to effectively staff and accomplish the work to meet departmental productivity and quality goals.
* Plan, evaluate, and improve the efficiency of business processes and procedures to enhance speed, quality, efficiency, and output.
* Manage the preparation and maintenance of reports necessary to carry out the functions of the department. Prepares periodic reports for management, as necessary or requested, to track strategic goal accomplishment.
* Communicate regularly with other managers, the director, vice president, president, and other designated contacts within the organization.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities, as assigned.

Manager Job Requirements
  
  

* Knowledge and experience in business, supervision, and management.
* Knowledge of the functions, operation, and mission of the specific department.
* Better than average written and spoken communication skills.
* Outstanding interpersonal relationship building and employee coaching and development skills.
* Management experience in a team-oriented workplace preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop a department and department staff members.
* Demonstrated knowledge of basic economics, budgeting, and accounting principles and practices.
* Demonstrated ability to serve as a knowledgeable resource to the organization's management team that provides leadership and direction.
* Excellent computer skills in a Microsoft Windows environment. Must include knowledge of Excel and skills in Access..
* Evidence of the ability to practice a high level of confidentiality.
* Excellent organizational management skills.

title: Assistant Director
description:
Team Leadership and Supervision: This is a key differentiator. You are responsible for leading a team—which may include direct reports or cross-functional project groups—providing guidance, managing performance, and serving as an escalation point for major issues.

Strategic Planning and Policy Development: You will assist the director in formulating departmental strategies, annual work plans, and budgets. For instance, in a health ministry, this might involve developing a national mental health strategy; in a technology organization, it could entail creating a roadmap for digital services.

Project and Operational Management: You will lead specific projects or optimize day-to-day operations. This includes overseeing digital transformation, automating processes, reviewing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and ensuring the achievement of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

Stakeholder and Vendor Management: Acting as a bridge between senior leadership and internal or external parties (such as government agencies, vendors, or community partners), you will coordinate resources, manage contracts, and ensure compliance.

Governance, Risk, and Compliance: You are responsible for establishing or refining governance frameworks, overseeing audits, and managing risks related to areas such as cybersecurity or data compliance.

Pay: $6,500.00 - $9,500.00 per month

Benefits:

* Additional leave
* Free parking
* Health insurance
* Parental leave
* Professional development
* Promotion to permanent employee

Work Location: In person

title: Associate Director of Philanthropy
description:
The work of GFI is funded through philanthropy. We fundraise as a network of nonprofits through a collaborative operating model toward a global fundraising goal. Asia Pacific is a strategic area of growth for our global fundraising efforts.
  
  
Reporting directly to the CEO of GFI APAC, you will be in a senior, frontline fundraising role, building and sustaining relationships with our growing family of supporters, and building a development team as part of the GFI global fundraising framework. Your role will have high responsibility and high impact. Your performance in this role has the potential to make a significant impact on how quickly the world moves to a more secure and sustainable food system.
  
  
Working closely with the GFI global development team, you will be responsible for delivering and executing a fundraising strategy for GFI APAC, fully aligned and integrated with the GFI global fundraising strategy. Your work will include:
  
  
Setting and achieving ambitious fundraising targets, that are part of our global development strategy. The ultimate goal is to be a net contributor to our global fundraising efforts.
  
  
Based on the outcome of a landscape analysis being conducted this year, and initial fundraising success, creating and recommending a growth plan for APAC’s development team.
  
  
Identifying and qualifying new philanthropic prospects.
  
  
Building strong, meaningful, long-term relationships with major donors and prospects (both individuals and foundations) across Asia Pacific to attract, maintain and expand their support.
  
  
Helping keep our supporters up to date with our activities and impact.
  
  
Ensuring accurate, timely and thorough correspondence, acknowledgement and record-keeping at all stages of the donor journey. You will use our CRM system (Salesforce) to manage your portfolio, ensure correct donor data, pull reports, and analyze data.
  
  
Coordinating closely with global GFI development colleagues, including aligning around donor strategies, participating in regular meetings (these may be outside of regular working hours, with colleagues in different timezones), and providing impact reports for stewardship purposes.
  
  
Coordinating with and providing support as needed to the global Foundation Relations Team with regard to prospective foundations and soliciting and stewarding grants.
  
  
Over time, potentially helping to drive GFI’s fundraising growth in the greater APAC region, including setting up development systems in those countries.
  
  
Coordinating with GFI’s global development operations team to facilitate transnational giving across national borders.
  
  
Perform other relevant duties as required.
  
  
**Who we are looking for:**  
As our Associate Director of Philanthropy, we want you to have:
  
  
A passion for our philosophy and mission.
  
  
A proven track record (8+ years) of cultivating relationships with major donors and securing significant gifts. Institutional fundraising experience would be an advantage.
  
  
The ability to persuasively make the case for support for GFI and to represent GFI to our stakeholders.
  
  
**Positivity and a genuine love of working with other people:** a passion for building warm, long-lasting relationships with our family of supporters, motivating them to maintain and increase their support.
  
  
Positive energy, a can-do attitude, bringing solutions rather than seeing constraints, thinking outside of the box, creative, and a pro-active mindset.
  
  
Conscientiousness and attention to detail in recording and tracking interactions with donors and prospects: comfort with the ‘science’, as well as the ‘art’, of fundraising.
  
  
Comfort working remotely in a rapidly-growing and evolving organisation: the ability to work well independently and under pressure, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and meet deadlines.
  
  
A very strong work ethic and self-motivation; a sense of ownership and responsibility to drive outcomes and get things done.
  
  
The ability to work in an organised and structured manner.
  
  
A willingness to travel throughout APAC in pursuit of philanthropic opportunities.
  
  
Ability to manage a non-traditional schedule as needed between travel and accommodating meetings with international colleagues.
  
  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Fluency in Mandarin, Cantonese, or another regional language would be an advantage.
  
  
We want the best people and we don’t want biases holding us back. We strongly encourage people of every race, orientation, age, gender, origin, and ability to apply. Because we value a diverse workplace, we prioritise an inclusive climate absent of discrimination and harassment during the application process and after you join the team.
  
  
The fine print
  
  
**Terms of employment:**  
Full-time
  
  
**Reports to:**  
CEO, GFI APAC
  
  
**Location:**  
Singapore preferred, but open to Hong Kong SAR
  
  
**Benefits:**  
Flexible working arrangements, including hybrid working from home and one weekly office day; flexible working hours; a competitive leave and benefits package; the opportunity to create meaningful impact; collaboration with supportive colleagues and respectful managers; and a yearly in-person retreat.
  
  
**Salary:**  
Annual salary between SG$125,000 – SG$145,000 based on locations, qualifications, and experience
  
  
Headquartered in Singapore, The Good Protein Network Limited (operating as The Good Food Institute APAC) is Asia’s leading alternative protein think tank, accelerating a shift towards a more secure, sustainable, and just food system through open-access food science R&D, corporate engagement, and public policy.
  
  
Globally, meat consumption is the highest it’s ever been. In Asia, experts have projected that meat and seafood demand will increase by an additional 78 percent between 2018 and 2050.
  
  
By making meat, dairy, and eggs from plants or cultivating them directly from cells, we can modernise protein production, mitigate the environmental impact of our food system, decrease the risk of zoonotic disease, and ultimately feed more people with fewer resources.
  
  
At GFI APAC, we’re building a world where alternative proteins are no longer alternative.

title: Regional Operations and Projects Director
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Regional Operations and Projects Director
  
  
Job Summary/Goals
  
Leads integrated facilities management operations across the APAC portfolio and capital project/programme delivery across APAC, IMETA, and Greater China for a major multi-service regional client. Owns both the day-to-day operational performance of the APAC portfolio and the end-to-end delivery of the client's rolling 3-year capital plan across all three regions, acting as the single senior JLL point of accountability for operational excellence, project delivery, financial performance, and risk governance across the account.
  
  
What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like
  
**Own the operational heartbeat of the account:** You'll oversee integrated FM service delivery across the APAC portfolio, ensuring KPIs, Joint Business Plans, and compliance targets are consistently met.
  
**Be the trusted partner to senior client stakeholders:** From day-to-day engagement to executive business reviews, you'll act as a strategic advisor — communicating performance, managing risks, and strengthening the client partnership across both operational delivery and capital programme outcomes.
  
**Lead and develop a regional team of 80:** You'll coach, develop, and inspire a geographically dispersed, multicultural team across APAC, building capability, managing succession, and creating a high-performance culture.
  
**Drive digital transformation and innovation:** You'll champion the adoption of AI tools, smart building technologies, automation, and data analytics across the APAC portfolio, leading change management to embed new ways of working across teams and vendors.
  
**Manage financial and commercial performance:** From budgeting and forecasting to vendor governance and supply chain spending across APAC, you'll support financial targets and identify savings opportunities that deliver value for the client.
  
**Lead on risk, compliance, and governance:** You'll own Health & Safety, engineering risk programmes, audit readiness, and incident reporting across APAC operational sites — fostering a risk-aware culture across all sites and service lines. This extends to ensuring Health & Safety and Client Security requirements are equally upheld across all live/occupied project sites region-wide (APAC, IMETA, Greater China).
  
**Shape and execute the regional strategy:** Working closely with the Account Executive, you'll translate client priorities into operational action, driving consistency, best practice, and continuous improvement across the APAC portfolio.
  
**Lead the regional capital programme:** You'll own end-to-end delivery of capital projects across APAC, IMETA, and Greater China — from business case and planning through design, procurement, construction, and handover to the Facilities Management team.
  
**Set the standard for project delivery:** You'll establish and maintain standardized project management practices and templates across all delivery stages, while spearheading the client's business approval process for capital works and driving cost assurance and value engineering across all packages.
  
**Identify and manage risk at every stage:** You'll proactively identify and address potential liabilities across the project lifecycle, ensuring risks are reported and managed from initial planning through to formal closure, across APAC, IMETA, and Greater China.
  
  
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  
  
Client & Stakeholder Leadership
  
Act as a trusted advisor and primary operational/project point of contact for senior client stakeholders, partnering with the Account Executive on strategy and escalation.
  
Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews and executive business reviews covering both operational performance (APAC) and capital programme status (APAC, IMETA, GC).
  
Manage conflict resolution and internal client challenge, providing accountability and certainty across both operational and project lifecycles.
  
  
Operations & Service Delivery (APAC)
  
Oversee integrated FM service delivery across the APAC portfolio, ensuring KPIs, Joint Business Plans, and compliance targets are met.
  
Partner with Workplace Experience, Real Estate, Engineering, and Risk teams to ensure integrated, seamless service delivery and positive employee experience outcomes across APAC.
  
Monitor Planned Preventive Maintenance (PPM) programs for regulatory and client-standard compliance across APAC sites.
  
Ensure business continuity, crisis management, and emergency response procedures are implemented and maintained across all APAC sites.
  
Accountable for the regional success of the "autonomous operations" model (EPIC) within APAC.
  
  
Project & Capital Programme Delivery (APAC, IMETA, Greater China)
  
Own full accountability for capital project delivery across the regional portfolio — from planning and business case through design, procurement, construction, closure, and handover to the Facility Management team.
  
Assist in developing and implementing the client's rolling 3-year capital project strategy, including annual planning and in-country delivery strategy.
  
Establish and maintain standardized project management practices, processes, and templates across all delivery stages, constructively challenging inherited approaches where regional conditions require adaptation.
  
Spearhead the client's business approval process for capital works, reviewing submissions before formal entry into client systems.
  
Drive cost assurance and value engineering across all capital packages.
  
Ensure Health & Safety is planned and implemented effectively across all project sites, particularly in live/occupied environments.
  
Ensure Client Security requirements are adhered to across project delivery, from planning to closure.
  
  
Digital and Innovation Leadership
  
Drive adoption of AI tools, smart building technologies, automation, digital transformation initiatives and data analytics to improve operational efficiency, service quality, and employee experience across APAC.
  
Lead change management initiatives related to operational technologies, digital workflows, and analytics platforms across teams and vendors.
  
Oversee collection, consolidation, and analysis of operational (APAC) and project (APAC, IMETA, GC) data to drive decision-making, using in-house and external tools for accurate status and financial reporting.
  
  
Financial & Commercial Management
  
Support achievement of financial targets, operational efficiencies, and savings initiatives across the APAC portfolio, including budgeting, forecasting, and operational expenditure management.
  
Provide governance oversight of vendor and contractor performance across both operational service providers (APAC) and project-specific vendors (designers, contractors, FF&E suppliers across APAC, IMETA, GC), including contract changes and commercial compliance.
  
Ensure all work orders and contracts for project-related contractors, designers, and suppliers are drafted, approved, executed, and formally closed out.
  
  
People Leadership & Talent Development
  
Lead, inspire, and develop a regional operations team of 80 employees across geographically dispersed, multicultural APAC sites, fostering a high-performance, accountable culture.
  
Lead and mentor a team of project/programme managers across APAC, IMETA, and GC, onboarding in-country delivery PMs and ensuring on-time, on-budget, on-specification delivery through to proper closure.
  
Maintain a robust succession plan for the account in partnership with HR, and manage team resourcing, workload allocation and participate in remuneration and talent review processes as required.
  
  
Risk, Compliance & Governance
  
Own Health & Safety and engineering/design/risk programmes across the APAC operational portfolio and all live/occupied project sites region-wide.
  
Ensure incidents are reported and managed per client and JLL procedures, and support audit readiness across both operational and project domains.
  
Identify and address potential liabilities and risk at every project stage, and ensure project/programme risks are reported and managed from planning through closure.
  
Ensure effective implementation of client standards and local regulatory requirements (fire, building code, accessibility) across diverse jurisdictions.
  
  
Key Performance Measures
  
  
**Performance will be measured through achievement of:**  
Contractual KPIs
  
Client satisfaction and employee experience outcomes
  
Financial performance, budget management, and savings targets
  
Operational consistency and service quality
  
Compliance, audit, and safety performance
  
Adoption and successful implementation of operational technology and innovation initiatives
  
Improvement in operational efficiency, automation, reporting quality, or digital maturity outcomes
  
Sustainability and operational efficiency objectives
  
Timely and accurate operational and financial reporting
  
Team engagement, capability development, and retention
  
  
Key Stakeholders
  
Regional Account Executive
  
Client Regional Leadership and Governance Teams
  
Country internal Workplace Experience Teams and client-side leadership
  
Engineering Operations and EOS Teams
  
Real Estate Teams
  
Finance, Procurement, HR, and Risk Functions
  
External Vendors and Service Providers
  
  
Competencies
  
Leadership — across both operational (APAC) and project-based (APAC, IMETA, GC) teams, with distinct management styles for each.
  
Decision Making — applying sound judgment to both day-to-day operational issues and discrete project risks.
  
Stakeholder Communication — consistent, trusted engagement across client governance layers for both operations and capital delivery.
  
Cultural Awareness — bridging global standards and local operating realities across three project regions.
  
Strategic Thinking — leveraging data and technology to improve both operational and project outcomes.
  
  
Required Qualifications & Experience
  
10+ years of progressive experience in facilities management, workplace operations, property management, or integrated facilities services.
  
Demonstrated experience overseeing multimillion dollar capital and fit-out projects of a diverse nature with multiple interdependencies (live occupancy, phased handover, FF&E coordination).
  
Experience leading or supporting digital transformation, operational technology adoption, automation, or data-driven improvement programs within FM or CRE environments.
  
Demonstrated ability to lead change, continuous improvement, and operational transformation initiatives.
  
Experience leading complex, multi-country, multi-service corporate accounts across APAC; experience across IMETA and Greater China project markets specifically is called for given the project delivery scope.
  
Strong contract literacy; confident liaising with international design consultants, fit-out contractors, and FF&E suppliers.
  
Bachelor's degree in Facilities Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or related discipline preferred.
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Procurement and Contract Manager
description:
**Position**

The Procurement and Contract Manager - Connectivity is a full-time role within the Procurement team, reporting to the Procurement Director and working in close partnership with the Connectivity business, Finance, Legal, Engineering, Project Delivery and Operations teams.

**Location**

Based in Singapore, with regional responsibilities and travel to project, supplier, landing station, cable depot and operating locations as required.

**Overview**

The Procurement and Contract Manager - Connectivity is responsible for managing day-to-day procurement activities and commercial contract management for Connectivity infrastructure projects. The role supports the Procurement Director in developing sourcing strategies, executing tenders, negotiating contracts, and managing supplier performance throughout project execution and operations.

This role supports the development and implementation of procurement strategies, contract frameworks, tendering processes, vendor management, and commercial controls to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with required technical, legal, and compliance standards.

This role will help establish and implement procurement policies, contract management procedures, governance routines, supplier management standards, and commercial discipline as BW Digital scales regionally and potentially globally.

The role contributes to commercial value, supply chain resilience, risk mitigation, and strategic vendor relationships supporting project delivery, operational reliability, and long-term business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Procurement Strategy and execution**

* Support the development and implementation of procurement strategies for the Connectivity business unit.
* Implement procurement policies, processes, governance, and approval routines.
* Build market intelligence across key connectivity suppliers, contractors and advisers.
* Drive best practice in strategic sourcing, tendering, bid evaluation, negotiation, and supplier selection.
* Act as senior day-to-day point of contact, drive accountability for procurement and contractual matters across projects.
  

**Tendering and Supplier Management**

* Manage end-to-end tender processes including prequalification, RFQ and RFP preparation, clarifications, bid levelling, commercial evaluation and award recommendations.
* Support and, where delegated, lead negotiations with contractors, suppliers, and service providers to achieve commercially advantageous outcomes.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with strategic suppliers and key market partners.
* Monitor supplier performance, commercial compliance, and contractual deliverables throughout the project lifecycle.
* Develop preferred supplier frameworks and long-term sourcing strategies for critical equipment and services.
  

**Cost Control, Risk and Governance**

* Maintain visibility of commitments, forecast costs, payment schedules, savings, variations and commercial exposure against approved budgets and business cases.
* Drive cost-saving, procurement efficiency, and value engineering without compromising quality, resilience, or delivery.
* Identify procurement, contractual and commercial risks and implement appropriate mitigation measures.
* Maintain strong commercial governance, transparency, and auditability across all procurement activities.
* Support compliance with legal, regulatory, tax, trade, and corporate requirements in each country of operation.
* Maintain complete and well-structured procurement records, tender files, contract registers, and change logs.
* Promote a disciplined, ethical, and transparent procurement culture.
  

**Contract Management**

* Support and, where delegated, co-lead the preparation, review, negotiation award, and administration of contracts, purchase orders, amendments and commercial schedules in coordination with Legal and the business owners.
* Track obligations, deliverables, payments, securities, notices, risks and deadlines through accurate contract registers.
* Review payment applications and milestone evidence and coordinate certification and approval before payment.
* Manage variations, claims, time extensions, delay impacts and contractual notices, preserving BW Digital's rights and supporting dispute avoidance.
* Support warranty, defect, SLA and maintenance-performance management during operations.
* Maintain compliance with contractual security, performance bond and insurance requirements.
* Provide clear contractual guidance to internal stakeholders during project execution.

  

**Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the principal procurement and commercial partner for the Connectivity business and provide timely, practical advice to project and operational stakeholders.
* Coordinate with Project, Design, Operations, Finance, Legal and senior management across countries and time zones.
* Provide regular procurement and contract status reports to senior management.

  

**Team Development and Capability Building**

* Help establish and improve connectivity-specific templates, commercial schedules, playbooks, negotiation positions and contract-management routines.
* Support knowledge sharing and promote strong commercial awareness across project teams.
* Contribute to building a high-performance, collaborative, and accountable culture.

  

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Mandatory Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Procurement, Supply Chain, Commercial Management, Business, Law, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Minimum 7 years of relevant procurement, commercial or contract management experience, with demonstrated ownership of complex, high-value tenders and contracts.
* Relevant experience in telecommunications, submarine cables, terrestrial fibre, network infrastructure, utilities, marine construction or another major infrastructure sector.
* Strong experience in competitive tendering, commercial evaluation, negotiation, contract drafting and post-award contract administration.
* Practical knowledge of contractual risk allocation, variations, claims, extensions of time, securities, insurance, warranties, liability and dispute management.
* Ability to interpret technical scopes, project schedules, pricing schedules and contractual documents.
* Strong analytical and financial skills, including advanced Microsoft Excel.
* Excellent organisation and document-control discipline, with the ability to manage multiple packages, deadlines, actions and approval workflows.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with clear drafting, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently across cultures, functions and time zones and to travel internationally when required.

  

**Preferred Qualifications and Experience**

* Experience with submarine cable system supply contracts, marine installation agreements, fibre construction contracts, cable maintenance arrangements or telecom capacity agreements.
* Experience working with international contract structures, multiple currencies, tax and customs considerations, sanctions and cross-border supply chains.
* Experience with digital procurement, contract lifecycle management, ERP and reporting tools such as Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power BI and e-signature platforms.
* Knowledge of the Asia-Pacific connectivity market and supplier landscape is advantageous.

title: Chief Operating Officer
description:
Position Overview
  
  
Responsible for reporting directly to the CEO and overseeing the Group's overall business operations, business delivery, organisational management, and coordination of domestic and overseas business activities.
  
  
The COO will be responsible for executing the Group's corporate strategy, ensuring business performance, organisational effectiveness, and risk and compliance management, while supporting the Group's international business expansion.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  
1. Strategic Execution & Business Performance
  
  
Translate the Group's corporate strategy into annual business objectives and operational plans.
  
  
Coordinate the execution of business plans across all business units and functional departments.
  
  
Take overall responsibility for key business performance indicators, including revenue, gross profit, and cash flow.
  
  
2. Operational Management & Process Optimisation
  
  
Establish, develop, and continuously improve the Group's operational management, internal control, business processes, and performance management systems.
  
  
Oversee cross-departmental collaboration and resolve operational bottlenecks.
  
  
Drive cost optimisation, operational efficiency, and productivity improvements.
  
  
3. International Business Development & Project Delivery
  
  
Coordinate domestic and international business projects.
  
  
Oversee business operations and implementation for overseas entities, including Singapore.
  
  
Manage external partnerships and communications with key clients.
  
  
Supervise the delivery of major projects and ensure effective risk management.
  
  
4. Business Performance Review & Financial Management
  
  
Lead business performance reviews, budget management, and resource allocation.
  
  
Establish data-driven business performance dashboards and reporting systems.
  
  
Ensure effective monitoring, execution, and closure of business initiatives.
  
  
5. Organisational & Talent Management
  
  
Build and strengthen the Group's core management team and talent pipeline.
  
  
Drive organisational culture and development initiatives.
  
  
Coordinate key corporate functions, including Human Resources, Finance, Legal, and Administration, to ensure effective organisational management.
  
  
6. Risk Management & Compliance
  
  
Identify and manage operational, contractual, financial, and overseas regulatory compliance risks.
  
  
Establish risk monitoring and early-warning mechanisms.
  
  
Ensure sustainable and compliant business operations.
  
  
Required Qualification & Traits
  
  
1. Bachelor's degree or above, with at least 5 years of senior management experience in digital marketing, new media, e-commerce, or the media industry.
  
  
Minimum 3 years of comprehensive business management experience as a COO or Head of Operations.
  
  
Experience in overseas business operations and cross-border project management will be an advantage.
  
  
2. Strong capabilities in business management, strategic planning, objective setting, management system development, and cross-functional coordination.
  
  
3. Familiar with end-to-end business operations, including commercialisation, sales commission structures, project payment collection, vendor management, and contractual risk control.
  
  
4. Strong results-oriented mindset with excellent stress management and problem-solving abilities.
  
  
Experienced in managing complex stakeholder relationships.
  
  
Possesses sound commercial judgement and strong risk awareness.
  
  
5. Aligns with the Group's strategic vision and development direction.
  
  
Demonstrates an open-minded and strategic outlook.
  
  
Strong capabilities in organisational governance, team motivation, and management development.

About the Role
  
  
We are seeking an experienced, results-driven
  
  
Head of Central Kitchen Operations

The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with a strong background in large-scale food production, operational excellence, manpower management and food safety compliance.
  
  
You will play a pivotal role in driving productivity, optimising costs, maintaining consistent food quality and ensuring efficient operations to support business growth.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Operations & Production Management
  
  
Lead and oversee daily central kitchen operations, ensuring smooth and efficient production processes.

Foster a positive working environment focused on teamwork, operational discipline and continuous improvement.

Coordinate with relevant departments to ensure seamless production, storage and distribution.
  
  
Provide regular operational reports, performance analyses and improvement recommendations to management.

Diploma or Degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Culinary Management, Operations Management or a related discipline.
  
  
Minimum 7–10 years of relevant experience
  
  
in central kitchen operations, large-scale food production, food manufacturing or institutional catering.
  
  
At least
  
  
3–5 years in a managerial or senior leadership capacity
  
  
.
  
  
Proven track record in managing high-volume production operations and multidisciplinary teams.
  
  
Strong understanding of SFA requirements, HACCP, food safety management and quality assurance.
  
  
Sound knowledge of production planning, inventory management, budgeting and cost optimisation.
  
  
Strong leadership, problem-solving, communication and decision-making skills.
  
  
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume operational environment.
  
  
Experience in process improvement, automation or operational expansion will be an advantage.
  
  
What We Offer
  
  
Competitive remuneration package.
  
  
Opportunity to lead and shape central kitchen operations.
  
  
Career growth and professional development opportunities.
  
  
A collaborative and performance-driven working environment.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Interested candidates are invited to submit their updated résumé, stating their current and expected salary, as well as their notice period.
  
  
Join us and take the lead in driving operational excellence, efficiency and sustainable growth!
  
  
'Srisun Prata.Com’, serving only South Indian cuisine started out in 2004 with an outlet located at Block 418, Yishun Avenue 11. Over the years Srisun Prata.Com has expanded to 13 outlets island wide.
  
  
With regular customers increasing requests for North Indian cuisine as well as a desire to bring a wide variety of comfort food to the heartlands, Srisun Express was born in 2012 with its first outlet at Blk 212 Hougang St 21. Open 24hours, we were privileged to serve a wide spectrum of diners, from the weekday office crowd to families and the night owls who were just looking for a good place to ‘lepak and makan’ with friends.
  
  
Today, our menu has expanded to include perennial favourites of North & South Indian, Malaysian, Western and local cuisines. It doesn’t stop there. At Srisun Express we’re constantly looking to introduce new flavours, keeping your taste buds on the edge. Our new menu includes our very own signature Sugar Rush Prata, Honeymoon Prata, Masala Buffalo wings, Goreng Specials, and a whopping 54 types of savoury and dessert pratas, as well as a drink menu that ranges from the usual Teh Tarik to Butterscotch Milkshakes and Mango Mojitos.
  
  
We’re open 24 hours a day and with such an extensive menu, we hope to cater to every taste bud and craving. We’d like to thank you for dining on board the Srisun Express, now let the food adventure begin!

title: Technical Superintendent
description:
**responsibilities are:**  
1. Ensure that the group of vessels assigned to him is performing according to the pool description and ship management agreements between PG and the respective ship owning company.
  
  
2. Ensure that the group of vessels assigned to him is run and kept in a condition according to company policy and relevant rules and regulations applicable.
  
  
3. Ensure the group of vessels assigned to him are manned with qualified crew.
  
  
4. Ensure that the operating cost for the group of vessels assigned to him is within limits, and that the future budget reflects the company policy with regards to quality and customer orientation.
  
  
5. Support PG Management on technical operational routines and development of maintenance policy / fleet management systems.
  
  
**The Technical superintendent has the following special duties:**
  
  
1. Make sure that the assigned vessel(s)at all times are maintained, crewed and kept in accordance with the rules and regulations applicable for the group of vessels assigned to him with regards to fulfilling same as well as any company policy, standard or instruction/guide-line relevant.
  
  
2. Stay in regular contact with the vessel(s).
  
  
3. In a proactive manner perform a revolving condition assessment of the vessel(s)and its development, and to identify potential risk(s) which could violate a safe and efficient ship operation.
  
  
4. Coordinate the technical operations with the commercial operator(s), and in a proactive manner inform if any deficiencies occur on a vessel that is - or can become affecting the vessel’s performance.
  
  
5. Attend vessel(s) whenever there is a potential difficult technical situation.
  
  
6. Conduct at least 3(three) visits to every vessel per year.
  
  
7. Follow up on and control of operational systems and routines such as systematic maintenance, reporting, purchasing, accounting, cost control and budget deviation, as well as other matters concerning the vessel(s) operation.
  
  
8. Evaluate received reports and verify that the reported items are correct, are reported at the correct time, and that reported items are within standards or guidelines for the matter reported.
  
  
9. Verify that all economical commitments affecting the vessel(s) operating cost is thoroughly registered in the purchase and accounting system with cost estimates, and that vessel's cost estimates are deleted at the time of passing an invoice for payment.
  
  
10. Verify at regular intervals that the vessel(s) have their Class system and Statutory requirements maintained.
  
  
11. Perform a regular follow up of the Vessel Master Plan for each ship and evaluate deviation from the plans with adjustments and imposing of corrective measures as found necessary.
  
  
12. Give information and report to/from the vessel(s) and the company management. In case any deficiency occurs on a ship the head of department shall be informed accordingly.
  
  
13. Establish "company culture" on board the vessels in cooperation with the crew managers in achieving an efficient, quality conscious Ship Management in accordance with the policies of the company as well as the Shipboard Instructions Manual.
  
  
14. Ensure that the event registry in the databased Safety Management support software for registry and analyses of accidents, near accidents and non-conformities are kept up to date and that it reflects the condition of the vessel and its history.
  
  
14. Identify cost effective improvements, modifications and alterations of technical, operational or human nature which will gain the company in respect of being a quality and safety-oriented shipowner with a sound profit margin.
  
  
15. Assist in the selection of officers and crew for the vessel(s) responsibility.
  
  
16. The company has a comprehensive set of manuals in accordance which you shall perform your duties and work. Special attention should be given to the contents of the Office Instruction Manual and the Office Contingency Manual.
  
  
17. Assist Business Development Team in technical issues to ensure experience transfer between operation and projects.
  
  
PG SHIPMANAGEMENT PTE. LTD.

The role also plays a key part in workforce retention, leadership support, and fostering a professional, collaborative, and commercially aligned workplace culture.

* Develop recruitment strategy for promoters, operational and admin roles.

* Refine and implement performance appraisal framework and continuous performance management practices.
* Identify capability gaps and coordinate targeted learning and development initiatives.
* Drive initiatives that strengthen employee accountability, teamwork, ownership, and performance standards across departments.
* Support managers in reinforcing a high-performance and collaborative work culture aligned with business objectives.

title: Crew Operator
description:
Calling on Crew Operators
  
  
At Maersk Tankers, we are experts in owning and operating tankers and gas carriers –through the energy transition. We are a global, evolving workplace where committed teams grow through opportunity, learning, and a shared pursuit for excellence.
  
  
Your opportunity to join the adventure
  
  
In Technical Management, you will join a team of talented and welcoming colleagues.
  
  
Based in our Singapore office, you will join our Crewing team and report to the Crew Manager. You will support the day-to-day delivery of crewing operations across an assigned fleet, helping ensure our vessels are manned safely and with compliant crew. Working closely with seafarers, vessels, manning agencies and colleagues across the organization, you will execute crew planning, crew changes, certification follow-up, travel coordination, and crew administration tasks. You will collaborate closely with our Crewing team in Copenhagen and be an active part of the day-to-day crewing activities supporting our global fleet
  
  
Keyresponsibilities include
  
  

* Execute crew planning and crew changearrangements
* Ensure oil major matrix requirements are met
* Coordinate crew related logistics
* Follow up on crew certification, training andemployment documentation
* Support payroll, illness and insurance cases
* General crew administration
* Participate in internal and external audits
* Build and maintain strong relationships with crew and key stakeholders

Travel may occasionally be required for vessel visits, crew seminars, conferences and other relevant activities.
  
  
Are you part of the solution?
  
  
At Maersk Tankers, you can come as you are and be among people who will expand your horizon. As our new Crew Operator, we do, however, expect that you can contribute with the following:
  
  

* Minimum 2-3 years of relevantexperience within crewing, maritime personnel administration, HR operations, orship operations support
* Knowledge of STCW and MLC Convention
* Experience with crew planning, crewchanges, crew administration, or certification management
* Strong communication, relationship-building,and problem-solving skills
* Attention to detail and the abilityto manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment
* Knowledge of tanker vessel operationsis an advantage
* Experience with a personnel management system is an advantage. We use Compas as our Crewing system.

About Maersk Tankers
  
  
Maersk Tankers and affiliated companies operate one of the largest tanker fleets in the world through direct ownership and commercial management solutions for shipowners. Our mission is to be experts in owning and operating tankers and gas carriers through the energy transition, building on a legacy that dates to1928. Maersk Tankers employs approximately 300 people in Denmark, Singapore, India, UK and the U.S. and is domiciled in Copenhagen, Denmark. Maersk Tankers is part of A.P. Moller Group owned by A.P. Moller Holding.
  
  
Additional information is available at www.maersktankers.com.
  
  
Maersk Tankers is an industry leader and owns and operates one of the world’s largest of fleet of product tankers in addition to crude oil carriers and gas carriers – all built and operated in accordance with the highest standards for quality and reliability. We acquired our first dedicated tanker in 1928, and we’ve been expanding and improving our fleet to meet changing customer needs ever since.
  
  
Maersk Tankers is represented across the world and employ about 340 people ashore and 3,800 seafarers – from a range of different backgrounds and with more than 25 nationalities.

title: QAEHS Lead APAC
description:
##### **Ever dreamed of working where fragrances tell stories?**

At Eurofragance, we don’t just create fragrances — we create experiences. With passion, excellence and bold entrepreneurial spirit, we’re growing fast and want you to grow with us.  
Join a global team headquartered in Barcelona, with offices in Dubai, Singapore, Mexico, Turkey, India… and more!

Here, your work truly matters — and so do you.

**What's your mission?**

The Regional QAEHS Lead – APAC is responsible for leading and continuously improving Quality Assurance, Environmental, Health and Safety performance across the APAC region, ensuring compliance with legal requirements, corporate standards and relevant management systems, including ISO 9001 and ISO 45001.

The role translates global QAEHS objectives into effective local actions through risk management, regulatory oversight and strong field engagement. It works closely with laboratory, production, warehousing and support functions to identify risks and deviations, drive corrective and preventive actions, and support safe, compliant and operationally effective practices.

**️Here’s what you’ll be rocking every day**

* **Regional QAEHS Leadership and Compliance Management**:
    
  Lead the implementation of global QAEHS strategy, objectives and standards across APAC. Translate global requirements into locally applicable procedures, controls, risk assessments and action plans. Establish and maintain a systematic process for identifying, evaluating and monitoring applicable Quality, Health & Safety and Environmental legal requirements in Singapore and support equivalent compliance processes across the region. Act as the regional technical reference, providing clear guidance to local sites, and escalating significant risks or compliance gaps.
* **Operational Risk Assessment**:
* Develop a detailed understanding of processes, tasks and materials, especially in production, warehouse and laboratories, observing activities, failures, deviations and improvement opportunities first-hand to identify hazards, and ensure that the resulting mitigation measures are implemented effectively and sustained over time.
* Provide practical, technically sound recommendations to Operations and take part in QAEHS assessments of new processes, equipment, materials and changes.
* **Quality Assurance, Procedure and audits:** Ensure effective implementation of the Quality Management System and ISO 9001 requirements. Develop, review and enforce QAEHS procedures, and manage quality risks associated with changes. Plan and perform internal audits with a critical, independent and proactive approach, identifying strengths, systemic weaknesses and improvement opportunities. Manage external and internal audits and ensure effective closure of findings.
* **Training and Awareness**: Identify training needs and coordinate appropriate programs for employees and contractors. Promote a strong culture of safety, quality, environmental responsibility and continuous improvement through practical communication, coaching and regular field interaction.
* **Environmental and Waste Management**: Oversee environmental risk management and implement an effective waste management system. Assess environmental aspects and impacts, including waste, emissions, spills, water, energy and chemical storage, and define appropriate controls and improvement actions.
* **Incident and Non-conformities Management and Reporting**: Ensure timely reporting, investigation and follow-up of accidents, near misses, environmental incidents, quality incidents and non-conformities. Critically review root-cause analyses and challenge actions that are unclear or insufficient. Ensure actions have defined owners and deadlines, verify effectiveness before closure, monitor recurrence and trends, and provide guidelines and leadership to APAC stakeholders.
* **KPI Monitoring and Continuous Improvement**: Monitor and track HSE-related KPIs to assess performance and drive improvements across safety, quality, and environmental management practices.
* **Emergency Preparedness**: Ensure that emergency plans are in place, up-to-date, and regularly tested to guarantee a swift response to any critical incidents.

**What you need to shine in this role**

* Bachelor's degree in Occupational health and safety, Environmental Science, Chemistry, Biology, Chemical engineering or another relevant technical discipline.
* Minimum five years of relevant QAEHS experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably within the chemical industry.
* Bizsafe Level 2
* WSQ Advanced Certificate in WSH
* ISO 9001 and/or ISO 45001 auditor training is highly desirable.

**What do we offer you at Eurofragance?**  
Much more than just a job! Take a look at everything we’ve prepared for you:

* Stability and growth in a solid company in full expansion.
* Staggered hours and hybrid work—freedom to thrive (as long as role is eligible for these arrangements).
* International environment with a multicultural team and language practice.
* Medical & life insurance for your peace of mind.
* Dental coverage for brighter smiles.
* Medical checkup reimbursements for your continued well-being
* Flexible benefits tailored to your lifestyle.
* Empowering your potential through continuous learning.
* Special prices on perfumes, because you’ll want to wear what we create.
* Family care leave for life’s important moments.

**Why Eurofragance?**

We believe in diversity and in creating a space where everyone feels welcome — regardless of gender, age, background, orientation, or ability.  
We’re also deeply committed to sustainability: reducing our carbon footprint, enhancing energy efficiency and cultivating environmental respect.  
By joining us, you become part of a company that actively works to make a positive impact on the planet — and on people.

**Ready to join us on this sensorial adventure?**

title: Application Vulnerability Management Lead
description:
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Vulnerability Management and Remediation
  
  
Review findings from security scans, penetration tests, threat intelligence, and security assessments. Validate severity and prioritise remediation based on exploitability, data sensitivity, application criticality, and business impact.
  
  
Partner with Cyber Security, Technology Risk, Development, Architecture, Infrastructure, and Application Support teams to agree on remediation plans, owners, timelines, and dependencies. Challenge proposed approaches where needed.
  
  
Drive application fixes, security patching, software upgrades, and technology obsolescence remediation across the portfolio. Track delivery against agreed service-level targets and escalate critical, high-risk, or overdue items.
  
  
Coordinate compensating controls, risk acceptance, and exception management when remediation cannot be completed within agreed timelines.
  
  
Maintain an accurate vulnerability inventory and validate supporting evidence before closure. Ensure remediation follows secure SDLC, DevSecOps, and technology risk standards.
  
  
Governance and Reporting
  
  
Report vulnerability ageing, SLA compliance, risk exposure, and remediation trends to senior management and Technology, Risk, and Cyber Security stakeholders.
  
  
Present material risks, delivery blockers, and escalations at governance forums. Maintain records and closure evidence to support audit, regulatory, and compliance reporting.
  
  
Act as the primary point of contact for application remediation and hold delivery teams accountable for agreed actions.
  
  
Application Support and Operational Resilience
  
  
Lead Level 3 support for mission-critical applications. Coordinate major incident resolution with Level 1 and Level 2 teams, lead root cause analysis, and drive corrective and preventive actions.
  
  
Oversee production changes, releases, and deployments. Monitor application health, performance, and service levels using enterprise observability tools.
  
  
Maintain support procedures, runbooks, and knowledge repositories. Support capacity planning, disaster recovery exercises, and operational resilience initiatives.
  
  
Lead and mentor support and remediation teams, including offshore resources where applicable. Work with vendors and internal stakeholders to resolve issues and improve remediation tracking, monitoring, and support workflows through automation.
  
  
Skills and Experience
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, cybersecurity or a related discipline.
  
  
12–15 years of experience across vulnerability management, application security, technology risk, application support, or technology operations.
  
  
Proven experience coordinating application vulnerability remediation across multiple technology teams, including risk assessment, SLA tracking, exception management, and evidence-based closure.
  
  
Experience leading Level 3 application support teams and managing major incidents, root cause analysis, and production changes.
  
  
Track record of delivering security patching, technology upgrades, and obsolescence remediation, and presenting risk and operational updates to senior stakeholders.
  
  
Strong understanding of application architecture, OWASP Top 10, secure coding, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, Agile, and CI/CD practices.
  
  
Experience with vulnerability platforms such as Veracode, Checkmarx, Snyk, Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, ACS, or equivalent, and with observability tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, or New Relic.
  
  
Hands-on knowledge of Java/J2EE, WebLogic, JBoss EAP, Tomcat, Oracle SQL, IBM MQ, web services and REST APIs, Apache HTTP Server, and Unix/Linux shell scripting. Good understanding of cloud and infrastructure technologies.
  
  
Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills, with the ability to challenge remediation plans and drive timely decisions under pressure.
  
  
Domain advantage
  
  
Experience in Cards and Payments, including tokenisation, 3D Secure, merchantacquiring, commercial cards, or digital banking.
