title: Growth Operations Manager
description:
First Circle is an **SME-focused, credit-centric, and multi-product NeoBank in SE Asia which is fast-growing (>100%), profitable, and internationalising soon.** We started life as an SME lender in the Philippines in 2016 to solve the SME credit gap by using technology to systemise underwriting, deliver exceptional UX, and automate away delivery costs. We’ve delivered our clients the fastest, cheapest, most flexible credit line available to businesses anywhere in Southeast Asia. We’ve been rewarded with both fast growth and exceptional unit economics, a rare combination in our space.

Over the past two years we’ve expanded our product range to include **business bank accounts & payments, e-Invoices, corporate credit cards, rooftop solar, and most recently deposits catalysed by securing a full bank charter in the Philippines**. In 2027, we’ll expand our geographical coverage to include at least two new markets in APAC.

Our excellent track record results from our people & culture. We combine high standards & intensity with a collegiate environment. Our barometers of success are the rate of **personal growth of our people, how long high performers choose to stay, and ensuring we we raise the bar with every hire.**

We’re looking for a hands-on **Growth Operations Manager** to join our Operations team, focusing specifically on the operations for our New Product launches. Operations is the team at First Circle that keeps the business running. We are launching new products and growing existing products, including corporate credit cards, invoice financing, and payments accounts and payroll. To launch and grow these products we need operators who keep a finger on the pulse of everything that is happening. You understand what customers want and need, you know our processes, and you execute with a high degree of precision and excellence. You will report to our Head of New Product Operations in this role.

The ideal candidate has **strong problem solving and analytical skills**, and is also **able to work with other people to make things happen in reality**. You don’t stop at finding a neat solution to a problem. You also want to implement change and to see the results of your work. You are comfortable working with data, have some familiarity with how sales teams work, and are able to partner with other people.

**First Circle is changing small business banking in the Philippines. The sky is the limit for someone who wants to get stuck in and make a difference.**

### **An example day in this role**

You are generating a report on daily payments. You see that there is a mismatch in the volume of transactions according to our internal systems vs the report from our payments processor. You write a query to dive deeper into the data, and you notice that there is a mistake in our third party report from our payments processor because they have double counted certain transactions. You discover that they have double counted all the transactions relating to one specific sub-set of customers. You reach out to our payments processor to inform them of this issue, and get them to update their reports. You also ensure that they identify the root cause behind their problem and update their process so it doesn’t occur again.

### **Responsibilities**

* Reporting on product performance (new customers, usage, growth, retention)
* Conducting ad hoc analysis and investigations to identify opportunities for improvement
* Designing new solutions to problems that we haven’t solved
* Refining existing processes to make them run smoother or faster
* Executing (and ideally automating) recurring processes

  
**Requirements**  

* **Must have: Strong SQL skills and knowledge with proven impactful commercial projects.**
* **Educational Background:** Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Management, STEM or similar field
* **Professional Experience:** 4+ years of work experience in an operations or an analytics role (ideally in a finance, fintech, or tech environment and/or in a sales operations team)

* **Strong Analytical & Technical Skills:** Proven problem-solving ability with experience in data analysis and tools.
* **Execution-Oriented Mindset:** Practical and solutions-driven, with the ability to take initiatives from problem identification through implementation. Highly practical. Can take a problem, find a solution, and then make things happen

  
**Benefits**  

* **Flexible work set-up**
* **Work at a fast-growing fintech on meaningful products** that reshape SME finance in Southeast Asia with plenty of growth opportunities
* **Additional perks & benefits** including health insurance from day one, MacBooks, training budget and more
* **Join a team with a deeply collaborative culture!** Learn more here: https://www.firstcircle.ph/careers

title: Manager – Manufacturing QA
description:
As the leader of the Quality Assurance Product Focus Team (PFT) in Tuas, you’ll drive Manufacturing Quality, Availability and Value across Resmed’s operations. Your work helps protect patient safety while improving performance and innovation in how our products are made.

You’ll lead a team that uses risk-based and data-driven quality methods to strengthen manufacturing systems and deliver consistent, reliable outcomes. Working closely with engineering, operations and digital teams, you’ll embed quality into every stage of production to uphold Resmed’s reputation for trusted, high-quality healthcare technology.

  

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead the QA PFT team to achieve Manufacturing Quality, Availability and Value objectives through risk-based Quality Engineering strategies that safeguard patients, customers and performance.
* Drive Quality by Design and manufacturing readiness for new products, processes and technologies, ensuring robust quality controls through all cross-functional deliverables and phase transitions.
* Establish and refine Manufacturing QA standards, methods and tools to enhance consistency, scalability and engineering capability across global manufacturing teams.
* Provide quality leadership for major strategic initiatives, including automation, MES adoption, site expansion and new production lines, ensuring quality readiness and risk mitigation.
* Use manufacturing data and leading indicators to anticipate risks, eliminate recurrences, strengthen Right First Time performance and drive continuous improvement.
* Advance QA transformation toward preventive and system-enforced quality controls using digital and data-driven technologies.
* Lead quality governance, risk management and compliance with Resmed QMS and relevant regulatory standards.
* Build collaborative partnerships across engineering, operations and digital functions, embedding quality in manufacturing design and execution.
Coach, develop and empower a high-performing QA PFT team with a focus on accountability and continuous improvement.  

  

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Science with at least 8 years’ experience in regulated volume manufacturing, including Quality Engineering leadership.
* Deep understanding of Manufacturing Quality, Quality Systems, risk management, process validation and Quality by Design principles.
* Proven success leading complex quality initiatives, managing risks and driving systemic improvements.
* Experience in readiness planning and risk-based assurance for manufacturing technologies and processes.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data, trends and leading indicators for preventive decision making.
* Effective leadership, coaching and collaboration skills within cross-functional and matrixed environments.
Demonstrated ability to deliver strategic priorities and outcomes at scale.  

  

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in Quality and/or Regulatory leadership in medical device manufacturing.
* Familiarity with automation, MES, digital quality, CSV/CSA and advanced manufacturing technologies.
* Exposure to AI, analytics and data-driven technologies for improving quality performance.
Track record of developing QA capabilities and leading organizational change.  

  

**What Sets You Apart**

* **Strategic Quality Leadership** - You inspire teams to connect compliance with business excellence.
* **Preventive Mindset** - You naturally look upstream to mitigate risks before they occur.
* **Data-Driven Thinking** - You translate metrics and signals into action that brings measurable improvement.
* **Collaborative Partnership** - You thrive in cross-functional settings and build strong working relationships.
* **Continuous Improvement Orientation** - You’re motivated by making good processes even better.
* **Coaching Focus** - You enable growth and accountability within your team.

  

**Why Join Resmed** Resmed exists to pioneer innovative solutions that help millions breathe, sleep and live healthier lives. In our manufacturing environment, your leadership will directly enhance product quality and reliability that patients depend on every day. You’ll work with diverse global teams committed to continuous improvement, innovative technology and operational excellence—each contributing to better healthcare outcomes around the world.

#LI-APAC

Joining us is more than saying “yes” to making the world a healthier place. It’s discovering a career that’s challenging, supportive and inspiring. Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now!

title: Sales Coordinator - South Asian Markets
description:
As a
  
  
Sales Coordinator
  
  
focusing on our South Asian markets (including India, Thailand, & Vietnam), you will bring critical project management skills crucial to speeding up the sales process, keeping deals organised by working closely with the deal team, including BDs, AMs, Pre-sales, legal, compliance, implementation, product, engineering, etc to ensure deals run smoothly from qualified opportunity to signed contract. This is a pivotal role on our deal team, organising and managing strategic deals across the region.
  
  
Your focus will be on project managing strategic deals, owning stakeholder management, and RFP submissions, working with cross-functional teams, ensuring alignment on deal timelines and more. Your efforts will directly impact our ability to sell better, quicker, and win larger deals.
  
  
**What you’ll be doing:**  
Strategic Deal Project Management - Lead and manage the highest impact and most complex opportunities. This involves coordinating multiple internal and external stakeholders to adhere to agreed timelines and ensure the timely completion of all critical elements. Maintain deal team accountability and proactively manage potential risks throughout the deal process.
  
  
**Stakeholder Maps and engagement management:** Develop and maintain detailed stakeholder maps for key deals and accounts within the APAC region. Proactively manage engagement with internal and external stakeholders, including working and C-Level stakeholders, ensuring clear communication, alignment on goals, and timely execution of deal activities.
  
  
Manage the end-to-end Request for Proposal/Information (RFP/I) process, including coordinating information gathering from Sales, Product, Legal, and Finance teams, reviewing and editing proposals for clarity and compliance, maintaining an up-to-date repository of standard responses, and ensuring timely submission.
  
  
Coordinating deal workstreams, decisions, and communication to ensure internal and external alignment.
  
  
Drive the deal teams forward across opportunities by assisting with tasks such as managing regular project cadences across internal and external teams, at both working and executive levels, and participating in RFP submissions.
  
  
Collaborate with the wider sales operations team to impact global initiatives, adding resources and tools to empower selling individuals for more effective, efficient, and successful deals.
  
  
Supporting various content and event strategies to effectively help create top of the funnel across APAC.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
**You'd be a great fit for the role if you have:**  
At least 2 years of experience in sales enablement or GTM roles within payments, banking, financial services, consulting, or SaaS industries
  
  
Demonstrated experience directing and governing complex project portfolios with multiple concurrent streams and internal/external stakeholders
  
  
Expertise with project management and collaboration tools – e.g Airtable, Asana, Google sheets, Slack, etc
  
  
Able to extract and translate raw data into actionable insights and strategic recommendations for stakeholders. With the ability to understand and write basic SQL queries.
  
  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  
  
Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  
  
Detail-oriented and organised with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  
  
A proactive and creative thinker who can contribute fresh ideas to the team.
  
  
Resourceful and adaptable, with a strong ability to build processes from scratch and iterate in a fast-paced environment
  
  
Some Extra Skills That Would Be Awesome
  
  
Knowledge of CRM software (e.g., Salesforce)
  
  
Experience as part of a team selling to enterprises (multi-stakeholder deals). Part of an outbound sales motion with a focus on consultative sales and account based marketing
  
  
Who we are
  
  
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move money around the world. With the Wise account people and businesses can hold over 40 currencies, move money between countries and spend money abroad. Large companies and banks use Wise technology too; an entirely new cross-border payments network that will one day power money without borders for everyone, everywhere. However you use the platform, Wise is on a mission to make your life easier and save you money.
  
  
Co-founded by Kristo Käärmann and Taavet Hinrikus, Wise launched in 2011 under its original name TransferWise. It is one of the world’s fastest growing, profitable technology companies and is listed on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker, WISE.
  
  
16 million people and businesses use Wise. In fiscal year 2023, Wise processed approximately £105 billion in cross-border transactions, saving customers around £1.5 billion.
  
  
What it’s really like to work here
  
  
At Wise, we do things a bit differently. There’s no corporate nonsense, and no old-fashioned hierarchy. Instead, we work in dozens of self-sufficient, autonomous teams. Think of them like start-ups within a start-up that learn from each other.
  
  
Each team picks the problems they want to solve. So there’s no micro-management. No hiding behind fancy job titles. And no one telling you what to do. You are your own boss. But you’ll get tons of guidance and plenty of support from talented, super-smart colleagues from all over Wise.
  
  
We’re going to be upfront — the way we work doesn’t suit everyone. But if freedom, autonomy, and life-affirming, head-scratching professional challenges rock your world, we could be a match made in heaven.

title: Sales Executive - Polymer (Engineering Plastics)

Sales Executive – Polymer (Engineering Plastics)

Singapore
  
  
Territory
  
  
Singapore and JB and Batam

Regional travel, approx. [30–40]% of working time
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
The Sales Executive is responsible for developing and growing the engineering plastics business across Singapore, Johor Bahru and Batam.
  
  
The role focuses on new business development, customer acquisition, account management and technical-commercial selling. The successful candidate is expected to independently manage customer accounts, identify new applications, provide material recommendations and drive projects from initial enquiry through to commercialization.
  
  
The position requires a strong commercial mindset, sound engineering plastics knowledge and the ability to work independently while leveraging technical support from suppliers and principals when required.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Business Development
  
  

* Proactively identify and develop new customers, applications and business opportunities within the assigned territory.
* Develop and execute sales strategies to increase market penetration and grow the engineering plastics portfolio.
* Establish relationships with OEMs, moulders, contract manufacturers and other potential customers.

**Account management:**  

* Independently manage and grow existing customer accounts.
* Understand customer requirements, purchasing behaviour and future business potential.
* Build strong customer relationships to improve customer retention and identify cross-selling opportunities.

**Commercial Execution:**  

* Manage customer visits, quotations, pricing negotiations, order follow-up and commercial agreements.
* Monitor selling prices, gross margins, sales forecasts and customer demand.
* Work closely with internal teams to manage inventory, payment collections and supply requirements.

Technical-Commercial Selling
  
  

* Provide material recommendations based on customer application, performance and processing requirements.
* Identify opportunities for material substitution, product improvement and cost optimisation.
* Coordinate with suppliers and principals to address technical enquiries, processing issues and application challenges.

Project and Pipeline Managements
  
  

* Take ownership of customer projects from initial enquiry, material selection and product trials through qualification and commercial supply.
* Coordinate with product managers, segment managers and suppliers to accelerate project conversion.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date project pipelines, sales forecasts and customer information in Salesforce.

**Market intelligence:**  

* Monitor trends in engineering plastics, customer requirements and competitor activities, and share relevant market and customer insights with the sales team.

**Performance:**  

* Achieve agreed sales volume, revenue, gross profit and gross margin targets.
* Deliver sustainable and profitable business growth.
* Monitor sales performance and implement corrective actions where necessary.

**Representation:**  

* Represent the company professionally at customer meetings, trade exhibitions, technical seminars, supplier meetings and industry events.

Qualifications and Experience
  
  

* Diploma or degree in Polymer Science, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry or a related technical field.
* 1–3 years' experience in B2B sales, preferably in the chemicals, plastics, polymers or industrial sectors.
* Basic knowledge of polymer materials, applications and processing, particularly injection moulding, would be an advantage.
* Experience in managing customer accounts, developing new business or working in a technical-commercial role would be an advantage.
* Good communication, presentation, interpersonal and problem-solving skills.
* Willing to travel regionally as required.

Key Competencies
  
  
•
  
  
**Commercial awareness:**  
Understands customer and market needs, identifies business opportunities and contributes to sales growth.
  
  
•
  
  
**Communication:**  
Works effectively with customers, suppliers and internal teams across cultures.
  
  
•
  
  
**Self-management:**  
Self-driven and well organised, handling multiple customer enquiries, projects and priorities at the same time.
  
  
•
  
  
**Customer focus:**  
Practical problem-solver with high integrity and a customer-centric mindset.
  
  
GME Chemicals is a premier distributor and supplier of specialty chemicals, polymers, and rubber, serving industries such as pharmaceuticals, food and beverage, personal care, and industrial applications. Known for their commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction, GME Chemicals offers a wide range of high-performance products from reputable global manufacturers. Their expertise in providing tailored solutions ensures optimal performance and compliance with industry standards.
  
  
Operating in seven countries across Asia, GME Chemicals has built a reputation for reliability and technical excellence. Their skilled team works closely with clients to deliver customized chemical and material solutions that drive efficiency and success.
  
  
In partnership with Biesterfeld, a leading international distributor, GME Chemicals expands its reach and capabilities. This collaboration enhances their access to a diverse range of high-quality products and global market insights. Together, GME Chemicals and Biesterfeld employ approximately 1200 people, leveraging their combined industry experience and technical support to offer innovative solutions and superior service.
  
  
GME Chemicals and Biesterfeld are dedicated to fostering sustainable growth and advancing their customers' industries through exceptional chemical, polymer, and rubber products and services.

**Job Description:** Workday Finance Manager
  
  
Role Summary
  
The Workday Finance Manager is responsible for managing the day-to-day delivery and support of Workday Financials, including BAU operations, change requests, system enhancements and Finance-related projects.
  
The role requires strong Finance functional knowledge combined with Workday Financials experience , with the ability to independently manage client and stakeholder discussions, coordinate functional and technical teams, and ensure issues, changes and projects are delivered effectively.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Workday Finance & BAU Management
  
Manage day-to-day Workday Finance activities and operational requirements.
  
Act as the primary point of coordination for Finance-related Workday matters.
  
Lead regular operational, project and stakeholder meetings.
  
Manage Finance issues, actions, risks, dependencies and escalations through to resolution.
  
Coordinate across Finance, IT, Workday support and other internal and external teams.
  
Ensure BAU services are stable and delivered in accordance with agreed service levels and priorities.
  
Change Request & Enhancement Management
  
Manage Workday Finance Change Requests (CRs) from requirement through assessment, estimation, approval, development, testing and deployment.
  
Work with functional and technical teams to assess scope, effort, dependencies and delivery timelines.
  
Maintain oversight of the CR and enhancement pipeline, including prioritisation and status.
  
Ensure appropriate approvals are obtained before commencing changes.
  
Coordinate testing, business validation and production deployment.
  
Workday Finance Project Management
  
Manage Workday Financials projects, enhancements and improvement initiatives.
  
Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, RAID logs and action trackers.
  
Coordinate Finance functional consultants, integration, reporting, security, data and technical resources.
  
Monitor project scope, timeline, resource requirements and dependencies.
  
Identify delivery risks early and drive appropriate mitigation and escalation.
  
Provide regular and clear status updates to key stakeholders.
  
Security & Access Management
  
Coordinate Workday security and system-access requirements for Finance teams and project resources.
  
Manage and monitor CyberArk/privileged-access requests and approvals , where applicable.
  
Coordinate access requirements across production and non-production environments.
  
Work with Security, IT and application teams to resolve access-related issues.
  
Ensure appropriate access-control and security processes are followed.
  
Release, Testing & Deployment
  
Coordinate testing activities for Finance changes, enhancements and projects.
  
Manage defect tracking and resolution.
  
Coordinate business validation and sign-off.
  
Manage production deployment and post-deployment validation.
  
Ensure proper documentation and handover to BAU support teams.
  
Required Experience & Skills
  
Strong Finance or accounting functional background.
  
5+ years of Workday Financials experience , preferably covering implementation, enhancement and/or AMS environments.
  
Strong understanding of Workday Financials processes and configuration.
  
Experience managing Workday Finance BAU and Change Requests.
  
Experience managing Workday implementation, enhancement or transformation projects.
  
Strong project-management and stakeholder-management skills.
  
Ability to independently lead client and business meetings.
  
Experience coordinating functional and technical Workday teams.
  
Good understanding of Workday integrations, reporting and security from a project-management perspective.
  
Experience managing testing, deployment and production support activities.
  
Strong problem-solving, communication and escalation-management skills.
  
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  
Preferred Experience
  
Workday Financial Management implementation certification or equivalent hands-on Workday Financials experience.
  
Experience across areas such as General Ledger, Accounting Center, Business Assets, Banking & Settlement, Supplier Accounts, Customer Accounts and Financial Reporting .
  
Experience working in a Workday AMS or managed-services environment.
  
Experience managing complex enterprise customers with stringent security and access-management processes.
  
Project-management certification such as PMP or PRINCE2 would be advantageous but is not mandatory.

title: Head of Business Development, Agency
description:
At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as Head of Business Development - Agency to play your part in that transformation. It’s an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.

**How you will create an impact**

You will be leading a strong team of Business Development Managers (BDM) to drive and meet agency business objectives, and at the same time, help the producers meet their professional goals. The team is required to have a strong understanding of the company sales process (product, underwriting appetite, compliance, claims, service process) and the external market environment (customer buying trends, competitor's strength and weaknesses).

**Sales Management**

* To demonstrate sound and strict sales management discipline over your portfolio through a planned and focused business review program/goal setting on selected producers
* To be proficient with sales numbers through weekly tracking and measuring of production trends to ensure budget are met

**Business Development & Retention**

* To drive and work with producers and underwriters to identify new business opportunities and procure new business
* To work with producers to identify business opportunities and build accounts pipeline through the producers’ networks and clientele base
* To be with producers for joint field work with or without the underwriters
* To work with producers and underwriters to achieve targeted retention ratio
* To work with producers to target profitable market and secure healthy business portfolio and business mix

**Reactivation & Productivity**

* To reactivate & engage dormant agents to increase overall activity ratio
* To support and execute activities to achieve targeted productivity ratio
* To develop producer’s career with AIG through business expansion, progression and succession planning

**Training & Engagement**

* To supplement core training curriculum to ensure producers under your care are competent to professionally represent our business
* To organize and participate in regular agency engagement events

**Campaign Management**

* To initiate and execute sales campaign to create opportunities for new business and/or renewal business through cross sell, up sell and portfolio analysis
* To support campaign through your sales activities in order to achieve campaign objectives

**Recruitment**

* To achieve recruitment target – new entrants, new Line of Business producers and upgrades of agent tier.
* To support and execute activities to achieve recruitment target

**What you’ll need to succeed**

* Bachelors’ Degree Preferred
* Experience in General Insurance industry with good knowledge of Consumer and Commercial products
* Possess BCP, PGI, ComGI & Health Insurance certification
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build credibility quickly with new agents
* High energy and driven to meet sales targets; and
* Adaptable and able to work independently and under stress

#LI-RO1

At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.

**Enjoy benefits that take care of what matters**

At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

**Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world**

American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become.

**Welcome to a culture of** **inclusion**

We’re committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other’s talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging through learning, cultural awareness activities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion. The talent of our people is one of AIG’s greatest assets, and we are honored that our drive for positive change has been recognized by numerous recent awards and accreditations.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Our Journey
  
  
The ShopBack Group is Asia-Pacific's leading shopping and rewards platform, trusted by over 20 million active members across 13 markets, including Germany and the United States. Driven by the vision to make every day more rewarding, ShopBack saves members money and time with more ways to earn and more to do with what they earn, and empowers merchants and brand partners to effectively engage its members. Founded in Singapore in 2014, ShopBack now powers over US$5.5 billion in annual sales and half a million transactions a day for more than 20,000 online and in-store partners.
  
  
**About the Role:**  
At ShopBack, AI is how we build. It is not a side tool. You will ship products with AI agents as teammates, and you will use them to ship features that reach millions of ShopBack customers, faster and with higher quality.
  
  
What You'll Own
  
  
Own features end to end. You take a feature from idea to design, build, test, ship, and operate. You use AI to move faster at every step, and you stay accountable for the result.
  
  
Turn repeated work into reusable AI assets. You use and improve the shared skills, tools, and agent workflows your team relies on every day, and you contribute the ones that are missing, so you do not write one-off prompts that nobody can reuse.
  
  
Make AI output measurable. You back every AI-assisted change with tests, review, and guardrails so that we can trust what agents produce.
  
  
Build loops, not tasks. You use agents in CI, code review, and incident response, and feed what you learn back into how the team works so the system gets better each time it runs.
  
  
Design clean, scalable services. You build the APIs and backend services behind our apps, payments, and partner integrations.
  
  
Find where AI changes the product itself. You work with product, data, and design on ideas that go beyond changing how we build.
  
  
Explain trade-offs clearly. You analyse requirements, propose solutions, and say when AI is the wrong tool.
  
  
Raise the bar. You lead projects, mentor engineers, and share what works so the whole org becomes more AI-native
  
  
Essentials to Succeed
  
  
Strong fundamentals. You know system design, data structures, testing, and debugging. AI makes good engineers better. It does not replace fundamentals.
  
  
Proof that you applied AI, not only used it. Show us something you built.
  
  
Healthy scepticism. You treat AI output like code from a new teammate. You review, verify, and test it.
  
  
Production experience. You have built and run services in the cloud. Experience with consumer-facing products is a plus.
  
  
Learning velocity. You pick up new tools fast, and you drop old habits when a better tool arrives.
  
  
**Fresh graduates:** side projects, hackathons, internships, and open source all count. Send us the repo.
  
  
Bonus Points
  
  
**You built agent infrastructure at scale:** sandboxes, runtimes, orchestration, or permission models.
  
  
You designed LLM-as-judge or eval pipelines that the team trusts.
  
  
You shipped AI features to real users and handled cost, latency, and failure modes.
  
  
**You put AI into the SDLC:** automated MR review, test generation, or incident triage.
  
  
Technologies We Use & Love
  
  
**Core:** TypeScript / Node.js, React, Postgres, Kafka, SQS, Kubernetes on AWS, Knative, Debezium
  
  
**Delivery & Ops:** GitLab CI, Datadog
  
  
**Data:** Redshift, Spark, S3
  
  
AI: Claude Code/Codex, MCP
  
  
We care more about how fast you learn a stack than about which stack you already know.
  
  
ShopBacker Traits
  
  
Agency
  
  

* We take ownership and act, rather than waiting for permission. When something's blocking progress, we find a way through it and follow through until it's done.

Judgement
  
  

* We aim for high-impact decisions, not just easy wins, and we put the bigger picture ahead of individual interests. That means moving quickly and confidently, while staying thoughtful about when a call really matters.

Learning Velocity
  
  

* We pick up new skills fast and let go of old habits just as quickly when something better comes along. We benchmark ourselves against the best and keep raising our own bar.

Tenacity
  
  

* We stay in it when things get hard, keeping a level head under pressure. We debate openly before deciding, then commit fully — and support each other along the way.

What's in it for ShopBackers
  
  
Career growth
  
  
opportunities to take on greater challenges that help you realise your ambitions.
  
  
Be part of a winning team
  
  
on a journey to global scale.
  
  
Competitive compensation
  
  
based on performance.
  
  
Candid, open, and collaborative culture
  
  
where feedback is valued.
  
  
The ShopBack Group is Asia-Pacific’s leading shopping, rewards, and payments platform, serving over 20 million active members across 13 markets. In 2025, the Group continued its global growth with its expansion into North America. Driven by the vision to make every day more rewarding, ShopBack is dedicated to saving members money and time, and delivering delight every day. The platform also enables merchants and brands to engage with their members in a cost-effective manner. Founded in 2014, ShopBack now powers over US$5.5 billion in annual sales for over 20,000 online and in-store partners, and has rewarded shoppers with more than US$900 million (over S$1 billion) in Cashback to date. Through its innovative offerings, ShopBack continues to create value for both members and merchants. Notably, its payment solution, ShopBack Pay, offers members a convenient and rewarding payment option at checkout.

title: Area Sales Manager, Export APAC
description:
Obsessed by Science. Entrepreneurial by Nature. United by Purpose.
  
  
Diasorin is a global leader in immunodiagnostic and molecular diagnostic solutions, advancing science to improve patient outcomes worldwide. For more than 50 years, we have combined scientific rigor with an entrepreneurial mindset, operating with a strong commitment to innovation, accountability, and results to deliver trusted diagnostic solutions.
  
  
As the Diagnostics Specialist, Diasorin continuously invests in research, technology, and people. Guided by our values of operational excellence, customer focus, and teamwork, we empower teams to think boldly, act decisively, and transform ideas into meaningful impact across one of the industry’s broadest specialty diagnostic portfolios.
  
  
When you join Diasorin, you are not just filling a role. You are helping build what comes next.
  
Why Join Diasorin
  
  
Build What Matters
  
Take ownership, challenge the status quo, and contribute directly to solutions that improve patient care worldwide.
  
Innovate with Agility at a Global Scale
  
Work in an entrepreneurial environment that enables speed, collaboration, and global impact.
  
Grow in a People-Centered Culture
  
Thrive in a culture that values accountability, inclusion, and continuous development.
  
  
Job Scope
  
  
**Location:** Vietnam or Thailand
  
  
The Area Sales Manager is responsible for successfully managing the distributors (Channel Partners - CP) to deliver revenue targets to Diasorin’s Export APAC region. The Area Sales Manager ensures 360-degree collaboration between CPs and Diasorin, in sales, marketing, service, logistics, regulatory and any other relevant specific or general business. The Area Sales Manager shows a great balance of business acumen and execution as well as demonstrated IVD knowledge, along with social, cultural and emotional intelligence. Success requires forecasting accuracy, deep understanding of each local market, strong IVD and channel management expertise, and the cultural fluency to operate across diverse Asian markets. Diasorin is a Specialty Immunoassay provider. Our products are deeply connected to clinical experiences and therefore our people can exhibit, learn and retain critical scientific and medical information that demonstrates our differentiators. This role covers some areas of DiaSorin’s Export APAC region, with primary responsibility for Vietnam, Thailand, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Indonesia and Nepal and therefore job placement will be in a main city of either Vietnam or Thailand.
  
  
Key Duties and Responsibilities
  
  
Organize, coordinate or influence the activities of the CPs in the assigned region with the objective of setting and achieving various targets that will result in mutual success of Diasorin and your business partners.
  

* Help your channel partners optimize their success with Diasorin products and services
* Maintain regular contacts with CPs within the area of responsibility by organizing weekly and monthly calls, along with regular in-person visits
* Help marketing implement the Marketing Plan which will include learning and development, trade shows, congresses, Symposia, webinars, and other mutually beneficial programs.
* Assist Diasorin and CPs to launch new products
* Optimize the CP plan in your countries. Optimize the performance of the CPs in your regions.
* Drive instrument placement planning with CPs and track installed-base utilization and reagent pull-through against plan
* Act according to the CoC and Diasorin Value Principles
* Strong team player in a matrix organization, meaning proactive use of resources available at local, APAC and regional levels
* Negotiate distribution contracts in conjunction with the Commercial Director/RVP
* Lead distributor transitions, terminations and new partner onboarding in conjunction with the Commercial Director, safeguarding tender continuity and customer retention through channel changes
* Provide regular and timely forecasting and updates on the business to the organization. This includes monthly sell-in and sell-out reconciliation, distributor inventory monitoring, and preparation of monthly forecasts and QBR materials.
* In conjunction with the Commercial Director, help prepare the region’s annual budget and strategic plans.
* Technical collaboration with service and applications teams to ensure post sales customer satisfaction
* Provide sales training or product training to local sales partners as a cascading of the Corporate Product Training as needed
* Follow-up with supply chain and operations purchase & sales execution in territory, including coordinating with European headquarters, manufacturing sites and finance to resolve order blocks (credit, compliance and supply holds) and ensure timely order release and fulfilment to CPs
* Coordinate regulatory activities required within the territory with RA

Education, Experience, and Qualifications
  
  
**Education / Specialization:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in biology, Immunology, Biomedical, Biochemistry or Biotechnology
* MBA will be a plus

**Experience:**  

* 10+ years' working experience in business/sales/marketing in IVD in either Thailand and/or Vietnam, with a minimum of 5 years in a multinational (MNC) IVD company — MNC experience is essential and is demonstrated success in building and maintaining account in Lab Chains and Major Hospital diagnostic networks
* 5+ years of hands-on channel management in the IVD sector (not Life Sciences): owning distributor/channel partner relationships end-to-end, including target setting, performance management, business reviews, and sell-in/sell-out and inventory monitoring, in markets where distributors are the sole route to market
* Demonstrated ability to translate corporate directives from an MNC head office into distributor execution — cascading pricing, marketing programs, training and compliance requirements through channel partners
* Demonstrated experience managing distributor transitions, terminations and new partner onboarding, with a focus on business continuity and customer retention
* Experience in government tender-driven markets, including tender specifications and bid management through distributors
* Proven ability to manage and coordinate with headquarters — supply chain, operations, finance and regulatory affairs — to support order fulfilment and commercial execution in-region

**Technical Competencies:**  

* Sales and negotiations skills in major diagnostic networks especially Biochemistry, Core Lab and or Serology/Virology sectors
* Result orientation
* Forecasting credibility
* Strong at problem solving and narrating the business
* Ability to interface at different levels within the Organization
* Capable of articulating go-to-market strategies
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, SFDC

**Skills:**  

* Self and Target driven
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Ability to prioritize and work on own initiative
* Sympathetic to different cultures
* Proactive team player
* Prepared to work varied hours if required

**Languages :** English essential; additional local languages such as Vietnamese or Thai strongly preferred
  
  
**Travel availability :** Approx 50 % planned travelling is required within the assigned territory
  
  
What we offer
  
  
Receive a competitive salary and benefits package as you grow your career at DiaSorin. Join our team and discover how your work can impact the lives of people all over the world.
  
Diasorin is committed to building a workplace where people feel empowered to contribute ideas, take ownership, and grow their careers. We believe diverse perspectives strengthen innovation and help us deliver meaningful impact for patients and customers worldwide.
  
  
Diasorin is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
  
  
This posting and recruitment process are subject to applicable local laws and regulations in the country where the position is located. Additional employment disclosures, candidate rights, and employment conditions may apply based on local jurisdiction.
  
  
Individuals hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and may be subject to a background check and drug screening where permitted by law. Diasorin is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities during the application process. If assistance is required, please contact hr@diasorin.com .

title: Operations XTP Support (VN3390)
description:
Marex has unique access across markets with significant share globally both on and off exchange. The depth of knowledge amongst its teams and divisions provides its customers with clear advantage, and its technology-led service provides access to all major exchanges, order-flow management via screen, voice and DMA, plus award-winning data, insights and analytics.

Marex's XTP Support team operates globally, delivering operational support and solutions that help the business meet the firm's post-trade clearing obligations. The team works closely with relevant business stakeholders, external vendors, and management to provide BAU support and deliver new exchange initiatives.

**Role Summary**

The Operations Systems Support role sits within Marex's post-trade product management team for ION's XTP clearing solution. Responsibilities include but not limited to Static data ownership, assisting with the implementation of exchange initiatives, system upgrades and enhancements required to ensure robust/stable operational processing, supporting/collaborating with internal stake holders and operation's departments globally within Marex.

All employees are expected to understand and comply with any Sarbanes Oxley operational requirements relevant to their role.

**Overall Responsibilities**

* Ensure that system static data is accurate for new products and new exchanges.
* Work with Operation's departments to ensure solutions meet business requirements, including testing new functionality.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues on a daily basis as part of the global support function.
* Build and enhance reports from the back and middle office across multiple asset classes.
* Identifying areas of improvement and working closely with the Head of Operations Systems Support.
* Ensure all systems and procedures are fully documented, including environment schematics.
* Collaborating with the Vendors Technical Account Management team in weekly meetings and calls as a subject matter expert
* Act as liaison between functional areas, third party vendors, and exchanges on market led initiatives.
* Assist with vendor system upgrades and patch sweeps, in accordance with the firms change control policies. this may require weekend work for product validation.

**Standard Responsibilities**

* Ensuring compliance with the company's regulatory requirements under the FCA, NFA, CFTC, AMF, AFM, MAS
* Adhere to the operational risk framework for your role ensuring that all regulatory or company determined parameters are complied with.
* Role model for demonstrating highest level standards of integrity and conduct and reflecting Company Values.
* At all times complying with Marex's Code of Conduct.
* To ensure that you are fully aware of and adhere to internal policies that relate to you, your role or any other activities for which you have any level of responsibility.
* To report any breaches of policy to Compliance and/ or your supervisor as required.
* To escalate risk events immediately.
* To provide input to risk management processes, as required.
* ***The Company may require you to carry out other duties from time to time***

**Competencies, Skills and Experience**

**Competencies**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* A collaborative team player, approachable, self-efficient and influences a positive work environment
* Demonstrates curiosity
* Resilient in a challenging, fast-paced environment
* Ability to take a high level of responsibility in a fast pace and high-volume environment
* Excels at building relationships, networking and influencing others
* Strategic collaborator with insight and agility, able to anticipate future challenges, ensuring operational effectiveness

**Skills and Experience**

* Understanding and knowledge of ION's XTP & FEES clearing solution essential
* Good Analytical and Problem solving skills
* Experience working in a regulated environment and knowledge of the risk and compliance requirements associated with this.

**Company Values**

Acting as a role model for the values of the Company:

**Be collaborative** - by working together across the organisation, we foster teamwork, can better respond to challenges and successfully deliver for our clients

**Act with integrity** - we pride ourselves on our honesty and high ethical standards. We apply these values when working with all our clients, colleagues and other stakeholders

**Be adaptable and entrepreneurial** - we embrace change as markets evolve to constantly increase our efficiency and create innovative solutions for our clients. We are interested in the world around us and inquisitive about understanding the challenges and opportunities our clients face.

**Be respectful** – how we treat each other, and our clients says everything about who we are. We always act respectfully and treat people fairly in everything we do.

**Nurture talent** – we aim to grow our own talent and make Marex the place ambitious, hardworking and talented people choose to build their career. This means giving and taking stretch opportunities, taking risks, and committing to career development and support – for ourselves and our teams.

**Conduct Rules**

You must:

* Act with integrity
* Act with due skill, care and diligence
* Be open and cooperative with the FCA, the PRA and other regulators (where applicable)
* Pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly
* Observe proper standard of market conduct
* Act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers
